Name: "Fox"
Known History: Little is known about "Fox" other than that they are under the employment of ETA. Taking care of enforcement or other protection operations for the company. If someone would have worked for SWORD a few year prior they might know of his previous alias. Besides for that, his history is largely covered up by ETA.
Physical Description: Fox stands roughly around 5'10 (177cm). He has vibrant blue hair that's been dyed from its normal colors. A pair of glasses rest neatly against his nose and a same color of blue fills his irises. Usually dressed in warmer clothing with a scarf around his neck. His jacket having the E.T.A logo along the arm and back. On his back is a long bag with a zipper along the top of it. Usually he has a small wrist-pad that assists him with Soulrunning or technology usage in general.

Name: "Kage"
Known History:
- Born in the forests surrounding Sakai, after a failed Kitsune expedition from the south.
- Her parent, instead of leaving her to the elements choose to excommunicate themselves from Sakai
- Years later the child would return to Sakai, now changed and alone
- Taking up the name "Kage", she'd become a Disciple under the leader of Sakai, seeking to learn balance and perhaps one day reverse whatever have caused their body to change
- Despite never fully fitting in, she'd find companionship with several new pupils who see her for the warrior she is, and not the monster that others see
- Having reached a plateau in her cultivation, her master suggested her to leave for the deserts. To either overcome her trials, or to do what many before her has and slaughter Yokai.
- Seeking a better alternative for the people of Sakai, she'd try and overcome her trials, only to be left in a pool of her own blood. Not long after she was caught in an all too familiar storm, lifting her to the worldhelm.
Physical Description:
After a ritual that pushed her to her limits, Kage now resembles more of a person and less of a walking nightmare. Standing at roughly five feet four, the young Half-Kitsune seems far healthier than when she first appeared on the Worldhelm. She now possesses an athletic physique befitting her station, no longer marred by the side-effects of her training. While her almost glowing cyan eyes remain alongside the foxfire burning within her body, her expressions are no longer muted, wearing her emotions far more freely.

Her wardrobe consists of her old bodysuit, now far more distinguishable from her pitch black skin, however she no longer hides herself behind an oversized poncho, opting instead to wear a sleeveless open vest. Her attire is dotted with white and grey geometrical shapes and symbols, in the past she marked herself as such as to not truly disappear in pitch black darkness, nowadays however it’s simply to remember the past.

Name: "Trillion"
Identity: Demon with a Heart of Gold
Known History: The demon known as "Trillion" has been around for a time immeasurable by human standards. Once the leader of a great Circle, he has long since lost his people to the many horrors of the Third Layer of Idyll. No longer a Witch of the Circles, "Trillion" finds himself seeking a new way of surviving, as well as a new flock to shepherd. A sudden revelation has sparked an ideology of pacifism; if the great Kuzunoha has been corrupted by madness, then he will bring peace to her furious hunger through self-example. He now serves to guide others onto this same journey. And, if you ask nicely, he may just let you know his name.
Physical Description: "Trillion" stands at a modest height of 5'9", with a slim, athletic frame akin to that of a young adult. His youthful appearance is marked by his vibrant blue hair and glowing golden eyes; however, he is also easily distinguished by his demonic features that have manifested with his time as a revered Witch of Aaruna. Equally vibrant blue scales fleck across his face, neck, and limbs; and his slender fingers are complemented by long and sharp, black nails. Despite this, there is an overall welcoming warmth to his composure.

Name: 'Dr" Maxwel Luuv
Known History:
-Parabellum field researcher
-Pirate Radio host
-Squatting in a super condemned mcmansion
Physical Description: Flashily dressed scientist with pink/purple died hair constantly carrying gadgets

Name: (the last) Stroke (on the canvas
Known History:
Two things are quickly noticeable about Stroke: They have a hunger for all experiences, even the bad ones, enjoying them quite thoroughly, for one. Two, they are an oddball. Stroke, or "The last stroke on the canvas" in full, seems to look at reality a bit differently. Using very odd metaphors, they see possibilities rather than facts.

Their history is traceable to the settlement of Snowmaw in Kor'Tarion, where Stroke was found near Spirit's Grove, nearly frozen to death but laughing in the cold snow. Stroke quickly picked up language and told about "being here in this wonderful realm since my old job kicked me out". 

Soon enough, Stroke turned out to be a Fae that was sort of trapped in the Mortal Realm. A peculiar talent they brought along was to be able to use their surroundings to 'paint' magic into existence.

For now, Stroke is using their abilites to travel the world and help. And experience all they can. Except webs. Webs suck.
Physical Description:
Stroke is a middle-sized individual with their 1.7 m, having blue hair "like the droplets of dew on a sunny day" like they will tell you. They have a scrawny build, but can swing their staff-sized staff quite easily. In their face, they are spotting freckles beneath their violet eyes, the freckles sometimes looking like splashes of color.  

They also have a very peculiar way of speaking, using metaphors and personifications that seem odd but seem to hold meaning for them.

Name: A'shibah
Known History:
- Born the seventh son of a Hiear merchant family.
- Family was killed; but used his body to shield his twin brother, Levan.
- Levan failed a ritual to revive the family, A'shibah took the consequence by making a deal with Akhir.
- A'shibah promised his soul to oblivion, but Musta'khan managed to save him by binding the brothers together.
- Now lives inside of Levan, sharing the same soul vessel.
Physical Description: A'shibah is tall, even for Hiear standards, and stands at an impressive 6'3" (7'2" with his ears perked). His hair and fur are a shock of white, as is iconic for the Hiear of his family, and his eyes are a piercing gold. Though fraternal twins, A'shibah is actually quite different than his brother, Levan, putting the obvious hereditary genes aside. He seems to bear an oppressive aura of intimidation and despair as he rarely speaks anymore; however, despite this, there still appears to be a hint of good and kindness about him, especially with regards to his brother.

Name: Abhila (Asva)
Known History: Born in a small village on the edges of the Tiger Lands. Asva growing up grew fascinated with music and how it can influence animals. He decided go around his village showing his talents off being able to use music and movements to have snakes mimic himself. After entertaing quite a few common folks. Though one day Asva had gotten an oppertiuny of a lifetime, show his talents with snakes to the Great House Ijya, which sadly ended up being his biggest mistake. When the moment comes he ends up to perform to the head of the house herself, though sadly she was not amuse when she saw Asva's performance not really understanding the snakes instead making them mimic his movenments. For this insult, Bhaviini ended up cursing Asva giving him a "Snakes Tounge" and banishing him from the House which also includes his home village. Without much left Asva was about to take the chance at the Tiger Lands before getting swept up to the Worldhelm.
Physical Description: A new form as Asva is now a snake, taking a form of a spirit from the Viper Gardens.

Name: Adelphel Durand
Known History: A armored man like that of a knight in appearance, they travel around Kor'Tarion to and fro just aiding people along the way. From things like protecting travelers from bandit muggings to aiding with work on a farm as a form of payment. They say they don't have a destination for their travel or don't remember exactly what journey they set off for, but they know it involved meeting or helping the people.
Physical Description: A man standing at about 5'11, medium length dark brown hair and a darker olive skin tone with hazel hued eyes, they have an odd faint glow about them in both eyes and body. Holding a genuinely young and kind expression that easily shifts to earnest one in times of hardship and danger. Their hands are somewhat bruised and rough from work and battle. They are very well acquainted to physical labor of many kinds for long hours just to get by during travels and it shows.

Name: Aelina Van Deivoet
Identity: Pressured Blade with a Storm Inside
Known History:
Awlina is a third generation lost of the house of Van Deivote. A noble house in one of the underwater cities of Ripplith that has a connection to storms. They act alongside the wardens to protect the settlement from the dangers of deep. Aelina herself is the current heir to the house and would take over when her mother retires or dies. For now though, she has been sent to Gnosis Academy to be a part of the house of Treasures where she became the Regalia known as ᵀʰᵉ CloudBurst.

Those form the academy would know her for the scandal of her being rejected at the ceremony of binding. This leads to her declining grades and sudden crash of her self confidence that led her to remodel courses on the Worldhelm.
Physical Description: Aelina is a medium height woman with straight purple hair that always seems well conditioned and cared for. She has two black horns on the top of her head and her violet eyes seem glimmer and shine with something like electricity. She is usually dressed in her school uniform but when she isn’t she wears a formal, almost regal, military like regalia. On her hands there are 9 rings, one on every finger except the ring finger of her left hand.

Name: Aer Drasil
Known History:
Aer Drasil was a fearless huntress and protector in her mortal life, renowned for her unwavering resolve and mastery of the spear. She perished heroically in a grand battle, defending her people from a relentless foe. Upon awakening in Idyll, she found solace in Asga, a realm of contests and camaraderie. However, the sanctuary was corrupted when madness consumed Idyll, turning friendly duels into a cycle of endless bloodshed.  

Determined to preserve what remained of hope and justice, Aer took up her spear once more. Now she protects wayward souls and fighting to uphold light against the growing darkness. Driven by the memories of her mortal sacrifices and an unbreakable will, she stands as a beacon of defiance in a realm descending into chaos.
Physical Description: Aer stands tall at 6'0", her posture ever straight, radiating poise and grace. Her long, curly brown hair cascades down past her waist, framing her commanding presence. She dons armor adorned in rich tones of brown, brass, and deep blue, exuding both strength and elegance. Black feathers accentuate her ensemble, lending her an air of formidable beauty and otherworldly majesty.

Name: Aerah
Known History: She would often get picked on growing up though because she would never speak to other kids. This was because she was told she was not allowed to by her parents, and she never understood why until she got older. In her preteens the bullying pushed her to a breaking point causing her to yell out and hospitalize several of her bullies, one of which succumbed to the injuries. The results of this pushed her family into debt, her mother eventually turning to try and gamble to get that "one big score" to pay everything off. That score never came however and the debt just grew. Someone in 777LC saw Aerah's potential between her skating abilities and though digging up dirt on her vocal "gift". The roped her into skating in their derby games that people bet on to work off the family debt.
Physical Description: Aerah is a 19 year old girl who is 5' 7". She has long black hair with a bit of green tones in it. She is typically walking around in a body suit and fancy skates to allow her quicker movement.

Name: Agata Nergath
Known History: Agata is from the kingdom of Merrane, from a town on the outskirts of its influence known Hidela. She grew up near a military dump where they abandoned  old and broken machines  from the academy's test sites. . However, she did not approve of the way Merrane was using its magitech. Living on the border, she had seen what suffering the common people in Karlsgaurd and her own tone where facing. The last straw came when her cousins where killed in a raid on Ionian. It was then that she broke in to the forbidden decomishened mech side of the yard and took one of the older model suits for her own. The government went after to recover the mech and she took off, shaking them in a Realmstorm where she ended up in the strangest place.
Physical Description: Agata is a young woman standing at about 5'10 in height. She has long blonde hair tied back in a pony tail most times. Her clothes usually are stained with oil and grease as the scent of machinery follows her around.

Name: Aiden Kane
Known History: A product of both the Moon and merged essences. He seeks to find the light in all darknesses.
Physical Description: Tall, nearly seven feet tall. His face is always hidden behind a wide brimmed straw hat. His fingers are long and slender and wrap around the handle of his Katana nearly twice.

Name: Akahime Fuyumi
Known History:
- Serpentine yokai who guides lost souls through frozen Aldistir.

- Found the glowing Night Lantern at the Grasping Tree.

- Became a beacon for the lost- and threats.

- Trained to protect the souls she ferries.

- Hunts godblood corrupted beings to free them from torment.

- Thanks to the Worldhelm, she now travels between realms, continuing her sacred task.
Physical Description:
Akahime, the Winter Serpent, is an ethereal being with a long, serpentine lower body that is is cloaked in obsidian-black scales, coiling with silent grace across the frozen wastes she calls home. Towering and poised, her upper half bears the countenance of a pale, silver-haired Ald—yet her piercing gaze and the faint, otherworldly glow in her pale eyes betray something far older and deeper.

She dons ornate, silver-on-black armor. Flowing silks trail from beneath the plate, catching ghostlight as she moves. In her hands, she wields the Night Lantern, a staff bound with chains and a crimson lantern that bleeds spectral mist. Its flickering light draws spirits near, some seeking peace—others, prey.

Name: Akar Ceba
Known History:
Not much is known about this eccentric, wide eyed wanderer. There is a certain innocence and wonder about his eyes, that makes his home somewhat easy to guess: the peaceful hills of Paradise, free of war and trouble. Through some way or another, he has left that place of harmony and now, thrust into a world filled with unknown dangers and painful experiences. 

The only thing that reminds him of his home is his woolly companion, the sheep Nyima. With her he now travels the world, trying to find his way back home and doing his best to protect and care for all that he might find along the way.
Physical Description:
Akar wears a comfortable, white robe and a heavy, black robe over his left shoulder. The seams of both his tunic and his robe are adorned with soft sheep wool. Both his lower arms and ankles are covered in red threads. Akar wears many decorative charms and colourful decorations, including earrings and a talisman in the shape of a bell, which is tied to his collar. He almost never seen without his shepherd crook, which is also adorned with the same charms and bells he wears on his body.

His long, red hair is tied into a casual braid. The young shepherd has small goat horns, growing from just above his ears. Usually his face has a soft expression with a bright smile on his lips and shining, green eyes.

Name: Akiko
Known History:
Akiko was born in the village of Ishiyama under the iron fist of the Oni. Like the rest of the human population, she was put to work as soon as she could hold tools and climb into the mines. With a natural Fire Qi affinity, however, her value was discovered and she was taken by the greedy Oni clan ruling over Ishiyama. Conscripted by a powerful red Oni, she ended up in the remains of the Temple of the Rising Sun as a living forge, melting metal and attempting to make powerful weapons.

In quiet moments, Akiko cleaned and cleared rubble away in the temple. This led to a discovery: a small room with dust, bones, and the remains of destroyed relics- one of which a black and gold sun shield cleaved in half.

As she knelt and grabbed the broken handle remaining on each, it was like her soul was set aflame, something stirring, awakening. The hopeless fog in her mind cleared. Akiko raised her head and lifted the relics, then raced out of the temple towards a newfound destiny.
Origin: Teisei, Tian Yin, Shrine of the Rising Sun
Physical Description: Akiko is a muscular young woman standing at 5'8" with long black hair and pale skin. Her eyes are a dull amber color, but a spark of light gleams within when she wields her black and gold shields that seem like two broken halves of one sun.

Name: Al-Amir
Identity: A Dreadful Smile In The Corner of Your Eye
Known History:
A kind and gentle story teller, that’s all he was ever meant to be. In a past life before ascending to the fourth layer of Idyll, he was just that. A young man that often got lost in both reading and writing stories for both young and old, creating realms for others to escape to when they felt the real world was too much to endure, or perhaps they just wished to see it through a new perspective. When he eventually met an untimely end at a young age, his essence found rest in the realms of dreams and hopes. A place where he could dream and a place where he could continue his favorite pastime, tell stories. Sadly, that dream was all but wrenched from his hands when the nameless lord fell. Madness took hold and everything he created, everything he cherished turned on him.

What happened after felt like a fleeting dream, all that remains is the memory of a caravan, a group of people who still dare to hope and a promise that he will never dare break. Nor could he, even if he wanted.
Physical Description: Al-Amir's form, much like a dream that you’ve just woken up from, is rather immalleable. Shifting and changing, however, if you dare look at them long enough his form would settle on an 8 foot tall nightmare straight out of a children's book. One that you read to make sure your children stay out of the dark forest at night. His skin glows with an eerie shade of purple, in place of a head he brandishes a crescent moon, while his “face” lacks eyes, his mouth remains. A dreadful smile that never fades, and in the middle of his chest rests a single unblinking eye that could stare into one’s soul. His attire consists of multitudes of golden rings, bracelets and other accessories gracing his arms, fingers and neck. While his attire is but a simple loose and baggy pant and a pair of worn dark boots.

Name: Alaska Vertigo
Known History:
A human born in the heart of Lorel.AI's slice of Terra, Alaska was taught to code at one of the company's official Employment Skills Cultivation Offices at a young age. She kept her head down and prioritised her work, and that got her a "comfortable" job within the company.

She remembers hearing about the employee backup initiative; something about preserving valuable knowledge in the event of unforeseen departures? She doesn't remember being signed up, but then again there's a lot she doesn't remember.

The next thing she remembers is waking up on the floor of an abandoned gas station in central in a metal body. wired up to expensive computing equipment and with a sea of corrupted memory files.

Discovering a bounty on her head, she went to ground, resorting to doing soul net work for disreputable individuals to pay for repairs.

When she was swept up in the affairs of the Goldhearted, she jumped at a chance for a place aboard the Worldhelm, away from Terra's authorities.
Physical Description: Wrapped beneath a worn cloak, Aly occupies what was, at one point, clearly a streamlined, and admittedly compact, modern LUA chassis. Between wear and tear and mismatched repairs, her body is far from the sleek corporate factory standard it was at time of manufacturing, covered in scratches, rust, and all manner of more concerning marks. From behind a cracked screen, she looks back at the world with eyes that manage to appear tired, despite their lack of detail.

Name: Albreich Surtova
Known History:
✦He was born to a family of knights in Brightshield and raised to become one in the future.

✦For many years he aspired to become a knight of great renown but as he became more familiar with their work he became disillusioned with the ideas of chivalry and whatnot that they touted so proudly.

✦Before he was to be knighted, he departed for Tradefair, From that day forth he would serve his own interests rather than the crown's.

✦He spent some time working as a freelance mercenary in Tradefair before he was picked up by the Golden Claw Mercenaries.

✦Though he refuses to acknowledge it, the fading embers of chivalry within his heart were rekindled after working under them for a couple years. Much to his surprise he's been recently chosen as a Goldenhearted.
Physical Description:
Albreich stands at about 6'2",

Though he trains his body regularly he only does as much as he needs to wield his weapon comfortably, preferring to forgo the bulging muscles for a body that allows more dexterous movements.

He carries himself with the confidence and poise of a man with twice his experience, after all the best way to win a fight is to stop it from happening in the first place.
(Will add more later, this is the thing I suck at most)

Name: Aldrich S. Escher
Known History:
Born in Tradefair to a family of merchants, Aldrich has always had an innate talent for Magic, which his family saw fit to encourage and finance.
That said, simply helping his family turn a profit didn't satisfy his curiosity for how the world functioned one bit. For that reason, he sought to set off and learn more, against the wishes of the merchants he called family.
It wasn't long after he began this solo journey that a Realmstorm spontaneously dragged him into the Worldhelm.
Naturally, he would now have many more opportunities to learn more.
Physical Description: Slender and fragile-looking, but with a confident aura of power. Always carries his Tome, which doubles as his Journal, where he records his findings and experiment results.

Name: Alec Lyon
Known History:
Alec Lyon comes from a working class family in Babyl City, Dawnstar Valley. Growing up, he had a natural gift for spiritual and light magic, which got the local NTTech branch in Dawnstar to watch over him. Making sure he doesn't misuse his magic. He lived a relatively normal life otherwise, eventually going into schooling where he met and befriended Mae Lavery.

Then after graduating, he enrolled into a college ran by NTTech. A specialized college that focuses on developing mages. After graduating, he eventually got hired to work for one of NTTech's subsidiary that focuses on investigation of magic in Dawnstar. Becoming a licensed mage.

From there, due to budgeting reasons, he and Mae moved into an apartment to save on living expenses. Eventually forming a romantic relationship. However, about a year ago, tragedy befell Mae during an accident at her workplace. In order to live once again, she became an Insolvent. They are trying their best with the new circumstances.
Physical Description: Alec is a tall, athletic man who stands at 5'11" (180cm). Usually wears a smile on his face when interacting with most people. Typically wears a set of battle armor when he's on the job, but otherwise the casual jacket and pants when not on the job. His grayish-white hair done in a stylish mess, with gentle amber eyes.

Name: Alejandra
Known History: Known to the people of Nirve as Alejandra, they've spent a long time traveling with the caravans. It's unknown as to who this name belonged to, but it seems attached to the armor somehow.
Physical Description:
A set of armor made for an imposing figure, standing at 6'4 and weighing over 200lbs, Alejandra's body comprises of a suit of armor forged in the first layer of Idyll. 

They walk with an unnatural nature. As if dragging themselves around.

Name: Aleksy Nowak XV
Identity: Respectable Bandit from an Ancient Bloodline
Known History: Descendant of the great Nowak the Golden, Aleksy XV is the heir to many things. His ancestor's name, his ancestor's treasure, and, most importantly, the leadership of his ancestor's men: the Dead Foxes. A storied group of bandits within Karlsgard that was rebirthed in the war, locals would have heard tell of the Dead Foxes harassing refugee camps and picking over battlefields. The most recent news, though, was them being wiped off the map by hellfire from Imperial mechs, perhaps the one good thing they've done. It's a mystery, then, how Aleksy ended up here. The Worldhelm chose him, though, so there must be something respectable to this bandit.
Physical Description: Standing a little over 6 foot with an athletic build, Aleksy carries himself with a special kind of pride not found in most. He's always adorned with some golden trinkets, bangles, earrings, whatever strikes his fancy, which pairs strangely with his rather meager choice of dress. Like a commoner playing royalty.

Name: Alexander Romani
Known History: Not much is known publicly about Alexander's early life but for Terrans if they frequent the Fortune Valley Casino he has been an opera singer and composer in there for years now. Terrans who also lives in Mount Providence may have also seen him scavanging abandon churches to find old and forgotten musicals antiques.
Physical Description: Light grey almost white hair, constant stern look on his face with piercing red eyes. Wears a formal but out of fashion suit with a red tie.

Name: Alexandra Stuart Lancastrian
Known History:
* Born to the Prestigious Lancastrian Noble Family. Her father, Charles, is a Mid level Noble in charge of administration of one of the larger Imperial Provinces

Was always a brilliant girl, and to many considered a Prodigy.

Joined the military on her 18th birthday.

At 25, she was placed as part of the Sky Service, working on the Vigilant Watch to hunt down people who Violate the Delver's Code.

Six months ago, upon the retirement of her Captain, Johannes Kranston, she was promoted to Captain.

Two months ago, a confrontation with Charlotte Morgan caused a stir as Charlotte was briefly put under custody. This led to decommission of the ship and her being placed under leave.

With her ship donated to the Adventurer's Guild, she followed the ship and agreed to join on the condition that she is allowed to keep control of her ship.
Physical Description:
Alexandra Lancastrian fills an imposing figure. She stands at 5'9, though she is often wearing heels or platforms that push her to 6'. Her long hair is nevertheless kept well groomed and straight, maintaining a professional appearance even in the air. And of course, her Service Uniform is kept immaculately pressed, cleaned, and ready for presentation.

Alexandra is an intense woman, with little patience for impropriety, and less for hooliganry or lawless behavior. The people who cross the line often quickly find themselves afoul of her custom service weapon, the 'Principles of Prosperity.'

Name: Alexei Volkov
Known History: Not much would be known of Alexei by any of the Goldhearted, though those that do a little digging, or any of his fellow Gnosis Academy students, would know that he is the son of two rather prominent mages back in Dreadlan. Past this, as already mentioned, he is a student of Gnosis Academy, at which he has shown remarkable results in all fields theoretical. In practical though, any who have had the pleasure of working with him, have had mixed opinions of the man.
Physical Description: Alexei is of average to thin stature and around 5'7'' tall. He's pale, his eyes eerily empty of any colour besides white and grey, and his black hair mirrors this scheme with long streaks of white already showing on the otherwise seemingly young man's black hair. Most notably, Alexei has a large scar that runs down his left cheek, neck and further down. Its not certain how large the scar is, as it eventually disappears under his Gnosis Academy uniform.

Name: Alwyn
Known History: A wanted Sky Pirate whom currently flies alone. Though he is wanted for Theft and Assault, there is no evidence that he has done so to any non-noble/rich people/group.
Physical Description: A relatively tall, well kept man with black hair wearing loose but well fitting clothes.

Name: Alyster Miff
Known History: Alyster always wanted to be a cook when he grew up. Living in Hedgeburg offered him a chance to learn how to cook (and he did well!)... that was, until a Mech from Merrane crashed nearby the village. He took it home and discovered that it was a MK.2 Legion, an older class of Mech from Merrane, but still very powerful. He had done some inventing alongside his old tutor, Maya, an excellent Tinkerer who taught him much. Slowly, he managed to get it back up and running. It was then christened Cook's Spice, and he went out to the forest to test it out on gathering some ingredients. Turns out, he accidently found himself a Goldhearted and chosen by the Worldhelm. His lust for adventure (and more ingredients!) now drives him forward to building a truly incredible restraunt with Mech-Made Meals.
Physical Description: At 6' and 185lbs, Alyster Miff is a pale skinned human with long, combed back brown hair and brown eyes. He wears a whitish-blue coat, a blue scarf, brown gloves, and brown leather boots and pants.

Name: Amber O'Riley
Known History: Amber was born in Hedgeberg, and moved to Korala to study medicine.  While there she met her wife Cassandra and after a few years of working together in the medical field they married, and had a daughter.  Tensions grew as the war began, Cassandra wanting to stay in Korala where it was safe while Amber wanted to go into danger to help the people who'd need them the most.  They separated, with their daughter Jessica joining Amber in Pikeway until the forming of Ionian Village made Amber believe she could do more good for the refugees there, and opened up a clinic in that location.  After working in Ionian for a few years, Jessica, now a teenager ran away from home.  Amber, while searching for her daughter one day is caught in a realmstorm and brought to the Worldhelm.
Physical Description: Amber is a middle aged Felkin with thick black hair.  Her eyes shift between green and yellow depending on the light.  She wears round glasses, and a doctor's coat over basic clothes.  She's usually frowning and/or smoking

Name: Ambrose
Known History:
This Napoleonic scholar is one of the few people at Hudal Academy who completely lacks the ability to use Spells like a traditional mage. His talent instead lies in the production of magical equipment that can channel Mana for spellcasting. 

While he can't use Spells normally, his savant-like understanding of Wands has resulted in his ability to use his mana, but only for the purpose of producing blasts of magical energy from his armaments. 

He's set to graduate soon, but he is not well-liked among the teachers. They have posed to him a single challenge, and that is to produce SOMETHING remarkable for the academy that isn't some kind of magical ordinance.
Physical Description:
Ambrose is a small person at only 4'5", whose lithe body is hidden underneath a couple layers of baggy mage clothing and alchemist tools laid atop them. He carries a large backpack covered in meticulously maintained labels. Any educated person in Kor'Tarion would quickly realize that this guy's inventory is stocked with magical payload that could easily raze a small town, if not most of a large city. 

Dangling from a short rope attached to the wrist is a charred wand, with its core compartment and focus crystal empty, and waiting for its next configuration.

Name: Ambrose "Alder" Silverpine
Known History:
- Lived with his nomadic people and family, the Deerfolk, following the guidance of the elementals via a Hearer, nurturing life along the way.
- Before becoming Goldhearted, he was suddenly, mysteriously, shunted out from his mother's domain, and hasn't been able to get back in or find his family.
- He has recently found his mother, Willow, learning that the Wyld Hunt has been responsible for hunting and tearing Fey, particularly those of the Spring Court, from their domains. He has also learned that his mother has had dealings with the Spring Court as well, but doesn't quite know how deep it runs.
- He still doesn't know that his mother managed to get Caladrius' favor to bestow upon Alder some of his power to protect him.
- Has yet to become fully aware of his aptitude as a Hearer for his people
- Yuzuru Eiji of Terra is his boyfriend. c:
Physical Description: Straight, tall, and lithe, covered in silver and white dappled fur, he stands at 5'11'' (not including the antlers) on deer-like hooves, peering at you with what look like distant reflections of stars in his blue(?) eyes. Over a simple linen shirt and pants, he wears a knitted white sweater and a night blue coat lined with white fur. He adorns himself with a pair of simple, hand-made necklaces, and a single earring on his left ear.

Name: Amelia Green
Known History:
Amelia Green born in North Rock and had an uneventful life, coming from two hardworking, low-income parents. Taking a leap as a young adult, she took out some loans to begin her college education, reasoning that she could surely pay it off once she found a proper career after gaining a proper degree. After graduating, her friends treated her out to celebrate. Being as ecstatic as she was, she overindulged and died that night due to alcohol poisoning. 

This also soured many of her friendships once she returned as an Insolvent. 

Amelia now has spent the last 5 years trying to live a normal life, having found an entry-level journalist position for one of Galeforce's smaller newspaper subsidiaries and struggling to move up in the company.
Physical Description: Amelia is a woman of average 5'4 stature with short pale yellow hair and bright red eyes. She often is dressed somewhat professionally and in light colors.

Name: Amina Grace
Known History: Amina is an Insolvent from Terra, who uses her unique aptitude for Cartomancy to harness magic and divine the future. While her activities on the Worldhelm are limited, owing to her recent arrival, she has made a minor name for herself in Terra, where she lends people her magical skills in secret, aiding those with uncertain futures to find the right paths for them.
Physical Description: Amina is a tall woman with dark skin and pale red eyes. She lacks any warmth, both in her tone and in her temperature, and walks with a gait that is very slightly offputting, traits that can all be attributed to her nature as an Insolvent. She wears clothes one might associate with a witch or other sort of mystic, but augmented with modern cloths, buckles, and other accessories that each work to make her not fit in neatly with the average Terran, or the average denizen of another realm.

Name: Anahi Tanglao
Known History: Anahi grew up in Sampaguita Village as an only child amongst her loving parents. Her friends, parents, and her community were integral to her upbringing. When she turned 12, she discovered her affinity with Wood qi. Her mentor and childhood friend, Arjo Caringal, took her into the wilds where she meditated and trained (it was life or death man). When she returned, her village elder, Seer Patu, divined her future. She was to enter a storm heading towards their village. Not one to question her elders, she ventured forth, entering the realmstorm with bold confidence.
Physical Description: Anahi is a lithe, 5'11 human woman with ragged traveler's clothes. Her armor compliments her tan skin with dark fibers and green cloth. She carries a strong minty, aroma wherever she goes.

Name: Anderth Rhastal
Known History:
Anderth is a simple man. He wakes up. He goes to work. He works. He comes home. He sleeps. Repeat. That's been his routine for a good 60% of his life. Being a human in the Scalefire Empire, he has lived a life of poverty and prejudice. And yet, he simply accepts it, seemingly never wanting more. Perhaps he doesn't even know there's more to life. 

The last thing he remembers is the mineshaft he was in shaking, before it totally collapsed on him and his crew. His supervisor decided to save his own skin first, and left his crew for dead. Upon coming back to consciousness, he found himself on the Worldhelm, with no recollection of what happened in between.
Physical Description: Anderth is a buff, stocky man who stands at 6'3". He wears a thin, patchwork shirt and a durable pair of trousers. His boots are so dirty it's hard to tell where they end and where his legs begin. He carries a beat-up pickaxe with a bunch of counting marks on it. He also wears a utility belt that has all the essentials for a miner. A lantern, oil, rope, a hunting knife, several maps, and various satchels and pockets. Anderth is usually wearing a scowl.

Name: Anise
Known History:
As far as she is aware, or at least, as far as she is willing to tell people, Anise has no past. The Nezzim found her as a child, and promptly branded her as being a 'mage' when her psychic abilities became apparent. They began to push Anise to her limits, attempting to hone her Esper abilities and forge her into a weapon on their behalf. Since then, that is the only life she has known for nearly 3 decades. Bodyguard work was her main forte, though her might and gravitokinesis found usefulness in manual labour, too.

The Realmstorm's arrival was a ticket out; newfound freedom, away from their demands, and their punishments. Now, Anise intends on directing her blade elsewhere - towards the throat of the Nezzim and their draconian empire.
Physical Description: Anise is a tall and imposing woman, standing at around 6'0" and wielding a large but otherwise ordinary greatsword. Her hair is light brown and often kept in the style of a chignon, pinned in place by the binyeo she wears. Up-close, scale-shaped brands can be seen going up her neck and parts of her face, though they are mostly hidden by her shawl and hair. Anise dresses in loose-fitting garb, accustomed to the heat of Nezmira. Other identifying features include her golden-yellow eyes, and small pieces of debris float around her at times, as if Anise had her own small gravitational field.

Name: Apollo Marinelli - ᵀʰᵉ Overture
Known History:
Hailing from a well-off family from Heartdom. Apollo is the son of a prestigious Paladin and an influential spokesperson. He had always had expectations of him. But, because he was never able to fully reach an acceptable level, he was scorned. One day when he had enough, he ran away from home to enroll in Gnosis Academy, the same as his brother did with their parent's support. He tried at first to be a part of the House of Paladins, but with the reality of him not truly being suited for such. Apollo took a gamble and transferred to the House of Treasures. Entrusting his dreams and wishes to his closest friend and confidant at the academy, Perseus, entering a Rite of Binding with the large Dreadlan-born.

Now as a Regalia known as "The Overture". Apollo fights by Perseus' side,  helping to realise his dream of becoming the best Paladin to have ever existed.
Physical Description: Standing at 5'7" and carrying himself with dignity. Apollo is a Yellow-olive scale colored Nezzim with a dainty form. He sports two sets of horns, green eyes, and a pair of glasses, likely to help with reading all the books he tends to carry around. He can typically be seen wearing his Kaiway uniform. A fuschia-colored top with baggy upper-arm sleeves, a crimson scarf, and a pauldron, along with a courier bag containing all of his necessities. He moves with grace and fluidity, often carrying a smug expression on their face.

Name: Arasaka "Saki" Sasaki
Known History:
Arisaka Sasaki is one of a pair of twins born to Sayumi Sasaki, a well respected member of 100G Security. She had average grades in all her schooling and chose not to go to university to better care for her younger sister Minebea. She works as a freerunning courier in the megacity of Haven to help their houshold afloat.

[HPD file Codename: Raven]

Possible affiliation with the Goldnails. Suspect in several armed robberies in relation to Goldnails activity. Uses a high powered rifle to suppressive fire  from a great distance. All attempts of pursuit are thwarted through rooftop and city pursuit. Be on watch for sniper scopes when responding to robberies]
Physical Description: Saki is a medium height at 4'11 very thin girl with long white hair. It often sticks up at odd angles either due to lack of care or to differentiate herself from her twin sister. Her normally blank expression hides eyes that seem to always be watching for trouble. She tends to wear heavier jackets that almost look too big for her and combat boots.

Name: Arashi
Known History:
A Kitsune from the Feywyrd; an eccentric Yokai that loves to play pranks, and make friends. Though raised by a guardian rather than her parents, she never let it keep her down. 

"I shall survive and live on, for all those who could not."
Physical Description:
Height: 150cm

Arashi is a short, silver haired Kitsune with a curious look to her. Usually dressed in a tight and elegant garb; though with colder climates has a full body cloak on for warmth!

Name: Argad
Identity: The Tower, a quiet and friendly warchild
Known History:
Argad is a quiet man: not much is known about him. He sometimes mentions a difficult childhood and how Father Hegar Seive saved him.
She took him to the orphanage and raised him as the child he is now. They were good times when no life-threatening events occurred.
With a boring life for a young man accustomed to war, Argad left the orphanage and the second life that Hegar gave him, promising himself to honor that opportunity by giving others the same opportunity. Shortly after beginning his journey, he was able to enter the Worldhelm.
Origin: Kor'Tarion. The White Feather House of Youth
Physical Description: Argad is a tall person (6'5'') with a bulky muscular body (240lb). His hair, almost as black as obsidian, a meticulously groomed beard, and intense black eyes give him an even more intimidating appearance. If it weren't for the almost constant smile on his face, no one would approach him.

Name: Aria
Known History:
Born as a daughter to one of the Matriarchs of Tangbawan, she was unnaturally gifted physically and spiritually. As such her story ended up as similar to other daughters for reasonings that were not really known to her she was eventually given to the Kabiya and traveled with them at a very young age. She only served to learn and grow even more under individuals of similar circumstances and through training of people who knew more despite her carefree spirit.

These times abruptly came to an end when the group she was traveling with came under brutal assault by a powerful Yokai. The Yokai was slayed but at a great cost. However in that moment she would be introduced to her next mentor for many years to come. Even following them to a place in a sea of clouds.
Physical Description: A not so tall young lady with a head of short red hair, dressed in lightly protective ware that doesn't hinder the movement. Behind the very relaxed and unbothered expression on her pretty face is a hunger to push herself into new heights and grow stronger for it with her swordsmanship. Evident in the physique she sports, while not a bulky build, her arms visibly appear built from constant use wrapping around to her back and through out her body. A combination of a lithe type that tightly bound the muscles and raw strength into a unassuming form.

Name: Arija Yamoshi
Known History: Arija is the eldest daughter of the Yamoshi Family in Tangbawani, raised from birth with both intellect and combat prowess. Her elementalism qi is unique, allowing her to adapt to multiple elements, unlike most practitioners who settle on a single one. In her early teens, she was chosen to join the Kabiya, an elite group dedicated to honor and protection, and was entrusted with the War King's Wrath, a powerful relic from her family's founder. Arija has served the Kabiya faithfully, striving for unity, protection, and joy for all people. With her new status as a Goldhearted, she views her unusual qi as a sign to pursue her path, no matter the challenges or realms she faces.
Physical Description: Standing at 5'8", Arija has an athletic build. She wears battle attire designed for agility on the battlefield. Her skin is fair, her eyes a striking sapphire blue, and her long brown hair is pulled into a wispy ponytail.

Name: Aslatiel
Known History: An elf from the fairy realm of Kor'Tarion. He was a bright and promising student of the Hudal Academy but wasted it away when he acted on a dangerous and unsanctioned ritual. His ritual failed causing a horrible accident that scarred half his body and injured many other students. He was banished and many began calling him the "Half-Dark Elf". He wandered the humans lands in search of his home but couldn't. Then during the blood moon, he fought off the demons he could and aided in the defense of a helpless family. After his sacrifice he wandered into the woods, tireless, refusing rest as to not die but fell all the same. When he awoke, he found his new destiny: Goldhearted.
Physical Description: 5'8" with pale blue skin, white hair, and purple eyes. Half of his body is covered in a shadow leaving only his eye and teeth visible like a gnawing scar. His clothes cover most of it which is a blue combat tunic with a big blue cloak with starts. He carries a sword at his hip and a blue shield with a white star either in his left hand or back. His neck has a two-toned collar and gold chain with a gem carved to look like a decorative star at it's center.

Name: Aston Aldebrand
Identity: Old Soldier, Cook in the Trenches
Known History:
- Born in Little Ottington in the Kingdom of Karlsgard. One older brother living in the Tundra, one niece who moved to the Bastion.
- Joined the military when his tavernkeeper parents died around twenty years ago. Assigned as an army cook after training.
- Survived the destruction of his battalion during one of the first Angel attacks of the Merrani invasion. Spent months in recuperation afterwards.
- Eventually helped with feeding and housing of refugees and wounded, instead of returning to the frontlines.
- Taken by the Realmstorm to the Worldhelm some time after, where he then joined the Goldhearted's embassy to the Dragon's Den, and learnt the true stakes of the Lhodos war.
Physical Description:
Aston is tall (6'1"), grizzled, and rather well-muscled (220 lbs) - he walks with a noticeable limp, but is otherwise in great shape for his age and (last-known) occupation. 

Being retired from active service, he no longer wears his old uniform anymore (doing so would draw too much attention anyway), although he still prefers clothes in similar colors, which he wears underneath his old gear. A small brass pendant is hung around his neck.

Name: Asuka Senko
Known History:
A girl that sought more out of her life than the oppression that her home had given her; seeking not really wealth, but a richer life than one she would have at Tokusou. 

Though she might seem a tad arrogant, she wants to help and protect people.

Life is meant to be enjoyed, after all.
Physical Description:
A dark haired beauty that hails from Tokusou, with a soft smile and gives the impression she enjoys luxury and the nicer things that places have to offer.

Standing at an impressive height of 5'1'', she is often seen floating, carrying small pouches and instruments, as well as the faint aroma of incense on her person.

Often if not always accompanied by a strange masked bird she affectionately calls Kumo.

Name: Asuka Yumiko
Known History: Asuka grew up far away from civilisation, with her mother. While purely human, she grew up away from the culture of the Alder, and instead was raised with the trappings and culture of the Yokai with her mysterious mother, and absent father. That is, until fate caught up to this family away in the peaks. Having grown up, she left for a hunting trip, and returned to her home destroyed, with clear signs of the Yokai's doing. With nothing else to live for, she started to travel Aldistir, hunting down the most dangerous Yokai she could out of both grief and civic duty, hoping to find the ones who did it, and why they have done so.
Physical Description: A woman standing at 5'8 with luxurious eastern clothing and a large bow. She stands with an aloof but scrutinizing look, judging all in her sharp eyes.

Name: Auro Benites
Known History: He's from Windhaven. (The Origin is not public information).
Physical Description: 5'9", lithe/muscular build.

Name: Axl Erenbrass
Known History: A sociable troublemaker by nature born in a scholar's paradise. While not the only one, the circumstances around his birth and subsequent natural quirks designated him as a gifted child. A mage among the magicless. However, when he was unable to meet expectations among his peers as a youth, ostracization, and shame followed closely behind. The experience warped him, and now he wanders to prove that he can be the greatest among them.
Physical Description: Axl is an athletic man who stands tall at 6'2, has dark skin, pierced ears, and a dyed blonde undercut. He adorns himself in a showy black duster with a red inner lining that leaves his chest bare, knee-high boots with far too many straps, a red scarf to mask the lower portion of his face, and an overly large brimmed hat that hangs behind his duster. He is often seen wearing several potions that hang by his waist, as well as a pair of glasses that obscure his eyes.

Name: Ayan Jabir
Known History:
Born to slaves, Ayan learned the harsh realities of Nezmira. Eventually, the Sikhaari Order assassinated his masters, and he and his family escaped slavery. He came to idolize the assassins that had freed him, and decided to join the Order, hoping to better Nezmira and help the slaves and downtrodden in a more direct way than the Blue City Revolutionaries, though he didn't dislike their methods. He learned the art of assassination, killing several Nezzim slavers and slave masters, helping many humans and mages escape slavery.

After the Revolution, the Order decided to continue killing Nezzim with no real cause, following their hatred and resentment rather than what would lead to a better Nezmira. He couldn't abide by that, so he left. In his flight, he stole Nightblood and Nalthis, two of the sacred artifacts of the Order, leaving behind the sacred mantle, Sel. Shortly after, a raid from Zalfira nearly killed him, surviving by falling into a realmstorm, appearing on the Worldhelm.
Physical Description: At 5'5" and fairly thin, Ayan is a beautiful young man, with dark skin and long black hair he ties back at the nape of his neck. He mostly wears clothing that lets him blend in with a crowd, and tends towards blacks and reds with gold designs. He's very attached to his crescent moon earring.

Name: Baaxee
Known History: Not much is known of the goblin race, found in the forest and ruins of Kor'Tarion. They're not usually worthy of notice, be it by the forces of good, or evil. But Baaxee doesn't just want to be noticed. She wants to be relied on. She wants to be a protector. She wants to be a hero! A rare aspirant to something great, she would move out from the hidden lodgings of the green-skinned species without much of a plan. However, stealing fancy armor and the biggest, nicest shields she can find during a chance find in lost ruins is, while not exactly heroic by itself, certainly a good start! And she knows that, if she were to find her very own band of heroes, that would accept her and see her as the Guardian she knows herself to be, she won't allow harm to come to those who'd give a goblin a chance.
Physical Description: Baxee is a 3'5 goblin, with the standard green skin of her people and with messy hair tinted purple by forest berries. Her head is wide, and her sharp grinning mouth, wider still. The sclera of her eyes is yellow, and the iris a solid red. More often than not, she is clad in armor across her whole body, save her arms, though those are often, instead, protected by dome-like shields that can link together into a closed sphere.

Name: Barry Strike
Known History:
* Born and raised in Vale, inspired by the arts and stories of grand heroes & stylish gunslingers
* Loses father as a young child during the attack on Vale ten years ago
* Family takes refuge in Bastion, persists through scavenging and survival skills
* Joins the KPLA as a teenager in hopes of fighting for freedom and becoming his own man
* Faces death's door when fighting to save allies during a skirmish
* Miraculously saved by a Realmstorm transporting him to the Worldhelm
* Aims to one day return to Lhodos with new allies and more experience to aid the resistance
Physical Description:
Barry Strike is an enthusiastic young man appearing to be in his late teens, standing at 5'6" with messy, fringe blonde hair and sparkling blue eyes. At first glance, it's his grandiose, larger-than life cowboy character that takes center stage. He's got the skills, looks, and attitude to back it all up-- but his excitable, youthful nature often cracks through his cool persona whenever he's caught unaware.
His attire consists of what you'd expect from a Lhodos gunslinger, his most notable accessories being a worn black hat and a tattered red scarf around his neck. In terms of demeanor, Barry carries himself with the exaggerated charm and bravado of a classic frontier hero, but shines the most is is the warmth of his presence-- bright, carefree, and impossible to ignore.

Name: Basim
Identity: Courageous Hunter for the Black Obelisk
Known History: Eight odd years ago, there was a body washing up the shores near the Black Obelisk, covered with both recent and older burns with a dull blade gripped tightly in his hands, almost like a death grip and might have been one if not for his luck. That person was Basim. The researchers within the Black Obelisk finding him on one of their expeditions into the desert and brought him back to their base to recover. After their recovery he has been working and learning under the researchers' guidance to help repay their perceived debt to the group. Now that he's here, well, might as well keep learning on behalf of the researchers and his own curiousity - hand in hand with the other goldhearted or otherwise.
Physical Description: A tall and bulky human male standing around 6'6 with their brown hair tied into a ponytail. Basim's form covered with several burn marks inflicted on him, the most notable of which being the one over the bandages that cover his eyes.

Name: Bear
Identity: Lone Survivor of a fallen resistance
Known History:
Bear grew up in Windhaven as a young human boy working day after day as a laborer. At about 12 years old, an older kid put it into his head that life doesn't have to be about laboring day in and day out, so he and a few friends went to attended their first resistance meeting. For a few years, he continued his labor by day, and learned how to fight by night. By his 17th birthday, he had grown into a proper shield, learning how to move in heavy armor and protect his allies.
On his 17th birthday, his resistance cell was eradicated. Bear was home at a small celebration with his family. The day of the next meeting, Bear hadn't received his usual message and he hadn't seen his friends at the labor camp for a week. 
Since then, Bear has continued laboring in Windhaven, his Guilt about not being around to protect his friends gnawing at him in the back of his mind. When Windhaven went into lockdown and was subsequently freed, he pulled his shields out of storage and started his journey.
Physical Description: Himbo build: broad shoulders, wide chest, muscular, sturdy, and "thicc." He has a moderately tan complexion, like that of a perfectly baked loaf of bread. His hair is a deep burgundy and he keeps his full beard. Wearing short sleeves and more airy clothes reveals the surprising amount of body hair that earned him the name "Bear," but he only wears so little while working out.

Name: Beatrice Verdenhart
Known History:
Having been raised by a powerful Mother Bear in the wilds, Beatrice was discovered by the town of Willowbough. Having known Beast Magic all her life, she was a natural candidate to become Willowbough's local guardian, a role she took with pride.
What captured her imagination from youth into adulthood, was the legends of the Green Knight's, and the ruined castle close to Willowbough. She absorbed every story she could learn of them, and with dreams of knighthood, vowed one day to rebuild the castle, and to become a true Knight.
After becoming Goldhearted, she took on the last name "Verdenhart" as a declaration to protect all life across every realm, one she holds to this day.
Physical Description: Standing tall at 6'1, she has fair features with a carefree expression, wearing her favourite piece of plaid over her steel armour.

Name: Bec
Known History:
Bec has been in Idyll since before it turned into Hell. Frequented Asga, but primarily dwelled in Nirve, which is where she was when Idyll changed.

Continued living in Nirve, but would go up to Sum on supply runs. Doesn't talk much about it.

Had a brush with a guard in Nirve while recovering from a supply run. It ended with her being accused of assault and getting exiled to The Bastard's Den, where she has been wiling away time, surviving amidst the criminal scum, cutthroats, murderers and monsters that made their way from the other realms, through the city proper. Life in hell is just that. But it isn't always so bad. Bec keeps her head up and keeps going.
Physical Description: Relatively short (5'3). Athletic and Sturdy Build. Dark Medium-Length Hair. Blue Eyes. Eyepatch Covering Right Eye. Scars along right side of face.

Name: Bellamie Ghoroznovich
Known History:
Years ago, Bellamie was just a girl, living life on a farm on the outskirts of Little Ottington as the eldest of her mother's three children. It was an alright life, if... stressful due to the war. 

Bella was always capable around the farm, always repairing the machines and tools often through brute force of will and grit. But when she took apart a Merrane angel that had shown up on her land as a scrap heap... That's when she knew she could make a difference. That's when she knew she could make sure her family was safe.

With determination and love weighing heavy in her heart, Bellamie left for the larger cities... There, she joined a project. Joined more as a test subject than as a scientist, which was a little out of place. But what was even stranger about the girl was just how far she was willing to push the boundary, all for the cause of Karlsgard.

At the end of it, Bellamie was no farmer girl. She was a soldier, more steel than meat - more death than mortal.
Physical Description:
Standing at 6'6 and several hundred pounds due to the metal under her skin and the heft of her gun arm, Bellamie is less an imposing figure, and more of an intimidating frame. Her silhouette is lopsided, her right arm much larger than the left due to the weaponry contained within. She still wears her old military jacket, and though it's old, it's been repaired and newly enchanted, giving it a near lunar shimmer in the right light, and a new confidence to boot.

But in her armor... Bellamie towers at 8'6", with broad plates and a heavy steel gauntlet. Just to make appearances, she covers the large chassis in an equally massive war coat, decorated with pins and badges,

Name: Benjamin Abram Moore-Fletcher
Identity: Bandit On The Right Foot This Time
Known History:
Benjamin Abram Moore-Flatcher used to not be a good person. 

You could say he used to rob folks, even killin' them sometimes. But lookin' for repentance in a gunfight gone south was enough to get 'im to Idyll, and his brashness with blue lightning got him safely down to Nirve, where he tries to make some space that he would have ruined back in his living life.
Physical Description: 5'10, slightly pudgy cowboy with a light fuzz for a beard. Medium brown skin and god's strongest lineup, immortally preserved in death.

Name: Benício Galhardo
Known History: Born in the Wandering Wings trailblazer caravan, Benício Galhardo is a lively yet rowdy and ready bird. A hunter of outlaws and some what a keeper of peace by proxy. Some might say they are heavy handed when it comes to dishing out punishment or dealing with thieves and highwaymen but he'd say that those who steal and mug others of their things don't deserve too much sympathy. The path of a criminal who holds up families and caravans with violence for their possessions, is a cowards path and that path is one that needs to be cut short. He's sure the cycle of retribution will come to hold the sword over his head but until then. . .
Physical Description: Dressed in a leather duster standing over five feet by a few inches. A rowdy looking kind of expression as a young man ready to tussle, yellow eyes and grey-ish feathers with sharp black talons. In his shadow looms the visage of jaws sometimes.

Name: Bjorn
Known History: Born in Dryholde, Bjorn lead a simple life as the son of a blacksmith. He would provide for his family and from a young age would help around at his father's smithery. As he grew older, he found himself drawn to the village's cemetery and on occasion would visit the elder whom watched over the grave. The years flew by and the elder passed away, but left the care of the graveyard in Bjorn's hands. As the years went by, Bjorn watched with great care and ensured each and every grave was treated with respect until one fateful night in which Bjorn stumbled upon a small font of magic in the form of a white shard. Unbeknownst to him, he became blessed with the powers of elemental magic, the ability to control the earth, fire, wind and more. He wasn't alone in this revelation though, and work quickly spread through town about how Bjorn had stumbled upon "foul magic" and was ushered out of the town, to never return. Not even his own father watched him leave. Now he finds himself wandering alone
Physical Description: At exactly 6'0, Bjorn is a rather broad individual who has seen his fair days at an anvil and other forms of strenuous labor. While he current travels in a full set of armor including a helmet, underneath the attire lies a simple man with dirty-blonde hair and brown eyes. Behind his back lies a greatsword that rarely leaves his side, and the tips of his fingers crackle with a small jolt of electricity every so often.

Name: Brandr Vol
Identity: A Man Striving to be Better
Known History: Hailing from the wilds of Alidistir within a clan of Vanagandr, Brandr was once human. Like many others, he tried to survive with his kin within the tundra. However, one long-lasting blizzard left him stranded alone for days using a cave as refuge. While the snow gave him a source of water,  he was growing weak from starvation. Out of desperation he braved the blizzard for food only to find the body of a dead Yokai. Lacking many options he ate of its flesh and while it kept him full long enough for the storm to pass, it changed him forever. Be it the nature of the beast, or arcane consequences from Kuzunoha, Brandr was warped into a fiery Oni. He now harbors an insatiable hunger for both food and battle like a raging flame he can't quell. After remaining within the wilds of his home aiding those he could, he no longer felt himself fit to live alongside his people within Aldistir. Feeling the same tug many Goldhearted do to the Worldhelm,  hoping to do good with his new life and powers.
Physical Description: Though only 5'10'' in height, Brandr is a unit of a man sporting only pants as most shirts are impossible for him to wear. Having a broad, wide, and stocky build that stores within it a well of power from his large arms and heavyset build. It is a form that opts for strength and brawn, visible in even subtle movements as what could be mistaken for pudge holds muscles underneath. His fiery mane of hair flickers and moves like a living flame. As he himself loses energy, though it takes on a black charcoal look to it. His skin is a dark ashen coloration and resembles scales or cooled plates of magma. Cracks and lines along it run heat akin to lava running through veins. Sporting light tribal markings along with piercings, many can tell he hails from Aldistir as an Oni if they're familiar with that realm. Despite his fanged maw, horned helm, and burning ember like eyes, Brandr comes off as a gentle giant or someone constantly trying to be friendly when not in the throes of combat.

Name: Brigitta ᵀʰᵉ Superstar
Known History:
* Born in the ruins of Heartdom, to a loving family of Lhodosian origins, with a laborer father and a housewife mother
* Would use the echo when climbing atop the metal skeletons of ruined skyscrapers to carry her words and song
* Applied to Gnosis Academy, intent on furthering her stage and find a cause
* Underwent the Rite of Bonding due to wanting to amplify other people's message, too, and be an echo for everyone
* Heads the Gnosis Student Radio, and spreads both upbeat song and a message against all tyranny
* Sent to remedial class due to a general flaunting of rules, especially dress code
Physical Description: Standing at a stunning 6'0, Brigitta sports a mane of sparkling, dark hair, with bangs that hide her eyes, but not her wide smile. It contrasts with her style of dress, favoring stage looks with bright, sunny colors, over-the-top choices like leotards and thigh-high gogo boots that have definitely had her yelled at by Gnosis faculty. Overall, it's hard to ignore, which is the point.

Name: Bronzeheart
Known History: The circumstances of Bronzeheart's birth are unknown. She was found in the northern forests of Kor'Tarion by a group of vagabonds and was raised as one of their own, learning how to protect the people of the land from dangerous beasts and monsters. Following a less than peaceful altercation between their brigand, Bronzeheart left to travel on her own, swearing on her life that she would never let another innocent soul die.
Physical Description: An elvish woman of average height and muscular build, typically clad in heavy armor. Her red hair is decorated with flowers and, in battle, a mask resembling winding branches.

Name: Brooks Howard
Known History:
To hear Brooks tell it, he’s a lazy scoundrel, a womanizer, and a liar. Only the last one is really true.

He's a quick-witted rogue with a knack for smooth-talking and survival. He made a name for himself as a mercenary and a negotiator for the desert’s merchants, using charm and guile to secure himself a living. For whatever reason, he willingly became an Insolvent a long time ago, and continues to wander to this day.
Physical Description: A broad and slightly unkempt Insolvent standing at about 6'. He has dirty blonde hair, a beige coat over a dark green open shirt, dark cargo pants, and brown boots. He carries a well-kept modified greatsword, a belt with magitech tools, and a pistol.

Name: Brym Terablight
Known History: The first clear memory is that of a brand being put upon him, everything before was a blur. Forced into the world of Nezzim rule early in life due to his magical talents. Going around, obeying every order given as if it's the sole purpose of existence, but it's always felt off. Freedom was but steps away, in the right direction. Up.
Physical Description: Blonde hair, orange eyes with a skinny build. He wears  a robe adorned with little decorations, The left side of his head containing a complicated brand running across his neck.

Name: CHAOS SHARD
Known History: Elliot Hilde was a young study in the Palace City Michalis in the skies. He quickly learned the arts or icons & rituals his family were granted for their loyalty to the dragons. Elliot used this power to channel chants capable of summoning draconic fire or granting healing & succor unto those who need it. Often using his powers to help others he was found worthy & goldenhearted, and rose up to grant his words of healing light to those who may need them.
Physical Description: 6'3" human man with a lean yet muscular build & fashionable clothes. Wields a magical staff, and bears a tattoo of a dragon across his back.

Name: Caelan Blacklaw
Identity: Corporate Supervisor seeking to reclaim a life lost
Known History:
Caelen comes from the family Blacklaw, a known lineage that has worked in Qilink since it's contracting days. A supervisor who's mission is to feed the theoretical fire of the Link Engine by gathering info in real time; mainly large events. Updating as time went on.

Graduating out of Haven Prep, he was thrown into the workforce in Qilink as per family tradition and being the eldest son. Working up the ladder to his supervisor position with pure on the job experience. A recent article recorded shows he was at the crash site of a shard during the **Skyfall** event.
Physical Description: Caelan is a wolf-augmented supervisor, grays and darker strands of fur decorate the scar ridden body. Standing at an average 5'10. Fitted to his frame, a suit lined with magic enhancing materials suited for an Esper from a reputable tailor.

Name: Caelum Fulmin
Known History: Caelum was a common civilian in The Veil, located in Karlsgard. He was known for being extremely helpful, going door to door and helping with chores, free of charge. However, on one fateful day,  a powerful soldier from Merrane, Fang, showed up and wreaked havoc. After desperately trying to escape, it proved futile, as he was captured by the soldier, and brought to Merrane. There, he was drugged and experimented on. Scientists rended his flesh, inserting highly advance technology into his skin. With the intention of making the poor boy into a walking weapon. Upon waking up days later, Caelum was informed of his new abilities, and was horrified. Desperate to return to his old life, he pleaded to Merrane. They promised he could become normal again, once they had won the war. Left with no other option, Caelum joined the front lines of Merrane. There, he spotted Fang again, after a brief conflict, He was convinced to make the most of his abilities. Him and Fang fled to Karlsgard.
Physical Description: A male Humanoid standing at 5'7, green eyes with a faint glow. Several black markings scattered across his body, birth marks. He wears a common grey shirt underneath his combat clothing. His combat clothing being a long black coat, dark grey slacks, and black gloves. He walks around barefoot, however due to Merrane experimenting on his body, combat boots are formed whenever his feet come into contact with certain molecules. His clothes differ immensely from what he would normally wear, as they were given to him by Merrane.

Name: Caerwyn
Identity: The Last Healer of the Old Faith
Known History:
Caerwyn is a young woman hailing from the Charred Hills of Kor'Tarian. The details of her birth or childhood are largely unknown, other than that she was left with the Fire Monks due to the unnatural fire in her soul. At some unknown point, she disappeared off the map and eventually showed up once again in the Cult of Brimstone, in which she had joined a circle of healing mages. However, a supposed betrayal led to the circle of those who had been her makeshift family being executed, much to the lost young woman's rage. Before the waraxe met her own neck, she lunged forward, tearing it from the executioner's grasp and turning it against its wielder, and then his allies.

Her retaliation drew the attention of a nearby Balefire brood, and as she realized the dragon was approaching, she resigned herself to her fate. However, fate instead manifested as a Realmstorm falling around her, sweeping Caerwyn away.
Physical Description: Caerwyn stands at 5'5" with blue eyes and long blonde hair that always seems to be fluttering and coiling uncannily like flames, even in a windless land. She is always seen in black, ashen clothing and dark armor ridged with reds and oranges.

Name: Cake
Known History: Once, there was a baker in Kor'Tarion who made the greatest strawberry shortcake ever. Before the last slice could be eaten, the cake decided that it at least wanted to go on an adventure first.
Physical Description: Cake is an animated strawberry shortcake with a diminutive height of only 3'0", or 0.9 meters tall. It's a bit of a coward, and it seems constantly wary of its surroundings.

Name: Calibre Harmony
Known History:
Calibre Harmony is a young member of the Karlsgard Peoples Liberation Alliance, a pilot of the towering Gallant Engine to which they're soul-linked. Hailing from Pikeway, Calibre has experienced the southward march of Merrane's conquest, taking up arms in defense of their country. Now becoming a Goldheart, they take their battle across worlds in hopes of drawing the Worldhelm's gaze back towards Lhodos.

The Gallant Engine is a machine designed and built by a group of Dupartist scientists and engineers, seeking to link mortal and machine by bridging the gap. The mechanics of the soul-link Calibre underwent are unknown, but the fragment of Lilith contained within has heightened their emotions beyond who they were before.
Physical Description: 5'8, Brown-skinned, Androgynous, Average form. Wears beaten-up Karlsgard military surplus, customized through years of wear. Their pilot suit is armored, and directly links them into the machine interface of the Gallant Engine.

Name: Carmelita
Known History: Those who know her from Sangang-Daan know her for being a resourceful and quick learner. She speaks with grace and makes sure to present herself as best as possible to everyone, she of course sometimes slips up and swears and talks in the language she learned in Amihan.
Physical Description: Standing at 5'8 wearing a somewhat traditional traveler's outfit with her hair tied up with this red cloth, wearing this white croptop and red scarf and a long cloth with black pants and brown boots. She wields an Enchanted bow with runes related to the old culture of Amihan.

Name: Carmine
Known History: A child of Vale, Carmine lost both of her parents to the war in Lhodos. Spending years scavenging parts from former battlefields, she repaired a defunct Merrani mechsuit and prepared to make her escape. To anywhere she might know peace.
Physical Description: A young woman of reasonably muscular and athletic build. Her hair is wild, fashioned into unkempt spikes with shaved sides. She wears light armor, with a re-breather hung around her neck. Beneath her gauntlets are a pair of pistols, designed to be accessible in an instant should she need to defend herself.

Name: Carol Belle
Known History:
Carol lived with their family, and many others in a frontier village at the very edge of the Marrane border. In semi-secret their family engaged in trade and barter with the travelers, settlers, and militia of Karlsgard. During this time Carol became a shrewd, and discerning businessman, but was later sent back to Korala to receive a proper education.

Carol received formal certification in R&D, and Engineering, as well as compelled military service training.

Upon returning home Carol discovered that their village, and others close to the border had been pillaged and bombarded in a push by revolutionaries to reclaim land. Despite only mild losses, the Marrane retaliation was massive, and deadly.

Carol was so distressed by the violence that they defected from Marrane, and assisted Karlsgard villagers in their efforts of recovery and defense. Despite their desperation, Carols efforts were valiant, and in their darkest moment were chosen to be Goldhearted.
Physical Description: Carol is a relatively diminutive person, only standing to about 5'4" tall. This, combined with their cherubic, androgynous features gives them a very unthreatening appearance that makes it difficult for people to take them seriously. They are of fair skin tone, often somewhat flush. They have mid-length brown hair, impressing somewhere between tastefully curly and mildly unkempt. Their eyes are blue like the sky, and just as open. They wear practical adventuring gear, leather jackets, and are strapped with an array of gadgets. Their tools, trinkets, and otherwise useful items are kept in a large shoulder-strapped bag.

Name: Caspian Riviera
Known History:
Caspian Riviera's bits of his own history is only known to those that attend Gnosis Academy. He is a student in the Regal House of Paladins. Caspian is also an honor roll student who comes from the upper class, with his mother, Cecilia Riviera, being a graduate from the Regal House of Wardens and notable figure in the Galeo Empire in Ripplith.

Those from the Academy would also know about the recent scandal in the previous semester that revolved around him refusing the Rite of Binding to a certain regalia (Aelina). And thusly suffered a reputation loss as a result from peers.
Physical Description: A young man with long, white hair. Standing tall at 6 foot. Fair skin and purple eyes, usually wearing a perpetual frown on his face. Wears the standard blue Gnosis Academy uniform, along with a hat.

Name: Caspian Wakes
Known History:
Near the old coast of Kor'Tarion, rumor circulates about a sea creature that roamed the area from time to time. Slinking off into a nearby cave to feed or scaring small children on the beaches.

In reality, Caspian looks disappointing from up close. Not much for a sea monster, despite the local tales.
Physical Description: Caspian has an athletic build, and stands at 5ft 11in tall. Otherwise looking like an average man of his age, save for the sickly pale of his skin and the shock white of their hair.

Name: Cassandra Maldonado
Identity: Daunted Mercenary Putting on a Brave Face
Known History:
She used to work at her grandfather's auto repair shop as a mechanic before he passed away. After the death of her grandparents she took over for a time before she was forced to sell the property to pay off some of the debt left to her. 

She became a temp to try and maintain her younger siblings despite the risks.
Physical Description:
5'11"

Well toned body.

Often smells like grease and motor oil, occasionally covered in it.
(Will add more details later)

Name: Cassius Caldonis
Known History:
Moved to the observatory after a beast emerged from it, but was shortly stopped by a group of individuals. 

They've been picking over the rusted magitech and created some unique gear.
Physical Description: Bearing pale skin and hair, standing at just 5'10" A single braid of hair over the shoulder amidst a rather messy head of it. They sport gear suited for colder climates.
