Name: Cecile
Known History: A short lithe chameleon girl with a penchant for taking things that don't belong to her. She has a reputation for being a no-good thief due to her kleptomania but has never stolen from other gold-hearted* (unsubstantiated). It is pretty common knowledge now that she and Yorick are a thing. She is currently working primarily on dealing with the ordeals in her home realm but occasionally shows up for other tasks if the headache is great enough.
Physical Description: Standing at 163cm Cecile is a short chameleon-tailed girl with large crimson-red eyes and a disarming smile. Her streaks of scales along her body (usually covered by a tight catsuit) and unique prehensile tail show her unique Nezzim ancestry as an Ophidiya. She has a few other distinguishing features that are unique such as her monocular vision (the ability to control each eye independently) and her very very long tongue.

Name: Cecilia-Carmillia (Ci-Ci)
Known History:
- Cecillia was born in Ripplith as a man, Her family carried a gift from the Ocean Singers, a magical weapon that resonates with songs of the ocean. She at first couldn't lift it.

- Even before her transition, she was talented in the roles of a woman, taking the skillset far easier than the ones given to her as a man, this helped her realize that she was more comfortable presenting as a girl. She sought out a Seamother.

- After going through the ritual, she found a weight lifted off of her and was able to carry her family heirloom. Her family sent her to Gnosis Academy.

- She is quite the character, and so regularly had friction with stricter teachers due to her bubbly and excitable personality.

- She didn't get into too much trouble thanks to good grades. But that all changed when she heard about remedial classes and the opportunity to go to new places.

- Despite the look on her academic record, she tanked her grades to get into the remedial course. She is hungry for adventure.
Physical Description:
Ci-Ci is a bubbly 4'11 girl with a lean but powerful physique. Her skin is a pastel shade of pink and her eyes sparkling a curious ocean blue. Her hair is mostly pink, with some accents of red. No one is exactly certain why her eyes became hearts after her ritual with the Seamother, but she sure thinks it's cute. Ci-Ci is also followed by her quite sizable tail, which is a boon in the ocean. But on land it feels far more like a liability. Only enhancing the girl's clumsiness.

Other notable features is the large seashell shaped weapon that she carries either on her shoulder or on her back. As she walks, you can hear the light clanging sound of symbol-like metal inside the shell. It is an heirloom she wields proudly.

Name: Charlies Erp
Known History: For the past Century there have been stories floating around Kor'tarion of lost books being found in nearby forests; open but barely touched. Fairy tales of kids who wonder alone at night that end up getting lost being led back home safely by the light of a lantern being held by a cryptid. Almost every account shares in common the moral of don't lie.
Physical Description: A faceless creature with long deer-like antlers and two eyespots. Vantablack like skin seemingly woven in with the colors of old pages. Looking at them feels like looking hundreds of compressed books bound together yet freely movely. No smile but their "head" compresses and shifts to changes shape to match silloute of someone who is. No words ever leave their person. Only the sounds of fluttering paper appear to escape them to convey thoughts.

Name: Charlotte Morgan
Known History:
Charlotte was born to the esteemed Morgan family in the capital. Her family is responsible for vast swaths of factories across the Empire and a great many sponsored inventors with shining promise.

Charlotte gleefully indulged in the plenty, but she possessed an uncontained avarice beyond even her peers... accompanied by a potent pride, fundamental disbelief in others to do what she could, and a passion for craftsmanship.

This led her to the dungeons, diving alongside the delvers for ancient artifacts to repurpose and going beyond in a reckless contempt for safety. However, sheer ~~luck~~ skill kept her alive and well alongside her cocky attitude.

Her parents quickly had enough. Delving was for the lower class, not heiresses. After briefly getting put into custody, in return for getting her out, they sternly demanded her to join the Adventurer's Guild instead if she so insisted on getting her own hands on things. She has begrudgingly complied and left the dungeons. For now.
Physical Description: Charlotte is a short woman standing at 5'2", with fair skin and steel grey eyes. Her appearance is meticulously kept; her brilliant red hair rolls in waves down to the middle of her back, face done up with cherry red lips and perfectly shaped eyebrows, nails flawless, and always dressed in a blended mix of high fashion and adventurer's gear. Her gold hairband reveals matching goggles when she pulls it over her face.

Name: Circuit
Known History:
- Commissioned at the [request of a LUA couple](<https://discord.com/channels/1169852846083153941/1170110466299809873/1291077076010668072>) in Silver Rock, Haven.
- Really enjoyed watching boxing and gladiator style matches, "growing up".
- Wanted to become a prize fighter, but they could not make the cut for a SWORD sponsorship.
- Eventually saved up for an ETA license and started doing Temp jobs to make ends meet. Has cultivated the suit and gauntlets image to make themselves seem more professional!
- It was during one of these jobs where they (and some others) fell foul of the leader of the Olympians...and they made their escape through a Realmstorm to safety.
- They're still looking for that big break that will make them famous...and maybe this Worldhelm can help them in that regard!
Physical Description: Circuit's frame is compact (5'8"), but bulky (223 lbs). Their attire for jobs (unless requested) is a tailored suit with the sleeves rolled up to keep the arms (and gauntlets) free. Gotta stay professional!

Name: Claire de Blanc
Known History:
As a demihuman orphan in Caldera, Claire was considerably impoverished during part of her childhood. Only until she successfully enrolled into White Wing Academy out of a combination of luck and effort at age 12. She was considered rebellous and rude, but very talented in combat and quick among her peers. Spending 6 years studying and training to be an Angel, formally becoming one by age 18.

Then she spends the next four years in service, taking on very dangerous missions or following orders that one would consider heinous. Even losing friends' lives more than one occassion. Suffering mental tolls throughout her service, to the point leaving the military at around age 23.

The next several months go by like a blur for Claire. Living her life aimlessly as she takes up random side jobs to feel useful every now and them. That is until one day she encountered her first Realmstorm...
Physical Description: A young woman with long black hair, a lithe build and light-brown eyes. She has wolf-like ears on top of her head, and a black wolf tail she maintains often. Standing at 5'3"/160cm tall, weighing 130 pounds/58.9 kg. Claire typically wears comfortable clothes such as a hoodie, shorts, or something she finds cool.

Name: Colin Subar
Known History:
Colin is a human from the wartorn lands of Lhodos. Born to an unassuming couple in the small village of Hemsway in the Kingdom of Karlsgard, Colin quickly showed that he had a true gift for higher learning. His small village put together their funds and sent him off to the Academy, believing that while it was funded by the feared Empire, it was still free enough to be its own institution, and it would give Colin the education he needed. And they were right. Sort of.

Colin never gained any kind of connection to magic, which frustrated him to no end. Eventually, he was offered a chance at testing a new piece of magitech, which promised to grant magical abilities to those with the proper intellect. But it was all a ruse. He was used as an experiment subject, and though he walked out healthy and whole, he was forever changed.

He fled the Academy, and began his investigation into the true nature of the world, to reveal the evil laying dormant in the magic the Empire used so easily.
Physical Description: Colin is a fairly pale man, tall at 6'8", with short, dark brown hair, pale indigo eyes, and a sharp nose. He has two lines on his face, running from beneath his eyes down to his jawline. He tends to wear simple slacks with a button down, a necktie, and a dark topcoat, and he has a pair of glasses, though he seems like he can see just fine without them. Strangely enough, despite his fairly thin frame, he's heavy, like he's denser than he should be.

Name: Cora
Known History: Living in relative luxary, Cora was an up and coming student at an academy until an incident where her instructor forced her to explore the outside world to learn humility and worldly knowledge
Physical Description: Taller and somewhat fit, with brown eyes dark hair and fancy clothing. Has a blue gem necklace and a flower crown

Name: Cressida Octi
Known History: Once a simple woman, she earned her humble income by reading cards to travelers and adventurers. When many came back to her asking for her to lift the curses she apparently put on them, she decided to seek wisdom from a spirit in a lake. Something in the ritual she performed went awry and now the two are entwined. Plagued by the doubt of being an hexer and a danger to the people of Tradefair, not even knowing if she's herself anymore, she started wandering the world in search for answers. Until one day she found a door in a tree, and curiosity got the best of her. Is she ready to be one of those to face adventure?
Physical Description: Her figure is long and thin, with sharp features so that more than one mistake her for a young man. White long and straigh hair encompass her face, and she's rarely seen wearing something different than a long robe and pointy hat. Her book of tarots always by her side hides a set of deadly magic cards.

Name: Crimson
Known History: Daughter of a mob leader from Karlsgard.  A mute, taken an oath of silence.
Physical Description:
Height 6'5"
Weight 175 lbs

Name: Cynthia
Known History: A lone Fae lived in solitude within the odd forests of the Fae realm. All that was on her mind was trying to live. Then, a man crossed paths with Fae, A scholar that shared with her his dreams. Over the years, the man would return with colleagues whenever they were passing by. They too shared their dreams with the Fae. But then, they stopped passing by. The Fae waited, longing to see them again, but it was for naught. So one day, when a crossing occured near them, the Fae left her home. The Fae now wanders the country side as a traveling healer, Wishing to find and make dreams of her own, and understand those that she had previously met.
Physical Description:
A wolven Fae hailing from the abstract wood of the faerie realm. Cynthia has a predominantly black furcoat with orange and cyan marking throughout.
Feathers also stick out from a numerous places in her fur, taking on similar colorations. 
She can typically be seen wearing a lightly colored hemp woven cloak over a piece of cloth covering chest and some baggy leggings. She's adorned with multiple different accessories made from twine, wood, and other greenery. While she doesn't seem to be carrying any weaponry, she typically can be seen walking around with a curved wooden staff

Name: Cyph
Known History: Cyph was formerly in a special 100G program of details she is not allowed to talk about. But due to how things in the program had been going it was discontinued freeing her from the obligation she had. However because of this program there were not many skills beyond acting as enforcer that she had, so they sponsored her for a TLEL. As long as she continues to uphold her agreements from the past contract and does good work they have agreed to keep her sponsored.
Physical Description: Cyph is a woman who stands at 5' 5" she has very long white hair and icey blue eyes. She seems to favor wearing an oversized jacket.

Name: Cypher Yuten
Known History:
A once solo game developer, having recently invited another to join the development team. 

Known to use a steel plated suite case to carry mysterious cards.
Physical Description:
A thin framed snow leopard, sporting eye catching hair. Attire from the upscale side of Silver Rock, showing a modicum of skill to live such a lifestyle.
     A plethora of both physical and mechanical augmentations decorate their body. Giving the likeness of a snow leopard

 Cypher clocks in at 5'10" and weighing in at 192lbs.

Name: Cyrus Sand
Known History:
- Born Cyrus K'zzek in the City of Scales, son of a wealthy merchant family.
- Ran away from home at a young age due to overbearing expectations and a smothering lifestyle. He has come to hold a distaste for the very concepts of decadence and nobility ever since. Took on the surname "Sand" to further sever his family ties.
- Eventually became a shield-for-hire and monster hunter operating out of The Last Hold. He uses what he terms the "testudo style" of hand-to-hand combat, though it's more shield-to-hand.
- Enjoys meat and booze perhaps a little too much.
Physical Description: A 6' tall teal-scaled Nezzim rarely seen out of a scarred and scuffed suit of well-worn bronze scale armor. His bearing is just as rough and unpolished as his mail, and his movements, while lacking in grace, show unswaying confidence.

Name: Céline Brighttail
Known History:
Born to an underground community of Ratfolk in the fae realm, Céline grew up in a world of rules and restrictions, longing for a chance to know the world outside. She'd dream of climbing up to the moon, and asking the stars why the world was as it was.

One day, the stars answered.

They guided her away from her familiar home, into the mortal realm, and to a distant, ancient temple. There she struck a bargain: she would be taught the secrets of the stars, and in return, she'd one day return there to restore the temple to its former glory.

With that, she bound Anyktera as her first Arcana, and set out in pursuit of the knowledge and power to make good on her promise. She eventually joined Hudal Academy, where she honed her magic until its ruin during Project Bloodmoon.

Her classes on hold, she took to wandering Kor'tarion, and eventually stumbled into a certain anomalous storm... And the rest, as they say, is history.
Physical Description:
"Many have told me that, when it comes to magic, the sky is the limit. I disagree. The sky is merely my starting point." 

 Céline is a rat-like fae with soft white fur, large rounded ears, and sharp violet eyes. She is most often seen wearing a set of deep blue scholar's robes along with a black mask and a matching hat. Standing just under 4ft tall-- which she insists is quite tall for her kind-- she sports a delicate frame, though her ears give a significant height boost to her silhouette.

Name: DRAGONTRAP
Physical Description: Unix is a male Wilkin that stands at five feet and ten inches and weighs around 175 pounds. He has soft brown eyes, golden blonde hair, and soft brown dog-like ears and a multicolored tail. He also has a strange burn mark across his eyes, causing the skin around his eyes to be slightly darker than his normal skin color. On his days in the field, he wears a set of bronze plates he got from his parents, and on his days off, he is normally seen wearing a set of casual clothing consisting of normal long pants and a short-sleeved shirt. But one thing always stays the same: the two shields he carries on his back at all times and a golden amulet he wears around his neck.

Name: DREADMOTH
Identity: Eldest Sister Given A Second Chance

Name: Dai Shuye
Known History:
Shuye was brought on the ship during a Goldhearted mission. She once denied her own status as a goldhearted. She has advertised her counselling services in the past, but shortly after avoided making too many public appearances.

Over time, she became royal seneschal to Gin, before coming Emperor in his stead. Now, she has both a feminine and masculine form, the latter of which goes by Dai Tenbin.
Physical Description:
As a woman, a 5'5 lightly melanated woman who dresses in colorful kimonos that, to those familiar with the culture, suggests an imperial background. As a man, much the same, but a few inches taller.

Her eyes bear the pattern of the Taiji, with topaz being on top in her masculine form, and amethyst in her feminine form.

Name: Daisy Starbloom
Known History:
Unlike other Deerfolk families, Daisy grew up isolated from the world, living instead with a secluded coven of Forest Witches in the far north-eastern region of the Gwaed Forest. Raised as a young initiate under the Coven’s eclectic teachers, she was taught the art of herbalism, gardening, and sustainability. 

However, despite her enthusiasm and reverence for the earth, she struggled keeping pace with the other apprentices - seeming to lack an intuitive green thumb that her other sisters possessed. No matter her determination, she felt she was always one step behind, a flower struggling to bloom in the shade of trees. It wasn't until one of the Coven's renowned Hedge Witches stepped forward and nurtured Daisy as one of her own that her hidden potential began to flourish. 

And now, like a sapling with budding leaves, Daisy recently has taken the leap forward to leave the hearth of her coven, and truly figure out what her own green thumb looks like beyond the woodlands.
Physical Description:
Daisy is a 5'2" half-deer girl with warm, dark-brown skin and white spots that dust across her cheeks and fawn ears. Her hazel green eyes seem to always carry an ever-curious, yet serene expression, looking almost lost in whatever occupies her thoughts at the time. An abundance of curly brown hair tumbles down her shoulders and back, partially entwining the small antlers atop her head, which bloom with small flowers that change alongside the seasons. Her everyday attire reflects her rustic upbringing, making up cottagecore dresses that are sometimes paired with a half-apron, even when she's not actively cooking. 

The sweet scent of honey, citrus blossoms, and fresh cinnamon seem to follow wherever she goes, as if the springtime warmth lingers in her presence.

Name: Dane Alston
Identity: Cowboy with a Heart Full of Scrap
Known History: A fairly well known seller of scrap material, trustworthy enough to hire for jobs but not trustworthy enough to keep around for the long haul. Generally affable and decent at keeping his nose clean, and it is that latter part that keeps him poor and without significant work. He is generally satisfied with enough pay to keep him full and enough scrap to keep his hands busy.
Physical Description: About as wiry as a life of wandering and scavenging can get you, Dane Alston stands at a lanky 6'3. His clothes are well worn to the point of disrepair, and the only piece he seems to wear for aesthetics is the duster The clothes underneath and the hat on his are all sturdy and function and lacking a bit of style. He carries on his back a large pack, and has a partially filled holster on his hip.

Name: Daphila "Daphy" Tinkertop
Known History: Daphila grew up in an isolated little community of Fae called Dazzleton. The Fae of Dazzleton are all adept illusionists, except Daphila, given magic never made much sense to the young Fae. Unable to help provide for the grand illusion that keeps the little town hidden from the rest of the world Daphila felt like an outsider among her own kind. In this solemn state she took to woodcarving, sewing, and even tinkering with clockwork, eventually being able to make a few toys for herself. They served as nice little distractions, letting her forget her predicament even for just a little while. She then started making them for other kids, seeing the smile on their faces made her realize what she wanted to do. So she packed up and left her hometown to travel across the world and spread the same joy she felt for a period of a few years, before the Worldhelm sought her out.
Physical Description: Delphila stands at a staggering 3'2". She has long sparkling purple hair and is usually carrying around a pack full of trinkets twice her size. Making jingles, and rattles everywhere she goes.

Name: Dastan of the Swirling Sands
Known History:
Dastan was born to one of the free-spirited clans living away from imperial influence, deep within the northern sand dunes. Dastan has always been a dreamer, fascinated by the heroes of old, he left his homeland to seek his fortune in distant lands. To survive in the harsh desert and make a name for himself, he turned to banditry, targeting imperial convoys and wealthy travelers. Yet, despite his roguish lifestyle, Dastan held to a code of honor. He never raided those who could not afford it and ensured his victims had enough supplies to reach safety.

After a particularly dangerous raid on an imperial convoy hunted by Kiir, Dastan took a mysterious relic, a blood-red gemstone set in brass known as the Raging Sun. While he could feel there was something wrong with it Dastan couldn’t bring himself to part with it. After all perhaps this gem was the key to become a legend like those of old.
Physical Description: Dastan is a human, 5'11 ft tall with a well built body. He has tanned skin, shoulder length blue hair and golden eyes. Often wearing ornate clothing that as well as jewelry.

Name: Dawn of Nezmira
Known History:
Dawn of Nezmira, she who was once named "Zero". Once she believed she had nothing, and now with the gift of the Dragonlord of the Dawn Atem she has a new purpose. Many of the Goldhearted would remember her for her odd behaviors and meek appearance. 

Now, Dawn stands proud of who she is and for what she believes in. Entrusted with the legacy of Dragonlord Atem she returned to the ship changed. Now ready to carry on the hopes, dreams and future for the people of Nezmira.
Physical Description: Standing roughly at 5'8 (172 cm) she stands a few inches above average for her people. Before she was malnourished and barely alive. Now, Dawn stands proudly for her people. Gifted with the power of Dusk and Dawn she glows faintly with an golden light. One of her eyes a crimson red and the other a pale turquoise. Proudly she shows off her draconic features, adorning her horns with jewelry to show devotion to the Dragonlord of Dawn.

Name: Deacon Farum
Known History: Deacon grew up in the city of Midholde, son to a wealthy merchant. He never really liked the merchant life much, so he would often sneak out from home in order to spend time with those who traveled through the settlement. Deacon found love in the arts. Singing, acting, story telling, these things brought joy to him, which made him love talking to the travelers all the more. To hear the songs and stories of peoples across the land, it was his dream. He left for quite some time on a trip to see a potential business offer at the behest of his father. When he finally returned to Midholde, he saw its ruins, his family gone, he was by himself. With nothing to his name, he spent no time with grief and went on a journey, not just to fulfill his dream, but as a duty to make sure those who fall will have their stories and songs remembered forever.
Physical Description: Dirty blonde hair, skin white, and eyes green like emeralds. Deacon stands at a height 5'7ft, his physique skinny and average in almost every way, save for the fact that his face is as beautiful as that of an angel. Upon his head is a reddish orange and gold cap adorned with the exotic feathers of orange and yellow birds. He wears baggy and poofy pants alongside a shirt of similar fashion, sporting colors of scarlet and a dark yellow. Around his shoulders and neck is an emerald green scarf of great length, long enough to almost seem like a cape at times. His shoes are rather goofy, but are made of good quality leather.

Name: Dealan-Dè
Known History:
Dealan-Dè was originally a seamstress from the town of Dryholde, tasked with sewing clothing for the townsfolk.  Though she was a master artisan by no means, she was dedicated to her work, and cared greatly about it.

One night, whilst exploring a remote corner of the Gwaed, she saw an entrancing sight out of the corner of her eye; a fragment of silver stone, with a colony of butterflies perched atop it. She approached the location, and touched the stone, causing a cascade of emotions and thoughts to pour forth. Memories of tragedies from the past, strong feelings of relationships she had, be they of love or hate, and a portent of danger approaching on the horizon. Her desire for justice shaped the stone into a blade, and the butterflies instead perched on her. Unsure of what to make of things, but fearful of the future it foretold, she attempted to cut through the darkness surrounding her, and in its wake, found herself upon the Worldhelm, with no guidance from the newfound creatures.
Physical Description:
Dealan-Dè is a remarkabaly short girl, measuring up to 4'7 in height, and weighing 92 lbs. Her features are svelte and eye catching, with hair and eyes of a subtle lavender shade. 

As if to compliment her elegant and dainty appearance, she is followed at all times by a small gathering of butterflies, or at the very least, apparitions that take the appearance of butterflies. With no physical substance, and an appearance that vanishes once in someone's peripheral vision, the ethereal creatures lend to her unique silhouette, making her easy to spot in a crowd.

She clothes herself in flowy, breathable outfits, prioritizing range of motion over protection, making up for it with small bronze plating in some areas. On her hip, even in casual settings, is a beautiful sheathed sword, that she constantly rests her hand upon, as if to ensure it still remains in its proper place.

Name: Dehua and Jiǔ Yǒu
Known History:
Dehua is a cultivator from Xuanwu City, in Wujing Guo. After joining her sect, the Golden Cicada, she learned the art of medicine, and eventually discovered her traveling companion, Jiǔ Yǒu, which set her on track to begin following the Dao of the Drunken Master.

Once the two had joined forces, Dehua's progress increased steadily, with her improvised cures and treatments growing more potent, if less predictable, until one day when her intensive treatment of a patient eventually whisked her away into a Realmstorm, and deposited her on the Worldhelm.
Physical Description: Dehua is a diminutive Bishi'e woman, coming up to 4'10" in height, when her heels and horns are out of the question. She's typically clad in black and gold, and covered in minor scrapes and scratches. Floating behind her at all times, is Jiǔ Yǒu, a drinking gourd with special properties, that seems endeared to Dehua, despite the object itself being unable to speak. It is thanks to this gourd that Dehua seems to always be moving as if she's slightly tipsy.

Name: Desoka Targandr
Known History: Born in the icy wilds of Aldistir to Star-Crossed Lovers, Desoka's life changed after he was abandoned at a young age outside the village of Camp Von Kibo. He has been honing his martial skill since childhood but has always had the innate power over the elements, After reaching adulthood, he decided to use his talents and become a monster hunter. Now known for his cold heart and sharp blade, his deeds only grew as he honed his skills facing the perilous beasts of the realm. After a deadly encounter with a draugr, Desoka finds himself upon the Worldhelm seeking a new purpose as he picks up his sword once again in the hopes of securing his new life and surviving whatever comes next.
Physical Description: A dark skinned young man, about 5'10 in a white combat tunic with a cloak and a large katana with a bronze grip. He has black hair and icy blue eyes, he typically has a mean look about him and always seems to be cold.

Name: Despina — ᵀʰᵉ Deliverance
Known History:
Despina Stripeless hasn't opened up much about her history at Gnosis Academy, but some things are pretty easy to tell about her. Just from the way she acts and carries herself, it's clear she's from Dreadlan, and her look as a Regalia all but screams it at a glance. People with a little familiarity could guess she grew up with Wild Souls, and probably ones living outside Gray Fox Castle. And from some of the things she's answered in questions or shown in practical magic, she knows a bit of the nastier magic Dreadlan's known for.

A student in her third year, Despina has already failed a few classes. She has talent and dedication, having already completed the Rite of Arms, but struggles with book learning. She also struggles with socializing, being clearly more used to the social dynamics of whatever wolfpack she grew up with. (Though she'd tell anyone who *asked* that they were striped hyenas.)
Physical Description:
*Despina:*
5'2" (158 cm)
Curly red hair, shy of chin length
Brown eyes with rectangular pupils
Light brown skin
Spiraling sheep horns
Wooly red tail, fairly long (like an undocked sheep)
Dressed in a Gnosis Academy student's uniform: a pink-purple shirt with gold accents, sleeves flaring at the elbows, with a darker undershirt going to the wrists; a red sash bearing the insignia of the Regal House of Treasures; off-white pants; and oddly shaped boots on her hooves.

*ᵀʰᵉ Deliverance:*
A one-handed axe with a haft that looks to be made of a long femur, cracked at its bottom. It is wrapped with fabric with white and black stripes to make a handle.
The axe is largely dark black, shifting to dark grey as it starts narrowing to the cutting edge. Symbols are etched onto the blade that dully glow when she is using her token magic while in her core.

Name: Devon d'Augustino
Known History: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1q-b_0MDDqucyATSm6KUEtIhzr6c01JfLH1twuY7wFm8/edit
Physical Description: Devon is a 5-foot, 5-inch king. His whole body has been modified to look like a tiger shark, complete with teeth, webs between his fingers, and a fairly long tail. He's got short black hair, coffee-colored irises and the back of his tan-and-sand body is lined with darker stripes all the way down his tail.

Name: Dhata Chamomile
Known History:
Dhata Mithril had worked tirelessly to further one goal: to imbue everyone in Lhodos with psychic abilities. To her mind, it could end Merrane's tyranny for good, elevate humanity, and usher in a new era of unity, peace, and joy in Lhodos. She went so far as to make herself the test bed for this experimentation, becoming an Esper and gaining incredible power at the cost of instability and pain, all in pursuit of this utopia.

For a time, they lost all ambition, and then, all memory. But now, they are prepared to make good on their dreams. To bring the world into a new era. To bring peace, happiness, and hope. To be a hero.
Physical Description: Dhata stands at a little over 5'9", with a rather reedy build. Their skin is dotted with scuffs and bandages from past training injuries. They carry themself with a calm, focused demeanor, their inner turmoil all but settled.

Name: Diu Pham
Identity: Eldest Sister Given A Second Chance
Known History:
Diu, who was once a promising cultivator, has spent most of her life acting as the sole caretaker for her two younger siblings after a spirit beast incident left her family fatherless and her mother despondent. It was a difficult life, but not without it was a warmth.

It was not fated to last, however, as after her sister was arranged for marriage, Diu learned that the suitor was planning on sacrificing her sister in a demonic cultivation ritual. She tried to prevent it with her brother, but the two were too late, and Diu was cut down in the encounter. The next time she opened her eyes, her brother was missing, and she found herself viciously maimed and barely clinging onto the thread of life. 

Her vision was rapidly darkening until a blurred figure appeared before her. Most of what was said became an elongated garble of words except for one thing. A promise at a second chance. What that second chance means is yet to be determined...
Physical Description: A young woman who stands at 5'7. She keeps her hair tied neatly with a single large braid and wears a dress from her home, modified to be more practical for long-distance travel. A distinct spectral quality surrounds her like she's not entirely there.

Name: Dolly Felton
Known History: Dolly comes from the Fae Realm, starting her journey when a travelling artisan mistakenly came across her domain and provided her with laughs and accidentally leaving the tools necessary for tinkering and puppetry— she now looks for said woman whilst exploring the outside with curiosity and explicit interest.
Physical Description: Dolly is a fae, whose physical body outside of her realm consists of a small, stout plushie doll. From the first look, it is not too apparent that the doll is magical, but it is where her spirit is stored, made from a very soft, durable fiber.

Name: Donovan Goodwin
Identity: Ceremonial Dancer With a Penchant for Fooling Around
Known History:
When he was younger, Donovan was a wandering dancer who traveled across Kor'Tarion and put on beautiful performances only to vanish the next day. He didn't stay for long, only using them to earn enough zenit to make it to the next settlement.  
As he arrived to the small town of Dryholde and started setting up for his show, he was approached by a kindly middle-aged man who seemed to be the town's priest. He asked if Donovan had appropriate accommodations for the night. Donovan brushed him off, but he was persistent. He gave in and was brought to the town's orphanage. Despite being 19, he was treated with overwhelming kindness. Donovan fell in love with the sense of community the quaint town had and felt at home there. That night, he put on the most heartfelt dance in his career. Enchanted by the town, he decided to settle down there, becoming a frequent helper at that very orphanage. Spending time with the kids softened him up, and he's developed a love for pranks and jokes as a result
Physical Description: Donovan is a tall, stocky, slightly intimidating human man dressed in plain religious vestments. On his shoulder he carries a long, golden cloth he uses in tandem with his fans for his performances. Despite his grey hair, he is, in his words, "29 years young".

Name: Doragon
Known History:
Doragon is an Ophidiya, born from a human servant and a Nezzim Master in the City of Scales.   Doragon was immediately hidden away or else risk the disgrace of the Nezzim parent’s bloodline.  However, soon it was discovered that Doragon had the ability to shape shift as either pure human or pure Nezzim.  Therefore, Doragon was brought back to “hide” in the Nezzim environment.  However, someone discovered their true natures and the tattling began.  Doragon, having so much love for their mother, left the City of Scales to avoid adding to a possible scandal.
Doragon forged ahead eventually finding their way to City of Sand Sailors where they have been fully excepted by the local citizens while they are in Nezzim form.  However, Doragon has not fully accepted themself and thus begins their inner journey.  They have trained in the ways of Fury which is fuel by their inner turmoil and hate for the Nezzim.  They also have found they have a way with the Elements garnered from the birth ancestr
Origin: The Realm of Nezmira from The City of Scales
Physical Description: 6'5"  and 200 lbs pale skin being with silver scales lining the sides of their head, neck, arms, torso and legs.  Black wings expand from the back and silver horns protrude from their head.  They have white strait hair.  They wear a long combat tunic that looks like a trench coat and have high black boots.  Shirt and pants underneath their tunic.

Name: Dorian
Known History: Dorian was sent by his family to a monastery in the mountains to learn the Fivefold Philosophy, a way to balance out the spirit against both the physical elements and the mental uncertainties that exist in the world. He devoted himself to studying the spear as a means of defense and also centering his mind. He strives to perfect his technique in both areas. Once he finished his training, he took a position at the Fire Shrine, helping protect the shards so research could continue on how their power could be used to reverse the damage that was done when the moon disintegrated.
Physical Description: Dorian is an athletic human of slightly above average height from Kor'Tarion. He has black hair and brown eyes. Height 5'10" Weight 160 lbs

Name: Dr. Eno Somata
Known History:
A doctor who has worked 10 years in biotech, specializing in genum-based health and cognitive tech.

Joined CLAW (QiLink) to apply his science in direct, real-world situations.
Physical Description: Eno Somata is a green haired person who is entirely clad and masked, making his actual appearance difficult to read. He wears a recognizable face mask that has lizard-like features to it. His body seems very lanky, but there is a strange strength to it nonetheless.

Name: Dr. Lawrence Faust
Known History: Nearly twenty years ago, he took out a simple and manageable loan to open a pharmacy with a friend. However, not long after, just as the business was beginning to take a dip, the Baylore Company collapsed. His loan was now in the hands of ETA, and there was little he could do about it. In a stress-enduced bender one evening, Lawrence attempted to return home, intoxicated. Unaware, and delerious, Lawrence stepped out into traffic, and passed away. Since then, he's managed his pharmacy as a diligent, passionless worker, with glazed red eyes. ETA had returned him as an Insolvent, and he was now to work for the rest of days.
Physical Description: Lawrence is a shorter man (5'5''), with pale ashy skin, and faded crimson eyes. His hair is a light gray and he wears a similarly toned suit. He has minimal skin showing, and simple metal jewelry. He's cold to the touch, and has a generally foul aura about him, to those familiar with magic. The boy is undead.

Name: Dull Ahan
Known History: Once a regular man who wanted to defend his hometown from the constant undead threat, he decided to go to the source and take down a necromancer. That necromancer Killed the man and turned the man into a reanimated monster. despite this, he still wanted to do good despite the people of Kor'Tarian treating him as a mindless monster
Physical Description: 6:3 pumpkin headed man with an eternal lite in his eyes and mouth (literally) and eternal sinister smile. He is dressed in raggedy clothing with a cape and coat over his armor. The armor has a massive almost magical gash over its chest and a heart stitch where his heart SHOULD be. he has grafts over his body and clear stitching where he was sealed together

Name: ELK
Known History:
The Fae Realms are a strange place - the fae crossings, only slightly less so. These places where the lands of men and fae meet are more... traversable than anywhere else in these alien lands - but make no mistake: these are still faerie lands. These woods are still dangerous to be in.

But there are rumors. Rumors of an armored figure, wielding weapons bearing no insignia. Rumors of a warrior that declares themselves ally of the innocent, protector of the meek. Rumors of a knight that ensures that even in a place as weird as the realms of the faerie, honor and chivalry still have hold.

This knight is real, and he does not know his name. He does not know his home. He does not know his origin. He knows only his oath, and the code he is sworn to. For strange years he has protected and served as arbiter of the places where men and fae meet... but now he leaves his appointed place, for a question has suddenly pierced his mind:

Who is he?
Physical Description: A well built, 6' tall figure decked in full armor, distinguishable by the mighty anklers on his helm. His arms, though well-maintained, curiously lack any markings or emblems.

Name: Ebb
Known History:
Very little would be known of Ebb, other than that they are a Cecrae. Rumors of a creature that is like Ebb would've started up around fifteen or so years ago around the western shores of Kor'Tarion. A ghost like creature that would watch people gathering Sea Glass or as they fished. While it was never malicious in its actions, many said that seeing it was an omen while others claims it was a blessing.

Stories do not need to be good or bad. Happy or sad, these things do not matter. As long as your story is fulfilling it does not matter how it ends. I am merely a follower in your story, and when needed I will light your way.
Physical Description: Ebb stands roughly around 4' (121cm), and is vaguely shaped as a normal person. Where there would be eyes are faint motes of light, similar to dim stars in the night. Their form matches the color of the space between the stars, a deep blueish black. Coming from the top of their head is a pair of antenna like pieces of 'hair'. Flowing down past their waist is seeming white colored hair, though it fades off into nothingness instead of normal ends of hair.

Name: Echo
Identity: The Fox Who Found His Rhythm
Known History:
Though granted sapience and power as a young kit, Echo holds no particular loyalties to any of the Aesir, including Kuzunoha. His early life was marked by the same strife as countless other residents of Aldistir, crafting barriers in his heart that have remained strong into adulthood. Having been born and raised on the outskirts of Camp Von Kibo, Echo was known to associate minimally with the Aldish and other yokai, preferring his solitude whenever possible. 

Since boarding the Worldhelm, Echo’s growing understanding of connections between his fellow Goldhearted has melted away that desire for isolation, and he finds himself swearing to become a dependable companion for all.
Origin: Outskirts near Camp Von Kibo, Aldistir
Physical Description: A large red fox standing about 3' at shoulder-height and 5' long from nose to bushy tail. Distinguishable as a yokai from the soft golden glow of his eyes and the way wind seems to play a soft tune around him wherever he goes.

Name: Edmund Archer
Known History:
Edmund Archer grew up in the streets of Lastport. From a young age, Edmund learnt quickly about the evils of the elite. Edmund used his pretty looks and charisma to get pity taken on him, using that to rob the rich blind. 

As he grew into a young adult, Edmund learnt how to behaviour as a servant, a common disguise he'd use to hide his identity. He does his best to help out the poor, acting as a sort of robin hood.
Physical Description: Edmund is a 5"4 man with long light blue hair with hazel eyes. He wears a butler's uniform.

Name: Edward Lowell Jr.
Known History: Ed is the owner of a small business known as "The Million Mystery" company. There's only a handful of people working at most, but they do alot of pro bono work for solving closed police cases and even supernatural occurances. Not much else is publically known about this man unless actively dug for on his records. He reeks of silver spoon privilege though.
Physical Description: Ed is a 6'4" decently muscular guy with blonde hair and blue eyes. His physique is often hidden in a nice, custom tailored suit that keeps him sharp. His cologne smells of a dark wood and old spice blend.

Name: Ekho
Known History:
With whatever limited vocabulary they have, a few of the induced hallucinations this one managed to provide, it's been only clear enough that Ekho acted as a warding flower next to the Kiir hives, occasionally taking proteins from fallen creatures. Things have changed when they ended up nursing a young woman back to health, just enough to get her back to safety. On a particularly rough night during the sandstorm, while this one was hiding away in an old sack, that decision ended up making this one eligible for the spot on the ship.

...or so this one recalls.
Physical Description:
To the naked eye, Ekho resembles a green-skinned desert plant in the shape of a young woman, with black eyes and a stretched-out mouth, with a hair bun that allows this one to open their own head as one giant bulb.

Standing about five feet high, this one wears an old linen sack they were thrown in with, with a rope acting like a sash to hold some of their possessions, like water skins and seeds of "little ones". One may also spot this one with a wooden stake they use for movement, gardening and, occasionally, fending off hostile creatures.

Name: Elaine Sejr
Known History:
Elaine grew up in Haven, though where specifically isn't widely known. She travels around in her Van she inherited from her good Uncle, and left her home thereafter without any goodbyes. 

Since then she has been doing on and off jobs for people. Eventually getting into a gig with 100G Security. Though spends most of her time playing games and only working when she has to by her superiors or has bills to pay.

On her van is a sticker for blood and plasma donations.
Physical Description:
Height: 160cm

Elaine is a blonde haired female presenting individual from Terra. Rather petite figure and a patch covering her right eye. Usually wears rather loose clothes and looks mostly unbothered by most things.

Name: Elara Alksnis
Known History:
Orphaned as a child due to Caden Lockflint's direct actions, she was fooled and taken by him as an adoptive daughter and raised to be a Magitech engineer. But her latent magic made it so the Magitech crystals consistently exploded from her touch, causing her to fail at the Academy of Korala.

Caden then severed ties with Elara, forcing her into a mercenary life. He left her with some equipment and two cyborg animal companions for support, of which only Quill remains. She managed to survive through these two years thanks to a band of mercenaries that saw her sharpshooting skills and took care of her.

She became a Goldhearted a year ago, and remained close to other Lhodosian, both from Merrane and Karslgard. She initially hid her relation to Caden, but was accepted even after it was revealed.

Recently, she learned the truth about Caden, and, with the help of Tika and Kviss, she learned to control her Chimeric magic. She then abandoned the surname Lockflint for Tika's Alksnis.
Physical Description: Young white-haired girl with wolf ears and often wagging tail. 155cm (5'1") and 59kg (130lb).

Name: Eleanor Radcliffe
Identity: A cunning Inventor protecting the one she loves
Known History:
Eleanor's life began in a peaceful village, under the watchful eye of her loving family and amidst her parents' experimental workshop. As war encroached, her idyllic life was shattered, forcing her to flee with her family and beloved Elysant. Together, they sought refuge in Bastion, a city that offered a chance to rebuild.

In Bastion, Eleanor and Elysant found strength in their bond, marrying and committing to their new community. Both joined the war effort, driven by a deep sense of duty. While Elysant protected others on the front lines, Eleanor used her skills to fix armors, create weapons, craft elixirs, and take out dangers with the experimental guns gifted by her parents.

Despite the danger, Eleanor's unwavering love for Elysant gave her strength, fueling her determination to survive and build a better world together. Each act of courage was a step toward ensuring they could share another day in each other's arms.
Physical Description: Eleanor has striking blue hair and vibrant green eyes. Her hair, cascading in waves, frames a face that alternates between a serene smile and a contemplative, almost pensive expression. She is mostly seen wearing elegant yet practical outfits. Her signature outfit being a a black cropped top with a high collar. Over her right arm, she has a beautifully designed armored sleeve with intricate gold detailing. The armor contrasts with the softer fabric of her white pants, which are loose and comfortable, tied with a blue sash that complements her overall color scheme. Black knee-high boots complete the look.

Name: Elijah-2615
Identity: A Fleshling of Metal and Magic
Known History:
For those from his school, it is known that Eli is a quiet first year in the House of Paladins who comes from Steelbin. He often needs medical or physical accommodations, and is often missing from class.

For the attentive, it would also be known that he was briefly considered for the House of Regalia before joining the House of Paladins instead.
Physical Description:
A lanky individual, a little over 6'1'' tall, with a face and body hidden inside an environmental isolation suit with a tabard, robes, and sigils atop, giving it the appearance of a strange mage's robes.

He carries a mechanized staff and a tome at his belt, as well as a wide variety of stimulants and medicine at his belt should his body begin to fail.

Name: Eluna
Known History: Despite her fangs there is no vampirism that some may think, neither herself or her village partakes in such practices or have a need to. Having spent a lot of time in an isolated fae village she hasn't interacted much with humans, beyond a few chance encounters in her moments of wanderlust. Very few of her interactions with humans have been outright hostile but many have been afraid of her. However, there have been a few instances that have given her hope music and song might manage to ease some of the discord between the fae and humans. Music and singing mean everything to the village she is from and as such she will not refuse to give an encore if asked and will never willingly leave a song unfinished.
Physical Description: Eluna stands at 5'2" with silver hair, pointed ears and fangs. Most notably though is the faint fire the seems to dance in her the irises of her eyes that grows brighter as she sings.

Name: Elvis Alden
Known History: Elvis will humbly share that he is a former scholar of Hudal Academy. He will perhaps overshare that besides that he has accomplished remarkably little otherwise, especially socially. This is due to having quickly developed into a total shut in who did nothing but study for upwards of a decade. A period of his life he is not... proud of.
Physical Description: A tall, gangly and all too pale Elven fellow. His notable features are his somewhat feminine face, and his absolutely absurd bundle of fluffy red hair.

Name: Elysant Radcliffe
Identity: A Knight Ready to Give it Her All
Known History:
Born in a town that was quickly undone in the conflict of war, Elysant ran to Bastion with her love in hand. There they became refugees in a new home before they picked up the pieces they could to make a life for themselves. There she and her other half married and had joined the war efforts. There she found another way to help those around her. 

Elysant threw herself into danger, protecting those she cared for while doing all she could to make sure that she could return home to the one waiting for her.
Physical Description: A woman who stands at 5'9, she still has an aura of confidence as she rarely falters in her steps forward. Her expression positive as she takes challenges head-on. Beyond that, she often is dressed in armor that is standard for those in Kalsgard with a shield and hammer in hand. Her preference for those things is simpler than the machinery around her.

Name: Ember Wake
Known History:
- Came from a poor family
- Went into debt with ETA to get qualification through higher education
- Worked for Orrery for a long time, and finally got a chance to work in sub-orbital satellite maintenance through a work-visa for the Trans-Orbital Relocation Colum
- Skyfall destroyed many orbital structures, one of which he was working on
- He died, and was brought back as an Insolvent, and then got picked up by a realmstorm only days after
Physical Description: Ember is a 6'5, bulky figure in maintenance gear suited for 0-G and Vacuum usage. His skin is a faded, darker grey with the classical glowing red eyes indicative of Insolvency for Terrans. His beard is trimmed but somewhat shaggy, as is his hair.

Name: Emi
Known History: Emi is the first daughter of a well-to-do corporate family. Tired of the pressure and responsibility, she ran away from home when her uncle died, changed her name, and started a new life as a musician. She's been playing shows and trying to make a name for herself in Haven ever since.
Physical Description: Emi is a short, pretty woman with medium length blonde hair, bright blue eyes, and a slight build. Her hair seems to by styled differently every other day, and always has some streak of bright pastel. Her wardrobe seems to be constantly shifting as well, though short skirts with fun patterns, thigh highs, jackets and crop tops are more common than anything else.

Name: Emil Stoneheart
Identity: Newest Knightly Recruit of the Goldhearted Coalition
Known History:
Those from Snowmaw would know Emil as being a simple guard after being released from being a Brightshield Knight. He became one after he was inspired to become a knight due to the actions of the Goldhearted's Heroism.

Those from the Knights of Brightshield would know Emil as an Aspiring Knight when they had recently joined but they were expelled due to the red moon's events and being half-fae.

Those from the Goldhearted Coalition know Emil from being the latest recruit brought in by one of the knights that serve with the coalition. He's new to the Coalition but has been an active member ever since they joined.
Physical Description: This character has short, fluffy pink hair and striking amber-gold eyes with slit pupils, giving a feline impression that matches their prominent pink fox ears. They stand at a height of 5'9. A small red mark rests on their forehead, adding a mystical touch. They wear white and gold-trimmed armor over a dark turtleneck.

Name: Emile Holdermann
Known History:
Coming from a family of policemen. It wasn't too surprising that Emile had an interest in following in their footsteps. Though a childhood largely comprised of being stuck to a hospital bed made that an impossibility. However, with the assistance of a charity organization and alleged years worth of savings from his parents, Emile was given near full-body cybernetics for a proper chance at life.

After having worked at the investigative branch of the Haven PD under his father for about a year. Emile has had his badge revoked after breaking into a large corpo facility to try and rescue an ally. With his occupation gone, and likely having drawn the ire of his family. Emile looks for direction in life, not having given up on the justice that brought him here.
Physical Description:
Emile can often be observed to be in a relatively calm state, typically either daydreaming or collecting his thoughts. He stands at roughly 5'6" tall, with his visage being mainly that of a canine with doberman-esque appearance and and eyes shimmering a pearlescent white. He is typically seen wearing either relatively casual streetwear or the uniform from his local law enforcement branch. A pretty striking point of interest though is the augmented mechanical left arm, with it's metallic construction readily visible.

When out on the field he can be seen with a blade attatched to his belt and vest. Leaving an impression of close combat being their preference.

Name: Enlai
Identity: Merry Farmhand Entering a Wide World
Known History:
- Resident of Bingchuan village where he earned a living as an ordinary farmer, gifted with a green thumb (or just plain good luck)
- Befriended a Jinshi martialist, Yang Xiang, who exchanges cups over discussing the Dao of the Drunken Master
- A yokai invaded the village and ruined their hard-earned crop, inciting Enlai to chase it furiously
- He unwittingly crossed a realmstorm onto the Worldhelm, and wishes to experience the joys of a broader world
Origin: Bingchuan Village, Jijing Xiantiao, Wujing Guo, Tian Yin
Physical Description: The Vanara stands just over 5 feet tall with a lean toned physique earned from laborious farmwork. Wears peasant clothing, a straw hat slung over his back and a stalk of grass in their mouth. Rarely seen without a smile on his face and a bottle in his hand.

Name: Enoch
Known History:
Enoch's life was fated to be marked with misfortune. As a child, he wandered the streets of Lastport, orphaned and starving, until he was taken in by a passing traveler known as Kannon Maruyama. 

This woman was in truth a communist revolutionary devoted to fight against the world's bourgeoisie, and a swordmaster who held the legendary cursed sword Kisshoten-Ichimonji. Under her wing, Enoch studied the sword and pen, and found a true family.

However, the Kisshoten-Ichimonji's curse built up over time, and Enoch realized that the next bout of unluck would deal grievous harm to his master. He stole the sword from Kannon's study in the hopes of transferring the curse to himself, as gratitude for the home she had given him. Unbeknownst to Enoch, Kannon had followed him, and he watched in horror as she died protecting him from the being that the sword's curse had summoned--the wielder of the Izanami-Ichimonji. 

Since then, Enoch has devoted his life to hunting swords.
Physical Description: A tall, lithe male standing at about 5'9'', with locks of grey hair that fall to his shoulders. His dress lacks ostentation, instead emphasizing practicality and durability, such as a padded mercenary jacket or hidden half-plate armor. The two swords he most often carries are Meteor, his personal longsword with a dark meteoric-iron blade, and the Kisshoten-Ichimonji, a legendary cursed katana with a beautiful crimson scabbard. Sometimes, people swear they can see large furry ears on his head, but it's just an illusion of his hair.

Name: Ephraim
Identity: A Mercenary Who Swallows his Sadness
Known History:
A nightmare, fires roaring through the village. It wasn’t supposed to be like this. The cries were deafening, and there was no sign of orders to stop. Men were descending like wolves, releasing an anger that had lain beneath the surface. These were his fellows, his comrades. They were no longer human. Ephraim shields his eyes, wishing to be anywhere else.

He wakes in a sweat. The stray dog he brought home licks his face, and he is returned to the present. Dawn. He had work to do, the bounty board would be empty and then so would his stomach if he didn’t hurry. To think… If his old crew saw him chasing down criminals, they would have called him a traitor, a dog brought to heel by the Nezzim. 

He wasn’t sure they were wrong. Sometimes it was meaningful work. Many men he brought in were wolves themselves. But other times it felt like he was the boot being placed on someone’s neck.
Physical Description: Ephraim is a mercenary with an easygoing attitude. He stands at 5'11'' and has hair the color of tarnished bronze.

Name: Epsilon
Known History:
They have a Master's in chemistry for fuck's sake. Why is his boss holding their reins so tightly when it's clear he can pour and mix circles around everyone else. They even set himself up with that efficiency upgrader, just to get that bonus to make rent in the small apartment they share with his partner.

God. They wish that he could open his own shop. All of the regulars here and half of the others would follow them there.
Physical Description: Epsilon Affogado, a tall guy with light brown skin, a hot enough body, and currently white techhair, enjoys bartending.

Name: Erin Shephard
Known History:
Erin, or known as Erin-31 by those in Steelbin, was born in the civilized zone of the reflection. There she was raised with her brother Anthony where they had a simple life with her parents being mechanics for Machina. 

Erin is far from the ideal paladin, having been able to join the academy due to her brother's recommendation to his patron. Whether or not it was a poor investment is still up in the air, though, as while her mechanical skills have improved, she continues to only barely pass on her grades. If only she applied herself more to school.
Physical Description: Erin is a 5' 10 young woman with tan skin and shaggy brown hair. She is often seen in her uniform though it has the wear and tear of being in it when she is both training and working. A mechanical board is often slung over her shoulder that has become a staple for many who see her.

Name: Eris L'arca
Known History: Eris grew up in a forest of Fae, spending her time performing dances with her family, spending every moment of every day in celebration. However, she woke up one day to find the party had mysteriously moved on elsewhere, leaving her in a fit of confusion and unrest. She desperately wandered through the chaos of the Fae Realms to find her family, eventually stumbling into a Fae Crossing, where she suddenly finds herself in a small but bustling town in the middle of Kor'Tarion's fields, constantly under attack by the darkness spilling from the realm. Seeing Kor'Tarion's suffering, she learns to fight the darkness to bring light and happiness to the realm. After a time, the town is suddenly struck by a Realmstorm. Eris had no time to react, getting pulled into the storm and onto the floating ship of the Worldhelm, where she finds herself lost once more. She sets off to become an adventurer to find her lost family, and bring hope and freedom to the rest of the realms.
Origin: The Faerie Realm and Ruined Kingdom of Kor’Tarion
Physical Description:
Eris is a Faerie with many rabbit-like features standing at 4'1". Small, but with plenty of presence. She has dark fur with a bright blond muzzle and short, puffy white hair with springy rabbit ears poking out from the top of her head and bright white eyes. Her favorite attire for dancing is a flowing green two-piece cloth adorned with flower patterns that leaves plenty of room for her to breath during her performances. A small, round fluffy rabbit tail sits on her lower back. 
During her dances, she sprouts bright glowing wings that seem to radiate with the colors of a peacock, leaving a torrent of feathers in their wake, which often depends on the dance she performs.

Name: Ernest
Known History:
Ernest was a city guard in Hedgeberg for most of their life. Within the city walls they settled down, and with their spouse they started a family.
One day, when they returned from their night shift, they found their only child missing. Unbeknownst to Ernest, they were taken aboard the Worldhelm.
Once every attempt to find their child failed, sadness and helplessness started to kick in. They retired and grew distant from the other people in their life. Most of their days were spent polishing their old uniform, checking every surface of their motorcycle for bumps or dirt and mindlessly carving figures or tools out of wood.
Very recently, they noticed a surprising calling, a rare feeling of purpose. They were led to the Worldhelm, and embarked on it in a search for... something, anything.
Physical Description:
"An older human. Their face is ugly with age, but their lineaments still have a softness to them. Their white hair is usually messily tied back, and it is not uncommon to see them wear a beret or cap.
They are always dressed with modest clothing, kept to near perfection.
Their posture is usually weary and tense; could it simply be the weight of their years?
Strange, they only go by their first name."

Name: Eurydice
Identity: Aspiring Weapon Saint Walking the Path
Known History:
- Eurydice was born within the Bazaar, not only an accidental birth but one believed to be born stillborn or sickly if the birth was even successful. 

- she had a normal upbringing, her father a blacksmith and her mother a merchant so life within the Bazaar was tame for her. Her parents were Keepers of the 4th Grave, Ogum.

- however, at a very young age she was discovered to be a Herald, a walker of Eminence's Path. 

- due to this, she was picked up by the Seven Slaying Arms Sect and trained under them to better foster her abilities. 

- either by her own desires, or the sects, to better honor the Path of Eminence, they set out to conquer an impossible challenge of taking a pilgrimage to the 5th grave, Apep.

- many lost their lives on this pilgrimage, and once they did get to the grave they were attacked by ghosts and spirits. Eurydice herself doesn't remember fully what happened.

- Eurydice now has a connection to ghosts and the Afterlife, having spirits bound to her.
Physical Description: A woman that doesn't stand too tall, only at around 5'4, 5'5 if the day is going well for her. Her hair a stark white like the color has been shocked out of it, half her head shaven as long loose strands of hair hang down one side of her hair. When open her eyes are a sterling silver, a glint in them as if she's seeing more then she should. Adorned in golden jewelry and a mantle of white feathers along her shoulders, her clothes the simple wear of a traveling exorcist. On her person are always an assortment of weapons be them swords to firearms. Most notably are two, one a simple blade perfectly made for her while the other is a broken sword once made for two hands but now fits one. Always, spirits or other ghostly figures are near her person as if tied or drawn to her. A constant friendliness and passive gentleness to her nature.

Name: Evelyn Mayer
Known History: Evelyn is a part of the Crow's Crew - a pirate ship that sailed both on water and through the air - that went along the Boundless Ocean. The main goal to pillage and otherwise steal from Merrani ships and selling to whoever else while seeking any treasure or otherwise that could be found in more extreme regions of Lhodos under the noses or in direct conflict with the various elementals that exist on Lhodos.
Physical Description: Evelyn stands at 5'9" with their messy blue hair only tied up with the ponytail behind then. A eyepatch over one of their eyes as they dress in an almost ostentatiously and aggressively in pirate fashion.

Name: Ezra White
Known History: A freedom fighter from Nezmira. He spent his youth hiding away from the world, his disabled caretaker taught him how to fight. When he came of age he began fighting against the oppression the people of Nezmira faced from the lizards. However on his last mission he was killed. But a young woman managed to connect their souls together. They live separate lives but beat the same heart.
Physical Description: A cat-eared skinny young man. He dresses primarily in red, tattered clothes, jewelry hang from his body. As if he wants to be the centre of attention.

Name: Fable
Known History:
They awoke, cold and alone in the darkest corner of Kor'tarians woods. But not alone? Feelings, needs, duties? A guiding ghost of dozens of histories that is there and not. But they see the threads, in everything, and know that it is their duty to bind them.

But this world is so cruel, so bitter, and there are so few, certainly none alike them. Do they do as they are compelled? Or do they do as they feel they must? A world in peril needs heroes. They cannot be a hero, but perhaps they can be a heroes hero. If Destinies villains draw blades and blood, so too shall they in defense of the fated hero. Oh but so many have fallen this way despite their best efforts.

But here, a higher purpose? A greater opportunity? They will take it, and see where it takes them.
Physical Description:
Fable is a tiny little thing, still standing as tall as they can at 4' total (but they float to about 5'7", usually) A body, bleak as ink, is blotted with tufts of fluffy snow-white fur. Flanking each side of their head are two perky, long ears like a rabbits, and a crown of jagged horns like those of an upturned buck. A floofy white tail, like a wolves sways behind them, and their slender legs end in a pair of tiny paws. They are decorated with muted cloths of black, and blue, bits of armor and metal protecting important bits. A large, blue-green gem hangs off their neck on a thick loop.

In total shadow, their moony yellow eyes breach the dark, as do the ends of their horns, and the bases of their ears in an eerie white and violet glow.

Name: Fabri Caetspells
Known History:
Coming from the famous "Caetspells" Family, she was raised as a point of controversy, because despite being part of said famous high lifes, she was a supposedly a mage. Despite being called and trained as a spellcaster her whole life, she simply could never get the hang of casting spells. it never clicked, but her brand was created and the public had there eyes on her, so she went to her inventor uncle, Dupal, to help. He created forms of micro spells that makes it look like she is actually casting spells! This and the brand her mother, Vindi, created the storms sweetheart! a new face to magic to make it more friendly and light hearted. Regardless, Fabri is going to try and be the best heroine she can be!

How much of fabri's upbringing had good intentions? 
Whos to say!
Physical Description: A smaller slightly wider woman with sparkly eyes and large poofy curly hair tied back with blue highlights in it. She is dressed as a lightning themed magical girl with slight Mechanical accessories, including her gloves that has her magispheres inside. She also has a cute little umbrella as her spellcasting implement

Name: Fafnir
Known History: Once a Patron Angel of Asga made of Ivory with a beautiful and immaculate warrior’s form, now entirely changed into human’s form from the melding and twisting of blood, madness and dozens of bodies into one into the appearance of a mix of mankind and demonic creature with features like that of a dragon. In the Three Faced God’s ruination of Idyll they lost everything including their name. What now sticks is the name Fafnir, due do the extreme violence they radiate from their presence, features and uncomfortable heat the pours from their body. Seeking vengeance for the one who brought murder into their home and protecting the layer from those who were twisted by madness.
Physical Description: Tall with a head of red hair like blood and fire, eyes that smolder like the inside of a volcano. Red scales lineing different parts of her body in clusters from her scaled and clawed hands and around her neck. Two black horns coming from the top that curve and curl into sharpened points along with large black wings that sprout out from the back. She stands at 6'3 normally, constantly radiating warmth and at times under certain situations smells of blood.

Name: Fancy Mouse
Known History: An Orphan, Mikkel fights to have his parents returned to him, and justice dealt to all who deserve it.
Physical Description: A man with decent looking features, but ones that would allow him to blend into a crowd. He has bright blue eyes and dirty golden hair. His skin is weathered, with decent scaring. Mikkel stands before you at 5'9, weighing a lean 210lb.

Name: Fang
Known History:
A bright, bubbly, and enthusiastic wilkin, Fang grew up as the adoptive son of a low-ranking member of the Merrani Angels. Trained from a young age towards a future at the WWA, Fang's ambitions, much to his father's chagrin, leaned more towards fashion than securing peace. Though one would be remiss to believe Fang's trainings with blades and minor magitech have garnered no results, as he utilizes the techniques learned both in combat and in pursuit of his work as a fashion designer. 
After finding himself drawn through a Realmstorm to the deck of the Worldhelm, Fang was enthralled with wide-eyed wonder at the idea of the intermingling of the fashions of multiple realms, and seeing what his muse could seek out amongst them all.
Fang's father, by contrast, upon being excitedly told the news on a return trip, sees Fang's status as a, pun intended, golden opportunity to spread the Edict of Savior beyond Lhodos' borders, and thus encouraged his wayward son on his journey.
Physical Description:
A quite effeminate young man with a lithe build, Fang stands at around 5'4" and 102 lbs. A pair of canine ears poke above a head of light auburn hair, tied back in a 'stylishly unkempt' ponytail and pigtails combo. A matching tail often swishes eagerly below any number of cute outfits, many of which were tailored by Fang himself.
He often wears a pair of odd gloves: stylish, but with a dull humming of magitech woven through the fabric that allows him to manipulate the small blades he utilizes in both dressmaking and combat.

"I'm not a girl, I'm just FABULOUS <3"

Name: Fenn
Known History: Formerly associated with the Autumn Court, Fenn was kicked out of the Feywild after a prank gone wrong.  She was imprisoned by a noble in Lastport, from which she escaped and fled to the Gwaed Forest.  She survived by stealing from various settlements and travelers, and amused herself by playing tricks on humans.
Physical Description: Fenn is a short foxlike humanoid with a wild mane of hair.  She wears a ceramic white mask, behind which can occasionally be seen emerald green eyes.  She wears fairly simple clothes often dull in color.

Name: Fernia
Known History: Fernia was just a simple traveler and botanist who had gone out to the Irathwood to find some flora to study and perhaps gather some seeds from to sample. Little did she know that as she started pushing deeper into the woods that something had been stalking her. Eventually she came upon a strange flower she had not previously seen, and it was while studying this flower that whatever had been stalking her struck. She does not remember what had attacked her but when she woke she found the plant that she had been studying seemed to have moved from where it was growing onto and into her body. Its roots seeming to have stitched up the wounds. She could feel its roots beneath her skin, in a panic she tried to pull the plant from her body but when she did she was wracked with pain as it felt was was trying to pull her own veins out. She isn't sure what exactly the plant is but has learned it seems to be what is keeping her alive.
Physical Description: Pale skin and white hair due to the color being drained from them. Dresses modestly with most of her body covered and has an eye patch over her right eye. Seems to wear several flowers in her hair. But with close impaction or high observation skills can tell those flowers are actually growing from her body.

Name: Finnley
Known History: Some people like to stay in one place , Make a home, But that's not for everyone some people like to roam and wander exploring what's out there, Finnley is one of those.... except he got lost and didn't realise till it was too late... WELL best not to dwell on that and keep moving forward in that case .
Physical Description: An average height individual of slim build adorned in "stylish" attire ,and pale hair

Name: Fionne
Known History:
A young adult witch hailing from Draenog, Kor-Tarian. At a tender age, in a different time, she found herself lost in the woods, eventually stumbling into the Fairy Realm, where an old fairy took pity on her. For many years, she resided there, aging and honing her magical skills under the tutelage of the warmhearted fairy. She became proficient in the arts of magic and potion-making, dedicating herself to healing fairies and other enchanted creatures alike. However, as time passed, the overwhelming magic of the realm became too much for her, compelling her to return to the human world. Yet, upon her return, she found that much had changed in her absence.

Resettling in Draenog, she utilized her skills to aid those in need. Alongside her, the Construct Flying Broom Stratus accompanied her from the Fairy Realm—a parting gift from her savior.

Then, she stumbled upon the Worldhelm, deciding to join its journey in an attempt to reclaim the wondrous life she once had in the Fairy Realm.

Name: Flare
Identity: A man who will never grow old
Known History:
Flare isn't shy about talking about his situation when asked. The magiseed embedded in his chest saved his life with its magic a long time ago and his body healed around it. 

Someday, this plant will constrict Flare's heart, killing him.
Physical Description:
Flare is 6'/183cm and 150lbs/68kg. He sports a head of "Hair" comprised of purple leaves. Though it does cause mild pain to pluck them out, he isn't terribly bothered by it, or by people who take interest in his unconventional physicality. 

Along with veins that show slightly through his pale/olive skin, keen observers will also notice a network of roots that spread through what little of his body Flare deigns to show. In combat, he rolls his sleeve upwards, revealing the magiseeds that are imbedded on his forearm. By channeling his magic, the seeds are temporarily "activated" and bloom to impart beneficial effects through their pollen. 

There is a single, larger magiseed imbedded in Flare's chest. The plant in question here is deep-rooted and has coiled itself around many of Flare's bones, making it slightly harder for him to move around.

Name: Florian Valstrider
Known History:
Born the second child of a nature mage father (one of few in Forest Home), and his war hero mother, he and his sister (Isabella) studied the traditional ways of magic and magical beasts. But Isabella went to join White Wing Academy, wanting to combine traditional magic with the piloting of mechs. Far too soon they were told she died in combat.
He felt it right, then, to follow her path with her mech Andromeda. Spreading magitech seemed to be a way to a brighter future – clear from contrasting the smog of the South with Caldera’s beauty. At the Academy he felt far from home, and learning to pilot was hard.
Recordings from Isabella inside the mech helped him learn. However, when he reached the final one it was purely dark. But he could hear his sister cursing, a struggle, and then silence. He knew in an instant he couldn't stay. That something was terribly wrong. With Andromeda stored, and his thoughts swirling, he snuck to the woods as a storm picked up and the world began to spin.
Physical Description: Moderately tall, and wiry for a would-be soldier, Florian dresses in a variety of well-tailored paints and vests with a long formal coat. Soft leather boots, suited for hiking, are the only part of his outfit that would suggest he was anything different than the average Merrani young noble or academy student. Wearing glasses over green eyes, his intricate staff and a crystal amulet tucked under his vest are the only weapons and/or magitech visible.

Name: Flynn Hyacinthus
Known History: Despite his appearance, Flynn was born to a poor family in Tradefair. His father, unknown to him, left Flynn's mother before he could ever remember. He did his best to help support his mother in any way possible, even at a young age. Taking odd jobs as a mercenary or whatever else he could find. Though now, his story has taken a drastic turn that he now realizes has been the best change in his life. He arrived in Worldhelm a year ago. During that time, he has made countless friends and found a family among these fellow Goldhearted. Now, with the aid of the Trueheart Coalition, he realizes that his dreams are even closer to a reality than he ever believed. With recent developments, he often spends more time in Tradefair working under his fiancée Victoria Voclain to further their goals of becoming nobles. After assisting Song-5 and other Goldhearted in the battle against Kor'Tarion's Utopian, Halycon. Flynn pledged himself to the Court of the Goldhearted.
