Physical Description: Flynn stands roughly around 5'5 (165cm), decorated in noble styled clothing and different jewelry. On top of his head is a pair of cat ears with tuffs of fluff coming out of them. A large, fluffy tail that often tucked beneath his cloak. His hair a natural blonde, being normally unkempt despite his best efforts. An aura of confidence and chivalry comes from him and his actions. A smile always present on his face.

Name: Forest Smith
Known History:
Born into a family of civil engineers. It was only natural for Forest to pick up a similar interest. Having at first expressed mild interest in computers. He and his brother Austin got hooked on RWO. As they both got further into the game, the difference between them kept growing. While Forest was okay at the game, Austin was well on his way to becoming one of the top players. Knowing the potential money involved, and also because of his performance in education, their parents started primarily focusing on Austin and his career. Leaving Forest to the sidelines.

Forest's future didn't turn out as fantastical, as he had to rely on one of his few friends from RWO to vouch for him. This led to him finding employment at a small Tubal and Cain subsidiary called Sodalite Workshop. However, with money being tight, Forest has to work as a Temp in his free time in order to continue to live comfortably. He does not mind though, as he enjoys helping out the locals.
Physical Description: Standing at roughly 5'11" in Height. Though, to some, they might be seen as shorter due to their terrible posture. Forest is one of a decent few who have partaken in extensive body modification, with his Image particularly looking like a spotted hyena. His hair is gray and his eyes are green, other than the right eye which has gone gray from blindness and injury. He is often seen to be wearing bland, cheap, yet comfortable attire. Be it large T's, sweatpants, or hoodies, all at most have two colors each if they aren't just black. Forest can also be seen with a large case and a backpack on his back.

Name: Fox Kensington
Identity: Lieutenant Fox Kensington, Loyal Officer of the Merrane Empire
Known History:
Born in Caldera, the Capital of the Merrane Empire, Fox Kensington comes from a long line of loyal Imperialists who served Emperor von Merrane's army since the earliest days of the war. The youngest of four children, Fox was conscripted into the Imperial Army at the age of 18. He first served as a footsoldier but was then later trained as a Cavalryman with the 8th Imperial Calvary Regiment at the age of 21. 

IAs his career progressed and the war grew more in scope, Fox rose from a lowly private to a fully fledged Lieutenant; having only lost two Automaton Steeds in his nine year Career. In his most recent operation against the KPLA, A weather anomaly occured and caused mass chaos on the battlefield. Soldiers on both sides of the front were considered either KIA or MIA in the aftermath of the storm's disappearence, including Lieutenant Kensington.

If only they knew the truth.
Physical Description: Fox Kensington is a young man in his mid to late 20s. He stands at a height of six feet and one inches tall with dirty blonde hair. espresso brown eyes with a 5 o’clock shadow growing across his androgynous face.

Name: Freddy The Chef
Known History: Freddy's story starts in a small village in Kal'Tarion. His family was descended from a moderately powerful fire mage who abandoned magic upon the moon falling. Eventually losing almost all their connection to the element of fire until Freddy was born with an affinity for it. With that fiery soul came a passion for cooking. His fascination began when he was 5 years old and has grown since. He would spend time going to the town library to learn more about cooking and happening upon a book for cooking monsters. Which only added to potential culinary ideas in his head. Spending the next few years looking up and trying to cook various things he eventually turned his sights to monsters when he felt his food needed more. He took up learning as much as he could about monsters and spent some time training before going out to kill some common and considered relatively weak monsters. This hubris got him a scar that he uses as a reminder. Now he travels to find monsters and rare ingredients.
Physical Description:
Height: 5'11"          Eyes: Red
Weight: 195 lbs     Hair: Light Red
Chest has a scar from his first battle against monsters. It is in the form of 3 claw marks.

Name: Fuji
Known History:
Fuji Iwai was born in Twin Peaks, to a nomadic group of Birdlike Yokai.

5 years ago, during an attack on her nomadic family, she was captured and enslaved by Sakura the Skalded.

Her wings were clipped to prevent escape, and also for the madman's amusement, being a fan of irony. Instead of being used as an experiment, she was tasked with handling toxic reagents.

This exposure to dangerous chemical mixtures and general maltreatment caused her to lose most of her memory.

At a point in her captivity, she was given the call of the edge.  In a spur of decisiveness, she ran, as far as she could. She followed her urge, hoping it would bring her safety.

She was cornered at the edge of a cliff, was she forced to make the choice of life in servitude, or freedom no matter the cost. With a scared breath, and the yelling of her master behind her, she stepped off the ledge.

Before she could meet her demise, she was swallowed by a realmstorm. Her life starting a new chapter.
Physical Description:
Fuji stands at slightly below average 5'6. She has emerald green eyes and hair like snow, she also has small animal ears on the back of her head. her body wiry and pale, strength that may have once been there seems barely a specter. 

Her wings are truly the sorriest sight to see, feathers burned and plucked deliberately with seemingly regular intervals. The pride and joy of any bird, what helps them fly, has been clipped. Now only serving as a reminder. 

Her face is surprisingly clean. Her forearms are covered in scars and burns. All of which she hides underneath some leather bracers. Her feet are scarred too. Still bearing some punishment from the day she was forced to flee on foot instead of flying away.

Name: Fuyuki Omura
Known History: When Fuyuki was still a child, his family had to move to Merrane for economic reasons.  In that completely new environment, however, he had several problems being with his peers and found himself isolated: the people he had met in that city were too different from Fuyuki and he couldn't understand them.  Eventually, as much as his spirit could stand, he fell into a period of depression wanting to end his life: one day he began running out of the house, heading far away and towards a cliff from which he threw himself, but this did not die thanks to a traveler who managed to save him.  The Wanderer then told him everything about his life experience.  From that story Omura decided to follow the goal that the savior also had: to be able to help all the people who need it.  Before leaving, the Wanderer will show him the dawn: with a vermilion sun and the sky with pink and orange ripples of the sky: "See? Even if there will be night in your mind, somewhere there will always be a dawn"
Physical Description: Fuyuki is a young man with slightly wavy, short, dark brown hair and narrow, dark brown eyes.  His bangs frame his face, while some are gathered in the center of his forehead.  He is 1.81m tall and weighs 67kg and especially likes to wear black, brown or white clothes

Name: Gabirel Moonfallen
Known History:
Gabirel was born inside a cult, worshipping the now shattered moon. The cult believed the moonshards would bring them closer to their moon, making them more monstrous. At age 20, Gabirel was forced to be transformed, the cult using a moonshard to corrupt their body. With a new monstrous body, they escaped, fleeing deeper into the woods. 

Years passed, Gabirel become a traveling self-proclaimed monster who seeks to free people from their shackles and to pursue their passions. They do their best to guide others to freedom. They are now simply a priest without a god. Eventually, they found themself in a realmstorm and encountered the Worldhelm.
Physical Description: A six foot lean androgynous person, covered all over in white feathers with two large white wings on their back. They have clothing that covers part of their head and neck. Their chest is mostly exposed (they have a male body) and they have a skirt made out of their own feathers down to knee length. They have bird like claws instead of hands and feet.

Name: Gabu
Known History:
- Formerly the incarnation of the demon of Envy, whose essence was tampered with by the Dream Weaver to create something less dangerous
- He spent 72 years claiming a semblance of humanity, eventually making a name for himself as Gabu, protector of the Mirland Coast
- Eventually, to save a friend they turned back into his old form, temporarily regaining his more demonic and envious persona.
- During the confrontation with Loftur, he showed his best self and reclaimed his Gabu-ness.
- Was finally turned into something more by the Queen of Hearts, Song-5.
Other Names: Sir Gabu, First Knight of Dryholde
Physical Description:
The Protector of the Mirland Coast takes on the appearance of a young man wearing flowing clothes, with white hair and red eyes. What remains of his demonic origin are just his sharp, sharklike teeth - all in all, he looks like a pretty normal guy!

He's usually carrying a kite or two on him, since he loves flying them with friends!

Name: Gaius Decimus
Identity: Seeker searching for a new Dawn
Known History: Originally born in Last Hold, Gaius came into contact with several key aspects of the Culture of the empire early on: Being oppressed due to being a human, the branding and exploitation of mages and the hunters, going out into the desert to cull the Kiir. All of this has influenced him to go out into the desert himself, to escape the constant oppression, but also to hide his nascent magical abilities from the Nezzim. He became a skilled hunter relatively fast, but much changed when he stumbled upon an old stone tablet, talking about Falak-khan in the Short Peaks. He had heard rumours of this god in the past, but was now completely fascinated with him.  Nowadays, he's wandering the dunes, trying to find a sign of this god to enkindle the spirits of his fellow oppressed  against the Nezzim. To this end, he's seeking out everybody who might know more about the ancient stories, but also talking to other people, especially hunters, to slowly spread the tales and a hope for a new dawn.
Physical Description:
Gaius is of average high, but is obviously quite fit. His mid length hair is a wavy, dirty blonde and the most striking feature of his face are the odd-coloured eyes. One is brown and one is blue. He tends to wear rather light clothes under his armour and when he can he at least carries his weapon everywhere, but quite often he can be seen with his shield as well. 
While he often looks serious or even anguished, he has a light smile and a friendly demeanour once people talk to him, which can clash with his martial appearance.

Name: Gareth
Known History:
He has lived in Idyll for as long as he can remember. He was originally born on Terra, but the memory has faded such that he doesn't know what his life there was like. He doesn't even remember how long he'd been in Barza when he met Mya. She was exactly what he needed to face the layers of Idyll-- quick and decisive when he was uncertain, ruthless and cutting when he was gentle. They made a good team. They made their way down over the course of years, until Gareth could scarcely remember a time before he had Mya. Down they went, layer by layer, until they got stuck in the sands of Sum. And when she hardened too much, when she turned to stone... he couldn't lose that. 
For the last two years, Gareth has been painstakingly moving Mya's statue with him through the sand. He is determined to find a way to fix her and bring her with him when he finally escapes Idyll for good.
Physical Description: Gareth is tall and pale blonde, with tan skin and dark eyes. He dresses in light layers and carries everything  he owns in a bag strung over his shoulders.

Name: Gianna Tomaris
Identity: Magically Unstable Owner of a Maid Café
Known History:
Gianna arrived to the Worldhelm at her life's lowest point, when she had just lost everything - her family, her home, her beloved inn - to the fire.

Once settled to the ship, she began working towards the objective to create a place where Goldhearted can feel safe and at ease, and maybe even get pampered a bit: thus, the Golden Hearth was born, thanks to the help of many people who believed and keep believing in the project.

The fountain doesn't call to her very often, so one would almost always easily find her at the Hearth... or hanging out at the Future's Anvil
Physical Description:
Gianna stands at 5'11'', carrying herself proudly and elegantly with a stylish walking cane she retains from a period of struggle. She can be usually seen in a maid's attire, complete with even an apron filled with pockets where she keeps all sorts of useful stuff. Lately, she picked up on dressing with more casual clothes, too. Whatever her outfit, she always wears her magical gauntlet, since it tends to react violently when separated from her.
Brown eyes, brown hair kept loose that seem to be burning at the tips

Name: Gin
Known History:
Formerly a slave of the Oni who reside in the Shrine of Inexorable Tides, this past is far behind Gin at this point. 
Having received the acknowledgement of several entities including Musashi the Sword Saint, Nobunaga the Last Warlord of the War of Heaven, and Tsukuyomi, the goddess of the moon, Gin has been thrust into the role of becoming the future Emperor of Teisei. 
Whether he is ready, or willing, at this point, is no longer relevant. Destiny has forged his path and he will not deviate from it.
Origin: Tian Yin, Teisei, Shrine of Inexorable Tides
Physical Description:
A lithe swordsman with feminine features, Gin stands at roughly 5'3"/160cm. Cerulean hair cascades over sapphire eyes and porcelain skin.

Their neutral expression conveys mixed feelings. A stern countenance wrought by grief and obligation, but a soft look in their eyes that conveys deep empathy for the pain of others.

Name: Gladiolus Amendola
Known History:
A septid from an apparently well-off family from South Rock, Gladiolus used to be a problem child, usually getting into trouble and being a bully at school. They used to take almost everything for granted, until they reached 14.

At the death of their parents they were left with a two years old brother to take care of and, most concerning, all of their parents' debt being transferred to their name. Turns out, you can fake a pretty good life if you know where to borrow your money.

They signed a contract with ETA to at least try repay those millions they now owe the company, leaving school and starting to work almost immediately. They resolved to be a better person, too - or at least try.

After fourteen years of work, the dent they made in that debt is smaller than they hoped. But they *will* escape insolvency and give their brother a better life.
Physical Description:
A slim and flimsy looking septid that seems to always be walking around dancing from joy. They usually dress in heavy clothes that cover all of their body, complete with gloves and turtlenecks - those are not negotiable. Strong cinnamon smell.
They have a tail-like implant that serves absolutely no purpose other than the fact of them having a tail, and oddly sharp teeth.
Bright yellow hair and heterocromic eyes, one being yellow and one grey. They say it's because they're part of ETA, their friends say it's a contact.
Always acts friendly, always happy to share their KAIJU or to lend a hand to people in need. After all, that's what friends do, right? Don't worry - *you'll repay me later ^^*

Name: Godric ~~Ashmont~~
Known History:
Godric Ashmont was the sole heir to the wealthy Ashmont merchant family at Brightshield. He became a talented mage despite disapproval from his family. After a certain incident, he renounced his surname and left them.

He became a mercenary in Tradefair for two years. But his "knightly" behavior and repeated failures to follow orders led to him being kicked out of three prominent guilds. He then resorted to menial labor or service jobs, but the Ashmont influence behind the curtains made sure he stayed jobless. While on his way to Hudal Academy, he was picked up by a Realmstorm.

He had much more success as a Goldhearted, acting boisterous and blabbering about being a hero. But repeated failures to protect those he cared about, as well as the nature of Tian Yin, have more than humbled him.
Physical Description:
Godric stands at 183cm (6'0"), most often clad in a white and gold armor, complemented by a large ornate shield and a permanently sheathed sword at his side (it's actually a wand). Sometimes he's seen wearing a simple Lhodosian attire of a black shirt and pants.

He has been looking consistently exhausted, but still responds in the usual unnecessarily chivalrous manner. His armor has also been renovated, offering more protection but being visibly heavier.

Name: Graveyard
Known History:
Brittle Winter Ground, The Graveyard Empty and Still, Welcoming the Warmth is a living person.

They must remind themselves of this fact from time to time. In their life of relative solitude, they either meditate alone, tend to the shrine and graveyard they live at or combat the occasional antagonist that approaches.

But they do not complain about such an honorable task, to watch over the Temple of Broken Blades. They were busier some decades before, but now it seems that their graveyard is emptier.

Oh well, they surmise. Soon, they will be given another task with great import. For now, they will make some more tea and meditate.
Origin: Teisei, Tian Yin [The Temple of Broken Blades]
Physical Description: Light brown skin, a youthful and hale visage, empty yellow eyes, and wisdom that also forgets how much time has passed.

Name: Grimalkin II
Known History: Grimalkin II is the son of a feral creature with whom he shares his namesake. This creature happens to be his mother, and the two shared a strong familial bond; before suddenly, Grimalkin II awoke one day, alone and seemingly abandoned. No longer was he the creature that he once was either, as he now had a new bipedal form, and the ability to understand and use spoken language for the first time. He understood this to mean that he had been gifted by the goddess Kuzunoha; however, he could not understand what this meant for his mother nor her disappearance. His search was dramatically cut short wherein mere hours after his transformation, Grimalkin II found himself chosen by a strange vessel and whisked away to adventure.
Physical Description: Grimalkin II is reminescent of a calico cat (albeit much larger), with the apparant mannerisms of housecat. The similarities stop there however, as Grimalkin II now walks on his hind legs for most of his immediate travel, he dawns a colorful cloak as a form of attire, and his tail is split in two at the base. When in his beastial form, Grimalkin II returns to his quadrapedal stride, and his body grows in proportion to that of a true coeurl (9feet long, 600lbs).

Name: Grün
Identity: Calm Woodsman with a Heart of Gold
Known History: From a lineage of woodsmen blessed by the trees for their service in protecting the woods, Ancestors were Lumberjacks. Word of tragedy and horrors in the world had reached him and so he went forth to aid any who would need of it.
Physical Description: A broad man who would seem entirely human if not for his body being green. He is adorned in a cloak of grass.

Name: Guo Mùchén
Known History: A humble and quiet guardian of the hidden village within Jijing Xiantiao. Someone who for a while now has kept to themselves and only focused on guarding their home, not much is known about the man. Due to being a Jinshi, avid user of Body Cultivation, though his own personal Cultivation stems from Blood Cultivation.
Origin: Tian Yin, Wujing Guo, Jijing Xiantiao, Bingchuan
Physical Description:
A dark skinned and tall man, bearing clothing of Tian Yin, specifically that of Wujing Guo. Loose and open robes along with more martially inclined clothing. Underneath these robes a more tight black outfit that hugs his body. Lion like ears sprouting from his head and a lion's tail flicking behind him. His eyes bear with them an animalistic look, his expression is usually calm or a tame smile. His body denotes one who relies on strength, having more of a "strong man's" build rather than one aesthetically please. Heavy and dense muscles lining his body from top to bottom. On top of his clothing he wears what looks like hand-made jewelry. 

When he is fighting, on occasion scarlet red blood can be seen as he uses his very own blood as a form of cultivation. The energy itself being derived from both Wood & Water Qi, a crimson hue that matches his hair.

Name: Gwyneth
Known History:
Gwyneth was fished up out of the ocean by a fishers near Traeth Village. She still does not know her real parents. Her parents were the ones that taught her to find the beauty in others, the kindness in strangers, and the responsibility it means to keep everybody safe.

Growing up, it was evident she was a little different from other villagers: taller, stronger, much more hungry than a normal person. It wouldn't stop her from taking up the axe and the armor to protect Traeth from the many threats that lurked along its edges. She was one of the many commonfolk inspired by the acts of heroism spreading through the realm, deciding to leave her village to spread her desire to protect and help beyond the little bubble of Traeth.
Physical Description:
Taller than most. Carrying a larger axe than most. Eats more than most. What isn't clad in armor is her face. She wants to assure others that she isn't a threat.

Smiles often. Laughs even more.

Name: Gyalwa Jigme
Known History:
Usually seen around the Temple of Strife, Gyalwa is a constant headache for the Empty Monks residing there. Originally one of Lama Dampa’s personal disciples, she made it clear very early that she did not resonate with the philosophy of self-annihilating “altruism” the monks preached, and decided to cultivate following her own Dao.

After an incident where her being almost become digitalized as part of Terra's Soul Network, she took onto herself to discover its mysteries, claiming for herself an old set of equipment constructed by the late Edward Baylore and Adam Batezier.

As a part of her Heavenly Tribulations, she acquired mastery over the Golden Spiral Cultivation and insight over the Harmonic Spiral Cultivation, two of three secret and complicate teachings preserved in the Temple of Strife.
Origin: Tian Yin, Leytik, Temple of Strife
Physical Description:
A woman with a tan complexion, orange hair, and golden eyes. Her skin is covered in scriptures that shine in a golden light, enumerating the twenty-five postulates of the Golden Spiral Circulation and Harmonic Spiral Circulation, the sacred texts she has taken onto herself to master and one day teach. Her clothing is a mixture of Terran streetwear and traditional Leytik Empty Monk robes, decorated with accessories from her travels.
She doesn't seem to always fit well in social situations, sometimes looking weird, rude or insensitive as a result, but she knows people don't always like this aspect of her and she respects that.
Her methods of cultivation are likewise odd and unusual, especially for a supposed Empty Monk, as she relies on imposing her own flow over things rather than annihilating her own Qi and presence.

Name: Haoran
Known History: Haoran is a natural Metal Qi cultivator, as well as a fairly good dancer. He is a novice of the spear after events in his life led him to the Worldhelm.
Origin: Tian Yin - Wujing Guo, Secret Fern Village
Physical Description: With a body mostly covered in shimmering scales the color of sapphires, he possesses luxurious white hair which winds down his back and along the thin tail behind him. Additional lengthy tufts at his elbows and knees lend a gentle countenance to him, reflected with his equine-esque face, plated ridges along the bridge of his nose leading to a single antler-horn arcing gracefully from the middle of his forehead.

Name: Haru Whittlee
Known History:
A member and employee of QiLink's Horn department, one filled with many peculiar yet highly proficient individuals in technological fields directly working one of QiLink's main assets, the Link Algorithm. 

It is speculated that during his childhood he was one of the subjects for a neuro sociological experiment that tried to see how much one could help foster a child's cognitive capabilities, but not much else is known about it.

Haru continued on with his life, eventually entering college and finishing his mathematics degree a year early, and eventually finding himself a spot in QiLink. Beyond that, not much else is publicaly known about them.
Physical Description: Standing at 5'1" tall, Haru is a modded human from Terra with a canidae appearance. He can typically be seen wearing an asortment of clothes with comfort in mind. His most prominent wear is an oversized shirt, some shorts, a large soft robe, and a pair of glasses he picked up because others at the company had them. He carries himself in a generally aloof manner with a peculiar set of mannerisms, not being the best at social gestures but still willing to make attempts communication.

Name: Heinrich
Known History:
Heinrich was born into Empire of Merrane, and as a child he believed, as most, in the justice of his homeland. He, too, wanted to fight for the people. As he grew older, the thought become more mature, but never really left. When the chance came, he signed up to join the army.

To this day, he's not really sure why that happened. Was the whole Empire involved in such things? Or was it individual, illegal cell that he had the misfortune of encountering? Whatever the case, he was found to have certain "potential", and next thing he knew, the Empire he so trusted was performing on him inhuman experiments. The goal was to somehow fuse a human with an elemental into some being of power for use in the war effort.

Though others died, the experiment succeeded with him, and he was brought to the frontlines. He already distrusted the Empire, but before that, he thought it was just "whatever necessary to win" kind of deal. Then he saw the reality of the war, anger filled him, and he escaped.
Physical Description:
183 cm tall, average build

Usually seen in silver armor with blue accents covering his whole body, especially the helmet. Even without it he usually wears clothes with long sleeves and high collars.

His body is covered with ugly scars that glow and buzz with elemental energies, which is why he prefers to keep himself hidden beneath armor. His hair is green, short and unkept, his pale skin has strange green tinge to it that makes him appear sickly, his face seems to have settled into a permanent frown, and his nose looks like it got broken and healed improperly. His eyes too glow with elemental energies, changing colors with his surroundings, and his Heterochromia is the only part of his looks that he actually likes.

Name: Helios, The First
Known History: Helios is a human soldier from the Islands of Samsara. Trained in the lost art of dragon fighting, he seeks adventure to issue in peace across the realm. He was granted the moniker of "The First" by his comrades, being the first of his name as well as the first in many generations to rekindle the art of the ancient Dragoons.
Physical Description: Helios has been described as a stoic, but gentle person with a fierce aura of determination and purpose. He stands relatively taller than most of his kin at 6 feet, 6 inches tall (198cm), and sports a short cut to his shock white hair. His eyes are a piercing gold compared to his complexion and armor. He also has a notable scar across his left cheek and lips.

Name: Hemlocke Perditos
Identity: Traveling Apothecary searching for a Breakthrough
Known History:
« ...Born in the Perditos family, in a small town in Lhodos, my boy Hemlocke was subject to a strict education and high standards since his childhood. Bringing respect to the Family Name has always been his highest aspiration. 
You see, all of Perditos family tree's names have been inspired to flowers. *Poisonous* flowers. The reason behind this "tradition" of theirs has been lost to time, unfortunately... but I think it's due to their w... [ this part is illegible ]
 
...When his hometown became a battlefield, his family nowhere to be found, he had no choice but escape to the north. I found him on the streets and offered him rest in my caravan. He helped me in my daily duties for years, even learned the job. When we ended up stayin' in Korila, he was allowed in the academy. Hells, even graduated. 
I'm sure he's doing alright... He's got the will, and he's got the brains. May his future shine bright. »
– An Old Man's note.
Physical Description:
Hemlocke is 186cm (6'1) tall. He's not particularly brawny, as physical exercise would take him precious time otherwise spent in deep thought. 

He features dark hair, except for a single white strand of hair... seems to be a "family trait", according to him.
When he leaves his lab, he always brings some tools, trinkets and little bottles filled with ingredients along. And don't forget about the notebook! There's always something new to discover, even in Lhodos!

Name: Hikmah
Known History: Originally from Windhaven, she spent most of her time studying.  She was enrolled in a school that dedicated it's resources to documenting the history is Nezmira.  Along the way, she learn to fight using elemental infusion to exploit the weaknesses she learned in her studies.  During one of her outings to study a ruin, she was picked up by a realmstorm.  (Leaving vague, will update later)
Physical Description: Height: 5'3 not counting ears, Weight: 71 lbs

Name: Hiya Salamin
Identity: Spiritual Glassblower of the Volcanic Peaks
Known History: Coming from a long line of Glass Cultivators centered around the volcanic peaks of Pagapalay Village. Hiya despite being born a male in a matriarchal society was born into a hopeful position. But, as she practiced her lineage’s cultivation, she struggled to cope with her feelings of self-doubt to the dismay of those who practiced before her. Eventually, she learned to channel her cultivation into a glittery avatar of glass resembling one of the auspicious beasts. For a while, she was satisfied with that progress. It wasn't until her little insulated world was nearly shattered by a catastrophic event stopped by the gold-hearted that she finally dared to step away from her mundane existence to investigate the volcano. Fortune would have it that one decision would lead to her being gobbled up into a realmstorm, displaced from her home, and joining the World-Helm with the hope of finding acceptance and purpose.
Physical Description:
Hiya Salamin is a boyish Bakla standing at a meek 5'4. She has a small frame with lightly discolored hands from the labor of glassblowing. She prefers comfortable clothes that do well to insulate her skin to the sweltering heat. She has two orange irises and black hair.

She does battle using a glass construct she calls Pagninilay, that resembles one of the four auspicious beasts, the beast of summer. It has red stained glass feathers and crystal clear complexion.

Name: Howi "Atlas"
Identity: Tough Warrior with a Heart of Gold
Known History: To be discovered and learned(And Totally not made up on the spot)
Physical Description: Standing at 10'5  wearing what most would consider rags or basic leather armor eitched with runes and markers. Brown fur with spots of reds mostly around the head with a small puff of jet black hair at the top.

Name: Hua Ying
Known History:
All that Hua Ying can recall about her mother is that she was rather young when she was entrusted to her adoptive father after her mother's passing. He was strict but kind both as a father and an instructor in the art of cultivation, always striving diligently towards the peak that his ancestors had once reached.

With each passing year she and her father would grow more withdrawn from the village as his training grew in intensity and their perilous trips outside the village grew ever frequent. Something had changed about the kind man from her childhood but she was unsure when it had happened or to what extent. Only one of those questions would be answered when she was brought to the brink of death and left to die by the one she cherished most. 

She knows not why she was chosen by the Worldhelm but after years of wallowing in doubt and grief she decided that she would get her answers, no matter the cost.
Physical Description:
Hua Ying stands at a respectable 5'5" (horns and okobo included), paired with her slender and androgynous build people foolishly assume her to be younger than she actually is, much to her ire.  For the sake of her pride she goes to great lengths to combat these assumptions, painstakingly curating every aspect of her appearance and the way she is perceived by others, making a point to always carry herself in a dignified and sophisticated manner.   

In these efforts she takes special care of her hair horns and tail, despite the latter's constant betrayal of her emotions at inopportune situations. 

Unlike the clothes she favors her body is largely monochromatic with sparse accents of color at the ends of her tail, hair, horns and ears. Along with a striking golden eye that's left uncovered by her mane.

Name: Hue
Identity: Something Else Looking For Something New
Known History:
A fae born into a world of color, they learned to love the new and exciting. From the orange of the sunsets and blue of the seas. And what was one to do with what they loved but create something new from it? So they did as such, using themselves to pull color from and create their own masterpieces.

Now they are sure to share their works from making new faces to play amongst the mortals or to leaving smidges of their artwork behind, both literally and metaphorically. Who knows what will happen though, they simply follow their artistic flow.
Physical Description: A humanoid-looking 6'8 creature, their body itself has little to no color. Their hair though often times swirls with different hues and shades of color that they pull from for their art. The only thing that seems human being stray articles of clothing they have picked up over the years simply because "they looked nice."

Name: Huong Jin
Known History:
Ever since joining the Worldhelm, they haven't shared much of their previous experience, aside from the select few. With background in alchemy and engineering, they've become a core member and a founder of The Future's Anvil, along with Myffa Sirrokh and Enoch. They've also been seen alongside the proprietress and the head maid of The Golden Hearth when off-duty, hanging out in her maid cafe after working hours.

After the defeat of Halcyon, they've pledged allegiance to the Queen of Hearts, turning from an elfkin of Lhodos to a fully fledged Goldhearted faerie. Surprisingly enough, very little has changed about them.
Physical Description: Standing at 5'10" and weighing 145 lbs, Huong Jin boasts a slender but defined figure with feminine features, which they proudly boast through the crimson flak jacket, simple brown pants with a belt that stores their infusion ampules, and some leather boots made for kicking. They sport medium-length black hair, ruby red eyes and pointy ears.

Name: Hydrangea
Known History: Hydrangea was originally a simple spirit of a tree in the village of Dryholde. She enjoyed watching the lives of the citizen around her for many years. Until a portal opened up in the village, spilling forth demons that killed the town. Filled with sadness after watching this unfold, she used all her power to grow a humanoid body for themselves with the intent to avenge the town. However, just as she was about to start her mission, she was taken by a realm storm.
Physical Description: Normally seen in wooden armor, Hydrangea is a 5'8" collection of plants in the shape of an average human woman. Most of her leaves are a bright green in colour that get lighter in the face, with a large flower on her head that changes based on which magiseed she is using. She has short "hair" black eyes and a mouth with noticeable fangs. She is normally seen with a hopeful smile across her face.

Name: Héng Xià Xīn
Known History:
Once a proud metal cultivator with friends and sister
Swore to defend those weaker then him
Corrupt cultivators kidnapped sister and forced him to work in bloodmines to get her back. 
found out that it was all for not and tried to raid the corrupt cultivators. 
The cultivators, fueled by negative emotion tried to drain Heng of his, but instead took all of his emotions.
now, fueled by metal and logic, found that this could be a newfound way of life. Metal is strong and stern. 

Long live metal, May it forever protect the weak flesh.
Origin: Xuanwu city, Wujing Guo, Tian Yin
Physical Description: 6:3 not including the metalic horn on their head. They have covered there body in thick layers of armor and grafted metal onto there skin. They have metal scraps flying into and off of them as well as some magnetic jolts. The only piece of humanity that is easily seen is one eye that can be seen past the helmet. They also have two large fused slabs of metal magnetically floating near them or attached to their arms.

Name: Iara Amrade
Known History: A Refugee of Dryholde. She's been to worldhelm for a month or so and just got used to life there. She doesn't talk much about her past beyond that, but she'll be glad to treat any wound from any person.
Physical Description: Slim, Tall (1,85m), with a faint blue for hair color and silver for eye color. Thick eyebrows and a face that portrays a distant look.

Name: Icarus Vittore
Known History: Considered to be a failed experiment by a scientific collaboration between NTTech and DHK Heavy Industries, Icarus was cast out of the facility he was born in and left to die in the Terran wilderness, alone. His body was meant to be a perfect fusion of human and a currently unknown avian creature capable of powerful telekinetic abilities. However, such was not the case as Icarus only presented with fragile and hollow bones, and nothing more. His determination to survive proved to be his salvation as he grew stronger with age, and was able to turn his deficiencies into gifts. Quick and light on his feet, with a penchant for silence, Icarus found himself winning against all odds; and eventually his deadly skillset found him at the doorstep of the Vignettes. With a gun in his hand, Icarus proved to be a force to be reckoned with, and his kill count rose to obscene numbers.
Physical Description: Icarus is a very slender, young man with a permanent grimace towards the world. He moves with a graceful precision, and his fierce golden eyes convey a sense that he is always intently focusing on something about to happen. He has light skin, and even lighter, platinum blonde hair. When fully clothed in his traditional Terran streetwear, one would not be remiss to assume him to be a perfectly normal human being. However, when exposed, one can see transluscent feathers erupting from the skin on his forearms and calves. These are a mark of his experimentation, and he hides them at all costs, ashamed that they remind him of failure.

Name: Ineza Brightscale
Identity: Nezzim Merchant Delivering Potions, Poultices, and Freedom
Known History:
For as long as she can remember, Ineza has been learning the art of the deal from her mother. From haggling with sandsailors, to crafting potions and poultices, tonics and tinctures, to upsell, upsell, UPSELL! For years now, she's worked alongside her mother, learning and aiding in the family business.
It wasn't until she was 15 that she was clued into the family's OTHER trade: people. More specifically, utilizing a bevy of contacts and favors owed, alongside the cover of legitimate business dealings, her mother acts as part of a group that aids mages in escaping beyond the iron grip of imperial doctrine. While it undoubtedly came as a shock at first, she quickly strove to aid in what ways she could.
At present, Ineza primarily operates on the surface running the more mobile parts of the family business, along with discrete message exchanges with underground contacts, primarily in Windhaven. But soon, a different wind will wisk her away, far beyond the white sands of her home…
Physical Description: At a mere 4’7”, the oversized merchant backpack Ineza carries around with her only serves to help make her look even smaller. Sporting bright red scales and the piercing eyes of a saleswoman always ready to make a deal, her practiced grin is about equally likely to bring comfort as it is mild suspicion.

Name: Ioes
Known History: Born and raised in a small town in Terra his life was immediately ruined by his parents overbearing nature which caused him to resent and despise them with no access to any entertainment. One way or another he eventually found out about twinworld and was enamored with its style and mechanics. He decided one day that this was the life for him so he left home and decided to work for sword to both earn a living, get a T.E.M.P. License and save enough money to be able to play triworld. Casually walking the streets looking like a warrior Ioes is nothing more than a huge nerd for a game he’s really really into, so into in fact that even his cosplay is considered military grade.
Physical Description: A Terran with brown hair with a black and blue aesthetic wearing armor similar to what an android would look like. Often carrying around a railgun under his big cloak. His armor seems flexible to where even his helmet asks more as a mask with how it comes on and off with a simple press of a button.

Name: Iori Hirose
Known History:
Born into the Hirose Clan, Iori was destined for a life of silk and servitude, but her father defied tradition, to forge her into a warrior. In Sakai, even daughters bore steel, and she was no fragile flower. She was a rose with thorns, both beautiful and deadly. When the Oni came, the capital fell, the emperor was slain, and the samurai, refusing to kneel, waged one final battle. Beneath a rain-darkened sky, they were defeated. Ready to die, Iori was instead forced to flee by her father, carrying the shame of survival.  

Beneath the raging storm, she cursed the gods, demanding a reason for her survival. And one answered. Lightning struck, searing through her, leaving power thrumming in her veins. When she awoke, she was changed. Now she is a Rōnin. A wandering blade with no master, no home, and a single vow. Never again would she bow to an emperor, never again serve a noble. Her sword would be sworn only to a cause worth dying for.
Physical Description: She stands at 5'8, carrying herself with unwavering pride, her stance firm and assured. Once a deep, natural black, her hair now bears a striking lavender hue. A permanent mark of her ordeal. She wears a modified off-the-shoulder yukata, tailored for combat, blending elegance with practicality. A simple black eyepatch conceals her ruined eye, a silent testament to the day the beneath the rain.

Name: Iris Blue, The Bleeding Heart
Known History:
being mages in Kor'Torian, Iris's parents wanted a simple life, which caused them to make a deal with fae. They traded the ability to live normal lives "by taking away there magic" for the eternal service of there daughter. they traded with a smaller sect of the autumn court known as the vine puppets, a collection of plant like fae chaotic hivemind that are linked together by vines in there back.
Iris has spent a majority of her life as a slave to these fae, including hunting down more innocent people to become slaves to the court. She became a kor'tarion myth known as the "the bleeding heart" and hating it. She was bound by semisentiant vines rapped around her arms and neck. During her imprisonment, a band of Goldhearted seized the place in a search and rescue mission. in the confusion, she broke parts of the vines off of her and snuck onto there ship, which only did spit her out because it recognized her as someone who could be goldhearted, despite Iris not thinking she is one
Physical Description: Iris is a 6:3 thin rail of a woman with the look of failure that can be easily spotted under the bags under her eyes. She has long black curly hair that looks unkempt and is over one of her eyes. she is wearing black leathers with a hunters skirt over her legs and riding boots, both with old insignia scratched out.  around her wrists and her neck is a large thorned vine that moves on its own. the ones around the wrists curl up to the elbows and the ones around her neck dangle down like a danger scarf with a blue bleeding heart flower that hangs lie a tie in front of her

Name: Irius Barnes
Known History:
Irius originally hailed from the slums of Nest with some history of hardship, working his way up to the Solar Fields as one of many of the hard-working individuals among there; Irius learned to develop some consistent skills and preparedness, managing to put these skills to use for their past odd jobs and work his way from the gutters of the slums to a housing unit much like any other working farmhand. Through the fruits of the tough farm-work and odd jobs he’d be subjected to, he has helped many with their troubles through his life, even if it can get repetitive.

Now; Irius is doing his best to fit into a role and world that he finds unusual among the Worldhelm. Helping others is one thing. Saving them is another.
Physical Description: Irius stands as a 5'8" male with brown hair and green eyes, a body fit for a physically inclined farmer and generally fair complexion despite his profession. He almost never leaves home without his weathered straw hat and various packed essentials he carries from his time in Terra. He typically wears lighter colors; most commonly his sand-colored overshirt, paired with typically a sky blue t-shirt or whatever other color he decides to wear that day.

Name: Isagani
Known History:
-Born in Tangbawan to the sister of a Matriarch, making her the Matriarch's niece.

-As a child, she was older and more skilled at cultivation than her cousin, the Matriarch's daughter. So, the Matriarch wants her out of the picture in order to secure succession.

-At 12, she is taken from her family and given to the Kabiya. She's old enough to understand why this is happening and is bitter about it.

-Lives among the Kabiya, learning how to survive the dangerous wilderness. Focuses on cultivation and self-reliance rather than trusting people.
Physical Description:
A muscular woman standing at 6' even. She has multiple piercings, tattoos, and scars, and its often indistinct which is which. 

She wears simple clothing, usually favoring styles that fit lightly or that leave her arms bare. She moves with an easygoing confidence, though it is harder to read her expressions on account of her yellow, catlike eyes.

Name: Iseult Medicus
Known History:
Despite the near extinction of his people, Iseult holds firmly to a promise they made made long ago: der Orden der Sieben Leben, or the Order of Seven Lives. His life is that of the healer, Medicus, and as such he is expected to heal, protect, and preserve the people of Vale and, as it seem, beyond. The Silvery Waters must have lead him here for some reason, after all. 

The work of a healer is never finished...
Physical Description: 5'9" | 140 lbs. | Silver-y Blue Eyes

Name: Ishaan & Ignacio Vol Sieve
Identity: The Dependable Griffin Knight-Courier(s) of the Woods
Known History:
- Earliest memory is surviving in the slums as a child.
- Rescued a poached griffin while stowing away in a merchant caravan.
- Raised by the Witch of the Jarwood alongside the griffin, Ignacio.
- Reintegrated into Tradefair under the Helping Hands guild, gaining renown as fearless couriers tackling extreme conditions.
- Earned heroic recognition for aiding Hafod (Midday Sun) and Doana Village (development & Night of the Red Sky defense).
- Knighted in Brightshield on ‘Knight’s Day’ during King Marcello’s coronation.
- Marked by battle scars from Sakura the Skald, slew the Sinner, and embraced the Vol Sieve family.
- During a battle for the fate of Kor'Tarion, as Ishaan rose back from defeat, Ignacio evolved into an angelic descendant aspect tied to Antikythera
Physical Description:
Ishaan is a tan-skinned man with red hair tied in a ponytail, standing at 177cm (5'10").  He has a bit of fuzz of a goatee.  He's adorn in a blue long coat with a sash around his waist, and beige pants with traveling boots.

Ignacio stands at 390cm (13') as a griffin of the twilight. His upper body is similar to an eagle with black, shimmering feathers while the hindside is that of a lion. Despite the black feathers, there is a hint of radiance from the griffin.

Name: Isobel Ashwynd
Identity: The missing heir of the Ashwynd family turned experiment
Known History: Isobel, a wolf of the Ashwynd family, the heir to the legacy, or at least she was, she went missing. But now she's been claimed by the worldhelm, and has returned, but changed, monstrous. Can she fins a cure or a way to channel these abilities to be worthy of going home? Will she find a new family in the mean time?
Physical Description: Tall, and with a body that shows clear signs of a physical life, one spent fighting.  Those that knew her before would notice her slightly more angular features, and how her naturally tanned skin has grown ashy and pale from extended lack of sunlight.

Name: Isolde Forvelkanta
Known History:
Like her classmates, Isolde is unlikely to be known by anyone on the Worldhelm. Students at Gnosis Academy, however, may feel as though they’ve crossed paths with her before—perhaps in a hallway, during a training exercise, or in the quiet moments between battles—but when pressed, few can say for sure. Her name is occasionally found on the roster.

If one were to search for traces of her, one might find a neatly tended garden in an otherwise forgotten corner of the academy grounds, plants thriving despite no one recalling who planted them. Some students may remember being guided back to their dorms after a long night of studying, only to realize they don’t know who helped them. There are no records of her accomplishments, yet her presence lingers in the small, unnoticed kindnesses scattered throughout Gnosis Academy.

Recently, she has been trying to make better attempts to keep herself rooted in the minds of others. Whether that'll be successful has yet to be seen.
Physical Description: A young woman often seen with a warm smile and a relaxed posture. She has short, wavy platinum hair that has been seemingly dyed mint-green at the ends and bright green eyes. Her outfit consists of a long-sleeved uniform sweater with the Regal House of Warden's emblem on the chest, layered over a dark high-collared shirt and vest. Like many other Kaiway students, an armored pauldron rests on her left shoulder. She also wears a dark brown skirt over tights and lace-up boots.

Name: Ixtab K'awixi
Known History:
Ixtab grew up in a big, loving, yet inherently racist family. Society in the Scalefire Empire was normalized for her, but she was more than happy to take her leave once an adult. Years dungeon delving and tomb raiding lead her to discover the ancient temple dedicated to the great Rajul-Kha, Son of the Sun Serpent.

Her delve was arduous, a once beautiful temple desecrated with kiir, fighting until she and her group reached the center where he was sealed. While Ixtab was reading the runes on the walls, her group greeded for his treasure with haste, Rajul-Kha awaking from his slumber, slaughtering all but her. The young serpent spared her life in exchange for being her vassal on this world, binding his soul into her right arm. 

Nowadays, Ixtab has grown into liking of her "partnership." Liberating slaves and stirring rebellion within the empire with a drop of a coin was hella FUN man! Her antics were about to catch up with her, but then a realmstorm sweeped over her to save the day! :D
Physical Description: 6'7" | 171 lbs | Red Eyes

Name: Izanami Shoshio
Known History:
Izanami Shoshio was born into a proud warrior clan in the Blood Grotto of Aldistir, a brutal land shaped by the constant battles of the Aesir. Her clan, like many others, fought daily for survival against the harsh environment and the twisted creatures corrupted by Godblood. From a young age, Izanami was trained to wield her family’s heirloom greatsword, learning the ways of battle.

Tragedy struck when a dark presence attacked her clan, leaving her unconscious during the battle. While she lay hidden by luck, the cursed Godblood rain fell upon the battlefield, reanimating her family, friends, and clanmates as mindless Draugr. Upon awakening, Izanami was forced to fight and kill the people she once loved, each cut of her sword corrupting the weapon further. By the end, the blade had transformed into the cursed "Soul Maw," a weapon that devours the souls of those it slays.

Now, as the last survivor of her clan, Izanami wanders Aldistir as the "Slayer of Horrors".
Physical Description: A woman with long, red hair and an athletic build, she is dressed in the traditional garments of her homeland. Her hazel eyes hold a sharp, determined gaze, and she wears sturdy battle gloves to wield the cursed blade, Soul Maw.

Name: J'yuto
Known History:
The son of one of the houses of the City of Scales, having been banished for fraternizing with a human house slave. 

He now works to bring salvation to Nezmira from those who would rob the masses at a chance of becoming better.
Physical Description: A Nezzim of blue and white scales, standing 6 foot even, light blue eyes and legs that end inf three clawed feet. A long tail accents their backside

Name: Jacomo Seidita
Known History:
- Hidela Academy drop out, and overall hooligan.
- Penchant for flirting and pranks
- Attempted a very high level ritual which failed
- Ripped from space and time; saved by Antikythera
- Currently fading from existence
Other Names:
The Jack of Hearts
The Devil
Jackie Six-Fingers
Physical Description: Jacomo is moderately tall at 6'0", but is exceedingly thin. In fact, his presence often goes unnoticed despite his statue; something that he often uses to his advantage. His hair is a raven shade of black, and his eyes are a dull crimson hue. He dresses in dark robes, which conceal the many surprises he has up his sleeve.

Name: James Braughton
Known History: Little is known about them since they seem pretty hesitant to tell anyone anything before they arrived at the Worldhelm. They don’t even seem comfortable talking about where they’re from, always avoiding the question or trying to find some form of diversion. Clearly they’re hiding something, whatever it is however it’s easy to tell it’s of shame rather than fear or malice.
Origin: The Realm of Aldistir, Camp Von Kibo
Physical Description: A somewhat fair skinned man standing at a tall 6’ 2” often seen wearing a full set of armor that covered every inch of their body. Their facial appearance is unknown as they never take their helmet off in public however they do often spend time relaxing in causal wear that excludes the rest of their armor. Any time their body leaves the armor it’s hard to tell how many battles they’ve been through due to the egregious amount of scars on them.

Name: Jane Winter
Identity: Schizophrenic Sniper with a Pet Rock
Known History: Jane Winter, known as "The Shadow" by those that they end up working on. While folks may not know their true identity, those in the city of Bastion with something to hide or enemies to fear fear the nickname. They say you’ll never know when they’ll strike. The person they have as their target is already down, or at least threatened, by the time you realise you are being watched. No one knows who this person is or anything about them, and most don’t want to know should you become their next target.
Physical Description:
Height - 5’7        Eyes - Lapis Blue 
Weight - 130lbs  Hair - Dark Grey

Name: Jiafei Lanying
Identity: Wasted Prodigy of the Mist Village
Known History: The only member of this generation of his family of guardians who had protected the Jijing Xiantiao for as long as they've been around. While normally they have many children, which all train to be powerful warriors, the hard times of the recent century have limited offspring. Only Jiafei has managed to survive to adulthood. Despite this, he fails to live up to his families warrior reputation, and has been cast aside by the common people as the end of his lineage. The Lanying family has lost it's prestige.
Physical Description: Jiafei is a just under six foot tall thinly built man. He has a mane of thick white hair that frames his face, and falls far down his back to nearly his knees. His two lion ears flick side to side passively at each noise or voice.

Name: Jodi Finch
Known History: Worked for T&C weapons development in Terra. Effectively gone rogue while still on the books, due to their esper breakthrough. Now on the Worldhelm.
Physical Description:
Jodi's curly short black hair frames a pale and unemotional countenance. She wears engineering overalls with Tubal & Cain's logo, has tools and spanners on her waistbelt and in her downtime often has a mug of coffee to hand.
She lives in a battered old helicopter, which doubles as her workshop.

Name: Jodie
Known History: Born to nothing and inheriting nothing, Jodie learned the hard way that anything gained in this life must be earned, and she earned it through theft! She'd often steal food, water, necessities and whatnot for the lowly and downtrodden of the city, and occasionally stole the nice piece of jewellery or nice clothes from an unsuspecting rich person. Anything to get by.
Physical Description: A tiny woman, she stands at 4'11 and has a very lithe, lean body that contorts well. There aren't any major blemishes in her skin, although she does carry a few scars beneath her cloak from close calls. She has bright orange hair and always has a stupid smirk on her face

Name: Johann Ackroyd
Known History: An ex-detective from the realm of Kor'Tarion with a strong sense of justice and an abhorrence for murder, he learned the hard way that with enough zenith even human life can be bought. Using his experience with crime, he takes up the sword during the night to commit  perfect robberies against people his daytime self cannot touch.
Physical Description: A lanky man with long red hair pulled into a short braid with a rapier and parry dagger sheathed over a long coat.

Name: Johanna Atherton Verstappen
Identity: Steadfast Lantern-Bearer of the Rebellious Angel
Known History:
Before the fall of Idyll, Verstappen was known for her gentle nature and healing touch, offering solace to both body and spirit. In the afterlife, she lived in peace among Hinno's snowy hills, guiding lost souls who drifted her way. But when corruption twisted her tranquil home into a frozen wasteland, Verstappen took up steel to protect those around her. Her courage and unwavering compassion caught the attention of Lilith, who offered her a choice: eternal rest in Nirve or the mantle of an angel to fight the encroaching horrors. She accepted, now dedicating herself to guarding the caravans venturing into corrupted lands.

Since arriving at the Worldhelm, however, her life has changed significantly. After months of trials and tribulations and the aid of many Goldhearted, she has regained a part of herself that she thought was gone: hope.
Physical Description: Verstappen is a tall woman with an imposing, almost oppressive presence. Despite that, she often wears a kind expression to those that don't draw her ire. Her long blonde hair is kept practical, usually tied in a high bun to not interfere with her duties. Despite the wear and tear on them both, her ornate plate armor and weapon are immaculately well maintained, serving both a practical purpose and faithful devotion to her lord. There are a striking pair of black wings on underneath her cape, though they are not majestic and regal in any way. They’re scarred and covered in burn marks, though she does not shy away from showing them.

Name: Kaiten-Shi
Known History:
Kaiten-Shi was born as the son to Dryholde's local apothecary and passing "witch's" fling. His name was given in the culture favoring his mother rather than local tradition. His mother gave him up to his father after needing to complete some manner of duty thrust upon in her homeland. He spent most of his youth engrossed in alchemical experimentation with his father: learning how to make antidotes and antitoxins from the local flora, shaving elemental crystal into smaller pieces to mix into powders and so forth. 
It wasn't until he turned 20 that he started wandering the lands of Kor'Tarion to strike out on his own. He spent a few years going from place to place: Eventually settling in Lastport peddling medicines and visiting Hudal Academy to listen to public lectures on new alchemical discoveries. He even had a small stint (2 years) working as a field medic to a mercenary group....until a surprise attack by criminal group wiped them out...
Now, the Worldhelm has called Kai to action..
Physical Description:
Height: 5ft 10 inches, 
Features: Of vague eastern descent, with dark hair and green eyes. 
Weight: weighs about 175lbs.

Name: Kana Hyderlan
Known History:
A human girl raised in the Azatar tribe of warriors, Kana was looked down on for her heritage, only elevated somewhat by her aptitude for magic. What made things worse was her defiance of the Azatar's principles of pursuing power at all costs and never displaying mercy.

During a raid on a village of rebels, Kana came face-to-face with one of the Azatar's targets - another human girl named Yuki, who had lost everything to the warrior tribe attacking her hometown. Kana did not kill her, instead vowing to protect her and help her recover. Even as her own tribe called her out on her "treachery" and exiled her at bladepoint, she never left Yuki's side.

In search of a safe haven, Kana has wandered onto the Worldhelm by herself.
Physical Description: A short, pale human girl standing at 5'7". Her horns are the result of her magic reacting volatilely to her brand, and her clothes cover the tattoos of her former tribe.

Name: Katya Yakhina
Known History:
Yekaterina Yakhina—Katya to her friends and most everyone too—is a Septid from Central. One of her moms had a history with NT-Tech working in the Old World but for some reason or other ended up in Central. Her other mother just saw *Gas Station, Shithole Desert* as a step up from a Septid slum.

Katya loved her dying little podunk and the others like it, and wanted to do what she could to spark some life back into it. Being Terran about this, she made a living with it: Going around, selling stuff she salvaged and brought from where it wasn't needed, doing odd jobs and most of all making things. Especially with plants and basic medicine.

Raised as a big believer in NTT, Katya still loves nature. Through some unburnt connections she even got a TEMP license from the company. Came in handy when she took in an exotic rattlesnake somebody had dumped for getting too big to be cute. (And too big for a rattlesnake in general.) They ended up inseparable. She named her Kelly.
Physical Description:
* 3'8" (112 cm) tall

* Orange eyes with distinctive 'bar' pupils

* Long, shaggy grey hair

* Pale greyish skin, getting progressively greener in her extremities

* Dresses in practical, worn clothing, fairly covered up; fit for the desert. Has a big, wide-brimmed hat. Looks *so* much like a witch.

Name: Keiji Saito
Known History:
Keiji S. grew up in North Rock, Haven’s roughest district, where survival often meant rebellion. As a teen, he joined a gang, lashing out at corporations he blamed for his community's struggles. His considerable strength made him a force to reckon with, but his world shattered when his mother was killed in gang violence. Devastated, Keiji abandoned the gang life, vowing to use his power for good instead of destruction.

Now in his late 20s, Keiji lives in North Rock, working to protect its streets from the chaos he once fueled. By day, he takes freelance jobs that require muscle and street smarts; by night, he’s a bouncer at Phobia, an entertainment bar in Silver Rock. While North Rock is gritty and dangerous, Silver Rock buzzes with life and diversity, offering Keiji a connection to Haven’s brighter side. Though haunted by his past, Keiji strives to make a difference, one act of strength and kindness at a time, in a city teetering between chaos and opportunity.
Physical Description:
Keiji S. stands at just over six feet, his muscular build hinting at years of grueling dock work and street brawls. His wild, fiery red hair frames a face that’s sharp and unmistakably human, albeit with some distinct fox-like features. Cybernetic implants enhance his cheekbones, lending a subtle metallic gleam under the neon lights of Haven. His ears are modified to a pointed, animal-like shape, and his mouth carries slight augmentations that give him a vulpine edge, with slightly sharper canines that enhance his intimidating aura when needed.

Despite his imposing presence, Keiji's freckled face and often goofy, unguarded expressions soften the effect. His usual attire consists of practical clothing: a sleeveless hoodie draped over a tank top that shows off his broad shoulders and toned arms, paired with rugged pants and combat boots. Keiji's style is as practical as it is distinctive, blending the rough-and-tumble resilience of North Rock with just a hint of Silver Rock’s flair.

Name: Keiko, Izumi
Known History:
Keiko's parents were killed by Oni when she was young, leaving her to care for herself and her younger sister Homura.  The pair were taken in by the leader of the village's dojo who taught them swordplay, both of them showing exceptional promise.  The two would occassionally brave the world outside the village, fighting monsters and retrieving resources.  One day Keiko returned to find Yamashita awash with blood, every single villager having been slain by Homura.  They fought, but were unable to kill each other, and Homura fled.  Keiko began to wander in search of her sister, with the goal of slaying her.

After falling in battle against Horoko's Halcyon doppleganger, she no longer has a heart that glows in Tian Yin.

Keiko managed to find her sister and with the help of the Goldhearted, managed to keep her from falling fully into corruption.  Choosing to save Homura instead of executing her, she's joined her on the Worldhelm as a Goldhearted.
Physical Description: Keiko is a tall woman wearing colorful clothes and a bright expression.  She carries a sword in a lavender sheath and moves with exceptional grace.  A small scar crosses her nose, and she has an almost permanent smile on her face.

Name: Keith Walker
Identity: Amnesiac, Cultivating Street Boxer Finding His Path
Known History:
- Life prior to abduction remain a mystery due to traces of his life wiped
- Keith was abducted as a candidate of the "Farseer Project", joint project between DHK and 100G to create Psycho Powered super-soldiers
- Escaped the lab and found life in North Rock under the care of Marcus Almasi and Maya Smith through the Rogue Reactor
- Gained notoriety as "The Stray", a Temp aimlessly wandering the streets and getting into brawls with various gangs throughout Haven, mostly North Rock
- Learned Cultivation under divine knowledge and as an unfortunate consequence of falling against a Corrupted Cultivator
- Eventually came to terms with the Demonic Qi which consumed all traces of the Psycho Power experimentation
Physical Description: Keith is a very tall dark brown-skinned man at 200cm (6'6") with his hair braided in cornrows. He is often with a black hooded jacket, a green undershirt, gold chained necklace, a pair of black slacks, and sneakers.

Name: Kelden
Known History:
Kelden was something of a prodigy in the small village of Dorlak of SE Pravaha Mandiva that secretly practiced the philosophy of "cycles" and kept snakes, while paying lip service and tithes to the Empty Monks. They believed that one merely needs to wait out their rule, and eventually they will be free.
Kelden, however, sought to leave to usher this dark age out. He was too valuable to let go, and was imprisoned. Soon he gained a cell-neighbour, a snake spirit beast captured by the village to coerce into teaching venom cultivation.
When Kelden saw one of these “coercions”, he grew enraged and with forming a bond with the spirit beast to gain access to some of its qi, managed to break both of them out. The newly named Norbu taught Kelden freely what Dorlak’s elders tried to force from it: venom cultivation, completing the bond. Eventually they took to wandering the mountains, helping people, only falling (quite literally) to a ravine where a Realmstorm rescued them.
Physical Description:
Kelden is a taller human with a lithe build, white hair with teal streaks in it, and inquisitive brown eyes. A single teal horn protrudes out from above his right ear.
He's dressed in loose Tian Yin clothing, and draped over his shoulders is a teal-coloured sake with two horns.

Name: Keldrin Embershield
Known History: Keldrin was a wandering adventurer who became an unlikely hero after his village was attacked by a monster. Despite his carefree drifter lifestyle, he bravely led the defense and saved survivors, catching the eye of noble knights. They inducted him into their order, and Keldrin reforged himself from an aimless wanderer into a protector knight of Kor'Tarion over years of valiant service. This earned him a summons onto the skyship Worldhelm to join other champions against greater threats.
Physical Description: Keldrin stands at three feet, five inches (3'5") and has spiky black hair and reddish highlights. He has striking teal eyes with the absence of a pupil. He wears a black combat tunic with a rerebrace on his right arm, paired with a pauldron that covers the shoulder.

Name: Khaal
Known History:
Born a half-Rakshasa, Khaal is the son of a Rakshasi woman and a father who relentlessly honed his mind and body. In the Tiger Lands, he walked the middle path between humanity and the bestial spirit. From his father, Khaal learned the importance of self-improvement, striving to be just a little better each day. His mother instilled in him a deep connection to the land and an unwavering courage. With these principles guiding him, Khaal faces the world, always ready to test his claws and be a steadfast ally and supporter.

With a number of adventures behind him and his power constantly growing, he's always prepared for the next battle.
Physical Description: Khaal stands tall at over 6 feet, with an athletic, muscular build. Tiger ears emerge from his head, complementing his slitted pupils, black stripes that run down his body, and lethal claws.

Name: Khasir Vol Seive
Known History:
Khasir was born into servitude, his own mother a house servant of the Alaoui family. Whereas some might be cruel enough to toss out a child who couldn't work... The master of the house, one Theoris Zeofar Alaoui, saw it as an investment. Care for the boy, keep him around, and bam, a few years later that boy is able to work, and incredibly in your debt.

Working for the Alaoui estate wasn't the worst thing. Hell, Khasir loved it. It was cushier than what work most humans could find in the City of Scales; he had a bed, good food, and even more, the family treated their servants rather well.

Through the years, Khasir bounced from job to job about the manor; cleaner boy to whatever else... But once he landed in the kitchen, it was set. That was his talent. Of course, when the old Head Chef fell ill, Khasir took their place in presiding over the meals of House Alaoui.

Under his care and exacting eye, every meal enjoyed by the house would be nothing less than perfect.

That is, until...
Physical Description:
An older man of 42, Khasir stands at about 5' 11" with a slim, yet fit, build. He keeps himself well groomed, with snipped hair and a trimmed beard. Lately, Khas has taken to experimental fashion of the realms he has ventured into.

However, once the need arises, he shifts. At the whim of a needle and a ritual scroll, Khasir grows larger, darker, with long purplish hair and a third eye upon his brow. Sometimes, being human isn't enough. And when those times come, there will be The Bullion.

Name: Kit Grannus
Known History:
A young man without any official public record of his existence, Kit's known history is limited. A child with a mutated right arm who first appeared at the age of eight years old. Adopted by a street doctor named Phillip Grannus, Kit was raised peacefully for ten years, during which time he was trained in medical science.

When Kit was eighteen years old, the clinic he called home was engulfed in a fire which killed Dr. Grannus. Taking up the doctor's coat, Kit worked as an itinerant doctor for three years, wandering from place to place to treat those who could not afford healthcare. This vagrant lifestyle continued until the Worldhelm claimed him.

As a Goldhearted, Kit learned various techniques and forms of science to enhance his medical treatments. The growth of his mutation, however, was also progressing. Learning the true nature of his right hand, Kit made the decision to put his faith in his friends, a decision which saved his life... for now.
Physical Description:
Standing at 5'9" with a fairly average build, Kit has tanned skin and hair that is dyed blue. His right arm is a prosthetic, a replacement for the mutated limb that was amputated.

He carries a variety of custom-built alchemical and medical equipment, a mechanical gauntlet and a strange staff which are all intricately connected to a cylindrical case which he carries on his back.

Name: Klaus Silver
Known History:
"You might be wondering why I have a mobile workshop, and why it's trusty engine has been forgone for this stubborn bull of mine. Well, Back before Magictech I decided I was done with military squabbles and became a deserter to Karlsgard and smuggled my way into Merrane with a fake identity... That didn't last long. Was only a few years later Magitech and "Edict of Savior" happened."
*Long cigarette drag*
"So, I did what any reasonable person would do, I stole a steam engine that was about to be decommissioned,  and made a run for it getting caught up in a scuffle and riding into a realmstorm... To arrive somewhere? The rules were weird, As was the politeness. Now I have a vengeance spirit sharing my mind, and Orloh pulling my home."  
- Klaus Silver a very tired toymaker
Physical Description:
standing 5'3 and weighing 108lbs Klaus is a short wirey older man. 

He has long Bassett Hound ears that have faded and grayed over the years. 

A prosthetic silver hand he occasionally takes of to charge , a large umbrella, and yellow tinted glasses to have any gloomy day seem brighter and happier. 

He is often at his mobile toys store making oddities and cursing at Orloh his cart pulling "bull"
Theme: The Lazy Toymaker Host to a Spirit of Vengeance

Name: Klez
Known History:
Klez is a former "employee" of QiLink Cybersecurity, a discarded faulty product from their prior attempts to bolster the talents of their workers with Ai, possibly supplied by Lorel.Ai in the earlier days of the Link Network, when other companies were still scrambling to compete with it. 

Klez's mind has long been corrupted by the work, as eventually his Ai assistants became bugged, and they, along with the rogue virus programs and AI from QiLink's former opposition were burned into his mind. He's likely fighting for control of himself against them, even now.
Physical Description:
Klez is 6'2", but is often slightly hunched over at 5'11. He wears a tattered suit that seems to have been repaired on several prior occasions. The back of his head and their spine are obviously chromed, and the exposed hardware at the base of his skull seems to be fitted with several dangling wires, many of which seem to be plugs for various computer ports. 

They occasionally let off barely controlled crimson/black sparks, a telltale sign that this person has been cursed by the Soul Network of Terra. Their eyes glow with the same baleful colors, but this is only noticeable if you manage to make eye contact with him.

Name: Klyra
Known History:
During her childhood Klyra read a lot of old stories about heroes and villains. She started idolising both, though leaned heavily to the plights and moral arguments of the antagonists. Inspired by these tales and battles she trained for a time with her mother Akeer, a Sparrow diplomat, before having to flee from their territory because of her criminal activity. She visited her father Marna at End Time Acquisitions but was disturbed by their policies and left to seek out something else.
During her roving, she was joined by two sentient masks created by her parents to spy on her and or convince her to head back home; one violent and narcissistic named Morden, the other benevolent and diplomatic named Firie. They joined her and began coaching her while trying to impose their polarised ideologies, putting up with each other only so they could continue to care for her.
She was eventually caught up in a realmstorm and landed on the Worldhelm.
Physical Description: Klyra is usually completely obscured by a massive dark purple cloak that reaches the floor, containing a plethora of archaic technology from The Old World, and a mask that covers her face. In this outfit she appears around 190cm but in actuality she's a shortstack who wears stilts and the intimidating garb to try and look more villainous. She's always accompanied by a pair of floating masks similar to the one she wears, one blue, the other a dull magenta.

Name: Kohaku Aiuchi
Identity: Hopeful Diplomat from an Old Bloodline
Known History: Kohaku has spent most of his life in Murata, maintaining careful diplomatic ties with the various Yokai in order to benefit the people of the village until the Goldhearted first returned to Teisei - with their help they repelled a group of Oni that would put Murata in ruin. Afterwards, with the encouragement of the Mayor of their village, would leave with the Goldhearted and now he aids where he can both on the ship and otherwise.
Physical Description: Kohaku is a slender man, standing at 5'9" typically wearing formal garments - strangely immaculate and obsessively clean exterior though suitable for his prior occupation.

Name: Koishi
Known History: An orphan originating from an oni-controlled town in Teisei, with half-oni heritage. After losing her mother at a young age, Koishi survived via begging and working in the mines. She has trained in cultivation to a degree, and claims that one day she will destroy the oni in Ishiyama.
