Physical Description: Koishi is a girl in her late teens with two red horns protruding from her head, slightly covered by a huge mane of white hair. She stands tall at 6ft and lugs around a great waraxe by her side.

Name: Koishikawa "Kawa" Sasaki
Known History:
Koishikawa Sasaki is one of a pair of twins born to Sayumi Sasaki, a well respected member of 100G Security. While she had excelled well in her schooling, she chose to not pursue college in favor of taking care of the twin's younger sister, Minebea. She currently works as a freelance hacker.

[HPD file Codename: Crow]

[Possible affiliation with the Goldnails. Suspected of a few armed robberies in relation to Goldnail activity. Possible link to cybercriminal activity.]
Physical Description: Kawa is 4'11" with a thin frame and pale skin. With long, white hair that is typically stylized and well-kept. She is fairly expressive, wearing a smug smile in conversations with strangers. Typically wears a jacket, with a tank top underneath,  as well as pants, and boots. But likes to dress up often.

Name: Kori von Kleist
Known History:
To the Worldhelm, she is a mystery wrapped in an enigma.

But in Kaiway, she is part of the renowned von Kleist clan. A history of Paladins of Lillith was broken when she chose to join the House of Treasures. This scandal has created such distraction that Kori finds herself in the greatest horror: Remedial classes.
Physical Description:
Kori is a relatively tall woman at 5'6. The best word to describe her would be: Well put together. Her brown hair is immaculately kept, her glasses are always clean. If she is not wearing her school uniform (always pressed), she is wearing a lovely, regal green dress (always immaculate). The closest to 'unkempt' one could argue for her is her freckles, which she never bothers to cover up with her make up.

Kori never wields a weapon, and the reason why becomes very clear as soon as conflict begins: She becomes a long, heavy spear. The spear has an impressively keen edge, and seems to truly come to life when battling truly impressive foes.

Name: Krod
Known History: Krod is a Beast of the northern dune sea. The warrior long since decided to live free of Nezzim rule. Since to be human was to suffer their leadership, Krod decided to become a beast instead.  Krod lives in a cave hidden by the shifting sands of the dunes. He leaves this cave to wage battle against the Nezzim and those that would serve them. Krod is unsure what he is and why he has been gifted his shifting form though believes it to be a thing all can do should they simply decide to stop being lmited to being human. Krod does not attack things weaker than him, believing this to be below the rule of beasts, a complicated and vexing moral code that the caveman has developed. He lives to prove his blade and see the Empire brought to ruin. Kiir blood awakened mutations. Krod doesn't realize this
Physical Description: A muscular tan man dressed in scavenged armor. His body is riddled with scars notable a twisting strange one around his right arm.

Name: Kunzang
Known History:
For all his life, Kunzang has been a steward to his people. He grew up in a mostly-Yakshi populated village on the edge of the Tanggula Mountains, overlooking the Chamado Forest. Though a relatively peaceful existence, there was the occasional Spirit Beast attack either from the mountain or on groups of foragers sent out to gather what they could from the forest. Still, these were at most a weekly encounter that never really ended in significant bloodshed... until one night.

In the wake of one Spirit Beast's rampage, after fighting all night and into the morning against this beast, Kunzang swore to himself and his herd to always protect the innocents from any being seeking to do harm. Over the years, he's had practice against Spirit Beasts, raiders, and the occasional Empty Monk squad seeking to "pacify" the region.
Physical Description: Standing at a rather imposing 8'5" before factoring in his horns, and weighing in at roughly 650 lbs, Kunzang is an absolute fucking unit, even for his people. This massive specimen sports a two-tone fur pattern of white and red, large horns that turn black as they go on, and traditional clothing of the Holy Harmony's practitioners.

Name: Kurso Armstrong
Known History:
Those that know him closely, are familiar with the fact that he had gone to Korala academy as a student in Magitechnologies until he suddenly left out of nowhere, and as much as his close friends and even his sister in Korala try to reach out for him they were always out of reach for some reason.

However years passing he would arrive at Karlsgard and is recruited to the KPLA with a group of what seems like test subjects for an experiment called the Full Metal Militia Project where he exposed their secrets since he was a scientist that helped out in the experiments. From there he would join the KPLA and incidentally join in those chosen by the worldhelm.
Physical Description: Standing at 5'0 ft tall with Dirty blonde hair, wearing a white jacket and carrying a brown backpack, he carries a magitech railgun and also has a prosthetic arm due to him losing his original one on his operations to fight merrane.

Name: Kushala of the Blood Scarves
Identity: Shrewd Heir to the Fallen Khaganate
Known History:
Kushala was born and raised in the merciless wilds of Nezmira by the Blood Scarves tribe. Stories tell of a civilization of humans that supposedly reigned over the sand dunes millennia ago, led by a khagan recognized by all as the greatest leader throughout the plains. The tales end with the arrival of both Nezzim and Kiir and an internal power struggle in the khaganate, bringing an end to that glorious age of humanity.

Kushala was raised on such tall tales, and yet never believed in them personally. They saw these stories as naught more than fairy tales spoken to children to soothe their worries in a nigh-inhospitable world... at least, that's what they thought before they stumbled across an old woven scarf in an ancient ruin. The same crimson as the Blood Scarves' eponymous garb, Kushala swore they heard the words of the first khagan, imploring them to seek strength in the Realmstorm... now, Kushala seeks otherworldly strength and influence to bring peace to the sand dunes forever.
Physical Description: Kushala has a lean build, but their most immediately noticeable features are their sky-blue eyes, porcelain pale skin, and shoulder-length, snow-white hair, highly unusual in the endless sand dunes of Nezmira. Their appearance was seen as an omen from whatever gods that had long abandoned the tribe - that this child of light would lead them out of the darkness into a new, brighter future.

Name: Kviss Nergath
Age: At least 73 years old, but arguably 0
Known History:
Kviss used to be part of a little-known species that occupies more fantasy books than scholarly documents. They were discovered emerging from the wilderness north of Snowmaw quite recently. They spent a few weeks in the town but not of it, following eccentric but ultimately benevolent whims centered around helping the denizens of Snowmaw. Kviss' unnerving nature and strange altruism led the people of Snowmaw to refer to them as a helpful spirit. Kviss didn't linger for long; they threw themselves at the first realmstorm shortly after, saving a young child from being swept up from it in the process.

Since then, Kviss has been relatively reclusive, showing up for missions but scarcely involving themselves beyond that unless called for. As of 7/25/2024, they have somehow become biologically human. Then on 4/20/2025, after messing with fate in ways mortals shouldn't during the siege on Utopia, she was reborn a Nephilim. Now, she's far more extroverted & dedicated to her ideal of heroism.
Physical Description: A 5'10" woman with antlers (6'2" with antlers included). She has purple eyes, and hair that's green on one side and black on the other. Her skin is brown. Her attire is a weird mix of Kor'Tarion and Lhodos, wearing a wide poncho with several completely unnecessary belts. For those well acquainted with Dhata, they seem like they could be cousins, aside from all the clearly inhuman influences.

Name: Kxaxukluth
Identity: Terrible Monster with a Good Heart
Known History: Kxaxukluth was wrought to life by strange means in the dungeons beneath the ruined Caer Moryd. The magicians who created him sought to harness the natural world for a living weapon in the form of a monster, and he prowled the surrounding area for many nights under their beck and call. When they completed Kxaxukluth by making him intelligent, he realized quickly he did not want to be this. He freed himself.
Physical Description: This lean humanoid usually resembles a bipedal cat, just over 5'6". The resemblance is superficial. The line that runs across their back is not coloration; it is a long row of teeth and fangs which open to a terrible tendril-filled maw that spans its entire body. To be polite and prevent panic, Kxax covers this unnatural form with nice ponchos, though he more often lets his head free now.

Name: Ky Kusho
Known History:
A sinister looking cultivator roaming and offering guidance, healing and protection on his path.

Tends to glare and or smirk and nothing in particular sometimes.
Physical Description:
Standing at 5'11

He has a refined yet sinister appearance, he has long dark hair with and usually has a constant smirk or seems to glare at something or someone. 

An eye patch covers his right eye, and the left red eye often glints with a  supernatural glow especially when using his magic. 

He exudes a cold confident energy surrounded by a faint dark aura, on his neck a tattoo of a snake biting a dagger atop of some flowers

Name: Köll Akihiko Vol
Known History:
There once was a Miko named Akihiko, a shrine priest of no renown, dedicated to the service of Lorelei and Kuzunoha. This boy, a yokai, had a dear friend, Köll. 

Akihiko loved his subjects, in his shrine in the Sea of Blizzards. He would do anything to protect them, sacrifice anything. His resolve was tested when Köll was infected with Godblood, and so Akihiko undertook a journey to find a cure.

But that journey ended in tragedy, for Godblood is not to be trifled with. Akihiko lost his memories, his identity, and his family.

Now, taking the name of his lost friend, Köll wanders the tundra of the Blood Grotto, protecting Yokai and Ald alike from the dangers that hide beneath the ice.
Physical Description:
A short and meek boy, Köll wanders the tundra of Aldistir in search of people to help and warmth.

Altough he is a Yokai, his only bestial trait are his sharp claws and teeth. He wears a fur mantle to keep the cold away, and under that he dresses as a shrine priest. His eyes are two cold blue rings within darkness.

Name: Lady Kezhari
Known History: Lady Kezhari was once a proud noble lady in Skamos, but never one with an incredible standing. She is a practiced spiritist, but also studied law in order to change the Nezzim empire for the better as she detested how humans could be abused so freely. As such, she frequently petitioned for laws against such poor treatment of the Empire's slaves, however she still held onto notions of Nezzim superiority over humans. In order to silence her, those in power fabricated a scandal which left her in utter disgrace, though she refuses to speak on the specifics. Her career was destroyed overnight, and she was treated as the laughingstock of Skamos. Khezari couldn't go anywhere without being recognized, and so she fell into a deep depression as all hopes she had of changing the empire were washed away. In her misery she freed all of her slaves and then ventured out of Skamos alone, waiting to die at the hands of the Kiir, only to find a realmstorm instead.
Physical Description: A tall, lizardlike humanoid standing at 6'2". Kezhari's purple scales are smooth to the touch, and she has floppy ears with a doglike muzzle to boot. She typically wears a long, flowing robe and hats of questionable fashion sense.

Name: Laeli
Identity: Broken Soul With A Yearning Heart
Known History:
- Laeli grew up a slave in the Black Wolf Warband, along with her younger brother Ikko. Having grown up around suffering, the sight of another's pain never failed to wound her--so she offered her strength to those who couldn't bear their burdens. She knew how little it mattered--but if she could do anything to make their lives better, she did. 

- The chance came to help in an escape, and the two siblings stayed behind to distract. They fled last, but the results were disastrous: Ikko perished, and Laeli was dragged back. The death of her brother destroyed her spirit--even after lashings, she wouldn't work--so she was sold to the now-Blood Wolves for sacrifice.

- Later in the year, the day came. Still gripped by soul-crushing anguish, Laeli bargained herself in place of three children. She could endure far more before passing, and her suffering would appease the Great Wolf. They listened. Just moments before she succumbed to their terrible work, a realmstorm snatched her from the end.
Physical Description:
A towering, 6'5" hare yokai with white fur and rough scars. Powerfully built, uses both plate mail and a heavy waraxe in battle. She has an eyepatch on her left eye, which partially covers a brand-mark on the left side of her face. The mark resembles the visage of a snarling wolf. 

Laeli's strength and height hardly match her demeanor. She's pensive, thoughtful, and exudes a gentleness that shouldn't belong on someone as scarred as she is. If her appearance indicates anything, though, it is that the young yokai has endured a great deal.

Name: Laurence Howell
Known History:
Through the Majority of Laurence's life. He was told that if he wanted to live with content, he needed to surpass his peers to land a job at a big-shot corporation and get out of North Rock. However, the more these expectations stewed the more difficult it got, and when his efforts got disregarded, he turned into a shell of himself. 

After having spent years in a shitty office, slaving away under horrible working conditions. Laurance was laid off so the company could properly hit fiscal quotas. Lost in life, He decided to use his savings as a buffer to try and find anything that could bring him joy. 

He eventually met an old man called Renaud who ran an art boutique and Atelier, and was drawn to the world of art, becoming his protegee. For the first time in years, things were looking up. However, the man turned weak and was forced to be hospitalized. With only art and sporadic freelance work on his side. Laurence is trying his best to make due off of this newfound passion.
Physical Description: Quite the peculiar sight at the Worldhelm, Laurence stands at 5'10" with a demeanor leaning on the benign side. The most glaring aspect of his appearance is his apparent canine features, achieved through methods of self-expression that are unique to his homeland. Beyond that though, Laurance can be seen dressed fairly nicely with different assortments of dress shirts, vests, suits, and jackets to go alongside his mellow green eyes and trusty bag that he rarely parts ways with.

Name: Lei-Lei
Known History: Lei-Lei is the twin sister of Mei-Mei. He grew up with her under a cool old man he calls "Gong-Gong." He taught him how to fish and how to fight, and when he introduced Lei-Lei to fireworks, the Vanara's absurd interest and affinity for the things made itself known. He searches for yet more beauty to inspire his displays and more people to show them to, and to do so (but also cause he was bored) he leaves to go on an adventure with his sister. After making one funny chaos formation, they end up in some trouble.
Physical Description: Lei-Lei is a 5'8" Vanara boy with a thin build and a lithe frame. Even though he works with dangerous, explosive alchemy, he's always well-kept and dressed in blacks and reds that compliment his own colors.

Name: Leilani
Known History:
There are rumors going around the streets. At night, make sure to keep you doors locked and your gates guarded. Unless you want to wake up with your valuables whisked away, as if they were never there. The Cat Burglar strikes at both big businesses and the mansions of wealthy individuals. She comes in and out without a sound, taking various precious trinkets with her.

But this got nothing to do with Leilani (obviously). The demi-human is a mercenary of little note. She is most often seen taking jobs that involves escorting refugees and protecting vulnerable areas of the city. And playing with the children at the orphanage too.
Physical Description: Standing at a glorious 5'6, with her head covered with short silver hair and a large pair of ears. Her golden eyes rarely stand still, always looking around.  Over her feline tail is her bag tied to her waist that she carries around at all times.

Name: Leo Kallio
Known History:
Those in unfortunate circumstances don't have many options when it comes to obtaining medical services. Thankfully, a kind soul has taken it upon himself to offer those people the most premium self-made pharmaceuticals at bargain prices.

"Pharmacist", as he often introduces himself, prides himself providing those *in* need with *what* they need. Minor ailments. Major conditions. Even recreational needs will be met with a smile and a personally formulated solution. Just be sure to follow the directions left on the sticky note.
Physical Description:
A tall, lean individual dressed in a suit far too expensive for the places he frequents. Beneath the black hat adorning his head is a short, messy bundle of golden brown hair that further conceals a pair of blue eyes.

Usually seen carrying a briefcase and exhaling colored smoke from a black cigarette.

Name: Leobald Mountainspine
Identity: Devout Paladin of the Old Faith
Known History: Follower of an old faith, previously worked as a guard.
Physical Description: Dark hair and blue eyes, a tall athletic build adorned in armor and a cloak. Leobald carries a shield and axe, both engraved with the symbol of his fellow paladins.

Name: Levan
Known History:
Two brothers were born to a Hiear merchant family in Windhaven—twins, always together, always in step. They spent their early years traveling with their family caravan, learning the trade and following the quiet traditions of their people.

On their 17th name day, tragedy struck. Their caravan was attacked. Only Levan returned.

He changed after that. Quieter. Distant. Some say he turned to old, forgotten rites out of grief. Whatever happened, he began traveling alone—though many claimed he still spoke as if someone else was there.

Years later, after a strange flash in the sky, Levan was seen again—no longer alone and now a Goldhearted upon the Worldhelm. Though he doesn't quiet know that yet.
Physical Description:
Levan is lithe, sun-kissed and slightly shorter than his brother, standing at 6'0" (6'10" with his ears upright). His hair and fur are the same striking white, though his features are softer—his face framed by long bangs and a calm, almost wistful expression. His eyes are a warm amber-gold, more curious than piercing, with a faint melancholy lingering beneath them. Unlike his brother, Levan’s presence is quiet and subtle, with a grace that borders on delicate.

He wears light, travel-worn garb—white layered cloth and fitted leather armor, practical and modest, with subtle patterns hinting at Windhaven craftsmanship. A choker sits snugly on his neck, etched with the symbol of his family’s patron.

Name: Li Dan-Dan
Known History: Li Dan-Dan, an orphan raised by Master Ghanzi in the secluded Peach Blossom Sect, grew up mastering Earth Qi and the ancient Blossoming Blade technique. Known for her sword dancing, tricks, and pranks, she brought joy to those around her despite her playful nature. However, her recklessness in fighting injustice led to the accidental revelation of her identity as a Goldhearted, forcing her to be constantly on the run from villains. Despite this, she continues to protect others and pursue justice wherever she goes.
Physical Description: A lavender swordswoman who leaves trails of vibrant peach blossoms in her path. Tall and slender woman with jet black hair tied in a high-top ponytail, eyes the color of violets, wears a slim battle tunic and pants, carries a Jian sword in the scabbard by hand. Height 5' 8".

Name: Lilac Brightshield
Identity: Unlucky and Exiled Princess turned Clothier
Known History:
Lilac is a clothier, a craftsman of garments. She hails from the City of Brightshield, in Kor'Tarion, and once upon a time, her name meant something. Those days of nobility are over for her though, exiled by her family and the City. Those who reside there may have heard of this incident, transpiring some couple years before Lilac arrived at the Worldhelm today, but the cause of her exile remains unknown. 

Nowadays, she roams the land, practicing her craft and honing her talents. Her privileged upbringing allowed for a variety of lessons and tutors, and in this time, she became a skilled dancer. With this, she now takes her ballroom dancing and royal etiquette to the battlefield.
Physical Description:
Standing at around 5'10" and wielding an oversized pair of scissors, Lilac appears intimidating, to say the least, despite her elegant dress sense and slender frame. She has long, white hair, purple eyes befitting of her name, and carries herself with poise and precision.

The strange scissors she carries everywhere is made of a pristine silver, inlaid with gems of varying purple shades.

Name: Liliwen Bremblebery
Known History:
Liliwen hails from an old Honeydew farming family. But between the founding of Tradefair and her father's fateful run-in with a fae, they're just one more landless poor family in that great city. Liliwen was always a rambunctious child, enjoying physicality and playfully throwing her surprising strength around.

As an adult she went into mercenary work, making something of a name for herself despite her obvious peculiarity. Not nearly enough to buy land and restore her family to the status they should have, but plenty to pay for their food and rent.

After a job went wrong, Liliwen encountered a Realmstorm and ended up on the Worldhelm.
Physical Description: At 4'10" with massive furry brown ears and a pink tail, Liliwen looks mousy in more ways than one. Despite her stature, she is strong and built with the muscles to show it. Not that they're often visible, with the bronze plate she wears over deep green padding. Her hair is long and pale blonde, falling quite far down her back when not tied up neatly to fit in her helmet. Her eyes are ruby red, and when she opens her mouth one can notice slightly pronounced buck teeth.

Name: Lillian Vox
Known History:
Arianwyn Wood, born and (mostly) raised in Brightshield, rejected the town's gloom and reinvented herself as Lillian Vox, a traveling entertainer. While many believe she's a true mage, she insists she's just a street magician: “Real magic? I’m not that blessed.”
Others whisper she’s faetouched, mistaking whimsy for otherworldly ties. Driven to spread wonder, she roamed from town to city, going wherever joy was needed. One day, she stumbled upon a realmskipper and, trusting in luck, stowed away. Arriving at the Worldhelm, she realized it wasn’t luck—it was fate. Ever eager to dazzle, Lillian keeps a card in her hand and a trick up her sleeve for anyone willing to watch.
Physical Description: Lillian is a living burst of carnival chaos—decked in vivid reds, purples, and electric blues stitched into a deliberately asymmetrical ensemble that seems stitched together by whimsy itself. Golden bells and patterned fabrics dance with her every step, while her patchwork jester’s cloak swirls like a stage curtain in motion. Her silver-white hair cascades in tousled waves, crowned by a flamboyant hat adorned with feathers, cards, and just enough flair to draw every gaze. Her heterochromia—one eye bright and curious, the other bold and mischievous—only adds to the mystique with quirky makeup always in place and cards never far from her fingertips.
Species: Human? Fae? People argue about that.

Name: Lin Baimei
Known History: ||A woman from Xuanwu City, a hoarder of junk and knicknacks. Sometimes treasure, who knows. Not even she, she kind of forgot what she has in her home on the giant turtle.  But within the bowels, she met and was saved by a Spirit Beast, that changed her forever.||
Origin: Tian Yin, Wujing Guo, Xuanwu's Grave
Physical Description:
A pale lady seemingly in appearance around her late twenties, with long white hair and a keen eye. Standing at 170cm in height, she carries herself with grace until she loses herself, in which case she becomes enthusiastic and eccentric to a degree.

Though almost always uses her right hand, even if using her left would make more sense.

Name: Lin Shěn
Identity: A Disgraced Student, Living In Self-Exile
Known History: Due to his sudden disappearance from his home and appearance on the worldhelm not much is known of Lin. He is a young man, hailing from the realm of Wujing Guo, living in self imposed exile with his adoptive brother Xuhu. After years of solitude and countless battles he was whisked away onto the worldhelm.
Origin: Tian Yin, Wujing Guo, Jinjing Xiantiao, Bingchuan
Physical Description:
A tall and imposing man, this Jinshi warrior possesses a powerful, towering physique. His broad shoulders and well-defined muscles sculpted through years of battle and cultivation, his chest and arms are marked with scars, each a testament to past conflicts. A thick, wild mane of dark hair flows around his face, further emphasizing his  guardian lion-like heritage. His clawed hands are large and calloused, built for both combat and protection. His legs are equally formidable, covered in patches of fur that lead down to powerful, clawed feet, giving him a beast-like stance.

He wears a flowing green robe adorned with subtle, intricate patterns, tied at the waist with a wide, crimson sash decorated with cloud motifs. A large fur pelt drapes over one shoulder, hinting at past victories over formidable beasts and spirits alike. Hanging from his waist are gourds and additional cloth ornaments, resembling ceremonial talismans and protective charms against corrupt cultivators.

Name: Lionel Il'Hrarra
Identity: Lost Little Fish Trying His Best
Known History:
- Born to a noble family in Ripplith, Lionel was the firstborn daughter, and the heir apparent, set to inherit the authority of the family.
- They come out as trans, and go to a Seamother to undergo the ritual to fit into a body of their own.
- Now a man, and unable to hold authority in the matriarchal society of the Galeo Empire, their family looks down on him for throwing away his birthright and responsibility.
- He is then sent off to the Gnosis Academy to find his own path, and so as to no longer be in his mother's sight.
- Lionel takes well to the classes and the trials of becoming a Regalia yet all the while there is a sense that something is wrong. He struggles to make friends and socialize, and after some months his grades begin to slip...
- Thus, he is in the remedial program.
Physical Description:
About 6ft tall, Lionel Il'Hrarra is a fount of little guy energy. To combat his little man aura, he dresses up in a style reminiscent of sailors and their ships in Ripplith, always decorated in a coat and a set of boots, usually with some sort of net for an accessory.

It is a rare event to see him in normal clothing.

Name: Lizbern "Liz" Harfell
Known History: Liz was born in the town of Vale in the realm of Lhodos.  When she was a child, Merrane's forces attacked her town and destroyed it, leaving her as the only survivor.  Liz acts as a member of the KPLA, fighting to free the land from Merrani rule.  One day, she and her allies discover the location of a prototype mech, and plot to steal it.  Lizbern is trained in the basics of piloting using stolen acadamy materials.  Getting to the mech goes as planned, but as they make their escape, Merrani angels descend on the rebels.  Liz chooses to fight, holding them back with the prototype while her comrades escape.  The prototype is badly damaged and Liz mortally wounded, but as the enemy approached to finish her off, a pillar of light rescues her to the Worldhelm.  Laughing at her fortune Liz christens the prototype "Liberty Wing", and resolves to return to Lhodos and finish the fight against the Empire.
Physical Description: Lizbern Harfell is an average sized young woman with short red hair and green eyes. Her torso and arms bear burn scars from when she was young. She typically wears dark cargo pants, a plain red shirt, and a black leather jacket. She wears fingerless gloves with a thermal device attacked to the back of them. Her left arm bears a metal bracer with a control interface that she uses to call in her mech.

Name: Lloyd
Identity: Naive Wandering Warrior Trying His Best
Known History:
Lloyd is a an orphan from the town of Dryholde who ran away from his orphanage, only to end up being saved and apprenticed to a wandering hero after a series of unfortunate events. Despite being otherwise bumbling and uncoordinated, Lloyd was found to be a quick learner in the art of combat - and soon, mentor and mentee became more like father and son.

Years passed by as Lloyd and his mentor wandered about, saving people from all manner of bandit and beastie. However, after a particularly successful adventure, his mentor suddenly disappeared without a trace. Driven to find out where his mentor had gone, Lloyd struck out on his own - wielding his spear and shield to protect others when he could!

... well, that was his plan, at least. Alas, only a week after making this decision, he was caught by a realm storm in the middle of an otherwise peaceful nap - waking up dazed and confused on the Worldhelm.
Physical Description: 5’6 feet tall, 140 lbs. Looks somewhat scrawny, but is just rocking a sleeper build. Never seen without his helmet on and his weapons close by, even when relaxing and sleeping. The only thing you can make out through the helmet's visor are piercing blue eyes. Gives off an intimidating aura that very quickly melts away the moment he speaks.

Name: Lochlann Carlisle
Known History:
A quick search on the Terran net for Lochlann will yield hundreds of results about him being the second son of Magnus Carlisle, the ruthless CEO of the family-owned Regenekhan Pharmaceuticals. Lochlann is employed as a head researcher and inventor for the biotech company beneath his older brother and heir apparent, Alistair. He holds Ph.D degrees in both medicine and business from Haven University.

Interviews with Magnus have him proudly share that Alistair and Lochlann are his clones through the use of Regenekhan's proprietary gene editing techniques that allow for augmentations of DNA in the womb. The expectations he has for both of his "sons" to take over the company are substantial.
Physical Description:
Lochlann is a lion-augmented businessman flecked with white, gold-tipped fur who stands at an impressive 6’9”. Contouring his muscular frame is a kevlar-lined suit that protects him in the boardroom and the streets of Terra.

His gentlemanly demeanor and typically warm smile can quickly turn cold when his friends and colleagues are threatened. Along with a power watch capable of creating energy shields, an unusual black device affixed to his belt reveals his technical skill as a medical researcher.

Name: Lock
Known History:
Not much is known about this mysterious little fox! Though she's clearly some kind of yokai, she claims innocence as to what *exactly* her nature is.

What she *is*, though, is an excellent salesfox! True to the necklace they wear, they have come to wear petals and peddle wares.

With a stock of nearly anything in her cute little backpack, she's ready to take on the world!
Physical Description: Lock is a regular-sized fox - about a foot and a half tall at the shoulder, and weighing 25 pounds. She wears a backpack perfectly sized for her!

Name: Locke 🔥
Known History:
Locke's upbringing was shaped by his hatred for the way the Scalefire empire treated his mage parents. In his desire to change his parent's circumstances, he wanted to become a force of nature. Something *angry*, and *hateful*. Something the empire would fear *more* than mages. In pursuit of becoming this terror, he attempted to bind himself to a demon arcanum of vicious burning, Tubalcain. This demon felt Locke's anger, deemed it worthy of his blessing, and allowed the boy to inflict himself with an arcanum of ineffable inferno. This created the half-demon burning with hate that we know today, Locke. Since then, he has acted against the empire - and has been taken away to the Worldhelm.

On the worldhelm, he must learn to control and direct his hatred now more than ever.
Physical Description:
5' 9"
190 lbs.
Locke wears a bandage-esque talisman wrapped around his torso, as well as baggy pants tucked into metal combat boots. which binds him to the flame demon arcanum, Tubalcain. Locke's right-half is perpetual inferno, while his left side is (most of the time) skin.

Name: Lucia
Identity: Nihilistic problem child, with a spine of steel.
Known History: Lucia, sometimes called 'Luce' by her few acquaintances, is a young woman struggling to survive. She reluctantly takes on the few jobs she knows how, debt collection and strong-arming being the most common. In her few years of work, she has claimed a small reputation as a somewhat talented fighter, and claims a meager wage doing so - barely enough to live on. Deep down, she hates the way that she lives, the way that this world forces her to be to survive, and has become quite nihilistic as a result. To her, the circumstances that led her to the worldhelm are, naturally,  just an accident - a freak accident. There's certainly no way that the ship would select her, of all people, to be a Gold-Hearted. Absolutely no chance.
Physical Description: Lucia has a lithe-lanky mix figure - a result of physical training/work, as well as malnutrition. She stands just under average height - about 5' 3", and has shoulder-length grey hair. Her usual attire is a large jacket or hoodie, paired with whatever combination of combat boots and shorts or pants she fancies that day. She speaks with a rough tone, and is quite quick to resort to physical violence when things aren't quite going her way.

Name: Lucia Vitarex
Identity: Royal Healer with a Heart of Gold
Known History:
Lucia was born into a long line of healers and priests, which served the royalty of the city, at least before the last day of the moon. After the disaster struck the lands, the Vitarex family concentrated their efforts on the safekeeping of the city and its people, which not only brought them trust and respect from the common folk, but also a lot of money, thus making them one of the more influential families in the city, but of course not on the level of the old or new royalty. 

That is the world Lucia was born into, which gave her the advantages a rich house has while still needing to prove herself by helping those in need, whether it be with her medical expertise, preparing meals for the poor or helping the city guard defend against outside threats. All of that together made her a person that understands royalty while still being very humble. 

That's why, when a storm took Lucia with it and gave her the opportunity to help many people on different worlds, she accepted.
Physical Description: Lucia has a rather small build, standing at 5'2 (160cm) and weighting about 130lbs (59kg). She has her hair in a bun most of the time and is either wearing a brown sweater and a pair of black pants or a, for her physique, surprisingly heavy armor, depending on whether she is helping out in the kitchen or is out in the field. On special occasions, one might also spot her in a priestly robe

Name: Lumio
Known History:
Carson died and was sent to heaven. He spent two hundred years watching people died and soon dedicated himself to helping others escape, not himself. After the first few decades it became so taxing that they started hallucinating. With a new name to inspire hope, Lumio, they started to spend their time trying to protect caravans everyday. They failed in saving their last caravan, but when Lumio got close to the edge the voices crept in and he escaped onto the Worldhelm..

Now Lumio is known as a warrior, a paladin, a shield to hide behind. He gives speeches to inspire hope, though he is a little unsure himself Lumio will always smile with a sudden confidence. After being apart of the war on the moon against Loftur Lumio won't put up with anyone saying they aren't enough. He *will* help others realize their potential. He's seen greatness and he'd be damned if he didn't help if blossom in others.
Origin: Fourth layer of Idyll, Maze Elysia
Physical Description: Lumio is semi-ethereal and looks like a medium height mid 20’s man. Their limbs, as well as their hair seem to fizzle into wisps on certain parts of their body. They have orange eyes and circle glasses that rest above their big smile, along with blue metal armor and two round shields. Lumio’s toothy grin lights up when there's people around and never lets people down with a frown unless he's really not feeling well.

Name: Lunira
Known History: Lunira was outcast from her home on Kor'Tarion after an encounter with a shard of the realm's shattered moon that left her permanently changed. She's been on a few journeys since then, but eventually she found her way to the Worldhelm, called in by the chance to make a difference.
Physical Description: She stands at a mighty 5'6" and while she used to be a normal human, she more closely resembles a humanoid monster in appearance after her transformation. Her skin glows with radiant light as her body struggles to contain the power stored within it and her head is adorned with horns formed to channel the power.

Name: Lupo
Known History: An orphan abandoned at the frontlines of the war that was taken care of by the KPLA. After growing up in an orphanage where no one came to pick him up, Lupo joined the ranks of the KPLA in the search for meaning. There, he found himself training harder and harder to eventually join the Sapper Core, a special anti-mecha division of the KPLA, where only the best of the best could join. When he finally managed to get himself in their trainee ranks, a nightmare triggered his Esper powers, leading to a massive fiery accident that culminated in him fleeing from Karlsgard with his training mech and a stolen airship. Months later, he paid back all of his debt and is now trying to resume his training with all his new experience within the Worldhelm.
Physical Description: Smoll little guy that looks young, but has seen war.

Name: Lyle Whitlock
Identity: Courier Tinkerer turned Combat Medic in Training
Known History:
To the people of Kaiway, Lyle is a well-known figure, often seen alongside his best friend, Vial, a Machina from Steelbin. Lyle has made a name for himself by handling deliveries for most of the students at Gnosis Academy, with Vial's assistance as they move swiftly around Heartdom, often using freerunning to navigate the city’s tight spaces.

It’s common knowledge that Lyle comes from the Whitlock family, renowned couriers who run Whitlock Deliveries, the primary messengers of Heartdom. However During his second year at the academy, in an attempt to cast magic, he nearly lost his life, only to discover that his body could not handle the strain of magic use.
Physical Description:
162 cm (5'4") tall, young, effeminate-presenting person whilst doing deliveries they wear a bulky white jacket and has black hair under a cap with goggles and equipped with various gadgets. 

Whilst at downtime he wears his Gnosis academy uniform, wearing a red scarf and an emblem of the House of Paladins.

Name: Lynne-4
Known History: While her history would be almost completely unknown to those of the Worldhelm, besides from her origin in Kaiway, her fellow classmates would know that Lynne-4, insisting that the number be dropped from her name in conversation, is a socially inquisitive, and kind student, if somewhat ignorant of boundaries. Sent to the Worldhelm because of her touchiness around her past, and her less than ideal teamwork and social skills.
Physical Description: Lynne is a sturdily built woman, barely coming up to 5’5” in height, with slightly tanned skin, and hair and eyes in differing shades of purple. She sports a slightly modified Gnosis Academy uniform, with a pale lavender light constantly flowing through her clothing. She carries with her, either in a carrying case by her side, or held aloft by magic surrounding her, several large cleavers with which she uses to fight, and enhance her control over her magic, and its influence on the metals she interacts with.

Name: Mabilis Na'ulan
Known History: Mabilis Na'ulan is one of the few surviving cultivators who took the righteous path after Xiang Shinan waged the war against heaven, having been a young cultivator under the boot of the Blackhearted, he trained in secret alongside another student under a righteous cultivator, Master Na'alon. During his time as a wandering warrior, his cultivation base was shattered, and remains in a state of recovery, severely limiting his potential despite his relative experience. Mabilis is accompanied by a spirit beast he calls Gan-Gan, who supplements his weaknesses, acting as a reliable companion, and old friend.
Physical Description: An old man who's appearance is hides his true age, Mabilis stands at 6'1 with an athletics build, bearded with a disheveled head of grey hair held up by a headband. He wears light clothing covered in a heavy cloak dyed a blue reminiscent of the ocean, a style recognized easily as that of a martial artist hailing from Tian Yin. His face is deep set with scars and wrinkles alike, but Mabilis often wears a smile despite the clear toll the life of a cultivator has taken.

Name: Madhuri Somasundaram
Known History:
Madhuri is a demonkin born in the underground city of Little Lantern in the Bahata Khajaana.

Her mother is a fire cultivator, and Madhuri pestered her for training from an early age.
While hotheaded and impulsive, she is also stubborn and dedicated. She put in the mental, physical, and spiritual work to become a cultivator of fire qi, in the old ways, banned in the Khajaana.

As she came of age, she was chomping at the bit to somehow help with things. To resist the Maharaja's forces, somehow. To hunt down dangerous spirit beasts before they struck. Or to venture elsewhere to help defend a smaller demonkin village. *Something.* She never took well to being told she needed much more time training first.

Eventually she set out to assist a small group on a short journey, and faced real dangers for the first time, narrowly all surviving. Only to one night be swept into a Realmstorm, leaving those she was escorting behind.
Origin: Little Lantern, Bahata Khajaana, Tian Yin
Physical Description:
Madhuri stands 5'10", or 178cm. Her frame is slight, pear-shaped, with very long legs... Which resemble that of a chicken, scaled from the knee down, with ankles resembling reversed knees and ending in very large feet. She wears fitted metal claws for use in combat.

She wears baggy, concealing clothing; not out of shame of her scales and feathers, but simply because she likes how she can move around in it. Her hands are also scaly, and end in claws, fairly blunted by work. She likes flower motifs.

She has long hair, which she tends to put up in a high ponytail. *(It's not nearly as much as in the picture.)* With very pale skin and white hair, Madhuri is noticeably albino; her eyes are even fully red, rather than the normal colors in human albinism. At home, though, it's not particularly remarked on. Few colors are exactly *unusual* for demonkin, after all.

Name: Mae Lavery
Known History: Mae works as a temp for T&C in addition to working in the explosives development program. Her temp work involves a lot of doing field demonstrations of T&C's experimental projects, primarily explosives since that's her area. A year ago was involved in an accident that claimed her life before she was brought back as an insolvent. The events of Skyfall when parts of Terra's moon rained down seemed to have been the push for her to get recognized as a Goldhearted, as not long after helping during those events she was picked up by the ship.
Physical Description: Mae is a young woman who stands at 5'8". She normally wears a bit of an angry expression when she is in thought or not actually speaking, which things then quickly change to a smile and she gives off a more upbeat energy. She skin is pale and her eyes read giving clear signs of insolvency to those who are familiar with it. Her normal attire would be a bit punkish in style.

Name: Mafqud Gazzlan
Known History:
Skamos always attracted people wanting to dive into the nearby ruins of Ista. So of course, some people tried to use that as an opportunity - like the Gazzlans, a family that made it their business to become guides to and in Ista. To be recognizable (and to distract the occasional Undead there), they started to wear Skeleton masks. 

As Mafqud's Grandpa died, something changed. The already quite curious and crafty Mafqud inherited an object the Grandpa found on one trip. A cabinet, seemingly able to attract lost things and gadgets. 

As that clearly was some kind of magic, Mafqud started to travel around, posing as peddler, to hide from the Branding as a Mage. In the nights, he fiddled around with the things from the cabinet and realized that he can make them make ... stuff. Just not very reliably. 

Just when he was about to be found out by some inquisitive guards, he got the call.
Physical Description: Mafqud is a slender man, not the buffest, but buff enough to carry the small cabinet on his back - which he also uses to hide behind when feeling anxious. Almost always wears a skeleton mask to hide his face. In the rare moments he takes it off, he looks like a shy man with black hair, a stubbly beard and tan, olive skin as many people living under the Nezmiran sky.

Name: Mahuizoh
Identity: Death Exorcist Seeking a Fitting End
Known History:
Mahuizoh was an exorcist who traveled, banishing undead and generally killing things that breathed too much for the common good. After a chance fight with his fellow exorcists, he found himself responsible for watching of Risata, a woman who eventually came to be his wife. 

Despite his apparent blindness, he's fairly canny, and has a lackadaisical attitude.

He REALLY loves his wife.
Physical Description: 5'10, wiry muscle, blind, tattooed up

Name: Majesty
Known History:
The burbling of a rock-choked brook, the crash of great waves against high cliffs, the gentle hiss of autumn rain... Each an instrument, a song in its own right. And Majesty was born of this song, birthed into cognition by the overactive minds of sailors and school children. The Muse in The Rain, The Naiad, The Siren, The Mermaid... 

Majesty was born alongside the merfolk, filling in the edges of storybooks and fairy tales like spilled ink on a square of pale cloth. And from there, they took flight into their own story.

A knight, a poet, a mage... They've played and sung for fae kings and fae queens, from the lowly gnome to the highest elf. At least, that is if you believe what they say. Why now are they Goldhearted? Why now must they act within the ballads they once sung? Who knows...
Physical Description:
Standing at 6'7", Majesty is a towering, slender shape with thin limbs lined with folding fins. Colored in shades of blue, with midnight black hair and a mouth of teeth that fold against their mouth, it is extremely apparent that they are nothing remotely close to human, no matter how human their song might sound...

Majesty dresses lavishly in flowing silks and satins, always wrapped up in loose fitting clothing. If not for social expectation, this emperor would have no clothes.

Name: Mako Torres
Known History: To those in Tangbawan they would know a family which was created thanks to the union of a Goldhearted and a Local. The young child of Mako the latest generation of the Torres family has been training in isolation for a while and has not been able to get too close to society in a long time. However as their master left for the heavenly war he was left to guard a place he called home, and as the realm was torn he was left with no one but himself. With the goal of completing his training.
Physical Description: Standing at about 5'9 with a very twinkish build, he's wrapped in bandages and has scarfs surrounding his neck and waist. He has brown hair dark brown eyes and emits this balanced energy of light and dark.

Name: Mari
Known History:
A self-proclaimed fighter who made a living by actively hunting monsters that emerge across Kor'Tarion, typically going for days at a time on hunts, endlessly beating down on the monsters one by one all day, keeping himself active with magic he'd aquired through exposure to the moonshards. While fighting a mage and bleeding out, everything went blank. His eyes opened, what's left was scars to remind of what could've been, he'd been brought back just so they could fight longer. The mage's hubris let him fight for another day, and perhaps more.

He's laughing........
Physical Description: A man with a thin, but muscular build. Blue eyes and brown hair that partially covered his face. Carrying scars across his entire body. Around 180 CM tall, and weighing 71 KGs.  Wearing a rather light hoodie and wields odd weapons instead of any traditional fighting equipment.

Name: Mari and Mori
Identity: The Silent Jester of Kingdom Road
Known History:
Mari and Mori travelled the Kingdom Road alone for many years. Long enough that rumors of a jester-child and a mechanical puppet assailing or harassing passerby's live in the ideas of legends as far back as a decade ago. Though, she's always simply been an agent of chaos, and never villainy. Scaring people, only stealing from the wealthy, and warding off danger from travelers.

She's shown herself a few times on the ship, but is rarely onboard.
Physical Description:
Mari is a 4'8'' girl wearing baggy mismatched patchy clothing. She has jesters cap on her head with a pair of red striped horns that rests over her messily cut hair. She weighs about 80 lbs, and is built like it. She walks with a dance to her step and never speaks. Inside her collar is the stitched name `Mari`.

Mori is a pink dog-mouthed stuffed toy, with patchy spots where holes have been filled. They're soft, and smell like an attic. They have heterochromatic button eyes, and are stuffed with something that feels akin to wool. Though, squeezing them reveals the metal bones that fill them, and the warm crystal at the center of their chest. Inside his collar is the stitched name `Mori`.

Name: Marianne Cheon
Known History: Raised single-handedly by her uncle after losing her parents before she even developed object permanence, Marianne developed a love for video games and the occult, both of which her uncle regularly exposed her to. Her inquisitive mind allowed her to excel in her studies, eventually leading to her dream job of becoming a developer at SWORD. Unfortunately, just as she got promoted, her uncle fell ill and could no longer run his business. Feeling like she owed her life to him, she decided to take up moonlighting as a rookie exorcist to keep his business going. She now tries to maintain both her jobs and her social life without crashing out.
Physical Description: A young woman who stands at 5'6. She keeps her hair short and parted to left, wears an oversized blue hoodie, and running shorts. She also has an assortment of prayer beads, both on her neck and wrist, as well as an ornamental sword on her back.

Name: Marie
Known History:
* Born to farmhands in a small farm off of brightshield
* Was a bright, cheerful child, but sometimes prone to anger
* At age 6 During a small fit of anger, her magic manifested when she accidentally caught the fields on fire, ruining half a season's harvest
* Hudal Academy was quickly called, and she was taken to learn
* Took to Fire magic very well, and did not have any talent outside of it beyond being able to preserve some of the magic from casting
* Graduated about 2 years ago
* Quietly returned to farm work, but got a little antsy and bored because she wasn't allowed to use magic.
* Snuck away to find an adventuring party like the old stories. This is when she was pulled into a realm storm.
Physical Description:
Marie is a short woman at a brisk 4'11, with a build that hits the powerful vibe of 'could be yanked away by a stiff breeze.' She is cute, with a constantly smiling face and an infectious cheer.

She wears exclusively witch's clothes, a long robe that looks very soft and comfy. And of course, a large witch hat. What kind of witch doesn't have a witch hat?
Pronouns: She/her, but its ok if you use others!

Name: Marilyn Maule
Known History:
Everybody knows that morals are the badge of the poor man. Luckily for Marilyn, she was never poor. She was born, raised, and trained for combat in Secura, which of course was thanks to their parents being employed by ETA.

Mary was put on a company contract from birth, this contract included what school she would go to, what classes she would attend, and what her job would be. Of course, since all this would be provided by ETA, who were her parents to say no? It was essentially a guarantee for success, and at no cost to them.

Needless to say, Marilyn was a star student all throughout her school and college years, as well as through her training period to become a Debt Collection Agent. 

With her tools and weapons in hand, Marilyn pulled in several hundred thousand zenit that would have been lost to the winds if the debtors weren't found or, in some cases, turned Insolvent.

But even machines can have a heart. Something had to give. So she vanished.
Physical Description: Marilyn Maule is a taller woman, standing just over six feet tall with a beanpole build. With hair just a few shades paler than her skin, Marilyn leans into her particular aesthetic, with her wardrobe consisting of various suits, all some combination of black, white, and red, and several pairs of satin gloves which she changes depending on context.

Name: May Shuggar
Known History:
May likes to keep her past to herself. She's open about certain parts, primarily that she's Vale born, isn't in contact with her family nor knows of their whereabouts, and has been drifting place to place for longer than she'd like.
Given her track record of financial instability, May's pursuits are often driven by monetary gain, out of a sense that she's personally justified in taking whatever she wins at the table.
If anyone asks about the arm, they always get the same response: "This? Lost it in a poker game."
Physical Description: Pale skin, freckles, dyed hair, unnaturally pink eyes, relatively short

Name: Mei-Mei (美美)
Known History:
Mei-Mei is the twin sister of Lei-Lei. She grew up with him under a cool old man she calls "Gong-Gong." He taught her how to fish, how to fight, and most importantly, how to play mahjong. She vows to be able to beat him in a game one day, and to do so (but also cause she was bored) she leaves to go on an adventure with her brother. After making one funny chaos formation, they end up in some trouble. 

Thankfully, a realmstorm saved the day! :D
Physical Description: Mei-Mei is a 5'8" Vanara girl with an incredibly light and nimble frame. With every step, she carries a natural, floral-toned scent of wild berries, matcha, and ginkgo leaves. Her hues of pink and purple clothes and fur ribbon downward and compliment her light brown skin.

Name: Mel
Known History:
Mel's from a carver family in the city of Brightshield, Kor'Tarion; a very much needed profession during its rebuilding. However, when she discovered a weak affinity to elemental magic Mel joined the city guard and only partially learned the family trade. She thought that, as long as the people in the city were safe, it would recover the wellness of the old days that old mans always moan about. 

She's learned to use the bow to fend off monsters, and also to pour her magic into crystal shards, which later imbue her arrows with elemental energies. And she's been of great help to fend off monsters threatening the city walls. 

However, Mel's yet to see any achievement significant enough for the people in the city. She understood that safety and time were not enough to bring people a brighter future, and that she'd need to do even more if she wished for it. 
Before she could even think of her next step, she found herself in the Worldhelm.
Physical Description:
Mel stands at a moderate height, around 1,75 cm. A dense high ponytail, woven with an intricate braid, showcases her striking yellowish orange hair, resembling that of a lion. Her brown eyes bear sparkling traces of yellow, showing to the future a bright view with optimism. 

She dresses in hot and sunny colors, which complement the looks of her hair and the little but furry tail on her back. Those colors exhibit her liveliness and her bright, positive view in life.

Name: Mel Monroe
Known History:
A retired monster hunter from Terra. Before ending her contract with PARABELLUM, she used to be one of their leading Hunters in the Battle Enforcement Division, but had to step out after her wife passed away.

Now, living her life as a widow in a corporate world, she tries to be her best self while living alone as an old woman.

However, as she was fighting a monster that invaded her neighborhood, after slicing through the creature, she was sent through a rift in reality into a flying ship above golden clouds.

It was time to take the dust off her old weapon, and bring back the meaning to her life.
Physical Description:
Melinda is a slim, tall and sharply dressed female human from Terra. Her white hair is often arranged in a high ponytail with little hair streaks by the side, hiding the handles of her round reading glasses she sometimes puts to good use.

Her style is often high class, after already having seen the lows of life, usually sporting a black tie as a habit from her monster hunting days at Parabellum. Her go to colors are white and black, matching her hair and overall personality.

A smile for the welcome, a fist for the wicked. This is the philosophy that has carried her for the last few decades, and will continue to until her last breath.

Name: Melinda Valentine
Known History:
Melinda was an activist that spoke out against the war in Lhodos. For this she was abducted and used as a guinea pig in Merrane's experiments for over a decade.

After many years Melinda is reunited with her child on the Worldhelm. The child she found has grown into a capable woman without her. Idyll made her realize Monique doesn't need her mother anymore. She would only slow her daughter down...
Physical Description: Melinda stands at 6'4" with pale skin and slender figure. Her short hair and eyes are white, a pair of fuzzy antennae sprouting from her head. She is often accompanied by a swarm of moths attracted to her like a flame.

Name: Merrick Wolfsgar
Known History: Merrick was a runemage of Vanagandr from Alidistir before falling on a battleground soaked in raining Godsblood.  Rather than succumbing to his infection then and there, he woke up on the Worldhelm, dazed and confused.
Physical Description: Merrick is a taller blonde human man with hazel eyes and a Godblood infection spreading across his body.  Some simple tattoos are visible from under his armor: celtic knots and valknuts alike.

Name: Miike
Known History:
- Born to a clan of snow leopard yokai living around the Kullroc Glacier. The patches on her fur were seen as portentous.
- Taught her clan's techniques in illusions, symbols and fate magic, in order to aid them in hunting and avoiding danger.
- Her clan fell to misfortune when they were massacred by a horde of Draugr from the Blood Pools. She only managed to escape when the Realmstorm spirited her away.
- Since then, she has been trying to rebuild her life and find new friends on the Worldhelm. She even has a shop now!
Physical Description: Miike is a very large (3'2" at the shoulder) but lithe snow leopard (132 lbs), with mottled brown and black patches of fur dotting her spotted white coat. Said patches appear to be *drifting* across her fur over time, if one gets to watch her closely.

Name: Mikael Everest
Identity: Entropic Mage Knight of Hudal Academy
Known History:
"I don't know much when I woke up but all I know is a someone gave me power and told me that there's a story out there for me" 

Mikael Woke up somewhere in Kor'Tarion with no knowledge on how he got there nor who he was before then. He was approached by a Cecrae who knew their story would end way too soon if they weren't given a blessing by them. After this as part of the universe's will he was taken to Hudal Academy and there many mages took him under their wing the more prominent being Secretary Wills who seemed to have a soft spot for the little guy but never really showed it outright, but thanks to them Mikael learnt Entropism. In this journey he met many other professors including the Environmental Professor Rowan whom left due to personal reason was what Mikael was told. As life continued on Mikael continued his studies learning about the worldhelm in the process thanks to some expeditions done by them. He would brave a realmstorm hoping to see one of many origins for stories.
Physical Description: A young Looking Rat Demihuman standing at 5'0 wearing either a casual looking dress or their mages robes and a hat, they have a deck of tarot cards in which depict the previous incarnations of the cecrae that blessed them when they woke up. They have black hair, fairish skin and a black rat tail that they use to carry things around. When Casting Mikael summons weapons and or entities via his arcanum cards that help harm or even heal members of the party.

Name: Milo Fleiss
Known History:
Riding a prototype motorcycle built by his father, Aravik Fleiss, Milo has been running messages between the Karlsgard Resistance and the city state since he was a kid. Only in recent years as the war has developed and in the wake of his fathers assassination, did he find himself joining the KPLA. He fought as a soldier, delivered messages, and so on, after leaving his family behind in a heated argument with his Mother and Sister.

Now he acts as the ace courier of the resistance, acting as their primary messenger, as well as a powerful soldier that can be used as a trump card against mobile enemies or ground forces. Though, he doesn't answer to anyone but the Crowndrake, despite the fact that he's only a Drake.
Physical Description: Milo is a lightly tan skinned man with blonde furred ears and shaggy hair, ending in a ponytail. He stands at 6 feet tall, 6'2'' with the ears. He's about 180 lbs. of muscle, but isn't the brightest. He finds himself in a constant state of brooding, with a resting glare. He hates this place, and the fighting it comes with, and he broadcasts that with his body language and his expression.

Name: Mimic
Identity: I am you, I am Them, We are Us
Known History: I was an apprentice to a shoemaker, I was the man on the side of the street looking for food, I was the local businessman making illegal trades. I was the old lady whom would feed the cats in the alleys, The knife in the dark who accepted much less pay for killing than most, The investigator who worked counteless extra hours because the people they wanted to protect. I am the soldier who fights for their home, The mentor to those in their time of needs. I am all of them. They are all me. We are us.
Physical Description: In long robes and garbs, face always hidden in shadow. Hands a dull almost claylike grey that form and morph to look like the hands and arms of others around them as they do things. Is exactly average height and weight. Varying slightly depending on the area they are in.

Name: Mimsim Samak
Known History:
Child of a family who trades aquatic goods in and out of Skuala, both through mercantile middlemanagement and the ownership of many fishermen. The Samak family treats those slaves with the standard one is to expect in Nezmira - a standard that Mimsim came to resent.
They speak out against this treatment and do what they can to thwart those who revel in it. This has often motivated them to light vigilantism with their implement of choice - an ordinary fishing rod.
Physical Description: A not-so-imposing nezzim. They're barely five feet tall, and carry a fishing rod of similar length instead of a weapon. Mimsim dresses in drab, baggy clothes that go well with their dusty scales and makes their bright yellow eyes stand out.

Name: Miruna 'Rue Dzata
Identity: A daughter of Akala, instrument of fear
Known History:
- Born into the Dzata family, the closest thing to a noble or royal house in Akala city, mama is Dzata and mother a warden from Heartdom.

- Was more protected than most Dreadlan people, protected by her status, her three eyes, and her parents, but in a place where might makes right she quickly discovered that she needed to hold her own somehow.

- Was sent to Gnosis academy to grow stronger and become the best Paladin she could.

- Became a Regalia :)
Physical Description:
Pale, with blue eyes, blue hair, even a natural blue tint to her lips. her pointed ears and her third eye hidden half way behind her bangs betraying her not completely human origins. 
Always dressed smartly, and with a posture that takes advantage of every inch of her 5' nothing stature.

Name: Mitaria
Identity: Sellsword from an old and forgotten army
Known History: Lost after a battle that saw many of his fellow soldiers fall overwhelming odds, Mitaria wandered, or at least attempt to wander back home only to find those seeing a his tattered uniform as the sign of a defeated loser. With little to no sympathy to his plight, Mitaria became a wandering mercenary for his services. Sometimes playing bodyguard, other times playing a cold hearted assassin, Mitaria gazes ever so often at the tattered feather on his helmet as it wanes and becomes more tattered as his wandering continues, forgetting the color it once was that adorned his proud head. That head now feels heavy with uncertainty and loss as he finds it harder to motivate himself to still use his skills he learned in the military each time he is hired for a job. Surely duty can still be found when one's banner is burned to ash to match the shade of color left in his very eyes.

Name: Mitchell Quill
Known History: Very few know Mitchell Quill, the self-proclaimed "greatest novelist of all time". Those who do, however, know that he's a remarkably poor writer with little to no sales, who uses any rumors about recent adventures to write stories about a self-inserted unnamed antihero. Even fewer know about his interest in entropic magic, and even fewer still know that his delusions led him far enough to purchase a crossbow and start going on his own "adventures". What no one knows, however, is that during a rainstorm, he got struck by a lightning in the middle of the woods and sucked in by the Realmstorm, which, to his surprise, got him aboard the Worldhelm.
Physical Description: A rather tall man with average body complexity, standing 6'2" and weighing 168 lbs, sporting short dark brown hair and sky blue eyes, Mitchell is almost always seen wearing black. From the fedora hat to the his beloved trenchcoat, partially fingerless gloves and pants, down to the lightweight boots. The only glimpse of another color can be seen in the underlying shirt. He always carries a small leather bag with a notebook and writing utilities, usually a quill and some ink.

Name: Mo Jun-Hie
Known History: Hailing from the ever-present chill of Xuanwu City. Jun-Hie is the son of Mo Tengfei, the head of the minor Clear River Sect. They specialized in archival duties and information gathering, until one the head betrayed the sect effectively wiping them out. Only Jun-Hie was left alive. He now resides in his empty home alone, working on improving his own craft.
Physical Description: A bishi'e standing at 5'10" with white'ish scales. He is often clad in robes and fine clothing, often carrying various vials and scrolls of parchment with him. The most eyecatching thing about him is that overly large brush he can be seen carrying. Considering his origins, it is likely that such is tied to their cultivation. They carry themselves rather crudely with a gloomy sense often emanating from them.

Name: Mokah
Known History: When one travels the western region of Aldistir, they may come across a silent cloaked yokai.  This figure would use the bells on their staff to get the traveler's attention, and then guide them safely through the wilderness towards nearby villages and towns, vanishing without a word once their job is done.  Mocah lost their parents to a blizzard when they were younger, and chose to become a guide, helping the lost in the best way they can.  Too shy to speak to most people, they usually gesture with their staff in order to communicate.  Mocah lives alone in a hut in the Silver Spire mountains.  A follower of the Aesir Seraph, they're a small kindness in the harsh lands of Aldistir.
Physical Description: Mocah is a small rabbit yokai with black and white fur covering their body.  They're usually fully covered by several layers of black cloaks, mittens, boots, and a red wooden mask.  They carry a black staff with several small bells on the top.  They're typically shy and say little, and can move very quietly.

Name: Monique
Identity: Cunning Trickster of the Smokey Slums
Known History:
• Monique was raised as a son of a thief in Smokeside, Hidela, after her mother disappeared 11 years ago.

• During a change of heart, she suffered a horrible accident in the middle ground from a landmine. Her father decided to leave her in the hopes that the Merrani that found her would give her a better life and away from his crime. He believed her dead after, something he regretted everyday. She survived, but lost her legs in the accident.

• Despite being a ne'er do well in general, the people of Hidela committed to her recovery, and with their help and ingenuity she relearned how to walk.

• Once she recovered, she took on a new name and new look, promising to be her authentic self and repaying the kindness of those around her forward. During her adventures, she discovered a new companion, Monique Halcyon, her soul treasure.

• After a long grueling journey of self discovery and self love, she has found belonging in the Worldhelm. As well as made peace with her disparate families.
Physical Description:
Monique is a woman with a staggeringly beautiful complexion, she has soft skin that holds a nice porcelain white. Her garbs are a mix of flashy and stylish streetwear and functional skullduggery gear. Keeping things cute and crafty. Her hair is a sea foam blue with a mix of her previous pink. An acknowledgement of both her previous appearance, and her old one.

She wears her father's old dated brown cloak. She also wears her old circular glasses that she had thrown off ever since she lost her soul treasure. One eye glimmers with a familiar celestial white of her twin. While the other gleans with a passionate pink.

Her eyes are like that of her fathers, cunning and determined.

Her face is dotted with a beauty mark. 

She is roughly 5'9, with an lithe figured that is practiced and toned.

Name: Moranoe
Identity: Dragon Maid who wishes to become a Knight
Known History: Wielding the sword and armor of the Hero of Old, Lumina, she wanders the Realms in search of Dragons to slay, all the while being a polite maid to those who need it!
Physical Description: A charming girl with dragon traits. She spots light green scales and horn nubs, the same color as her hair. She also has an extremely large and long tail. Her eyes are golden with dark vertical pupils.

Name: Morgia Sophus
Known History:
Morgia was born as a normal human, however her heart contains a fire-attuned moonshard. Forcibly changing her form into part flame dragon. If one were to put out the flames or remove it, it's speculated she would die. 

Morgia was raised by a priest who worships Caladrius. Living in a cabin all the way out in the Farwood in near isolation. Raising her into becoming a young woman who devotes herself into healing magic, as well as apothecary.

However, recent events has forcibly removed the moonshard. Thusly her flame traits have faded away. Relying on her faith, her knowledge of medicines from multiple realms, and her resourcefulness.

But after remerging back with her Soul Treasure, she returns back to her original form. Visibly much happier nowadays.
Physical Description: A woman who stands at 5'6" ft/167 cm, with long, platinum blonde hair and green eyes. Now recently picking up a set of blue and white robes that she sewn herself one day. She has draconic horns, a large tail with fire lit at the tip, and her chest glows a fiery glow. Dressed in a white dress and carries a staff.

Name: Mori Cadwal
Known History:
Born and raised in Brightshield, Mori spent much of her life wishing she was somewhere else; jaded with urban living and desperate to see what else the world held. This made her easy prey for the fae that abducted her.

The Veiled Stewards, as they called themselves, insisted that they were doing her a favour when they stole her from her home and reshaped her into something new. She spent her next years in their "Menagerie", kept within a gilded cage to sing for strange fae nobles, all while yearning for her freedom.

Her chance came when one of the Stewards' new "catches" proved to be too much for them to handle, and she escaped in the ensuing chaos. When she returned to the mortal world, she found that only months had passed. Her family, wary and distrustful of everything the fae touched, rejected her for what she had become.

Torn between two worlds and truly at home in neither, Mori sought out work as a courier, hoping it would provide her the feeling of freedom she yearned for.
Physical Description: A short, scrawny young woman with tan skin. She sports white feathers over much of her body and two large, flight-capable wings, along with other avian and inhuman features, such as talons and sharpened teeth. She favours light, practical clothing.

Name: Moritz Von-Suntower
Known History: Moritz Von-Suntower is an ex-Merrani Angel who was adopted by the retired General Charlotte Von-Hardwick. After a silent graduation from the WWA, he's had experience as a Strategic Supervisor under Commander Hailey Bennet, Commander Erich Valn, and now Prince Damian Von-Suntower. After Suntower's succession, he works at the First Knight of Suntower, swearing to make every one of his prince's (and his sister's) dream for Lhodos true! He can see the future of the people, and its a bright one.
Physical Description:
5'7" | 151 lbs. | Silver Eyes

Moritz is a felkin man with a perpetual smile on his face. His healthy, live frame is hugged by ambiguously ashen-toned skin. A faint apple, cinnamon, and lavender tone wafts around him. When compared to his first arrival on the ship, he his happy, healthy, and particularly clean looking.

Name: Mouse Ruba
Identity: Street Thief of the Rodent Hoodlums
Known History:
Mouse doesn't remember much before he was taken in by the Rodent Hoodlums. He wandered alleys and streets while living off the scraps of merchants and travelers. Rat picked him and trained him in the art of thievery alongside a few other kids, Hamster, Capybara, and Squirrel. Each of the kids had a special talent in the art of thievery, and Mouse was best at infiltration. He spent his years opening doors, locks, and even hearts as the scout for the gang.
On a botched attempt at a banal pickpocketing, Mouse was addressed by an adventurer and told a few stories about the world outside of Skamos. After being told the stories, the adventurer released Mouse and sent him off with a pouch of money.
With a glimmer in his eye and his heart set on dreams, Mouse returned to the Rat's Nest and promptly told Rat, "I'm going to go on and adventure!" Seeing the look in his eyes, Rat couldn't stop the kid, so he handed over his old gear and pointed Mouse toward his destiny.
Physical Description: At a stout 147cm, Mouse lives up to his name. Short, narrow, wiry, and somehow able to sneak around undetected. He has raven-black hair and darkly tanned skin from his days running across rooftops and awnings.

Name: Msrah
Identity: A Free Man Chasing A Good Time
Known History: Msrah was one out of countless slaves in the Scalefire Empire, having only ever known life under Nezzim's thumb. For years, he broke his back in manual labor and was only ever seen to be lesser. Still, he learned to find joy in simple things, such as the arts and finding beauty anywhere. It was only after the moves from outside forces that he found his chance to escape his binds, for a mystical portal could lead anywhere else. Anywhere else is better than fucking here.
Physical Description: A younger-looking man with loose-fitting linen, Msrah is often seen with a spear by his side that he wields as if it were a dancing partner more than a weapon. Though he is a very lean figure, he has developed muscles that come with years of manual labor.

Name: Murdoc Allweather
Known History:
Murdoc was a highwayman once, traveling with a gang of roaming bandits. It was the only thing someone like him could do, but he paid the price for it in the end. His execution would have come swiftly, but then Merrane began their expansion.
Murdoc was offered a deal: His life, in exchange for serving the resistance. Naturally, he took it. His comrades never stopped eyeing him with suspicion, but he was a good soldier nonetheless. Still, he held no real loyalty to Karlsgard, so when the worldhelm came, he saw his chance and took it.
Physical Description: A tall, toned man standing at exactly six feet tall with a body covered in scars. He has long, unkempt black hair that reaches down to his shoulders and brown eyes that are almost always accompanied by dark circles underneath. When transformed, he grows to be nearly seven feet tall, and his eye color turns to a crimson red hue. Shaggy black fur covers his entire form while his bones crack and pop as they morph to fit his new, wolflike appearance, and a lust for blood begins to permeate the air.

Name: Musashi Shiori
Known History:
* Appeared out of the forest when she was probably 4 years old.

* Her adoptive parents disappeared when she was young.

* It is known she spent some time in the forests around Hanae, and that when she returned from the forest she had displayed a great deal of talent as a swordswoman. She will now say that her Father taught her all that she needed to know at the time of the Sword.

* After a journey into the Zoumeng, Horoko discovered that she is only half human, and that her other half is that of a Living Dao of the Sword.
Physical Description:
Shiori isn't outwardly a terribly intimidating presence. She is calm and quiet, often seen smiling when not in the middle of a battle. She wears a simple blue kimono and hakama, and carries a rather nondescript katana at her left hip.
