She'd almost be easy to miss if not for the striking white hair and icey blue eyes that make even her smile just a little disconcerting. Still, she seems harmless enough, and her light, cheerful voice always speaks words of encouragement and cheer.

Shiori stands with a confident posture. If there is one thing that she is sure of... it is that she is one of the best Swordsmen of any land she stands on.

Name: Mutt
Known History:
Once, wanted posters of one Jesse Blackburn, along with his infamous Knucklebone Gang, dotted the walls of every town in the wastes surrounding Bazaar. But five years ago, Jesse Blackburn was found dead in an alley, shot by one of his own men, and the gang scattered to the wind.

For years, nothing was heard of the traitor who killed Blackburn... But a couple months ago, that man-- Mathias "Mutt" Teixeira-- appeared at the counter of an adventurer's guild outpost, seemingly looking to make amends for his past. Why he did what he did back then, or why he has returned now, is anyone's guess, but one thing is certain: Mutt can't run from his past forever. One of these days, it's gonna catch up to him, and he best be ready when it does.
Physical Description: A lean canine beastkin with black fur, blue eyes, and a lonely, taciturn aura. He sports a practical Drifter outfit, invariably along with a colorful poncho and a wide-brimmed hat.

Name: Myffa Sirrokh
Known History:
Myffa was born into the Crimson Seal merchant caravan. Her father was an eccentric magic blacksmith who secretly crafted enchanted tools and weapons. While fighting back against slavers after a betrayal, his magic sword exploded, burning both of them.

Myffa then lived as a traveling artisan and mercenary, marginalized due to the burn scars. She learned to use the remnants of the magic sword in secret, while trying to continue her father's legacy.

While on the Worldhelm, she opened a communal workshop called The Future's Anvil, alongside Enoch and Huong. Claire and Tzera are often there too.

Through the year, she became involved in Kor'Tarion. She enrolled at Hudal Academy, got stuck in her sword for a month, and acquired magic by fusing with a Fae called Icarus. She even had a shop in Brightshield for a while.

Recently, she was drawn to the Demon of Desire, Atee, and became both their priestess* and lover. But dating a demon isn't that simple...
Physical Description: A 5'6" southern Nezmiran young woman, with burn scars on her face, torso and arms. Nowadays she wears colorful new clothes with quite a few magic accessories like rings, pendants, bracelets and more.

Name: Nai Ki'tari
Identity: Emissary of a Tribe Long Forgotten
Known History:
The being known as Nai remembers very little before about a year ago, where they awoke in a campsite to the north-east of Gwaed. They have spent the time since familiarizing themselves with the world, and following their yearn for arcane understanding. Eventually, this lead them here. 

Since then, he has overcome his fading nature and materialized as a 'real person'. He is still unsure of his nature, but no longer has a timer.
Physical Description:
Naiki'tari is a 5'7'' feline eared, tailed, and eyed man. He has short shaggy black hair, gold colored eyes, a white tipped black tale, and lightly tanned skin. They normally wear heavy white and black robes and other adornments, such as a wide brimmed hat, and heavy boots and gloves.

As of 2025/02/17, he is now missing an arm.

Name: Nameless
Known History:
A martial artist, presumably from Tian Yin, who has forgotten everything about her past, right down to her own name. Although she possesses tremendous martial arts power within her body, most of it has been sealed away. 

She arrived on the Worldhelm without any possessions save for the clothes on her back. Devoid of memories, power, or purpose, she'll have to discover (or rediscover) herself gradually.
Physical Description: A 5'7'', lanky girl with a wild mane of red hair and a seemingly permanent scowl. She often wears a pair of cloth handwraps and whatever clothing she can find that's easy to move in.

Name: Nanashi
Known History:
* Was always a fighter, whether against bullies or those who deserved it.
* Thought Kuzunoha's war was pointless. Doesn't believe in harming others who are not involved or are innocent
* Left to seek out Nimue, fighting her way there with glee and joy. Caught the attention of Lilith. Accepted her deal, and bound her power.
* Took shelter in a Blizzard when a Realmstorm came and snatched her up.
Physical Description:
Hair: White
Eyes: Red
Height: 165cm (5'5'')

A young woman clad in armor, with snow white hair and dark horns that protrude out of her head that contrasts with her hair. 

Though she might be smaller than other Oni, she is fierce and should be vary of what kind of smile she wears for you!

Name: Naomi Falken
Identity: The Resistance Fighter Desperate to Find a Purpose
Known History:
Once a Drake of the KPLA, Naomi gained quite a reputation for managing to find and steal a prototype mech from Merrane forces. Only, she was not nearly skilled enough to pilot it.

The mech was tragically destroyed in her last conflict, after which Naomi was deemed unfit for field-work by the KPLA.
Physical Description:
A rather muscular figure, Naomi's signature characteristic is her flowing long red hair, which reach below her torso.

She usually only wears baggy and comfy clothing, enough to protect from the elements but still be comfortable enough to fight.

Name: Naomi Ohm
Known History: Naomi does not talk about her past often, but she does work for 100G Security. Besides this though, she is mostly unwilling to discuss history.
Physical Description: Naomi is a short (5'1''), stout, gentle looking girl. She has a permanently soft, unassuming expression. She wears heavier clothing, that covers her near completely and carries around a complex sword folded a number of times on her back. Her tail pokes out the back of her coat, and grey ears poke out beneath her hair.

Name: Nara
Known History: Once a yokai warlord in the War of the Fox and Hound under Kuzunoha. During that time they were a formidable force but personal tragedies led them to making a deal with a strange beast that led Nara to believe themselves likely indestructible. This hubris led to their downfall, at which time the beast appeared once more offering their gifts. Nara accepted but found themselves sealed away in a cave where memories became hazy and unclear. Eventually Nara was freed by a follower of Nimue who fought and made Nara promise to guide and help others. Even with initial reluctance Nara kept to the promise. But recent events back home in Aldistir Nara began feeling a call. Upon following the call it led them to meeting with this beast again. Here Nara was forced with a choice to accept a fate they agreed to or to reject it. Nara choosing to preserve this beast's abilities accepted and has taken on a similar form and its abilities, even if they don't yet understand them or how to use them.
Physical Description: An incredibly large vulpine beast standing at a towering 6' 3" on all fours. Its body seeming to radiate with shadows that dance along its form. Its eyes white orbs with a slight glow to them and a pair of massive horns adorn their head.

Name: Narantsetseg
Known History: Hailing from the Temple of Growth, she had lived under the Empty Monk's guidance for many years until she accidentally came across her own aptitude in Metal cultivation. And this frightened her law-abiding nature deep down. Their attempts to snuff it out of her began to leave a bad taste in her mouth. It wasn't until others planned to make their departure via caravan with the help of Goldhearted that she dared to leave. Having managed to leave the Temple and settle into a newly established little village they've called Daringanga, she had to find a way to continue in a way that aligned with her. With the discovery and acquisition of her main tool in deepening her practice of Metal cultivation, she decided to follow the doctrine of the Holy Harmony, making her bonded partner to be Organa, someone who opposes her default to control and order, pushing each other to grow together in their authenticity and practice.
Physical Description: She stands at 5'7'' with long dark hair in a half-updo'd bun. She wears a usually stoic yet serious expression, and simple, practical garments of leather and cloth for both proper warmth and maneuverability. With rough hands, she wields a heavy and ornate halberd, standing stalwart and focused.

Name: Nasim ibn Khaled
Identity: The Sandship Artisan, Building His Path To The Future
Known History:
- Born in Windhaven, the City of Sandsailors.
- Sandship racer under Mustafar, the Racemaster of Windhaven, like his late father before him. Trusted enough that the Sand Serpent was a semi-permanent loan.
- Went into smuggling with Auro Benites, and continued after Auro left to join the Revolutionaries. Some of the smuggling jobs were to get people safely to the Blue.
- Was caught out by Nezzim patrols when returning from one of those trips, but a Realmstorm brought him to the Worldhelm. Suspects that Mustafar may have ratted him out, but he has no proof.
- Has pivoted towards being a sandship artisan rather than just a racer during his time on the Worldhelm. Recently reached a breakthrough after lessons from Huong Jin and Kurso Armstrong and exposure to Terran tech, allowing the Sand Serpent to fly.
- Considers the Sand Serpent his own sandship now. And with Mustafar dead after the liberation of Windhaven, there's no one to contest this.
Physical Description:
Nasim stands at around 5'10", and has the dune-tanned skin one would expect of a human native of Nezmira.

In his Terran drip, he's rocking a tailored collared shirt and jeans that shows of his toned build (144 lbs). He's also let his dreadlocked hair down and put on a pair of stylish sunglasses.

Name: Nasser Sayid
Age: Appears to be a young adult.
Known History:
- A "Legendary" figure from Nezmiras past, he has been summoned thanks to a wish most powerful.

- His inability to fulfill the wish has caused his very being to be corrupt and so does have the wish itself.

- After laying the girl who wished him into this world to rest, he took upon a new wish, to vanquish the Kiir.

- Wandering the desert wastes of Nezmira, he was backed into a corner by the very same creatures he has sought to vanquish, before being lifted away in a realmstorm to safety. However his bloodthirst for the Kiir is insatiable.

- His history revealed, Morning Glory shed their previous form. He'd take up their old name and identity as General of Nezmira, Nasser Sayid, the first so sing the song of betrayal.
Physical Description:
Nasser Sayid appears to be of human descent, standing at about a formidable six feet in height, although at a closer glance one could discern that his irises shimmer and shift between blue, pink and purple.

After a fated confrontation he now wears the garb he met his grizzly end in, dressing in blue and red fabrics which cover an armor accented with gold. Upon his shoulder rest a carcass of a Kiir.

Name: Neishin
Known History: Was abandoned by her original pack and left to die when she was brought to Kuzunoha, who offered her a chance to live should her gift be accepted. As Neishin, the name she adopted with her new form, is here and alive its clear that she took this gift. She was never truly welcome in any yokai village even if they were willing at least least give her shelter when needed, it never lasted for more than a few days. But she has since spent her time wandering fighting against Vanagandr's wolves and Alds to bear his mark. One such occasion she was caught and to be turned into a ritual sacrifice when a new voice offered her gits to help her escape should Neishin continue to amuse them by defying Vanagandr, once again not wanting to die Neishin accepted these gifts and broke free of her captors. However she still wears the collar and a manacle as a reminder she will likely never be truly free.
Physical Description: Neishin stands on the shorter side of around 5' with a neutral to angry expression on her face. She wears fairly plain worn and tattered clothes as well as an iron collar and manacle that she refers to as a reminder. Both her hair, which has streaks of white in her bangs, and tail are a dark grey that fade to white as it reaches the ends. One of her ears clearly had a piece taken from it as one point, she also has a scar over her left eye which is pure white unlike the golden brown of her right. Her left arm is notably completely wrapped in bandages.

Name: Nemik No.3
Identity: Shield to all a sword to none
Known History:
Having spent the last few years wandering and defending people from power hungry mages and magical creatures. Nemik now finds themself here. Having the name Nemik No.3 because the placard they awoke next to. Only the memories of moonfall, glimpses of their unspoken  past, and the desire to protect: keep them moving along in this world they barely understands anymore. 

"Only need paid in a meal and a stable to rest in."  -Nemik No.3
Physical Description: Blue grey skin that when in her mutant transformation becomes ghostly and moonlight like, a long tail with four tendrils at the end that they use for spear flourishes and unexpected strikes. They stand 6'8 and near 220 lbs

Name: Nicholai "Romer" Aivar
Known History: HGe doesn't remember much of anything from the time before he found himself in the middle of nowhere nor his actual name, Romer was the only thing he found that gave him any meaning after he crashed with his exoskeleton. With his training still being fully engrained into his mind and body as the only things remaining to him, he set out to reclaim that which he lost regardless of the cost it may bring to him.
Physical Description: Nicholai is a red haired with bottle green eyes, with a tanned slender build, though he is rarely seen outside of his exoskeleton and without his helmet. Standing in at 5'7" and weighing 121lbs.

Name: Nico Bastion
Identity: Eccentric with a heart of gold
Known History: (Full name is Nicholas Integro Concherto Omario Bastion)He grew up in skamos, accidentally poisoned his grandfather, german suplex sea serpent, he tanked a Sand broodmother head on and survived, and learned bee keeping.
Physical Description: Always smells like Dr.Squatch shampoo/beard products. Big boy, standing at a solid 6'4", carrying two massive frickin' shields and a suit of bronze armor he bought and polished. Big golden retriever vibes, and needs to shave every night or have a full beard the next day santa claus style

Name: Nikola Technis
Known History:
Nikola's parents were researchers at NTTech, where they worked on the C.A.R.D. project (Chimerist Algorithm Reconfiguration and Deployment). The project aimed to transmute the abilities of magical creatures into monster cards, tools that allowed anyone to harness powerful skills without harming or overexploiting the creatures themselves. If successful this innovation would be a great aid to NTTech’s efforts to fund its operations ethically while minimizing environmental and magical exploitation.

When Nikola was still very young, tragedy struck. The entire C.A.R.D. research team was assassinated, and most of their work was destroyed. The reasons behind the massacre remain unknown, but whispers of corporate sabotage circulate in hushed tones. Due to this Nikola was left with the only working C.A.R.D. system.

Now older, Nikola carries two objectives:

   1.- Complete his parent's research.
   2.- Uncover the truth behind their deaths and enact vengeance on those responsible.
Physical Description:
A somewhat tall young man, has a athletic build, white hair, blue eyes and somewhat pale skin.

He wears a heavy white coat, a pair of leather gloves, a tight shirt and field jeans.

Name: Nisshoku Kodatsu 幸田
Known History: Kodatsu is a holy man from Aldistir. A speaker of the Aesir Kuzunoha, and one of her chosen. He acts as her vassal as he ventures into new realms. Besides this, however, Kodatsu holds many secrets. One of which is his past. He's tight lipped about how he first arrived in Kuzunoha's care, or how he even arrived in his forest-home of the Feywyrd.
Physical Description:
A six foot tall young looking man. He's lithe, light, and sways when he walks. He has a sharp look to his eyes, and a number of tails which seem to flick about on their own. 

In times of crisis, Kodatsu flickers into a new form. While the shadow of Kodatsu's standard appearance represents the New Moon, his hair shifts white, and markings glow red. This represents the Full Moon. With this change, his voice and personality change quite drastically as well.

Name: Noah ♫
Identity: Experiment Vocalist with an Aching Heart
Known History:
Noah's first and most precious memory is singing a song to his mother while his father was sick after being discharged from the Karlsgard military. As he sang to her, she cried for the first time in a long time. Her teary eyes met Noah's, and in a hug and a "Thank you, son.", she set his life path in stone. As he grew, Noah sang as his career, and worked as a therapist. Once his career came to a head, his memory is fog.

The earliest memory Noah has after his memory was cut out was on the Worldhelm. It was a conversation with a fellow Goldhearted, that resulted in every object around them to fly towards the fellow Goldhearted's face. As he began to apologize, the air flooded with guilt. Noah's voice rends now, and he doesn't know why. He promptly found a face mask to protect the world from his voice, and he is now learning to do good with it again.

Noah sings to help his friends and others feel the things they need to, and share stories with the world that helped him.
Physical Description:
6' 01"
180 lbs.
Grey Hair, Bangs and Tied Back
Noah *always* has a face mask on, unless he's evoking his will upon the world with his vocals.

Name: Noel Salbe
Identity: First Mate of the Red Otters
Known History:
Noel grew up in a poor family of three in Lastport with his mother and his younger sister. As a teen, he tried to help his mother with living expenses by taking a job as a waiter in a seedy harbor tavern, which is where he got introduced to the captain to-be of the Red Otters. The captain took a liking to the young boy and eventually offered to let him join their crew!

Years passed and the Red Otters went from an up-and-coming group of seafaring outlaws to one of the most well known pirate crews in the Lachfair Sea. Noel grew with the crew - both as a person as well as a leader - eventually becoming First Mate a couple years ago.

Now, how did this guy come to the Worldhelm you ask? Well, during what should've been a simple delivery job from the western continent over to Boar's Island, the ship was attacked by some massive water monster. During the fight, Noel was thrown off of the ship... and right into a Realmstorm. Not the most ideal of situations, but surely we'll make it work!
Physical Description: 5'10'' | 137 lbs. | Black Hair | Green Eyes

Name: Noir
Known History: Was born and raised in Korala, but left not too long after her parents were killed in a questionable airship accident. She salvaged the ship and began to use it for her own personal transport. She took all her inheritance and used it to acquire materials for her to do her own work and to find a place she can work in secret away from the war. Here she has been working on trying to compress the strength of a mech into the size of an exosuit. She has made small progress and is testing an experimental suit currently.
Physical Description: Noir stands at 5' 3" with a slim build. She has sapphire colored eyes and pink toned hair.

Name: Nora Estelle
Known History: The chosen child of the secluded village of Astra, Nora Estelle's home was destroyed a decade ago by an unknown witch and her cohorts whom put the village to the torch and its citizens to the sword for its sacred artifact. Alone, Nora stayed warm by the embers of her destroyed home till found by Ernest Mayweather as he returned to his home after years away. Ernest adopted Nora and raised her with his daughter Laura in the City of Brightshield. Nora seeks to learn more about his destiny promised to her and perhaps to both reclaim the artifact stolen from her home and to rebuild the once proud village of astrologers and entropy mages known as Astra.
Physical Description: A young, lithe woman with azure hair and eyes, standing around 5' 10" she tends to be timid around others she does not know well.

Name: Nova
Known History: She very recently and suddenly showed up outside Suntower City in disheveled rags and in poor health condition, unable to recall anything up until that point. She was taken in to be treated but while recovering there she had an outburst of her esper abilities and had psionic suppressors placed on her. During this time she had a moment of lucidity and she was offered treatment at New Hope Laboratory to purify her mind demon. She accepted and has had little issues with her abilities in the short time she has tried to use them since.
Physical Description: A young woman with a thin build standing at 5' 6", she has long white hair with red streaks and faded red tips. She has heterochromatic eyes, her left eye blue and her right a redish brown.

Name: Nyx Selenbourne Atramentis
Known History:
Nyx's parents died in the crossfire of a gang shootout when she was young, and she was left providing for her sister. 
She made a "living" by working at a gold farm for RWO, and eventually was promoted to farming events for rich people in Triworld itself! Just as the moon decided to mildly explode and rain entropic shards down on Triworld. 
Nyx got caught in an explosion and developed entropic powers, but the medical bills resulting from her seizures and temporary coma left her in deep debt. She decided to keep digging in case she came out on the other side of the planet, took out *more* loans to body mod herself into her RWO character and commission cosplay, and fight petty crime in her neighbourhood. She was taken by the Realmstorm as an extremely enhanced stylish exit.
Physical Description: Nyx is a short woman who to Kor'Tarian eyes might appear a fairy: silver hair, pointed ears, big purple eyes, butterfly-winged outfit that might appear to be growing out of her body. However, Terrans would notice that she's just a human with quite a few body mods.

Name: Olia Vol
Identity: Heretic Trying to Save Her Home
Known History:
Olia was originally left to live in a small clan out of both pity and kindness. Her gift from Lorelie was another factor that made her useful enough to be kept around with her healing. 

With time she was eventually considered too much of a danger to the village as horns began to appear, and she was leaving the youngest years of her childhood. So she was left to fend for herself, a sure death sentence for even many of the most experienced of warriors.

She would have surely passed if not for an Oni who found her and kept her safe.
Physical Description:
A 5'6 woman, Olia's most notable features come from being a Yokai. Short horns appear from her head and goat ears. Beyond that, hooves can be seen taking the place of normal legs. Her eyes lit up with friendly glee to most she meets.

Still, she is often seen with most clothing from Aldistir, but a collection of things from both Kor'tarion and Lhodos on her person.

Name: Olivia Moonshine
Identity: Spoiled Merchant with a Heart of Gold
Known History:
Hailing from a family of respected merchants, Olivia has spent much of her life living in luxury and elegance among the elite of Tradefair, somewhat sheltered from the harsh realities of the outside world.
In her late teens, however, she began to learn more about her family's history. She discovered why her family had been so successful in the last 70 years: her ancestors abused the crisis of the Moon's Fall, jacking up the prices of basic necessities and profiting off the backs of the desperate and vulnerable.
This revelation sparked something within her: a compassion for the needy that she'd never been taught by her rich, selfish parents.
She tried to express her feelings to her family, only to be shut down and ignored. And so, she resolved to pack her bags and leave: she wished to travel the world, using her talents to help everyone in Kor'Tarion.
Turns out, fate had even grander plans. Just as she left Tradefair, a Realmstorm struck her vehicle, bringing her somewhere new...
Physical Description: Standing proudly around 5'1", this young woman sports a carefully-curared hairstyle and a permament smug grin. She dresses elegantly but fashionably, and she wouldn't be caught dead without her magical monocle: an item passed down through her family that aids in appraising precious goods.

Name: Ophelia
Known History: You don’t know about this character yet!
Physical Description: Ophelia has dark skin, purple eyes and long golden hair. She has green scaled ears typical of a mers along with some green markings on her face. She wields a spear and a hand held harp. She wears a purple bandeau and a long green scarf skirt that fades into blue with some sandals. She also dons some blue seaweed bracelets along with a pink sea shell pendant on her neck along with a crown. She bears some scar marks on her shoulder.

Name: Ophelia (#2)
Identity: Masked Gardener Of The Forest Of Souls
Known History:
- One of the residents of Shade, the Sixth Layer of Idyll.
- Lives in Siomykos, the Home of the Masked. Has been one of the defenders of the underground village ever since she reached the Layer countless years ago.
- Has learnt how to use the fungal growths farmed by the Masked villagers in battle, empowering herself while sapping her enemies.
- Was brought to the Worldhelm by a Realmstorm, when holding off one of Shade's monsters to let the surface-going foragers escape.
- Now tries her best to readapt to the living world once more, while waiting for a chance to ensure her home in Shade is safe.
Physical Description: A short woman (4'10"), her figure hidden beneath a thick, enveloping cloak and padded dress. Beneath her beak-like mask, her face and hair are bleached and faded, due to the untold years she has spent in the sunless forests of Shade. She wields an old and battered scythe, one of the few weapons cold-forged in the Masked Villages.

Name: Ophiuchus
Known History:
Born in Skarta and quickly thrust into urchinhood by the harsh living condition imposed on the humans of Nezmira, Edith quickly learned to go about her life under the cover of night, to make her life easier. Hiding her aptitude for magic as she came of age, her focus had always been on the star-dotted inky blackness above her, and what secrets it might hold. A painstakingly cobbled-together 'telescope', barely worthy of the name, would offer a further glimpse that only emboldened her desire for that great expanse, as well as, by pure happenstance, revealing the existence of the Ancient Observatory to her, far in the distance. Her growing obsession would lead her steps there, to where she might grow closer with that infinite void, more familiar, to learn all she could in her need to explore a place so pure, and devoid of what had darkened her life till then.

Following cataclysmic events in Terra, she is now a Board Member of Orrery, now known as Ophiuchus.
Physical Description: Ophiuchus is short and slight in stature, at 4'8, with a pale complexion from her nocturnal lifestyle. She wears big, round glasses over pale blue eyes, and a dark bob of hair atop her head. She wear purple robes, to protect herself from the Nezmira climate, and on her back, carries an intricately designed telescope, folded up for ease of transport, and built by the long gone civilization responsible for the Ancient Observatory.

Name: Opus Resbina
Known History: Created by the Puerluna, the inner circle of the Hudol Academy, Opus Resbina is the group's first proper success in creating a homunculus after hundreds of failures. The Puerluna intended on keeping in him in a laboratory for however long his Refined Moonstone Core would sustain him, but Opus Resbina decided otherwise. Utilizing the spiritist magic that came naturally to him, alongside the powerful Arcana bound to his Core, Opus escaped. He’ll return some other time, he says, for now he wants to walk this world and any other than he stumbles upon, searching for the true extent of his perfection.
Physical Description: 5'10" | 200~ lbs. | Porcelain Skin w/ Black Sclera (One with Golden Iris). Break Over Left Eye.

Name: Orbeen
Known History: There people have lived in peace isolated in side the forest for generations but after the moon shards rained down they have seen more attacks from monsters. One day they even found wounded humans they took back to the village, after treating there injures the adventures explained what they know have happen "outside the forest" and about a flying ship that was there "village". The chief elder decided that the bravest would follow these adventures back to this ship and gain more knowledge and compainons in order to save the forest. Among those that follow is Orbeen.
Physical Description: A small plant-humanoid who is 116cm long and wights 66kg. The head looks like an onion with orange hue on the "leaf/hair". He weilds a waraxe that is longer than him.

Name: Organa Baatar
Known History:
Organa's origins are as mysterious as the winds she commands. Discovered as an infant during a violent storm at a decrepit temple, she was raised in the Temple of Growth, where monks tried to shape her into a vessel of their ideals. Yet, her spirit remained untamed. A raging gale rather than a tranquil breeze.

As a young girl, she was taken to the edge of Leytik to confront the void, a rite meant to instill humility and reverence. Instead, it became a crucible of transformation. There, she encountered a powerful Arcana, its passage heralded by a cataclysmic storm that threatened to tear the group apart. With survival hanging by a thread, Organa was forced to embrace the storm's fury. Bonding with its untamed power.

In time she would embark down the path of Holy Harmony. Narantsetseg, her opposite in temperament, became her mirror and blood sister. Together, they fled the Temple with 28 others, aided by the Goldhearted, and built a new life free from the constraints of their past.
Physical Description: Organa stands at a commanding 5'6". A height that belies the formidable presence she exudes. She is clad in Mongolian-inspired black and white furs, each layer tailored to balance elegance with practicality. Her short hair is adorned with a crafted jade hairpiece and intricate beads that tell stories of her heritage. At her side, she carries a gracefully curved bronze sword, its edge gleaming with a promise of precision, while a sturdy round shield rests securely on her back, ready for any battle.

Name: Orion Marduke
Known History:
Orion grew up in a merchant family in Tradefair, being addicted to books at a young age with his favorites being stories of nobles rising up from dire straights to become heroes. However reality is a cruel being as he has witness corrupt nobles take adavantages of those below them. Normally he would not interve until a noble has decided to gouge Orion's family into debt forcing them to sell all of Orion's books. This inspire Orion to do something extreme, he takes his most formal clothes and dye his hair blue to take on a persona of "Lord Marduke". A noble who holds on to the ideals of nobility and honor to prove to the world that nobles can be just as fanstatical as in the books!

Recently, Orion had lost his confidence after confronting the now Warlord Gaul on nobility however he still strive to prove him wrong by showing the world that you can be great without lies, deceit and murder!
Physical Description: 5'9 ft tall, has brown hair (dyed to blue). Wears almost comical noble attire including the frills.

Name: Orpheus
Identity: Renowned Spirit of a Fallen Saint
Known History:
- Born in Tessalia as part of a Trailblazer caravan passing through the city, Orpheus has lived a life walking across the entirety of Aranova.

- His caravan fell ill to disease brought about by an encounter with tainted monstrosities. Orpheus struck out to try and find the monstrosity in hopes of learning how to heal his caravan.

- Orpheus found himself quickly outmatched, but before he could die in battle a sect of Exorcists seeking glory in the hunt saved him. Witnessing their faith and courage, Orpheus would join them and begin walking the Path of Eminence alongside them.

- Years after, he would lead members belonging to the Seven Slaying Arms Sect to search for a new Herald, eventually finding Eurydice.

- As part of walking the Path of Eminence they undertook the impossible challenge of making the pilgrimage to the 5th Grave, Apep.

- Once they arrived at the grave they all died to a horde of undead. Now wandering as a spirit, Orpheus is bound to Eurydice's side.
Physical Description: A large, ghostly armored figure in heavy mail emblazoned with tales of legendary members of the Seven Slaying Arms sect and their Sword Saints. His form is translucent enough to make it obvious he isn't entirely physical, and wisps of energy seem to lick off as he moves in space. Typically, he hovers behind the shoulder of a living person, those wisps of misty energy pooling around their feet as they walk. However once detached those wisps form into legs that "touch" the ground, but provide little in the way of weight in each step.

Name: Orpheus (#2)
Known History:
Born as David Redfield to aging parents who worked NT Tech careers, life got harder for his family when the downsizing started, and they found themselves out of work without severance.

A screen-bound kid, by 14, he was pawning their old things on the Link Engine.  By 17, he's taking calls on ETA's dime, and by 20, he finds a Corp internship doing Link Sec with 100g. 

He pays rent on his apartment in Secura for his work, and he pays their rent on a little shack in South Rock, Haven. 

Every job has compromise. What corporate wants, versus everybody else getting screwed.

These days, he works border security, validating/denying people entering Secura while keeping the network hardened. Though he's starting to learn there's a gap... a little wiggle room where Galeforce and 100g aren't looking, where a little mercy is possible.

Not always, of course. Sometimes he has to take the hard line, call the enforcers. Keep their rent paid. That's just Terra.
Physical Description:
Orpheus is a young man from Terra accompanied by a virtual assistant. He stands at 5'3'', though his lean into his hoodie makes him look a little shorter.

His outfit is comfortable, casual, and bears a little ID tag indicating his affiliation with 100g Security. He's often carrying a coffee while he watches a fight, seemingly happy to be tactical support rather than a fighter himself.

Name: Oscar
Identity: Little Merchant in a Big Market
Known History:
Born to a family of farmers in Hedgeberg, Oscar quickly became an outlier within his home. Being sickly from a young age, he was hardly the ideal picture of a farmer's son. While his poor constitution improved with passing years, he was no closer to meeting his parent's expectations. Rather than tend the fields, Oscar's curious disposition led him to sneak off to the markets. It was there that the boy's passion for trade became evident. Realizing that restraining Oscar's passions was a fool's errand, his parents allowed him to study under the tutelage of a merchant they had dealings with. 

Oscar spent years learning of merchantry, as well as the state of Hedgeberg and the wider region, eventually striking out on his own. Making use of an old Karlite truck that he repurposed for moving cargo, he scavenged old war wreckages in order to bring valuable metals back to Hedgeberg.

Oscar's heartfelt ambition to see his homeland prosper sparked something within, and so the Worldhelm called.
Physical Description: At 5'6", Oscar is shorter than average for his age, having a wiry physique which does little to add to his presence. His freckled complexion is pale and smooth, framed by wavy red hair. His attire is well-worn and somewhat mismatched, consisting of various articles he haggled for in market stalls.

Name: Oskar
Known History: Lived life with a nomadic clan on the Blood Pools of Aldistir. Betrayed by his clan's Diviner, causing the rest of his tribe to be turned into Draugr. Was on a bloody path of revenge until he was pulled onto the Worldhelm.
Physical Description: Tall, Burly, Brooding

Name: Ox Deadbeat
Known History: Training bots never needed to possess a lot of intelligence. Whatever would've been left in their internal storage had high risk of getting damaged during sparring matches, so Ox never thought what would it feel like to be disconnected from the Soul Network or the Baylore System. All it could do is admire the fantasy heroes from afar and wish it could become one of them.
Physical Description: A pretty rough-looking build of a bot running an outdated, scrambled version of the system that wasn't meant to do much more than to be pummeled into ground by other players. The only few things this model can boast is integrated roller skates in its legs and an insufferable personality.

Name: Panlinggo Umaga
Known History:
All Panlinggo can know is that he was born under auspicious circumstances, which left his mother chronically ill, and his father missing. Panlinggo and her stayed further out from Pagapalay, the villagers worried they would grow sick, or cursed, leaving the boy alone to take care of her when he came of capable age. Despite occasional visits from the master Mabilis, and medicinal care from well-meaning village shamans, the mother's illness would not cede. So when Mt. Magayon rumbled with dire warnings, the choice was made clear.

Poor Panlinggo could not handle the pain, and sought Mabilis for aid. He begged the old master to teach him Cultivation, but Panlinggo's Qi seemed seized, locked somehow. In desperation Panlinggo climbed to the top of Mt. Magayon, and threw himself into it's belching maw. Nobody had seen Panlinggo for quite some time since, but he has found himself in the worldhelm, the rage of the mountains swelling inside him.
Physical Description:
Panlinggo is a very tiny mountain, standing to a straight 4'9" high. His almond shaped eyes are deep as volcanic smog, and bare an ember of red sparks within. He has soft, round features, a pudgy, short nose, and big, circular ears. His earthy, tan skin is speckled all over with dusty freckles, and scuffs from burns and bare body strikes. A fluffy mop of deep brown bounces on his skull, the longest of it tied in a ponytail behind them and in two short tufts of blond at the front.

Pan wears a loose, patterned, bright red poncho overtop a snug, black shirt cut at the midriff and elbows, and high at the neck. Two wide, gold bracers cuff at their wrists, and a drape of gold lanyards hang from his neck. Around his waist he wears two sashes, red and sky blue, tied and draped to cover the back and front of their lower half. Loose black shorts end with similar patterns to their poncho, and  gold bands wreath their ankles.

Name: Paraluman
Known History:
- Paraluman grew up in the harsh barren lands of Lupaing Dinungisan, fending for herself against the selfish evil cultivators on top of sustaining herself. Through her wish to not wanting a life of savagery, she had cultivated her magic and wit, and used those to escape to greener pastures. She ended up within a Grove in the Tikba Forest. 
- Among the residents and travelers of Sampaguita Village, there were rumors about a mysterious maiden exuding a comforting, revitalizing aura, yet shy enough to remain elusive. On sightings of her, the abundance of blooming flowers is one thing people say consistently - prevalently Sampaguita, its scent filling the area.
- Then one day, Paraluman shook off her born distrust of people keeping her isolated in the grove and stepped out into the village. She was easily accepted by the locals, maybe mistaken as one of the Kabaya. Paraluman nowadays is often seen resting besides the shade of a tree or walking around, greeting them with a gentle smile.
Physical Description: Paraluman is a fair lady with snow white hair adorned with an intricate headpiece and eyes that are as blue and as reflective as the sea. She usually wears a teal and white dress covered by a white robe with a fur trim. She often is also seen with a fan that is made with feathers that gradate from white to black by the tips.

Name: Peri Ozeyn
Known History: Born and raised in Nezmira, Peri was faced with the usual trials that someone of her kind would. Despite working mainly as a monster hunter to provide parts for crafting, the hiear also occasionally worked to escort travelers to and from Last Hold to nearby cities. Thanks to the recent events in Nezmira, her brand was removed leaving only a shadow of the mark.
Physical Description: Standing at 5'9, this Hiear's most notable traits are her lop ears and a shadow of the branding that ran down the right side of her face. Aside from that, her orange hair and dull blue eyes stand out from some of the other Hiear she's met.

Name: Perseus of Dreadlan
Known History:
None among the Goldhearted would know Perseus, however those of Kaiway would know he is the son of a graduated Dreadlan Paladin Argos and his Mother a Witch of Dreadlan. Having entered the school at the age of 16, his patreon being Queen of Beasts Akala herself ensured he had a position within Gnosis so long as he could keep his grades up. Over the years of his stay within Gnosis Academy, he made it apparent he excelled in the physical performance the school demanded of them. Academically however, he fell behind in repeatedly. It wasn't until his second year, being asked by Apollo Marinelli to be his Regent did his grades pick up considerably.

Perseus has a tendency to be capable in combat, he and The Overture a stalwart team when push comes to shove. However, Perseus does have a tendency to get into more trouble than other students due to resolving many issues with physical prowess. Many also claim that his ego and self confidence equal his size, both as unshakable as he himself is.
Physical Description: Before you stands a monolithic man, clearing well at and past seven foot when standing with a width to him that matches such heights. His appearance from head to toe gives off the appearance more befitting a monster than a man. Deep scars along his body and face, heavy furred body, piercing yellow eyes, and large teeth visible when he smiles or speaks. Despite resembling a hyena like monster, Perseus comes off as either focused but more often jovial and good natured. He makes himself the biggest man in the room simply by being in it, be it by standing grand or being bigger than life in presence alone. His attire ranges from the blue Gnosis Academy uniform and Paladin Crest, to the dark black armor along with crimson cape resembling the style of Dreadlan. Always around his neck is a collar resembling the face of a fox. If he is seen carrying a weapon it is more often than not his Regalia 'The Overture', an oversized and unruly yet regal Gunblade.

Name: Petra
Known History: Born in Sampaguita Village, Petra was lead to fear the demon, and seek a nice and quiet life. Despite her best efforts, trouble would always find her, which lead her to seek cultivation. In mastering her own body and spirit, she found herself with a natural affinity for Demons, or Yawa. With this affinity, she bound a lesser trickster demon to her will, and now roams the land to do as much good as she can with her wicked power.
Physical Description: 5'6, Light for her height, Petra sports a somewhat lanky lean build, but is covered in cyan tattoos that crawl all the way up to her neck. She does not think herself worthy to cover her face in tattoos as of yet, she has not become a true warrior yet.

Name: Phoebus "Fee" Scium
Known History:
Phoebus has always liked trying to understand things, so why not try to make money doing what he loved?

Unfortunately for him, he was banned from the Academy after his internal stores of magic were too weak to let him do any subtantial magick. His saving grace came in a sudden flagship project while he worked as a theoretical arcane contractor. The deck of cards that suddenly appeared in a wayward person's home, filled with latent magic activated by games of chance became a recent obsession to find other forms of magic that he can control outside of his own aetherial stores. He finds the charisma to be granted permission to do a longer study involving personal usage. To continue such a venture, he takes on separate projects to keep up funding.
Physical Description: Average build. 5'10 (177cm), dark brown skin, braids and cornrows. Always wearing some sort of overcoat.

Name: Primrose
Known History: Primrose and her family were once comfortable enough in South Silver Rock. Her hobby was dancing, both artful and new, and it was her life until an unfortunate accident paralyzed her from the waist down, stealing her mobility. Her parents urged her get surgery to install tech and grant her access back to her life's love even if it would put them back several steps in their financial security. Working to repay the debt for her family, Primrose took on what jobs she could as a courier, especially if the money was good, until one day her coveted cargo made her a target. Attacked by gang members, they took their haul and ripped the tech out of her that granted her mobility and threw her down an open chasm unknowingly into something old and ancient. Whatever was down that chasm, however, is what granted her new life. And so, she's back, ready to repay DHK and those gangs for their exploits. To be their problem as much as they've been hers.
Physical Description: A 5'5'' petite young woman with pale yet pink-toned skin that's soft to the touch like flower petals, yet with dark veins here or there. Dark red scleras make the bright burning pink of her irises stand out from beneath her equally bright pink head of hair with ends that fade into remnants of her blonde hair that's tied into high pigtails trailing from thorn-wrapped buns. Fingers are pointed into sharp wood-like tips, and thorns dot up and down her spine from beneath her skin-snug white clothing and her favorite luminescent jacket.

Name: Priscilla
Known History: A devout priestess to the Theocratic Monarchy of Merrane, until her belief structure was upended by the Worldhelm itself. Other than spreading her religion priestess primarily tends to take advanced courses to act as coordinators that help and guide Merrane Angels in combat. As such she has been more known to coordinate and command despite assuming a visage of a healer. Very curious about the people of the Worldhelm and these other realms she had no idea existed before her arrival, it has also caused her to question the breadth of power the divine actually controls. Intensely curious, she seeks answers to many questions as she travels and learns of all realms.
Physical Description: A short unassuming-looking blind girl, usually garbed in a white veiled priestess outfit.  Most notable are her clouded pink eyes, unable to see naturally.  Despite this, she has a knack for fashion and can also be seen as a realm-specific dress of different types. She holds a white cane that looks like a complex technological key.

Name: Professor Ozu
Identity: Wandering Spider With An Endless Hunger
Known History:
Some have seen him travelling around with his companions in their caravan amongst the Kabiya. His companions sell various wares to villages and other Kabiya. He in particular is the alchemy vendor, selling various pills of healing and remedies. Some have referred to him as the Wandering Spider, others who have gotten to speak with him call him Professor Ozu, and the ones closest to him just call him Ozu.

He has study and practices cultivation of Void, Alchemy, and Web Qi. He has taken up Aria as his pupil and is training her in the ways of Cultivation. His goals are to continue the research of remedies and aids to fight against the new reality of Tian Yin in hopes of being able to live without fear.
Physical Description: A masked man clothed from head to toe. His outfit is a mix of light grey and purple with accents of gold throughout. The most obvious things about him is the giant Spider symbol on his chest. He has a slim, but not too thin of a frame. His baggy clothes hide the true physique underneath.

Name: Qu Fuling
Known History:
Qu Fuling used to be a statue of the Kami Jizou near the village of Hanae. One day, the curse Yato no Kami manifested in a young red-headed boy who used to use the statue for protection together with his brother Kidomaru, but when he grew to adulthood, the protection of the statue was gone. The statue animated then, but the now Qu Fuling was too weak to do anything but send him "on a different road", which even then drained all of her powers reladed to the domain of "Road".

She spent a few years afterwards cultivating to delay her return into the statue, until the ship picked her up to help people of the many realms.
Physical Description: A daintly pale beauty with long black hair. She is 5ft 4' and thin. She dresses in greens and whites, often wearing a white veil covering lower half of her face. Her skin is cold and almost like stone to touch, and careful observation will reveal that parts of her skin are in fact white jade rather than skin.

Name: Quivira
Identity: Devout duelist inventor from the high academy
Known History: she was born and raise in Korala and move to Caldera to study at the high academy, after graduated she focus on very kinds of games right now she focus on cards.
Physical Description: She is a girl with blue cloths, silver hair and a cute hat. she really likes any kinds of games but she likes to win even more.

Name: RAZORBIRD
Identity: A Dreadful Smile In The Corner of Your Eye

Name: Rahim
Identity: Discarded Mutant on a Journey of Self Discovery
Known History: A slave living in The Last Hold of the Nezmira Empire and a victim of the Empire's disregard for human life. He was abducted by scholars and was used as a test subject.  In his confinement, he was force-fed Kiir  parts and Kiir blood to figure out its effects on Humans.  During one of the experiments, he manifested mutations which allowed him to escape the facility. He survived but  not unscathed - the experiments resulted in both his body and his mind being damaged resulting to permanent mutations on his body and amnesia.  Deformed and mentally scarred from the experience, he currently roams as an escapee, he seeks to figure out his true identity and the truth about what happened to him. The only thing he knows about himself is what he assumes to be his name written in a band attached to his legs.
Physical Description:
Hair: Brown
Eyes: Black
Skin: Brown
Height: 172 cm (5'8")

A young man with simple clothes often wearing a cloak or poncho to hide his disfigured arms and scarred body.

He often carries a blank expression as if in contemplation most of the time. Although, he also shows a friendly demeanor to offset the quite scary nature of his mutations.

Name: Raia
Identity: A Shaman Kitsune who loves Cooking
Known History: A yokai who had partaken in the war of the Fox and Hound. But he is known for using his foxfire to create campfires, cooking for the local community and providing bits of joy whenever he can.
Physical Description: Raia is 5'10" (178cm) tall with a solidly fit body. White hair that ends on his shoulders, fox ears with gray tips, and a noticeably long tail that is very soft to the touch. He wears a set of cold weather black robes, with a long red scarf around his neck. Icy blue eyes. Usually wears a smile on his face when in safe company.

Name: Rain
Known History: Not much is known about Rain besides that she has strange shields and that she appears to be a prisoner(?) of some kind back in Terra, she doesn't seem that keen on talking about the past and often walks away swiftly when approached by the topic.
Physical Description:
Standing about 5 feet tall, Rain has a rather frail appearance. Wearing a ragged yet refined white dress and obstructing black shackles from her wrists, ankles, torso, and neck that seem to glow a dark redish hue from time to time. Having feline traits, Rain has two cat ears instead of normal human ears and a cat's tail that normally sways rather lively since coming to the Worldhelm. 

Besides her physical appearance, her shackles seem to construct two blackish red crystalline shields that protect Rain from any danger that approaches her. She is often spotted laying on top of one of her shields from time to time as it flies around the Worldhelm, like a sleeping cat on top of a moving box.

Name: Raine Levia
Known History: A gifted Soulrunner from Terra who rose to become a "cyber mercenary" for PARABELLUM, fighting Daemons within the Soul Network and monsters outside. Her targets include other companies and hackers, claiming to be a guardian of the "forest" she holds such a close connection to. She desires to bring order back to the realms and acquire more power to protect the home she holds most dear.
Physical Description: A petit Septid of 4'3" and very slender build. She has long flowing blue hair tied into pigtails and piercing red eyes. She typically wears a blue dress that covers silver and blue scales around her torso, wearing a pendant that resembles a broken lock and chain around her neck.

Name: Rama (राम) Huracupriya
Known History:
A Slayer born under the blessing of the Second Grave, after Rama left the Shiva Tribe she quickly began making a name for herself through hunting beasts and wanted criminals.

Rama is also known for being a rather greedy person, often times taking unnecessary risk for just a couple of additional zenits. At the same time, she also yearns for worthy challenges, and has been referred to as an "adrenaline addict" on multiple occasions.

Strangely enough, even though Rama is often seen gaining large profits, she doesn't live lavishly and instead prefers to humbly wander Aranova in search of her next target or adventure.
Physical Description:
A rather tall and agile girl, Rama stands at 5'9'', with light dark skin and pale blonde hair. Her right eye is blind, with a scar through it, a wound taken in battle.

Rama usually wears large green ponchos or cloaks, usually to resist the strong currents of wind she rides using her blessing.

Name: Ranmaru
Identity: Adroit Fox with a Hero's Mask
Known History: An exile from his people in the Farwood after his faith in Kuzunoha grew too doubtful. He speaks just as fondly of his early days with the yokai there as he does of the time he spent wandering alone.
Physical Description: Ranmaru is 5'7, and hides a lithe figure beneath heavy cold-weather dress he doesn't seem to want to depart from. His faceless mask is supernaturally expressive, eyes moving like lights, and it never comes off. That, his clothes, and his wild white hair that is only sometimes tied into order leave no skin visible most of the time.

Name: Raye
Identity: A young woman lost in a fake world
Known History: Raye was born under the name Roze Shizuku but little of that girl remains now. Roze always had an affinity with games and with some rather wealthy family came the benefit of being able to afford all the gear and the new games to match. Her parents didn’t have much time for her so what they lacked in time they tried to make up in entertainment. Roze spend most of her life immersed in fantasy worlds under the name Raye and when she got her hands on the hit game SWORD it became her life. In the real world she worked as a performer portraying her character as a persona and in her time of she continued that persona in the game. So it only was a matter of time that she was more Raye then Roze. She fell victim to Dive Corruption fully identifying as Raye and unable to tell reality apart from the virtual world.
Physical Description: Raye is a 5‘8 tall, commanding figure with long, flowing blonde hair and almost always with a look of determination in her eyes. She is mostly seen wearing the armor that she made inspired by her character in the SWORD Game.

Name: Rayyan
Known History:
An unwanted child of a Nezmi slum, Raye was taken into the hands of labour young. She was wilful, unrepentant, and oft punished for her attitude and behaviour. 

It was not until she was taken into the custody of a wealthy merchant family in Windhaven that she saw any glimpse of hope for freedom. She yearned for escape, and when it found her, all she could do was take the hand of her partner and run.
Physical Description:
An athletic and sharp young woman, Raye’s muscles are not flashy or toned; her body is simply built for labour. Whether it be physical work or physical violence, Rayyan is perfectly capable. Her face is often stern, her eyes resting in a narrowed position and her lips pulled into an intimidating scowl, though her expression often takes on a cynical edge when she speaks.

Raye’s outfits change often, often not of her own desire. Shale simply will not accept either of them looking as casual as Rayyan would often prefer to.

Name: Retti
Known History: Retti always worked hard to become a knight of the Fae Domain of Pryn, but struggled to meet the standards of his peers. Before achieving his goal, he slipped through the stream of souls from the Realm of Fairies into Tradefair, Kor'Tarion, and found a way to fulfil his dream of helping people outside of the Faerie Realm. He took to the causes and plights of the local people with chivalry aplomb. A few years later, finding himself on the Worldhelm, Retti yet again faces unfamiliarity and unknown evils - and greets them with a head held high.
Physical Description: Retti is a 5'5'' fairy knight, with fair skin and hair. He is visibly strong and well-trained, with a caring demeanor and an air of confidence and cheer. Retti wears a crystalline construct when adventuring, fashioned from gemstones, crystals and runes, allowing him to exert his crystal magic fully.

Name: Revin Aegian
Identity: Earth Mage of an Ancient Lineage
Known History: Student of the Earthbound Temple, now journeying in order to know the world beyond.
Physical Description: Short, a bit thin, blonde hair, jade green eyes. Wears white robes with golden dragon embroidery, the mark of his order.

Name: Rex Deckard
Known History:
Rex had once worked for Tubal & Cain Company, spending 16 years of his life slowly building his career from being a gofer, until he eventually became one of their more reputable transporters of goods.

But as he rose through the ranks and participated in more and more of the company's darker side of arms dealing, handing off powers into the wrong hands and seeing their consequences first-hand, his heart also grew wearier by the day, burdening his conscience.

The final nail in the coffin is an incident during an off-the-book transport mission between T&C and The Olympians delivering a batch of firearms, espertechs, and temp licenses, where upon the successful delivery of the goods, an unfortunate series of events culminated into the deaths of 3 homeless young teens from Central Outskirts.

Shortly after, Rex decided to retire from T&C and has since spent his days working odd jobs such as delivery, transport, and procurement, mainly for the underprivileged community outside of Haven.
Physical Description: Rex is a rugged-looking, weary-eyed middle-aged man wearing a Terran leather coat over his relatively tall build. He had thin unshaven beard stubble spread across his chin, and some mildly greying hairs on the root of his head. Multiple signs of old scars can be seen across his face and visible neck area, accrued throughout his years serving as a transporter for T&C.

Name: Reynaud Girardin
Known History: He has been all around Kor'Tarion in the passed decade in some way shape or form. Little is known of his deeds aside from the fact that he spins tall tales and writes. Much of the stories of any sort of prowess he would have is dubious at best and an outright lie at worst. The prevailing opinion of the rumour mill about him is likely that he is an alright enough man, that he has the spirit, but just is lacking something to actually make him great.
Other Names: The Snow Covered Swashbuckler, The Brilliant Bastard, The Steel Poet, The Mistcutter, The Wandering Comet
Physical Description: A wiry man passed his prime. Wearing an ensemble that seems to be the spitting image of what a Swashbuckling Hero would wear. The frayed edges of his clothing imply that he is a man of action despite looking very well put together. He wears a well-kept moustache on a face that always seems to just be bordering on a smug grin.

Name: Rezul
Known History: Calling the fire shrine his home for most of his life and training there, he still can't control his emotions that easily. He still feels guilty about heavily injuring one of his friends when he lost his temper. He believes it might be the area he lived in that affected him. Hoping in finding new shards of the moon and getting his temper under control, he sets out on his journey and soon gets discovered by the Worldhelm.
Physical Description: He is a pretty skinny and fairly tall warrior monk, who in the shrine has trained his mind the most, at the cost of his finesse and body.

Name: Rin
Known History:
Rin's secluded village in the mountains has always had Oni troubles. A particularly powerful white oni has lurked nearby for centuries, and to keep it appeased and at bay, they had to sacrifice one of their own every decade. By a stroke of bad luck, a very young Rin was chosen for this duty. As the horrid oni attempted to consume her soul, her latent psionic abilities awakened, protecting her. However, the process still corrupted her soul with the white oni's essence.

In the chaos, Rin managed to escape, but she was tainted and changed. As she grew up, she developed features similar to those of the oni that had tried to eat her soul all those years ago. She could not return to her village, so she learned to use her abilities and what little she learned in her short time in her old home to survive.

These oni traits included a semblance of its overwhelming hunger. Rin tries to channel her monstrous appetite into rare exotic game to avoid her urges leading to more humanoid targets...
Physical Description: Extremely pale skin, red-tinged horns, bright crimson eyes, squishy, wears a loose-fitting light gray tunic with a sash and sandals

Name: Rin (#2)
Known History:
Those from or who live around Murata would have heard of a Half-Kitsune who was thrown out of the village many years ago. During those years Rin had taken it upon themselves to protect the village's outskirts in whatever way they could. Since some of the villagers at least still cared for Rin. Though after many years Rin was forced to leave the outskirts of Murata after they discovered how much of a monster Rin's cultivation made them seem.

Cultivators from Tian Yin might see their cultivation as borderline corrupt or highly suspect him of being a corrupt cultivator. Though in reality ||Rin is attempting to purify a corrupt, heavenly cultivation technique that the Kitsune had used in attempt to corrupt and turn Rin to their side. Using their own Demonic Qi against the Heavenly Qi within the technique.||
Physical Description: Rin is a Half-Kitsune standing roughly at 5'10 (180cm) with a head of messy black hair and tall fox like ears. A pair of yellowish irises that faintly glow in the shadows. Due to their cultivation they often dress lightly with baggy pants or other clothes they've managed to piece together. Their forearm and legs are covered in a thick, matted black fur that goes into a pair of claws and padded paws respectively. Different animalistic parts may grow due to their cultivation technique but those are not always present.

Name: Rinchi Amaya
Identity: Half-Yokai (Kitsune) From a Fallen Warrior Family
Known History:
From a fallen warrior family who once protected a small village from threats. After her mother, the head of the family, was forcibly impregnated by a kitsune, there was nobody to protect the village as the elders of the family had retired.
Doom swiftly fell upon the village as monsters attacked, wiping half of the village out. The survivors cursed the family out and exiled them.

Now 19 years old and having been trained in the ways of combat and magic by her mother, Rinchi sets out to take revenge on her father to restore her family's honor.
Physical Description: 167cm tall, long teal hair, teal fox ears and tail with white tips.

Name: Risata
Known History:
Risata lived in Providencia for a long while taking care of children in the orphanage. Life lead her to joining the exorcists. In an attempt to seal away an ancient evil, she exchanged most of her power and life. The reason she's so open about this? She's a woman on borrowed time. It's important to accept the end of all things. 

Despite her stoicism, she remains happily married to her husband Mahuizoh. 

He's gives her hope; maybe they can have a happy ending.
Physical Description: 5'10" | Indigo Eyes | Lavender Skin

Name: Ritveja
Known History: A strange and eccentric trader who answers to the name Ritveja. She roams a circuitous path between cities and settlements, large and small, foraging and hunting for unique plants, furs, and other curiosities to trade to the people she meets along the way. While seeming harmless and unassuming to many, in the rare scenarios where she has to defend herself or a town she visits, the knowledge of Formations, and the Void Qi she has cultivated over her travels make her capable of being a steadfast defender when she is needed.
Physical Description: Ritveja stands at 6’2” of height, with a somewhat broadly built frame, as is typical of all of her kind. Her brown fur, which is kept manageably trimmed at all times, is often speckled with simple braids and beads made from shells, rocks, and leather, complimenting the strange ensemble of items that dangle from her robes, causing a light clinking noise whenever she approaches. Apart from her various baubles and curios, she has precious little in the way of other possessions, aside from the large staff she uses to walk, and a large knapsack by her side, always empty.

Name: Robbins
Known History:
Robbins has lived all his life in the Kullroc Glacier, in Aldistir, and was given his intelligence already later in his life, choosing to maintain his animal form. 
In the Kullroc, he created a family for himself and has a partner and three children. Having a family brought a realization to Robbins' mind: he wants them to be safe. He then finds himself reluctant to associate with Kuzunoha, and finds Nimue's values a lot more sensible.
After Nimue's death, Robbins told his family he was going on a gastronomic adventure around the land, to come back with more recipes, but instead, he grabbed an Ald's helmet and left to protect the realm, as best as he could, hoping this would bring peace to his family.
Physical Description:
Robbins is a fat, but tall (for a penguin) creature, standing at 1.25 meters of height and a whopping 43 kilograms of weight. He is often found overencumbered, as he carries his many ingredients, as well as helmet or shields made for normal sized humans.
His bubbly and overly kind demeanor leads him to talk and offer help to just about anybody. While kindness has its bounds, Robbins' regularly increases to match the size of a request.

Name: Robin
Identity: The Yielded Knight of the Sun
Known History:
When he first arrived in Idyll, he wandered its peaceful lands before they were tainted by evil. His journey led him to Nirve, where he became Captain of the Guard. Empowered with authority, he was always ready to help those in need, his dedication serving as an inspiration to the people.

But after the fall of Idyll, something within him changed. Despite his relentless efforts to protect the realm, he eventually withdrew from the fight, abandoning his duties. No longer a hero, he became reclusive and aimless, the fire that once drove him extinguished, leaving behind only the shadow of a once-great leader.

Just like when he was still living in his own and much older Realm.
Physical Description:
Height: 175 Cm
Weight: 80 kg
Physique: Slim Effeminate

Unique Feature: Both of his arms are Spectral and See through. Within them you see different objects, from potions, to chains, to swords, to axes, and more. 

For Clothing and Looks use image as basis :3

Name: Rokuro Tamashii
Known History:
Most of his history is kept a secret from others but regardless of where he goes he tends to cause rumors to emerge due to his off putting behavior.

The title Salesman of Souls comes from a belief that most of his wares are actually the souls of anything that crosses his path during his travels though the extent of this has varied with some claiming to have even have been saved from the clutches of monsters due to this tendency.

Some believe that he may have been a former member of a heritage of cultivators but it's been well known that any questions regarding this topic are often ignored.

Some even speculate that Tamashii isn't a real last name but something he simply made up during the fall of the gods.

The truth is that everything people speculate is much closer to fact than fiction yet one thing that's clear is a lack of willingness to share any details himself.
Physical Description:
Brown hair but with streaks of a white that almost looks like the color was scraped out of it over time.

Often seen in his travelling clothes he always wears a calm smile. Because of this he is often seen as shady even by those he conducts business with.

He's taller than most at 6 feet yet not so much that it would seem abnormal.

Name: Rolando Yitters | Sleepy Chef
Identity: Let food warm the body and battlefield.
Known History:
The Faerie Realm of Kor'Tarian, the home of the mystical and magical, hidden away from the mortal plane. A realm where maps are words and grass giggles beneath your feet. One would think that a denizen from that realm would be… boisterous, flamboyant, or even a little crazy…
Not sleepy and dozing off every few minutes.
Rolando Yitters, quite young for a Fae, is a former resident of the Faerie Realm, exiled by the court's decree after feeding mortals food of the Fae, resulting in a… messy outcome.
Being cursed to forever be drowsy and getting sent to the mortal plane wasn't enough to dampen Rolando's love of his craft, and when a realmstorm brought him to the Worldheim, he knew he could spread that love even further, never letting anyone go hungry while he was around.
Origin: Exiled Fae from the Kor'Tarian Realm
Physical Description: 5’ 10” and weighing 177 pounds, he has a rather light stature, but not one that makes him look thin as he is most definitely not malnourished.

Name: Ronan Ashwynd
Known History:
Ronan Ashwynd was born into the storied Ashwynd Clan, renowned for their expertise in hunting demons and monsters. However, his heritage held a dangerous secret. His mother was a Fae, and his father kept this truth hidden for years. When Ronan was a teenager, the secret of his mixed blood was revealed, leading to his banishment from the clan. The betrayal cut deep, leaving Ronan with resentment toward the family that raised him yet rejected him for something beyond his control.  

Forced to survive alone, Ronan embraced both his Ashwynd training and his Fae powers, using them as tools in his quest to carry on the clan's mission. Despite his dedication, his Fae abilities often mark him as an outsider, drawing mistrust from the human populace. Once, Ronan wandered Kor'Tarion as a lone hunter outcast. But since, loved ones from his past walk with him. 

Now he forges a path forward. Fae blood awakened to protect what he holds dear. Woe be to anyone who dares get in his way.
Physical Description: Ronan stands tall at 6'2", his imposing presence enhanced by a cloak of dark fur draped over his shoulders. His skin carries a rich, sun-worn tone, complemented by dark brown hair that falls in unkempt waves. A single piercing sky blue eye peers out from beneath his brow, the other concealed beneath a weathered eyepatch. Beneath the cloak, he wears a black vest paired with rugged traveler’s garb, hinting at a life of constant motion. Rings of piercings adorn his ears, adding a touch of rebellious flair to his otherwise stoic appearance.

Name: Rosanna Westwood
Identity: Distant Protector with a Heart of Gold
Known History:
Rosanna doesn’t like to talk about her past, but the fading, incomplete set of scaled brands that drift across her collar bone tell part of the story on their own. The usually reserved, often intimidating young woman sticks close to the companion she arrived with at all times, with the two of them frequently appearing to communicate nonverbally and always knowing how the other is feeling or what they’re thinking… Though only those with the ability to see souls would understand how this is accomplished. 

Her presence with the cat-eared young man at dinner every night is guaranteed, yet despite this, no one ever seems to see her eating. A keen eye could catch a glimpse of oversharp canines when she chances a smile. Rose seems to take much interest in experiencing new places, even if she would not admit it, and expresses fascination in what others would deem mundane. Although she appears aloof, even the most oblivious of people would notice how she drools at the sight of a candy shop.
Physical Description: Rosanna is a tall (standing at around 6’2”) young woman with bobbed pink hair and brown eyes. She opts to dress in purples and blacks at every opportunity, but doesn’t seem to mind lace or frills. Her default outfit consists of a dark purple off-the-shoulders shirt with wide sleeves (cinched at the elbows with ribbon), a dark corset, and a mid-calf black skirt overtop a layered purple and black petticoat. She also tends to wear an insulation layer on her legs, hidden beneath the layers of skirt and her boots.

Name: Rowan Sondergaard
Known History:
At Hudal Academy, there's a common warning - "Don't take Environmental Magic 101".  The head of the Nature Department, Professor Sondergaard has been teaching at the academy for at least 25 years, and has gained a bit of a reputation for being a bit of a scary teacher. His unwavering love for all things natural can come off as a bit intimidating to other, but it is that fervor that has earned him such a prestigious position at the academy. 

Recently, he learned about the enigmatic phenomena known as Realmstorms, and he set off on a month long field trip with his students to investigate. When it was nearing the end of the trip, when Rowan was working throughout the night, he noticed this fantastical show of colours outside his tent, and ran to see what it was. He was greeted by what he'd been searching for, a Realmstorm! He grabbed whatever was near him and just started running towards it. One bright flash of light later, he found himself on the Worldhelm, surrounded by strange people.
Physical Description: Rowan stands at 5'11" with a frail build befitting a researcher. He is always seen wearing his hat and visor, which glows a slight blue hue. Rowan sports a blonde beard he keeps well trimmed, although it can get unkempt if he delves too much into his research notes.  He wears a purple robe adorned with jewels and carries a botany textbook which doubles as a magic tome.

Name: Roy ⚡
Identity: Shy but Electric Inventor Who Can't Sit Still
Known History:
Roy is a young electric inventor who evades responsibility, often using the excuse of putting all of his effort into his self-named exosuit, "Megasword". 

Roy grew up in an impoverished family, he and his parents trying to become magitech engineers. His younger years were full of magitech study, his parents holding hope in Roy's genius. 

He was told as he was growing up to not to touch metal, others, or go swimming. They made one exception though, "Megasword". This was something Roy drew pictures of as a child, and worked on all the time. One day, a school friend tried to grab the compressed box that holds Megasword out of his hands, trying to pull a prank. Roy, out of surprise, shocked the heart of his friend until it stopped. The memory rings in his head to this day.

Roy left his only friends, his family, recently after his father begged him to leave the city that already shunned him. He only recently has begun to use his gifts for something other than keeping his family afloat.
Physical Description:
5' 10"
175 lbs.
Bolt Blue Eyes
Contact with Roy Can Shock

Name: Ruby Rivers
Known History:
The perfect soldier, from what they had seen. Nightmare to hostiles, a killing machine.

Codenamed Project R. Instance labelled Rho-Beta. Her self-assigned name came much later.

Ruby is, as far as she's been made aware, the last living result of a Lhodosian black site project to replicate the power of the gods. An attempt to create the perfect adaptable supersoldier.

It didn't go well for them.

After escaping, Ruby was taken by the Worldhelm - presumably an attempt by Yubel to direct and corral this force of nature into something that could be used for good. Though she's certainly taken the long way around to do so, with the help of fellow Goldhearted, she's gotten there.

Of course, she DID have to kill and eat what was ostensibly her brother, but that's a story for another time.
Physical Description:
Ruby is 6'0", weighing 174 lbs. She is generally clad in loose, light clothing, and any extra layers are similarly light so they can be removed if necessary.

When her flesh warps through Akromorphosis or her Therioforms, it seems to liquify, appearing like a non-Newtonian fluid as it shifts into its new form.

Floating behind her at all times are the twin halves of the 77th Holy Sword, Damocles, earned and hard-fought for in a battle against Project Q, or Quinn.

Art from D&D's Tasha's Cauldron of Everything; if anybody finds the actual artist, let me know so I can update the bio.
Species: Human-appearing biological chimera, containing aspects of Lhodosian Nimue

Name: Rulekeeper
Age: Originally 20 but unknown since entering the Faerie Realm
Known History:
Once a student who one day ventured too close to a Fae domain with their colleagues. They all became trapped in the Fae Wilds and eventually were pulled into the gloom. Only the Rulekeeper escaped by making a deal with a powerful Fae, agreeing to serve them and losing their humanity.

However, even the process of becoming a fae could not rid the gloom from them completely and it continues to draw him closer no matter how far he may flee.

Still, they have a large amount of gratitude both towards their Fae master who saved them and their fellow Goldhearted who he believes have saved him again and again.
Origin: The Faerie Realm, Domain of Equinox(Kor'Tarion)
Physical Description:
Wears a large black cloak with further black colored clothing underneath covering most of their body. Even their hands are covered in gloves and their feet with large boots.
