They are heavily adverse to any of their skin being seen going as far as wearing a strange mask. The only thing that can often be seen is a pink glow from beneath the eye slots of the mask whenever they exercise their influence as a Fae.

Their exposed skin would reveal the illness that plagues them. A colorless haze that leaks from them as an indicator that the gloom once made direct contact.
Species: Once Human, now fae servant to the Rulemaker

Name: Runihura
Known History: A ex-servant in the palace of the Alaoui family, witness to the destruction and decay left by Vanagandr. The ruin left in the wake was enough for Runihura to flee the city and so he did. His status since the incident has been vague with the occasional spotting in various Nezmiran cities.
Physical Description: Runihura's scaled tattoos would run along their neck and chest depicting their knowledge in Entropism. He stands around 5'9 with long black hair that goes past his waist.

Name: Russo "Basil" Abetti
Known History:
- Born to parents both who worked within QiLink, both parents killed during a "hostile takeover" when they were younger.
- Adopted by the company, raised and joined QiLink's Paramilitary as one of their mech pilots.
- Piloting a full dive suit mech after undergoing extensive surgery to perform within a mech called - "The Dauntless" the runs on QiLink state of the art technology.
- Works under the AEGIS branch of QiLink, their handler being Tiberius Crowne.
- Has built up loyalty to Tiberius Crown & QiLink, more so Tiberius due to the shadier aspects of the company.
- Also performs in Pulsefire/Mech combat during his free time as he simply enjoys mech piloting both leisurely & workwise.
Origin: The Zhuanli Union, Lumina Prime, Terra
Physical Description: An average built 5'11 individual, nothing about their appearance truly is striking or eye catching when it is in comparison to the everyday people of Terra. A face and body that falls into a crowd easily, with a casual lethargy in their face though they look to try and be friendly. Their hair is a messy long brown mop of hair either tied up or back, it hanging longer than they like when it's fully down and gets in the way. Their clothing is more often casual, save for when they are working or demanded to dress professional by their higher ups.

Name: STATIC OOZE
Physical Description: An athletic and sharp young woman, Raye’s muscles are not flashy or toned; her body is simply built for labour. Whether it be physical work or physical violence, Rayyan is perfectly capable. Her face is often stern, her eyes resting in a narrowed position and her lips pulled into an intimidating scowl, though her expression often takes on a cynical edge when she speaks.

Name: Sable
Known History: Sable is the Ambassidor of Ixatali and the Goldhearted. Once her people learned of the Worldhelms existence and Sable's gold-hearted status she was appointed Ambassador of her people to keep tabs on the potential danger something like the Worldhelm could hold on Samsara. More recently her people have begun casting a deadly doomsday spell on the people of Nezzmira below that she dose not support and has been tirelessly working to prevent.
Physical Description: Standing 177cm tall, regal pearlescent swan-feathered Ixitali, with large white wings that bridge out in iridescent color of all kinds. She holds her wings before herself when standing, forming a feathered dress-like visage, and tends to look at things suddenly and directly when giving something attention. The rest of her body is lightly covered in the same feathery down as her wings outside of her stomach area (usually covered by how she holds her wings together in front of her like a veil). Her legs are like two small long twigs ending in two very sharp looking three taloned feet.

Name: Saga
Identity: A Story that Has Lost Their Title
Known History: Most of her own history is obscured to herself, she is aware that she was a Inkstone written to detail a story about Aldistir and often tells what little of the story she remembers. The stories of others, on that topic, seem to catch her attention rather well and this ship she has now found herself on has so many to record.
Physical Description: A generally humanoid woman at 5'10 with white hair that goes just past her shoulders though more notable would be various ink stains that coat their form and the long spindly fingers that constantly drip ink.

Name: Sahar'divh
Identity: Seeker of Knowledge By Any Means
Known History: Sahar did not really know his parents, other than what they left behind for him and his two brothers. That primarily being the grand library of their house filled with collections of books and tomes and encyclopedias of the world from the time his parents traveled it. One day, they just never came back from their travels. So then as Sahar'divh grew up he buried himself in those books those same books that made him feel like his parents never really left. He had a love for reading and knowledge is what led to become a studious mage and travel the world to learn new things above all else to follow in their footsteps, and perhaps along the way, if he is incredibly lucky find his parents or at least find out what happened to them. All the while repressing the feelings he has of abandonment and resentment to those who were supposed to raise him.  As for Sahar'divh's brothers, they were all distant from one another and each pursues different paths. Despite only having each other.
Physical Description: Standing at 5 ft 10 inches with an "unrefined" build a pale non-threatening looking scholar adorned with purple robes, meanders about. A monocle adores his one eye. Whether or not it serves a purpose is hard to tell from a glance. An unkempt mess of light purple hair sits atop his head. At his side and often in his arms resides a book that is often different from day to day ranging from many topics. To describe him, physically, as a bookworm would be an understatement.

Name: Samuel Reyner
Known History: Born into Birghtshield, Samuel was a model citizen. Working as a guard in Brightshield for years before reaching the point in his life where he was happy to retire. Until demon attacks spiked and the city went into high alert. Being unable to provide proper work as a guard as his body isn't what it once was, he still looked for ways to help as he felt he still had a duty and responsibility to the city. Until something else called for his attention and now he is here.
Physical Description: An older man, standing at attention at 6'0. Time already turned most of his hair to a light grey while smile lines and crows eyes helped show his age. Most would rarely see him with a supportive smile and a reassuring aura that comes with doing his job well for a long time.

Name: Sarah Montrofier
Known History: Growing up in slums of Tradefair in Kor'Tarion, Sarah always dreamed of leaving her life of poverty. Although she developed the skills to steal, she only really stole from the corrupt aristocrats of the city. At a certain point, she met a Dancer woman from a traveling show. Sarah saw immense beauty in the Dancer's art form, asking the woman to teach her how to dance, and so she was taught. Over the time that the Dancer was within Tradefair, she taught Sarah to the best of her ability, Sarah taking in every bit of information and move that she could. The Dancer woman eventually left, and Sarah left Tradefair herself to learn more Dancing and Roguish skills so that she could truly become a big shot.
Physical Description: Her skin is a deep tan, her short hair pitch black like the night sky, and her eyes are a grayish blue. She stands at 5'8ft with a slim yet lean athletic figure. Sarah wears a red cape with a hood over herself and her chest covered by a crimson wrap. Sarah's ears and neck are decorated with gemmed silver and gold jewelry, though most of it fake. Below the waist she wears incredibly baggy cloth pants held up by a leather and iron belt with a satchel attached, on her legs are leather boots the go up to her calf and shin. On her hands are fingerless leather gloves with bracelets gemmed with large opals, which are also fake.

Name: Saroja Narayan
Known History: Saroja was born into one of the few villages hidden in the Viper Gardens. There one could say she had a quiet life, living amongst the dead. There she cultivated her own Purusa, connecting with the ambient flow of such things around her, to even gaining a connection with the beings that surrounded her home. So with care she strengthened this connection. And as her spirit connected with the world around her, her body began the spark of a physical transformation. A spark that has begun to be slowly tended to until it was left behind to fix a mistake she made.
Physical Description: Standing at 5'5 , Saroja is dressed in the simple and traditional clothing of her home. Now, she is often decorated with flowers to regain any semblance of who she was before.

Name: Sasha
Known History:
Born in Merrane, his family left a few months after his birth. During the voyage, his mother and others of the group got captured by the Kingdom's army.
As a result Sasha grew up travelling with his father among the refugee camps at the border; he had a penchant for shenanigans and tricks, not knowing his father had built up a group of rebels to storm Merrane in search for intel on the lost members.
In time he got old enough to join the Wayward Bears in their quests, starting with the harshest training his father could devise, which clashed with Sasha's idea of life and got him his nickname "Wayward Rebel". When he finally grew strong enough he was assigned a mission, which went all kinds of wrong. Most of the group got captured, and he only saved himself by highjacking an old magitech Mech. Just when he was almost at camp a rainbow light hit him and he found himself on the Worldhem.
Physical Description: Tall, well built human, usually wearing tank tops, cargo pants and other comfortable clothes. When in mission favours a dark tunic that offers limited protection and helps mixing with shadows. Has two daggers of different intent, one white, the other black

Name: Satsori
Known History: Once part of the Caldera's infantry, Ogha's retired after a failed squirmish against a group of bandit left her scared from a while in both mental and physical state. She would spend the rest of her life training her body as a coping mechanism to forget this tragic event. She put on this face of a tough girl to hide her trauma. Now enlisted as a mech pilot, she hopes to at least prove herselft even if she's haunted by her past, to both herself and others.
Physical Description: 6,0 ft, 200 lbs, broad muscular figure, scars, red hairs, red iris (right) and blue iris (left).

Name: Saya
Known History: Saya hails from Ishiyama, the first Oni stronghold of the realm of Teisei. It is known that she shares a soul bond with some type of shadow spirit which appears to reside in the reliquary on her hip. She has spent recent years combatting evil Yokai and those that would follow them with the aid of her bonded spirit Kyoei, The Lunar Shadow.
Physical Description: Saya appears to be in her 20's with white hair tumbled into a bushy ponytail. Her eyes are violet, matching the color of the shadow flame within her reliquary hanging from her belt. She stands roughly 5'6" with a lean frame. She wears a white and black kunoichi garb accented with red bronze. Her bracers are inlaid with two amethysts from Ishiyama which she once called home. In her hair, a bronze ornament in the shape of two parallel horns. She wears an ornate katana at her side.

Name: Scarlet Alba
Known History:
"They broke me, but they made a mistake... They made my body my weapon..."

Once, she was nothing. Tested and drained until all that remained was a pale, hollow shell—her skin, hair, and eyes stripped of colour as everything that made her human faded away. She had no name, no self. Only a designation: Project 0413.

But the blood remembers. And the blood evolves.

The blood remembered warmth, even when she did not. The blood remembered emotion, even when her heart had long been silenced. And when it finally tore through its prison, it remembered one last thing—not everyone is cruel. Not all hands reached for her with needles and chains. In the chaos of her escape, there were those who whispered her name instead of a number. Those who hid her, who opened doors meant to stay locked, who saw the ghost she had become and chose not to fear her.

A name was given to the ghost,  Scarlet Alba.

Now, she seeks to relearn. To rebuild. To remember, and to make sure no one suffers a similar fate.
Physical Description: Scarlet stands tall, her entire form devoid of colour—a striking canvas of pale white. The only contrast comes from the vivid crimson markings that slither across her skin like living tattoos, shifting and flowing at her command.

Name: Selaphonea
Known History: Once a girl with a dream, to sing for the world with her wonderful voice, she has been disilusioned, still holding on to her dream however, hoping to one day change the world for the better through her voice.
Physical Description: A beautiful and enticing woman standing at a statuesque 6 feet 4 inches, she was engineered by SWORD to not only look as good as possible.

Name: Sella Askelson
Known History:
* Parents are nomads
* parents killed at Kald Forest, passerby warrior saves Sella
* brought to camp von Kibo, grow up
* aim to become a warrior to protect the weak
* in a nearby village when kitsune raid
* Sella attacc, Sella protecc
* Sella barely kill a bit kitsune
* Nimue blesses her
* later kidnapped by snowstorm to Worldhelm
Physical Description:
* Ald woman
* Tall, muscular build, 190cm
* Blonde hair she wears down, ice blue eyes
* Simple bronze sword + large runes-inlaid shield
* Bronze brigandine above chainmail, circlet
* White wings she can extend and retract from her body at will

Name: Selvaria Lightheart
Known History:
Not much is known about Selvaria besides the fact that she cared for those that resided in Camp Von Kibo as if they were her own children, helping the sick, the mournful, and the lost. Her history as being a prominent figure of tending to the wounds within the camp has led her to be known as a motherly woman, always willing to help others with grace even though she didn’t gain anything from doing so.

Even though her transfer to the Worldhelm was abrupt, Selvaria showed no sign of resentment towards her new surroundings but instead extended her own love and care to those around her once more - after all - even in the camp she tended to strangers, there was nothing different than tending to those who are deemed fit for this vessel. Though she often worries about those in the camp, hoping they’re alright - she hopes to visit them soon and aid them once more.
Physical Description:
Standing about 5’11, Selvaria has a rather refined yet somber appearance. Wearing a long radiantly snow white dress with black accents, an ornamental pendant on the left side of her chest, and a shoulder pauldron to protect her from any light attacks. Being blessed as one of the Oni in Aldistir, Selvaria has a pair of long black horns fixed on the top of her head. 

Having long pink hair with redish tips, Selvaria conducts herself with grace and care as her vibrant light red eyes look around the Worldhelm for anyone needing assistance with any particular task or matter. Yet even as she conducts herself normally in her new found environment, Selvaria occasionally shines brightly like a beacon - like a heavenly angel with loving etiquette to match.

Name: Sephi
Known History: She is A working product of the Cyborg-human experiments by Dr Caden. She was sent to an associate for research on mind-control methods, namely the implantation of a 'Control Module', containing an alternate personality which they can program, installing combat data obtained from WWA in hopes of her joining the ranks of the Merrani Angels. Despite their efforts, the attempts to control the other personality was unsuccessful, leading to her escape into the greater reaches of Lhodos.
Physical Description: Black, short-haired girl, red eyes, wearing a black dress with a small tie and a baggy overcoat. Cyan Magitechno markings strewn across her arms and clothes. She is 160 CM tall.

Name: Seraphina
Known History:
There isn't much to say in regards to Seraphina, she doesn't particularly enjoy people calling her Sera nor does she like to talk about her own past. What can be gleamed of her is that she has had a traumatic experience in Nezmira, being the source of a deep pool of hatred towards the Nezzim. 

Even though she appears to be 'happier' ever since arriving in the Worldhelm, she carries a rather fake smile, a defensive mechanism she uses to protect herself and to push those she doesn't find trustworthy away. One can only assume what has transpired in her life to make her such a way, but for those from Nezmira, it's an obvious case of what she is - an outcast who has lived for too long, a girl given another chance at life or another chance at something else...
Physical Description:
Standing about 5’7, Seraphina has a sleek yet foreboding appearance that could often be described as boyish. Wearing a white blouse with long sleeves and black accents, black trousers, and shin high steel tipped black boots. With long silky onyx black hair and crimson red eyes, her appearance leaves a striking impression with the addition of her pale white skin and the adornment of her pitch black draconic horns extruding from the top of her head.

Seraphina acts with suspicion yet expresses a friendly outgoing attitude, even on board the Worldhelm, she conducts herself with respect - one couldn't even know from a glance what her true emotions are underneath her protective facade. A part of her that she doesn't aim to reveal, not to no one but solitude itself.

Name: Seraphine
Identity: A Magical Dancer, ready to protect those in need
Known History: Seraphine worked as a bodyguard and private dancer for some influential merchants before her work eventually led her to some unfortunate exposure to a moonshard, changing her forever. The big magical exposure made her able to adept using magic to changer her body much like the beasts mutated by those very shards. She now uses her new powers and her swift feet to aid those in need.
Physical Description: Seraphine's attire is a blend of ornamental and functional elements. She wears flowing, vibrant garments that allow for fluid movement, adorned with gold and red hues. Her hair, often decorated with magical charms and ornaments, flows freely during her movements.

Name: Serena Ansaze
Identity: ☆ Sparkling ⟡ Shining ♡ Ex-Propaganda Spewing Pop Star
Known History:
Serena grew up like many children in Merrane, listening to stories about brave  Merrani Angels and their good deeds. Unlike many Merrani children, she was gifted with musical talent: perfect pitch and a beautiful singing voice. Music was a part of her daily life, she'd sing songs about the food she ate, the people she loved, and those amazing heroes, the Merrani Angels.
Eventually, she was noticed by a talent scout, who immediately asked her to join their agency, promising much better equipment and other perks. She signed immediately, and began her career as the "Pop Star of Gold, Seri-Nya☆". She stopped writing songs of her own, instead singing songs by management with themes boasting of Merrane's imperialism, and painting them as heroic.
She lived a cushy life, becoming relatively well-known until she overheard her managers deriding, how it was nice to have such a naive mouthpiece. She took her things and ran. She came across a realmstorm, and wanting to disappear, let it take her.
Physical Description: Serena is a 5'3" girl with pink hair that is tied into pigtails. Out of costume, she dresses very plainly, a yellow blouse, brown skirt, and fake glasses to hide her identity. She walks with a hunch and is usually seen either frowning or a deadpan face. In costume, she wears a frilly, flowery, sparkling dress and carries a microphone. She always has a smile plastered on her face. Every now and then, wires can be seen running through the dress, connected to different speakers and mics in the costume.

Name: Sharry Skelter
Known History:
Sharry was born in a small village that cant be found on the map but, according to her, its somewhere in the Albury Hills. Her memory fuzzy but she remembers having parents that loved her, and being alone in her house reading adventure and romance books. She remembers at some point in her young adult life, she was gifted a book by . . . someone. She cant remember who, just that it was someone who was not from her village. The book was on necromancy. She studied the ways of the undead.
She hardly remembers the night it happened but she remembers grabbing everything from her room and running into the forest. Then something or someone knocks her out and then she remembers falling off a cliff into the ocean.  She did not survive, but her necromancy helped her revive herself. She also says that her arms were mangled in some way and she had to get new ones but she never elaborates. Now, she is an adventurer  traveling the lands hoping to prove that she can be a hero.
Physical Description: She is about 6'0" tall human woman. She has pale white skin, silver-white hair, and red eyes. She usually wears black outfits, dresses for non-adventuring and dress pants and suits for adventuring. She always wears long, thick leather gloves and she never takes them off. She also wears the same black boots for all her attire.

Name: Shibana
Known History:
- Originated in the Feywyrd from a rosebush
- Retains the memories of past warriors from the war
- They journey Aldistir, broaching peace to Ald and Yokai alike
- Camp von Kibo has been the main area to sympathise with Shibana's attempts, in particular an Ald named Blom has become Shibana's mentor
Physical Description: Shibana is a person born from a rosebush drenched in the blood of Ald and Yokai. Parts of their body are soft and light blueish green like a stem or leaf, others are coarse and grey like scar tissue. Brambles and purple roses wreathe their neck and form what might normally be hair. They wear clothes and armour, usually of Ald make. Around 5'8''.

Name: Shiel Don
Known History: A Warden within the forces of the KPLA with big dreams of becoming his own hero, It is that dream to become a hero and to shield others from as much harm as possible that resulted in him being picked up by the worldhelm
Physical Description: a 6'3 relatively muscular man with brown mid length hair and slight beard, wearing high tech (for the area he comes from) powered armor bearing iconography of the KPLA

Name: Shizuko and Tsubasa
Known History:
Shuzuko and Tsubasa are a pair entwined, their souls tangled inseparably due to the nature of the ritual Lorelei pulled them from the center of when they were young. Their rescue was violent, and fast, and thus their essences did not funnel back to their proper vessels in full.
During their time recovering in the care of Lorelei's retainers, the pair were discovered to have an aptitude for the arcane, bending both the physical and inner worlds to their will. It was found that in straying so very close to the center of things, being pulled against the seams of their realm, the sisters had on some subconscious level grasped the truth of it all. And to witness the truth of something, to see the whole of it, in many ways, is to claim the purest of powers over it.
Physical Description:
Shizuko is a humanoid Yokai. She has a mane of pale white hair which extends far passed her shoulders, seeming to operate under slightly less gravity than the rest of her form as it flits and floats behind her while she moves. From her top of her ear extend two vulpine ears, clad in the same white hair, which twitch often in response to noise, as if always on guard. Her adornment is mostly simple, remaining lightly armored, apart from a white mask which often covers her face almost entirely, shielding her eyes from the sun's reflection on the snow of her homeland. 
Tsubasa is another vulpine Yokai, though her form is quadrupedal and much more bulky and athletic than Shizuko's. Her posture is similar to a typical canine, with rending claws and a thick mat of grey and white fur, though patches of incandescence give her the impression to sometimes be gleaming with a spectrum of light. Tsubasa is larger than most other fox Yokai, and is very capable of carrying another on her back.

Name: Shizuru
Known History: Shizuru was born a commoner in Caldera, she worked as a maid for a wealthy family. Her job gave her the means to attended the White Wing Academy in hopes of receiving enough training and recognition to become an imperial servant. However after losing an eye during combat drills, she was fired from her position as a maid for being "disfigured".  She dropped out of the academy believing her disfigurement put her dreams as an imperial servant out of reach, and is now a freelance adventurer.  However, she keeps a picture of Princess Cora von Merrane as a reminder of her loyalty to the Empire. She believes the Imperial propaganda, she doesn't hate the people of Karlsgard, she thinks they are simply ignorant and mislead by their leadership.
Physical Description: Shizuru is a girl who is short in stature and has reddish gold straight long hair. She wears an eyepatch over her left eye, her right eye is emerald colored. She wears a military camouflage pattern scarf, and a maid outfit. While her face is beautiful, her emotions can be hard to read.

Name: Silida
Known History: A painter from the "free" city of Blue, located on the southern coasts of the land of Nezmira, he owns a book of many stories and fables...it's contents shift and change based upon his own knowledge, and what little he can glean of its previous owners causes great consternation.
Physical Description: A boyish looking man of fair features and mid-length hair, he exudes an aura of scholarly wisdom...and mild trepidation.

Name: Simone Katsav
Known History:
Simone was born in the Nezmiran city of scales to a family of butchers. As she grew older though, she would begin to feel that she could do more for her country and its people. So at the behest of her parents, she joined the Nezmiran Army

Her early days in the army were tough. But through the personal assistance of another officer, and her own effort, Simone was able to land herself a career as an officer. Reaching the title of captain due to her efforts in dealing with the Kiir.

However, one day she was given a personal invitation by Theoris himself. Ignorant of Theoris' malicious goals, she accepted it and ended up getting experimented on, gaining wings in the harrowing process.

She now assists the Worldhelm with her capabilities. Hoping to one day also relieve Nezmira of their senseless prejudice and create unity within its people.
Physical Description:
Simone is a 6'4" Nezzim with Crimson colored scales, fiery orange eyes, and curved horns. She can normally be seen wearing either her Cobalt colored armor or her black and blue captains vestments. She carries herself a level of rigidness almost akin to a model soldier. The biggest oddity to her looks is the two large wings on her back, something that is not at all typical for Nezzim.
Her choice of armaments is usually a spear or some kind of polearm, supplemented with a round shield for protection.

Name: Skada Ralgarsdottir
Known History:
• Born to the small village of high pass in Aldistir
• Trained in healing, and scholarly studies. Known for her kindness and love.
• Due to her younger sister, Sigrid, picking a fight with the Jarl's son and losing. Being the first of kin and Sigrid being a minor, the punishment and disgrace of the name Skada fell upon her.
• Lost a lot of her innate kindness in the struggle for survival in exile.
• Finally was found by Sigrid after Sigrid joined the Warband of the Branded, reuniting them, they were then gobbled by a realmstorm.
Physical Description:
Standing at a lengthy and almost hostile 6'2, Skada is a woman with eyes that are as piercing and judgemental as a crow. Her straight red hair is draped over her shoulders in a slightly wild and unfettered manner, like the licks of angry flames. Her form is tense most of the time, ready. Just in case.

“The unwise man
    is awake all night
    worries over and again.
    When morning rises
    he is restless still,
    his burden as before.”  — The Havamal

Name: Sloan Romani
Identity: A Once Great Magician Chasing Magic
Known History:
What was once the Pureblooded noble of Nezzmira, is now just a practitioner of the Arcane. No longer pureblooded nor blue scaled, Sloan Roman's heights were in shackling a spell around the Angel of the End, Loftur. Such an act was not left unpunished, as Loftur stripped her of her prestige and abilities, hurling her back to a beginning many Goldhearted start at. Where many would crumble or crack under such strain and torment, Sloan has never looked happier in her life. Able to carve her own path forward unshackled by the weight of her past, or defined by a need to do bad in the name of good. Now she is as any scholar should be, on the pursuit to learn. Setting her sights to better understand magic of every realm. 

"The study of the Arcane, is learning in the end you truly knew nothing and starting again. All it took for me to rekindle my desire to learn, was being a thorn in Loftur's side. Fret not, this is nothing to the likes of me. I will be great again, for I already am."
Physical Description: The once Blue-Scaled Nezzim now bears dark black scales, the occasional glint of purple and blue hues along them. A change in her very magical nature altering her physical form, showing the severing of her magic from the Dragonlords of Nezmira. Standing taller than most women due to her draconic nature, her stature denotes her as a scholar of the Arcane. She now bears the clothes of a wizard or witch, the styling that of Kor'Tarion of all places as if she found a fascination with their style. Even the looks of her magic altered and strange, now taking on dazzling colors and an otherworldly nature to it.

Name: Sol
Known History: Sol, once a powerful Archfey known as the "Guardian of Protections," was revered for his mastery over all elements, including light and dark magic. After a great battle left him weakened, he retreated into a long slumber within an ancient tree to recover. For decades, he lay dormant while the world of Kor'Tarion transformed, ravaged by the destruction of the moon and the chaos of wild magic. Sol finally awoke after the Night of the Red Sky, stirred by the demonic invasion and the loss of life. Now, though greatly diminished, Sol must adapt to this new world. Discovering who he is beyond his time and accept this new life wherever it may lead.
Physical Description: A tall, slender man with long, wispy white hair cascading down his back, adorned with intricate runic tattoos etched along his limbs. Delicate wings made of faint rays of light extend from his back, shimmering softly with every movement.

Name: Solaraynn Ista
Known History: Another Ophidiya from Skamos who has rarely if ever been seen dancing in the Ruins of Ista or the coast between those ruins and the Cerulean Bay sometimes even in the dead of night. after many years of being an outcast living with their human parent on the outskirts of town nearly undiscovered, and gazing from across the Bay upon what he believed was Falak-Khan, but upon inquiring about him and seeing how much people were trying to cover up his existence... Solaraynn left home with some essentials, and a book of research that he still uses to improve his dance, with many questions burning in his mind such as "Why was Falak-Khan cast back down to the ground for trying to escape circumstance?" or "What would life be like up there above the clouds looking down on the world that has cast you out?" ... Solaraynn, too has begun to dream of the skies and beyond. but now a new question emerges, will he ever be able to reach that which he dreams of?...
Physical Description: slightly tan with a white, gold, and blue color scheme. Around 5' 11 in height, with some features of his non-human parent showing (such as his horns, tail, and patches of scales on his skin)

Name: Solaris Storm
Known History: loves mangos and was from The fire ant village before going on his own venture. Returned after hearing gold hearted were there and needs to find out why
Physical Description: Lithe Physique, armor focused on protecting the legs more than the torso and up, and a massive slab of metal for a sword that ignites and reshapes to that of a sword. a bandana on his brow and short chopped hair. also just generally exudes heat indiscriminately.

Name: Solomon Winter
Identity: Estranged Son of a Sorcerer King
Known History:
Solomon Winter is not his actual name, but it's the one he gives out to people who ask. Born in Lastport to a merchant's daughter, his childhood was relatively rough, given the seeming lack of father. In his late adolescence, his grandfather disowned him, causing the young lad to adopt his new moniker and work in the streets of Caer Laie.

A few years later, Solomon traveled to Caer Oarid, where he found out the truth. His father was a reviled sorcerer lord, and his mother had wed him in secret. His grandfather, who had basically sold his daughter, was to raise a proper heir, but the boy turned out to be too soft. Distraught by this revelation, Solomon fled until he came upon a storm of myriad colors. Seemingly struck by lightning, he then woke up at the Worldhelm.
Physical Description: A young man of middling height, Solomon Winter nonetheless stands out from a crowd. His hair is blond and tied back, his eyes a soft brown. His attire is an odd mix of a traveller's garb and finery. He carries himself with an air of nobility that belies his inner insecurities.

Name: Solána Olowe
Known History:
In her youth, Solána scoured her family's ancestral journals that contained stories of pursuits for ancient herbal knowledge beneath the sands. Her fascination with healing remedies blossomed, strengthening her desire to counteract the hardships burdening her people under the Scalefire Empire. While attempts at creating traditional medicine were mundane, her enthusiasm made up for it.

Years later, while wandering the hidden alleyways of the Blue City, Solána stumbled across a small, yet vibrant altar dedicated to Al-Shifā, The Maiden of Light. The energy that radiated from this sacred space beckoned her to stay, inviting her to reflect and draw  warmth from within herself. A night of clarity later, Solána felt something awaken within her, as if the very essence of the sun itself imparted her with a promise: to spread vitality to all those decaying under the Empire's malady.
Physical Description: As a young, statuesque woman standing at 5'8", Solána carries herself with purpose and a dash of curiosity. Her rich dark skin serves as a canvas for the delicate spread of freckles across her nose, shoulders, and chest. Being a desert native, she often wears loose-fitting dresses, accessorized with bangle bracelets and large-hoop earrings that reflect the vibrant hues of her amber eyes.

Name: Sonam Kham
Identity: The Solitary Bowman Seeking to Rekindle A Dojo
Known History: What is more known about Sonam is the reputation of his father, a man who has a list of accomplishments that are rarely seen, including the fostering of a Dojo in the more distant lands of Leytik - Sansarko's Gasp. The dojo has since fallen in obscurity in recent years.  Sonam has been seen in various villages in those isolated islands, leaving as soon as he can, getting resources along the way though very occasionally he stops and gives his aid to the townsfolk.
Physical Description: Grey and brown mismatched eyes with and long black hair put in a ponytail, braids partially decorating the hair. A bulky build with several prayer beads and the like wrapped around his wrists. Silk, Furs, and leather belts draped across his form.

Name: Song-5
Known History: Song-5 used to have a name, family, and home. Everything changed on the day she was about to be sucked up by the realmstorm. Pushed away by a foreign entity, she was instead yoinked through a dark magical vortex, waking up in the Spirit's Grove. Now with a new body and powers, there was no way she could go back home. Eventually after crying herself to sleep, the crackling of familiar sounding lightning came back for round two. Now she's here!

Name: Soot
Known History: The youngest child in a family of blacksmiths, Soot chose to follow a different path, training as a wielder of arms rather than crafter in the hopes of one day leaving the nest on some grand adventure or other. His coarse methods of self-instruction have likely left him with some bad habits notable to those more experienced in martial training. Though a self-admitted daydreamer, he is even-tempered and bears a strong sense of responsibility, particularly to those he has promised to protect.
Physical Description: An ashen-haired Hiear youth of slight build at 5'/152 cm, Soot hardly cuts an imposing figure. Yet beneath the armor is a body toned and shaped through many long, dedicated hours of harsh training under layers of metal heavier than himself.

Name: Soren Jaeger
Known History: A forester and hunter who, like many others, took up arms to reclaim a home lost. But as the years came and went, so to did the number of those who still remember what home was. Now only a handful remain to struggle against the changing world, holding on to the burning memories of a better time.
Physical Description: Beneath the damaged armor plating of his ramshackle exoskeleton is a perpetually tired man with dark brown hair and hazel colored eyes, wearing clothing befitting someone who spends most of their time outdoors.

Name: Soryn Camelia
Known History: Not much is known about Soryn besides him being usually found in the Blue City, as well as missing his right arm. He's known for assisting in hunting the Kiir from time to time, as well as being particularly quiet about his own magical prowess.
Physical Description:
Soryn is a young man who stands at 6'1"/185cm tall. With long black hair, purple eyes, a muscular build, as well as having rabbit ears and a cotton tail that indicates traits as a hiear. Wearing green robes that he wears it in a half manner that shows much of his left arm and torso, as well as cotton pants and a pair of sandals.

One would be able to notice that he is missing much of his right arm, leaving a bandaged stump. Typically using the sleeve of the green robes to cover it.

Name: Stock Trinity
Identity: Merrane's Number One Stock Trader (From Another Realm).
Known History:
Stock’s whole life had been preplanned for her before she was even born. Her parents were lucky enough to work at the Trinity Inc and be allowed to carry a prestigious last name: Trinity; a last name many sought out to obtain. With it allowed to have only the best education and granted the purpose of working at the best company on Terra.  The organization that monopolized peace & saved Terra from itself. She loved the idea of being able to give back and earn money to help fund the prosperity that her future work environment already provided. 

"shit got fucked with a crazy storm and now i'm in this realm"

Stock struck a deal with a war factory owner in the Kingdom of Gold and with five years of work she still felt like she had only begun to scratch the surface of this land's different cultures, magics, and markets. After obtaining the owner of the war factory’s blessings and a parting heirloom to show their faith in her, Stock left the Kingdom of Gold to make her way to the Worldhelm.
Physical Description: She has a slim muscular build with a 5'6" frame that is often covered by magitech gear. Short black hair, with dyed ends, are usually managed by being tied up or hidden with a hat. She always has her heirloom in her hands and a backpack stocked with goods to sell. When her blue eyes aren't looking down at her heirloom she's looking confident towards her next investment.

Name: Storm
Known History: A 'pirate' working for the KPLA, Storm's always had a knack for exploiting others' weaknesses and knowing exactly where to twist the knife, and used this mostly to take from those she thought could afford to lose (mostly the Empire of Merrane) and give to those who needed it more (keeping plenty for herself of course). After Merrane began their conquest, she decided to lend her services to the KPLA, more than happy to be as much a thorn in the Empire's side as she could.
Physical Description: Nearly six feet tall (6'10" if you include the ears), Storm has dark skin that contrasts her silvery-white hair and ice blue eyes. She typically wears a sky blue coat fringed with white and her entire right arm, up to the shoulder, has been replaced with a metal prosthetic. (She always gives a different story when asked how it happened.)

Name: Suitori Izu
Known History:
Suitori Izu is a girl born near Ishiyama, and raised by another Village after her home was raided, where she fled into the night and miraculously survived. 

Taught to dance by her mother, and learned to fight by watching and studying others until she found herself a mentor of the blade.

She picked up Cultivation, taking the paths of Water and Body; with a hand dipped into various bits before settling on two.

Now a Goldhearted, following the Dao of Water and seeking to Liberate Ishiyama, alongside pursuing Pursua in hopes of achieving her dream.
Other Names: Suitori Izu, Wardancer of Flowing Rivers, Jade Beauty of Ishiyama
Physical Description:
Height: 160cm
Eyes: Deep sea Blue
Weight: None of your business.
Complexion: Pale
A rather beautiful young woman, with long dark silky hair, donning a dancers attire and carrying a varied selection of weapons (2 for now). Normally seen with a Ringblade roughly her size.

A sly smile, a curious gaze, a gentle touch. These are among many of the tools she has at her disposal.

Name: Summer Rain
Known History:
Summer Rain lived their life with their clan. They taught Summer to hunt, eat, cook and how to survive the harsh wilderness of the mountains of Rhew by learning to fight like the savage beasts of the land do. 

Their tribe taught Summer to hide their body to all for they considered themselves not mortal, but spirits of the land who do not consider race and gender a thing. 

When Summer one morning found a man from outside the tribe being attacked by a beast, Summer went to rescue the man. They succeeded but in the skirmish their identity was revealed to the man from the outside world.

Summer's tribe demanded that Summer kill the man to keep him quiet forever. Summer refused to take another's life in such a way. Summer's tribe took the mans life anyway. For this Summer was exiled, which devastated Summer. But they figure that if they can kill enough legendary beasts and prove themselves a true spirit of the realms. They will be accepted back.
Physical Description: They appear to be very tall. Standing around 6'6. As for other physical attributes they cover their body in heavy layers of cloth and robe.

Name: Sunya
Known History:
Once a young mortal girl, then was indoctrinated into the Empty Monk order that prevailed over the lands of Leytik. Going on the path of becoming a cultivator by sacrificing their individuality, bit by bit.

Removing their name, their ambitions, their sense of self comfort, their bonds, their empathy... However, there was one thing that they never fully remove: their love for music. And that alone was the driving reason for abandoning her current path.
Physical Description: White hair, usually tied in an elaborate manner and wearing white robes. Standing at 5'4, usually moving in a graceful manner. Expressionless yellow eyes gazing at the world around them. Sometimes carrying an ornate guzheng that they seem to guard jealously.

Name: Syl'thra
Known History: Syl hails from the distant Farwood, supposedly, but not even Syl knows where she’s really from. Nor does she know who - or what - she really is. All she knows is that she crawled out of a pale silk cocoon in a dark forest one day, and before her wings could properly dry, a terrible storm swept through the foliage… and in the chaos, she saw a beautiful light which beckoned her closer. Now, somehow, she’s here - and Syl intends to learn as much as she can about the various realms and their peoples. So much to see! So much to do! So many things for a little moth girl to experience!
Physical Description: Syl is about the size of a human child and looks similar, with pale skin and a humanoid body structure. However, what sets her apart from a human are her gossamer wings, which hang like a cloak from her back, as well as dainty antennae which twitch inquisitively atop her head. She is clad in robes that are seemingly made from the remnants of a silk cocoon, and clutches a curiously-shaped tree branch close to her at all times.

Name: Sylvaine Corinth
Known History: Sylvaine's past is unlikely to be known by anyone on the Worldhelm. Those from Kaiway on the other hand would either know her as one of the top students from her class, and class representative of her class in Gnosis Academy. Having come from a Upper Class family of Graduates this is almost expected of her in some regard. She is the wielder of the Regalia known as The Hegemony, though she still refers to him by Myeongjun.
Physical Description: Sylvaine stands roughly at 5'10 without her heels on but stands closer to 6' with them. She holds herself to a level of prestige that many would make fun of. Her uniform is always well kept and the emblem of the House of Paladins always shown proudly on her shoulder. When she is without her Regalia she is usually unarmed, but in combat is seen wielding a machine gun known as The Hegemony.

Name: Sūn Si Yu
Identity: The Fist of the Jade Art Sect
Known History:
Born in Xuanwu Village to the mastery of a Minor Sect known as the Jade Art Sect.

Born male, but her father had found a pill that he used to help her transition when she realized she was femme

Trained in Cultivation under her father, showed a knack for Body Cultivation and Heavenly Qi.

The Jade Art Sect held onto 5 magical artifacts. A Spear, A Gauntlet, a Sword, a Bow, and a Hammer

Coveted by the Black Fist Sect, the major sect attacked it and managed to steal four of the artifacts.

Si Yu was able to escape only by fleeing with the gauntlet. Her father sacrificed himself to let her escape.

Her life was saved by Dehua. She did not trust the girl at first, but eventually came to rely on her after she was healed.

After 5 months, she was finally fully healed and ready to enact her vengeance. And then a Realm Storm happened.
Origin: Xuanwu City, Wujing Guo, Tian Yin
Physical Description:
A tall young woman at 5'8, Si Yu is a powerful woman. Her body is well muscled, and she wears clothes to show that off. Long brown hair hits the swell of her back, framing her body well.

Often on her right arm is a ludicrously large gauntlet motif'd with a dragon face. The gauntlet often catches fire, especially mid punch.

Name: T.R.E.E
Known History:
*Upon asking T.R.E.E about their past, they always give the same general sounding response.*

"Hello there, I'm T.R.E.E, otherwise known as the Terrestrial Robotic Environmentalist Entity! Though the majority of my data repositories have become too damaged and corrupted over time to read, I am aware that my former duties consisted of documenting information regarding Lhodosian wildlife, and working towards the conservation of species that are affected by Merrani industrial efforts. I am to continue this mission here on the Worldhelm, and all the other realms, unless a future operating function forbids me otherwise! As for how I arrived here... I'm not very sure. Days and nights blur when you're sitting at the bottom of a pond for... I'm not sure how long, it seems my calendar module has been lost... Well, the water is murky, and storms are loud. One day those everyday ripples became surging waves, and in a flash, here I was. I hope this information can be of assistance to you!"
Physical Description: T.R.E.E stands at about 5'6", and is unnaturally dense and heavy due to their construction. Each footfall leaves a dissonant clang as they walk. Where cogs and scrap metal fail them, however, overgrown, seemingly magical flora keeps their form together, and assists in their movements, as vines lace in-between each joint. They carry around a simple binder of magitech cards, and are able to capture photos of whatever they are looking at, as upon closer inspection, the magitech lenses in their eye sockets appear to extend and retract, and change aperture.

Name: Taavi
Identity: Wandering Peddler of the Tundra Clans
Known History:
- Human from  the aldish Clan in Gravernmarq, left some years ago to learn more about cooking in other dwellings.

- Since he seldom returned to his birthplace, he often had a longing to belong to the places he studied at.

- So when a group of Wandering Merchants came along, all from different parts of the Realm he joined them. The call themselves "Catalysts of Commerce"

- While on a trip to Blood Pools to gather some bloody thistles for a dish, he was swept up in a Realmstorm and woke up in the Worldhelm
Physical Description:
Taavi is a light-skinned man with shortish brown hair. He wears a rather wide-brimmed green hat, sometimes decorated with multicoloured flowers.
The coat he wears is rather old and shabby looking, yet it has pleasant look about it.
He carries a bag on his back that contains all the things he needs in life.

Name: Takaoka Kiyo
Known History:
Kiyo was born and raised among a small group of tengu. A community of several families, all moving between the smaller mountains abutting the Kald Forest as needed. They brought her up as a devout follower of Kuzunoha, and Kiyo still keeps to that faith today.

Spending many years as a warrior, defending her community and fighting in the War of Fox and Hound. Nearing forty, however, the hatred has guttered. She is tired of conflict and bloodshed, and wants nothing more than for everyone to know peace; to live, and to let live. Nothing could be worth all the pain, the death, all the days and nights spent in terror of enemies finding you, the heartbreak of finding bloody corpses in family homes, of cradling a dying brother in your arms. Nothing. Not even spreading Kuzunoha's beautiful natural order.

After chancing upon the Worldhelm, Kiyo found herself driven to do what she could to help others. Without children or wife, she could leave her community behind for a while, to do her part.
Physical Description:
Height: 6'4" / 194 cm
Wingspan: 10'9" / 328 cm
Eye color: Golden yellow
Hair color: Dark brown / Black
Plumage: Mottled browns
Weight: Much less than you'd think.
Shoe size: Not in stock.

Kiyo strikes an impressive silhouette, even when her prodigious wings are folded in. Her clothing is loose and flowing, ornate but generously layered. Beyond the practical needs of any clothing made on Aldistir, it was made to catch the eye and accentuate movement. Her hair hangs straight and falls halfway down her back. It's usually kept either loose or in a high ponytail.

In contrast to her sheer size, when the shape isn't lost in her dress, her figure is quite slight and willowy. Lanky, really, by all rights *gangling.* Yet in motion she is fluidity and grace, nothing out of place and not a single wasted movement. She always carries herself with elegant poise, as it if is all effortless to her. It's anything but. Still, a tengu has her pride, you know.

Name: Tanamachi Kaoru
Known History: A Swordswoman hailing from Teisei, known for carrying around a large greatsword that is as tall as her, is usually found and seen enjoying some sliced peaches by the wayside - out of sight. She doesn't say much about her life, as if not wanting to remember the past or wanting to make newer memories in the present and future... Strange, is it not? Either way, she isn't one for long dialogue but she won't turn away a potential snack partner.
Physical Description: A 5'3 tall girl with pale white skin, snow white hair, and ruby red eyes. Adorn on the top of her head is two black horns, she has a firm and maintained build that still illustrates a natural figure. Despite her strange physical appearance, Kaoru usually dresses up in traditional Teisei garb - just to feel close to the place she calls home.

Name: Tatsuya Sakanagi
Known History:
Tatsuya was a very dutiful man. Through long days, hard nights and extended required overtime, he gave long-standing years of hard work to NTTech. Always simply following what was needed to get the work done even if seemingly dubious though never illegal.

As a desk worker by nature he never cared for Temp work. The license he received from the company and the training was purely for the dangerous work.

The steadily growing feelings of discontent within him gave rise to a hidden desire new formed within his heart. He never considered himself to be a good person, and even less so someone who could stick their neck out for others in this city. However, once when overseeing the transfer of a monster and seeing said creature let loose on an agitated rampage into the city. All so that some forces could be dispatched to the scene and rewarded for stopping it. Instead of acting selfishly, Tatsuya found himself safely subduing the monster instead of executing it, to protect it and the people.
Physical Description: A 5'10ft man, cleanly shaven and cleanly cut hair. Edged proper to standards of a professional working man. A Serious expression with sullen cheeks as a standard look, making it hard to tell whether or not they are upset about something, sad or otherwise from years of wearing the same look. Beautiful amber eyes dulled by a look of dispassion. While up there in age, maybe due to keeping fit or taking great care of his appearance, he does look maybe a few years younger than he actually is.

Name: Telerion
Identity: the former fae scout seeking a home.
Known History: He is definitely from the Realm of Fae, but what he was doing on the Woldheim was anyone's guess.
Physical Description:
The figure was humanoid, familiar, but thin like a tree sapling. His finely detailed face seemed sculpted from wood. Telerion's smile was small, soft, and warmed the room. He was not a captivating beauty, yet nothing was plain about him. Even when the slender figure stood still, the ends of the elf's dark hair softly waved like black birch branches in a wind. His sharp ears peeked out from his inky dark hair or held the hair back, which fell to below his shoulders when not gathered up. Something about his gentle voice reminded you of the wind rustling through trees. His laughter was a lilting, merry sound.

When Telerion looked at you, you knew you had his complete attention. The longer people spent with Teleri, as some call him, the more apparent it became he was not from around here.

It is also hard to ignore the rhyming. Telerion didn't speak in verse when surprised, stirred to wrath, or in depths of sadness, but when it happened it marked him as distinctly fae. He hated that.

Name: Tenzin el-Shayekh
Known History:
Tenzin spent his whole life forcibly worked and used as a test subject when it came to more magically dangerous areas. One day, when he was guided into an area of eldritch magic, it reacted to his own capabilities to channel ambient magic seeped into him, vastly changing his internal magical balances and making it difficult to keep himself grounded in the current time, space, and elements. 

This part is fixed now, and he's awkwardly getting used to being in the present; being more connected to people is more difficult than he thinks it would be.
Physical Description: Tenzin is 5'7 (170cm) with a slight build. He has dark skin and now bright white eyes and hair. On the left side of his face is the bright blue scales that showcase a magic user.

Name: Teodoro Deocampo
Known History:
As the latest member of the Năm May Mắn Caravan, little is publicly known about mister Deocampo. Much like his acquaintances however, he too sells his own goods in the form of tea, and sweets that go well with said tea.

As a cultivator hailing from Sangan-Daan, his qi takes the form of water and ice, and while not the strongest amongst his peers his control over it only grows with every year. 

He is known to both guide and aid his companion and others from distance, in hopes that they might see a better tomorrow. It's uncertain if this is due to past experiences or if he simply fancies himself some sort of commander. The truth probably lies somewhere in-between.
Physical Description:
Even in his old age, Teodoro stands at an imposing six feet tall. It's uncertain if he's in fact blessed with an unnatural physique, or if he simply wears some rather tall wooden sandals.

His attire is rather unassuming for a cultivator of his caliber, choosing to drape his body in silken robes with the colors of Autumn, faded gold, orange and brown. While he is not as physically capable as some of his travelling companions, he still showcases remarkable flexibility for his age.

Name: Thalia Cornerstone
Known History:
Those who have been around Tradefair 10 years ago have seen a variety of bounties or warnings of a child who was a full-fledged part of a bandit troupe. Now, that same child is now one of their protectors of the city under the Golden Claw mercenaries' supervision. Regardless, to say that the Golden Claw's reputation had taken a plummet when that child was taken in would be taking it lightly. That is Thalia, seeking redemption for her actions, bracing herself for any ridicule, humiliations, or distain that comes across her path as her protects her land and her people.

And she has. Though it did take her family down below and her friends above to finally convince her of that fact. She has protected Kor'tarion time and time again. She's a bandit no longer. Not the ex-villain she made herself to be. A squire under the Marshall himself. A Knight of the Goldhearted Court. A blazing bonfire of Hope. That's who Thalia is. And she wouldn't have it any other way.
Physical Description: A short female human standing at 5'2 with short brown hair and green eyes. She is found consistently in her armor. Though more recently, she has started to come out of her metal shell.

Name: Thamalaine & Thamalina
Other Names:
Thamalain the Broad
Thamalina the Swift
Physical Description: Standing at six and a half feet tall in either form, Tham is a bulky/lithe satyr whose fur ranges from soft golds to fiery reds in a mane-like beard upon his/her chin. They dress in airy, loose clothing, and wrap themselves in ribbons and trinkets meant to catch the eyes of those they dance before.

Name: The Assistant
Age: N/A - They do not seem to age
Known History:
Hailing from the Suntouched Isles of Nezmira, The Assistant awoke with one purpose: to aid, protect, and embetter those around them.
The folks of their home realm seem to disagree with that notion.

With their innate, primordial, magical talent, they can cast a wide variety of rituals and assistive spells, which is surely a boon to those venturing from the Worldhelm. They don't desire fame, fortune, glory, or anything of the sort... what *do* they want, anyway?
Physical Description:
Assistant is 7'8", weighing 319 lbs. They seem to be always cloaked in rocks; though it's unclear where the rocks end and the body begins, this outer coating of rocks seems to differ from day to day.

Though they have no mouth, their "speech" seems to emanate from the crystal embedded in their "face", coming out alongside a low hum.

Art from [Nico Schmieder on Artstation](https://www.artstation.com/ultimakrecia)

Name: TheresioldaGaratsumiYumikoDraugr
Known History: Born to a nomadic clan, this kitsune is used to the frozen hellscape that is known as Aldistir. Having studied the Elemental fusion style with the caravans chieftain, he now seeks to find the meanings for his masters words: If you want to be the strongest, you need to find a purpose for that strength
Physical Description: A small and seemingly fragile looking person, Due to his past he looks extremly effeminate and it would not be wrong to assume he be a woman. A fact he likes, simply because he likes womans fashion more than mens

Name: Theta-13, resident creature #3
Known History: Theta's a government experiment made for military reconnaissance and scouting [aren't those synonyms?],they were created in a lab, a mix of...... so many kinds of DNA. mostly human though, she used to be fully organic but failure after failure led them just replacing more and more of him with robotics, at this point xe's 64.85% mechanical by the time she finds her way onto the worldhelm, they only recently escaped while on a scouting operation, as such she's incredibly paranoid about being re-contained by her creators, which, seeing as they've only been out for a week, is a fairly reasonable fear. it's goal at the current moment is simply "to live" to experience whatever life it has left, seeing as, to her knowledge she'll be dead by 20 years old. in actuality, she will not die at 20 tears old, she somehow broke her bio chip [ever watched the clone wars animated series? remember fives? good, you get the concept] and since that's broken. good news! she is not dying at 20!
Physical Description: 6'2, pale skin, white hair, a thin tail, horns, one green eye one blue eye, pointy ears, it's outfit consists of a sleeveless shirt with basic armour plating over where his guts would be [y'know.... IF IT HAD ANY], as well as heavy duty black pants and combat boots.
Pronouns: anything you can come up with. he's just happy you're treating xem like a living thing.
Species: I mean............. legally speaking it's human? granted it's mixed with so many other species that her dna looks like a mixtape.

Name: Tika & Bow
Known History: Tika was an engineering prodigy in Merrane. She's one of the youngest ever to attend the Caldera Engineering Academy, where work for the crown is designed and constructed. When the conquest of Karlgard began, bright minds from Caldera were put to work to win the war, Tika among them. She didn't approve, but she kept quiet and put herself to work on infrastructural studies that could prompt a more peaceful joining of nations. When she presented her findings to the regent, she was dismissed for her dissent.
Physical Description:
This duo consists of a, like, 4'9" pink engineer girl and a cat-size robot that's always either following her around, perched on her shoulders, or folded up into a briefcase somewhere on her person.

Tika's bag has downsized over time, but lots of technology is strewn about her person: a big capacitor on her hip, the butt of a bespoke rifle poking out of her pack, and all the tools somebody might need for impromptu invention.

Name: Timotee
Known History:
"Growing up in Constance, Timotee never knew war, not firsthand, at least. They had heard of it, sure, but it was nothing more than news and a distant thought. However, Timotee was not someone to stay back and watch, so when they came of age, they decided to take matters into their own hands: they took whatever they could from their lab, their last experiment, their instruments, their notes, anything light enough to be carried, and moved to the front, where they started helping the less fortunate recover when they came back injured from the trenches.
After the ceasefire was signed, they kept working in Vale, until a multicolored storm spirited them away to the Worldhelm...  (powered by 2NA)"
Physical Description: A human with a gentle appearance, almost invisible unless illuminated by sunlight. A very frail body, and the slight curvature of their back makes them even shorter than their already modest height. Luckily, their hat adds a few centimeters, and sometimes even R4 lends a hand

Name: Timothy Maclain
Known History: Timothy lived a relatively normal life before ending up on the worldhelm he took an interest in the inner working of computers at a relatively young age. This interest combined with natural proficiency would lead to him taking up a job as a programmer for SWORD, it was while working for SWORD on some project or another where Timothy would learn how to enter the Network of Souls itself which was simply fascinating, officially Timothy mostly just used these powers to solve relatively minor SWORD backend problems however on the side Timothy would solve problems for other individuals as a Soulrunner. It would be a gig gone horribly wrong that would cause Timothy to come into contact with a Realmstorm, with the next thing he knows being waking up in environment not all that dissimilar to a SWORD game like RWO but somehow feeling all the more real and not a cognitive projection
Physical Description: Timothy stands a relatively small and scrawny 5'5ft wearing what can affectionately be described as the cyberpunk equivalent of clothes you would throw on in a hurry to get to to work, glasses and in a sort of retro touch carries a wrist mounted computer despite having access to more efficient cybernetics

Name: Tonis
Known History:
Tonis was born a mute in Dryholde, growing up in the orphanage in The White Feather House he struggle at an early age to communicate
with others. However during his teenage years he fell in love with the strings seeing them play at the plaza. Once he started playing the cello himself he became more in tune with the souls of others making it easier to socialize have others understand him...however Tonis realize he was being too much in tune with others that he realize he was showing signs of being a mage. Luckily it was easy for him to hide his magic by just not playing as often as he would have like to however that changed when he was 19 years old. Tonis ended up using spiritist magic to heal a wounded construction worker after an accident, revealing himself as a mage to the public of Dryholde. Acting in haste Tonis had to quickly exile himself leaving his home behind with only his clothes and his cello.  However despite these events he is still very excited to explore the realms!
Physical Description: Blond Pompadour hairstyle with blue eyes. Wears a small goatee and white tattoos on his face.  He also wears a sword earring. His clothing is a simple blue over coat with a feather to its side.

Name: Trif
Known History:
Trif was born in The City of Nest and worked with her father at a young age to maintain the fields or the machines that do so. 
She was raised on company values and often found herself attached to her plants that she had once she was young.
She had made a name for herself, amongst others in various plant bioenginnering projects in Nest though never as the head researcher. Occasionally, she helped fix up any accidents within the workplace, if someone got injured handling a machine and so on and so forth.
And now she finds herself here!
Physical Description: A short 4'10 gal, often found in baggy clothing that hides most of their physique, often stained with dirt given her prior and current occupation.

Name: Trinity Heartwell
Known History: Known to be a student at hudal academy. New to being goldhearted and was shown the ropes by Dul.
Physical Description: 6 foot tall human male in blue and purple outfit

Name: Tson Gongn
Known History: He grew up in the mountains of Tanngula, in a secret palace monastery, nestled between two great mountains. Once a seat of power to a great demon king, Niu Gongn, who ruled this valley with an iron fist. He and his wife, Tieshan Gongn, a human sorceress. The Gongn's, hides here. Away from the eyes of heaven, where the traitor sits. The family was once allied to the throne taker, Xiang Shinan, but he betrayed them and took the powers of the demon king for himself. Now this family survives on its ability to kill monsters and offerings from the local village as repayment. For many years, they stayed in the valley, away from the chaos of the world. The demon king and sorceress would eventually have a son, and they decided to train him in the ways of Qi and hand to hand fighting. Tson, their new born child, became a master of fire and martial arts, and a skilled monster killer. He trains to achieve immortality like his parents and then challenge Xiang Shinan. . .
Physical Description: Tson is 5'10. He wears a long read robe with blue pants, and black slippers. He has a pair of black, armless sunglasses. His hair is a blazing red hair an his ponytail moves like flames, pointing up and flickering and moving. On his for head is a Bindi and has pointed ears, signifying his half-yokai heritage.

Name: Tsuihō Hira
Known History:
Tsuihō Hira is a half-kitsune who grew up in the outskirts of Hanae, never been able to truly go into village proper though is not hunted down with a mixture of fear and cautious respect for his natural use of wood qi and healing the injured that comes by, With the Kitsune rejected him for being too young and the Humans out of fear, Hira decides to make a oath to pacifism out of spite to both of them while he tries to understand and learn from both races.

After a few missions with the Goldhearted he has grown a more distaste for violence while still searching where he truly belongs. Inari's Will, Humans. Yokai, or none at all?

Even more missions past as Tsuiho ideals been pushed and challenged from coversating with the Yato no Kami and feeling true care from Inari even when Kitsune despises him. He now meditates on these new revalations to discover his place in this world.
Physical Description: White hair fox ears. Wearing a blue overcoat with a set of flowers on them. (White Anemone)

Name: Tsutsuji
Identity: The Spring Herald of the Feywyrd
Known History: Tsutsuji is the warming breeze, the new life that grows from the fading of winter. Her appearance was first noted three years ago as she appeared in the Feywyrd on what would be the first day of spring, racing a path through the forest with lilies and azaleas blooming in her wake. She creates wild gardens with her natural magic and care, and any who end up within find respite from the bite of the Blood Grotto- lest they seek to trouble the Spring Herald or her wards.
Physical Description: Tsutsuji is a large fox standing 4'2" at her shoulder with pale blue eyes and a pure white coat. However, when flowers begin to bloom across her body, the fur beneath turns an earthy black. She has three ribbon-like tails that float around her and branches that sprout from her head like antlers, flowers often growing upon them. All manner of flora may take root where she once stepped.

Name: Tucker Kawasaki
Known History:
Mr. Kawasaki is a reckless man who is used to facing the consequences of their actions. It's just that its his family who has paid the cost of his mistakes up until now. 
Having gambled most of his savings away, Tucker Kawasaki now works for/around 777LC in Fortune Valley as a Security Detail on temporary contract. He always catches his mark, but the company often hesitates to actually make him work. This bastard costs the company more in damages than what they save by catching someone who thought they could cheat the Company. 

In addition to this main cashflow, he works Odd Jobs across the several territories of Haven, scrounging up what he to pay off his family's debts can before they end up being turned into Insolvents by ET Acquisitions.
Physical Description:
Tucker Kawasaki is an unkempt man who would seem to be homeless if not for the fact that he has a vehicle and the seemingly sufficient cash flow to maintain its performance. A weather-worn trench-coat is layered atop a plain beige button-up and patchy jeans that have been repaired on countless previous occasions.
He has a "gun" on his hip, but it's actually a toy. When activated it unfolds into a portable electronic table for playing card games.

Name: Tylar Lin
Known History:
That one day, Tylar Lin’s life would change forever. It was like any other day, he was working on his family’s farm, trying to meet ends meet, despite all of the trouble Teisei was going through with no Sun… he was truly happy. He had a true love named Mari, and he was going to live an ordinary life.

That was, until a group of Oni attempted to take down Murata for good. Tylar saw Mari get struck down by a cruel and careless Oni, and in that moment… something snapped inside of him. A passion. A light. A want to bring hope and make things right. Picking up the Katana of a fallen town’s guard, Tylar, alongside the assistance of the town’s guard, pushed back the Oni menace.

He had earned the power of the Sun long thought lost in Teisei. After driving the last Oni from the town… he found himself on the Worldhelm, separated from his home.  But with his hope and the power of the sun now in him, Tylar hopes for a future where he can restore the light to Teisei… and eventually returning home.
Physical Description:
Tylar Lin is a 6' 1" man with a lighter medium skin and a thin, but surprisingly bulky stature. He has long, ponytailed brownish hair, a light stubble, and brown eyes.

He wears what mostly looks like standard peasant's garb, but slightly modified with more practical adventuring gear. A gauntlet with shining jewels for his sword arm, a practical waist wrap, and better boots ready him for his journey.

Name: Tyra Godbinder
Identity: The Witch of Death and Adoration
Known History:
Apart from her parents, Tyra spent all her life in Aldistir being rejected and shunned for her half-blooded nature. Once they passed, she was left alone... just her and the snow. And so she wandered. She wandered until she found company in a fellow outcast, an old witch by the name of Olga, who taught her the blackened art of necromancy.

After some time, Tyra put theory to practice, and put life to the lifeless. With her talents, and some months of work, she created the being who would be her son. Though he seemed monstrous on the outside, she loved him with all her heart.

Recently, after an extended stay with the demon Sanctimony and their cult, Tyra has found a measure of confidence. Should the world shun her for her being, then let them do so. But never will she hide herself again.
Physical Description:
Tyra is an odd woman, standing at 5'8 with a build that ends up just on the chubbier side. Unlike before, she bares her arms and scars proudly, no longer will she be shamed for her past, not her present. She is covered in Aldistiri runes and tattoos, and scars from battle and blood sacrifice. Her cheek is marked with the brand of the archdemon Sanctimony, and her hair is tinged with gold and an otherworldly teal.

Her 'son', Utsuki Halfborn, is a hulk of a man, some eight feet tall with dark hair and fair skin. His flesh is marked across with stitches, and even though he doesn't talk much, there is a doubtless innocence in his eyes.

Name: Tzera Crawford
Known History: She might have been heard of as one of the captains of the White Saber mercenary group. A group of swords for hire that tended to move towards more organized monster exterminations for large cities. However no one has heard from them in months after they took a mission in the far north.
Physical Description: A tall red haired woman with pointed wolf ears on the top of her head that seem to constantly be shifting towards the nearest sound. Her long mane of red hair is scruffy and full of split ends that seem to curl upwards. Her figure is on the more muscular side with thick arms and legs that are usually covered by the dark tunic and pants that she is wearing.

Name: Uriel
Known History:
Uriel has only ever known Paradise; they do not remember their life before Caladrius. Their body took shape to serve their lord even before the threat of corruption. Uriel being a Chaplain that quitely cared for the simple things such as the gardens and homes who lived there.

Their heart is soft and has never known the true hell that neighbors them.

And as any good devotee, they plan to share the gift of Paradise.
Physical Description: A 6'0 humanoid being dressed in white ceremonial robes and gold embroidery. Their expression is unreadable behind the flurry of feathers and eyes. But behind their wings, there is a smile that has rarely left their face throughout their years.

Name: Valen
Known History:
Born to the unforgiving lands of Aldistir, Valen was no different than the land itself. From an early age the lands taught him that the strong endure and this was drilled into him every day as he was being molded to be one worth remembering.

His father, Erik the Fierce, was the person that pushed him the hardest and Valen looked up to him as a role model. His tales of valor and combat told by anyone that trained him to be a warrior of his father's caliber. 

Reality reared it's head, in his 15th year of life his home was raided by Yokai seeking to eliminate them for their resources. Valen joined his father and the other warriors, and in this battle he saw why his father earned the title "The Fierce" as he stuck close to his side and did his best to imitate him. Valen fell in battle and the last sight was his father fighting alone against hordes of Yokai.

He awoke alone in the still simmering fires of his home, his father gone and the only thing he can do is be ensure the strong live.
Physical Description: Tall, pale skinned man and with scars, his brown eyes holding the burning signs of life in them. His no sign of facial hair along with little signs of aging in his face betrays his age allowing many to see his youth.

Name: Valen Bell
Known History: Valen Bell was born and raised in Ironholde living a laid back life living with his father and working as a guard and had plans on moving to Brightshield. Though sadly his planned trip was over before it even began when he got the news of his father's death when he was late to his post.  Valen was succumbing to grief until he took a chance in joining a church belonging to the rising Goddess Atee in which they welcomed him with open arms. After being converted and having a new view on life Valen sets out past Ironholde on a pilgrimage to protect the innocents while also spreading the word about the Goddess!
Physical Description: White hair novice looking male guard wearing outdated armor with a sword and shield.

Name: Valentin Bernstein
Known History: It is apparent at first glance that Valentin still carries his former profession as a butler with him. He is open about the fact that he used to serve as one from his home in Terra.
Physical Description: Valentin is a 6'4'' tall augmented human, likening the appearance of an anthropomorphic tiger. His fur has an orange/cream tone. Usually he is clad in a tidy and expensive-looking suit, as well as a few distinct adornment, such as his gold necklace that holds a beautiful amber gemstone in it. Valentin's posture is quite proper and polished, adding to a perhaps imposing impression at first sight.

Name: Vania
Known History: Had been a career solider in the People's Guard with Merrane, standing out enough to gain respect from her superiors. However she developed an unknown illness that caused her to be removed from fieldwork as the illness caused her to begin internally bleeding if she became to stressed or strained her body.
