With her skills she became an instructor who over saw drill practices, eventually being stationed in Suntower. Having lived in Suntower for over a decade when the rumors of it seceding from Merrane arose, she made the decision to stand with Suntower. As such she began to prepare for the worst and began trying to resharpen her skills.
Physical Description: A middleaged woman standing at 5'7" with long silvering hair and gray eyes, a beauty mark beneath her right eye. Typically dressed in a well kept uniform she carries herself with and air of discipline and confidence.

Name: Vanigad Ensed
Identity: Temporal Trickster of the Fallen God
Known History: A follower of the fallen god in Aldistir, Vanigad just kind of showed up. He said he was a warrior, but he uses no axe. He said he was a hunter, too, but his archery skills are odd. No one recognized him, and no one could tell exactly where he was from. But whenever someone thought they had him figured out, he would be gone before they knew it.
Origin: Forgotten Shrine to the Fallen God, Aldistir
Physical Description: A little shorter than average at 5'8", Vani carries himself tall and proud. He has short blonde hair and tends to wear comfortable and well-worn gear suitable for his frozen homeland, though he likes to keep a set of nicer clothing for walking about, and he wears an eyepatch over one eye. His irises seem to shift in the light, so the color is difficult to pin down, but he always has a smile on his face, as if he knows a secret no one else could ever guess.

Name: Vanille Kuylenberg
Known History:
Although Vanille was an adventurer in her younger years, she retired at 19 due to a severe injury. She settled down in Dryholde, where she would eventually marry her husband Arthur and have a son, Donovan. Arthur made his living as a monster hunter, and Vanille found fulfillment in turning the spoils of his hunts into incredible home cooking. Life had its struggles, but the family found their way together.

That all changed a year ago, when a monster attack beset the village of Dryholde. In the chaos, Vanille was separated from Arthur and the then 13-year-old Donovan, and she was knocked unconscious. When she came to the following morning, she found no trace of her family. Since then, she's trained her body and her techniques to once again take up adventuring.

Now, Vanille has found her son - under the name Marcelo Brightshield, the young king, a pawn for the Merchant with no memory of his mother. She will do whatever it takes to see him safe, and get revenge on those who hurt him.
Physical Description: Vanille is a somewhat petite woman, who would only be about 5'2" if she could stand. She has no use of her legs and so is always found in a wheelchair, either a ruggedized one for adventuring or a more basic one for more domestic affairs. Despite her disability, however, she maintains a strong physique, displaying lean muscles in her arms and upper body, though these are usually covered by her modest clothing.

Name: Ven & Vid
Known History:
Cogitav was once a powerful demon. With its particular mastery over void qi, separating its victims' souls from their bodies, it terrorized the populace.
It never anticipated the advent of the Empty Monks - particularly one by the name of Ergo Nonsum.

After long duel, Cogitav finally landed the killing blow - but only as its opponent landed their own.
With Ergo able to turn Cogivatv's soul-rending against it, both of their souls got separated from both their bodies.
The maelstrom of shattered souls and bodies eventually settled down into a humanoid figure with an amalgam of souls combined into this gestalt of something entirely new, containing fragmented memories and traits of their components.

This gestalt soul wanders the land, trying to understand other creatures, their Qi, and how they all intertwine.
True to their origins, they excel at draining life energy and turning others' strengths against them - though they can infuse others with excess energy if necessary as well.
Physical Description:
Ven is 6'0", weighing 136 lbs. They seem to be frequently tired, though they frequently look around to gauge their surroundings.

Vid is a small, dark sphere with a single yellow light in the center. It seldom leaves Ven's side, floating around them and acting as their form of speech.

Name: Verdugo
Identity: Duelist of instinct and the wind
Known History: A known Duelist from Lhodos with an unusual connection with the elements that he seems to keep hidden seemingly out of habit. mostly relying on instinct and melee weaponry paired with his passive observation and spacey expression he is often underestimated by his challengers. He prefers to be on the side of justice and often refrains from engaging enemies unless they are caught red handed breaking the law or if said enemy attempts the first attack and he must stand his ground
Physical Description: 5' 10" with a split aesthetic the white and gold representing the "good" side of justice such as returning stolen good or zennit to their original owner or breaking up a bar fight, but the red and black side to represent the "dark" side of justice such as carrying out a death sentence for a known killer, or fighting back against assassins sent after him. with more loose or comfortable clothing his movements remain unrestricted and allow "flowy" or "smooth" movements to be done easier a rapier to accompany his swift and adaptable fighting style

Name: Verge Forrester
Known History:
Verge was created as part of an experiment by Dr. Howard Forrester of Parabellum in order to assist in subduing and capturing dangerous monsters.  She developed a close relationship with her creator, however, for unknown reasons she was sold to Tubal and Cain, where she was abused and used for weapons testing.  After a full year she escaped, slaughtering her way through the corporate lab until she was chosen by the Worldhelm.  Verge seeks to find Dr. Forrester for answers on why she was betrayed, and if she so decides, revenge.

After a mission from the Worldhelm, Verge confronted Forrester and made peace with him before his death.  She returned with two sisters:  the Doctor's birth daughter and another living weapon created off his research.  She also gained an understanding that she had friends among the Goldhearted and didn't have to be so alone.
Physical Description: Verge is a tall, dark-haired humanoid with pale skin and red eyes.  Her limbs and a portion of her face and torso are covered in dark purple scales.  Her hands and feet end in sharp black claws.  Her most obvious feature is a massive second set of limbs that grow from her back which she can morph into different appendages.  She wears a sleeveless bodysuit under a black trenchcoat.  Verge has a calm and unintentionally menacing demeanor.  She is poorly socialized and can come across as cold.

Name: Vespa
Identity: Scholar of the Past on a Mission of Altruistic Discovery
Known History: An orphan she grew up on the streets of Windhaven her quick wit and keen eyes kept her out of trouble and once she found Brody he kept her safe. Once she was old enough she found work on expeditions until she could fund her own spending her time exploring ruins. When it came time to fight in the rebellion she did not hesitate, and seeks to discover new ways of helping anyone she can to this day.
Physical Description:
Hair: Curly Brown
Eyes: Blue
Skin: Freckled & Sunkissed
Height: 5'7"

A woman of average build usually sporting a collared shirt and bracers attached to well worn pants tucked into boots. 

She is never without her loyal hound Brody ever at her side.

Name: Vik (Vicorious) Aracar
Known History:
Vik devoted his life to being a helper. He worked as a tattoo artist, community worker, and occasionally even a hunter against Draugr in Aldistir. He fell behind in his hunting career as his merchant life developed, so to aid him in his adventures Vik was gifted a magical crossbow from his father. This crossbow was stolen from a mage, and one day Vik came back to see his father brutally murdered. It was a spontaneous discovery that shocked Vik so much that he packed what little of his things he had and left camp to clear his head. He ultimately couldn't find his way home and starved in the cold.

Vik awoke on a ship he didn't think he belonged in. People were kind where he was harsh, accepting while he was judgmental, and so skillful where he only had a few items. Since his adventures on the Worldhelm Vik has learned that his disliking to non-Alds was misplaced, and tries to build others up like they have helped him.
Physical Description: Vik has a medium build but broader frame at 6'2 (short for an Ald) and has slightly messy long white hair. They generally travel light with a flowy outfit to show off their multitude of tattoos spanning his body. His smile is usually noticeably small but his eyes are approving, offering his support with a stern face. This merchant sports a heavy crossbow across their back with faint orange runes carved into it and always walks with the sound of clinking potions in their bag.

Name: Vio Mortenkaisen
Known History: Vigo grew up in Brightshield, as a member of a small aristocratic house focused on the way of the blade. From a young age, she was trained with all manner of weapons and tactics, from swords to blunt weapons, and all sorts of combat strategies. Upon reaching her 21st birthday, as was custom for her house, she set out to make a name for herself, and would only return to claim the family name after doing so. She took the name Mortenkaisen, and now seeks to improve her skills out within the world.
Physical Description: Vigo is 5'10", with black hair and blue eyes. She has a slim frame, but that misleads from the years of built muscle. Often times she can be found wearing her military uniform (as pictured in her art), and carrying her sword.

Name: Viola Zabala
Known History:
Born into the lesser nobility family Zabala within Nezmira's rigid hierarchy, Viola led a charmed and privileged life. She was a bright, cheerful, and obedient child, embodying the ideal daughter, never giving her parents reason for disappointment or tears. If she ever made a misstep, she’d quickly confess, seeking absolution with an innocence that only won her more favor. 

This honesty, combined with her privileged upbringing, afforded her a quality of life beyond the reach of most outside Nezzim. Her parents, known for their generosity, even showed kindness to their slaves. A rare quality that led to their reputation as the "belles of the ball" as it were. Their halls had no room for talk of rebellion or animosity; all was safe, serene, and far removed from danger. 

That was, until the fires of rebellion began to rage across Nezmira. Viola may be unprepared for the cost of what lies ahead, but she’s determined to help restore the harmony she once knew.
Physical Description: Standing at 5'10" with a slender, serpentine frame, she has a body adorned with smooth white and peach-colored scales, accented by aquamarine markings along her ribs and tail. Her eyes are a striking rose-red, and she typically wears light armor in shades of white and gold, leaving her midriff exposed for a balanced blend of elegance and agility.

Name: Violet
Known History:
- Carmelita Aneta, codenamed Violet, was adopted by elite assassins after her parents' death and raised by a brutal mentor named Yori.

- Trained to suppress her emotions and become a ruthless killer, Violet harbored resentment toward her mentor.

- She seized the opportunity to betray Yori when a - group of Vignettes was tasked with eliminating her, killing Yori with a single shot.

- Violet was taken in by another Vignette member, who taught her hacking skills in addition to her combat training.

- After connecting with 100G officers, she became a Vignette assassin, eventually rising to become the right-hand woman of a 100G higher-up.

- As per recent events she's fully gone through a Full Makeover! Changing herself via Body Modifications. She now looks more distinguished. Now sporting a more beautiful outfit with a white coat representing her position in 100G. However remnants of her previous style still stand as her purple tips on her hair have now become the color under her hair!
Physical Description:
Violet/Carmelita stands at 5'7", with striking white hair colored with purple on the inside. She wears a sleek white coat over her whitish blue top sporting a more fanciful outfit and somewhat buisness like outfit. Fit for a chieftain of 100G.

Always ready for action, Violet carries two pistols holstered at her sides. Her stylish appearance blends cold professionalism with deadly efficiency.

Name: Viridian „Song“ Leafsong
Known History:
Viridian always possessed a gift for transformation—turning one thing into another and crafting beauty as he saw it. So when his corner of the Faerie realm found a connection to a location near Tradefair, it felt natural to establish „The Verdant Thread & Vial“. The shop became a haven where travelers could rest, drink, and smoke while browsing his alchemical creations and finely tailored garments. It was also an effortless way to collect names, thanks, and apologies.

Perhaps it was too easy. Over time, Viridian grew careless. One fateful day, his recklessness cost him dearly: a powerful fey stole his true name. Ensnared by an enchantment, he was left unaware of who had taken it, and even worse, he was rendered incapable of speaking his full name. Now, he goes by the fragments "Song" or "Green" and devotes himself to the quest of reclaiming what was stolen.
Physical Description: On first glance the 6 feet tall Viridian could easily be mistaken for your average layed back human rocking a hippy vibe but the closer you look at him the clearer you can see hints of his fae nature. His long green hair that is braided in some parts turns into plant fibers on some parts, his iconic clothing has slightly moving patterns and his hookah often by his sides changes the color of the smoke coming out.

Name: Vista Wynn
Known History:
Vista took up the role of croupier in one of Tradefair's more seedy gambling dens, in the hopes of fleecing some hotshot, big-name, more-money-than-sense merchants out of their zenit. It's not like they were using it, after all!

After some time, though, she realized that the more frequent customers were those who were already down on their luck, those in deep debt, who had already exhausted most means of recovery and were resorting to the riskier options - shady jobs, gambling, crime.

Vista was already able to bend her own luck when the time called for it. She couldn't change others', not like that. Not the way they needed it.

And when opportunity knocks, she flung the door open. Aboard the Worldhelm, all she wants is to make a decent living. Not necessarily an *honest* one, mind you - old habits die hard - but an above-board one.
Physical Description:
Vista is 5'3", weighing 159 lbs. She is always dressed smartly, though her outfit is loose enough to move about comfortably, and so she can have cards up her sleeves - both literal and figurative.
When the chips are down, she has her lucky dealer's visor, which might be a bit more special than just some purple-tinted eye cover...

Art from [very_ito on Twitter](https://twitter.com/very_ito/status/1404052790582792199), edited by Sawzie

Name: Vivian Ashblanc
Known History: Born to the Ashblancs in Dryholde, Vivian lived her life happily betrothed to Ronan Ashwynd. Hunters of the night, trained, tempered, ready to fight alongside the Ashwynds against the monsters that would bring ruin to the pockets of humanity across Kor'tarion. All that was changed when Ronan was cast out, Vivian nearly killed by a Moonshard monster as she pursued him, and left infused with ice magic as she was taken home. Sent to Hudal academy to deal with this new curse, she went for years, only for her life to be upended once again at the blood moon. Surviving and fighting off demons, she returned home- only to find Dryholde shattered, house empty, and her family missing.
Physical Description: Vivian stands at a shorter height of 5'6", a lean figure draped in lightweight hunting gear of mixed leather and cloth with a black mantle edged with black feathers over her shoulders. A feather pendant rests perpetually over her chest, tied with old leather. Pigment seems to be lost in a patch on the right side of her face and on other parts of her body, turning her right eye a smoky grey and interspersing her hair with locks of white with patches of skin a pallid white. Her unaffected eye is an inky black, and her hair is dark brown.

Name: Vuk Yekno
Known History: Born in The Scalefire Empire never knowing his mother or father, Vuk has lived his life seeking friends and family. Only thing he knows about his parents is one of them most have been an elemental. His dark red hue scales that always seem to be admitting heat from his body that burns red hot when near any fire source or when overexcited. With people seeing his,  he was seen as an asset for harsh environments that other's may not be able to deal with. With the harsh life that comes with  living/going outside the Empire walls Vuk has had to train and be as tough as possible. At a young age Vuk joined up  with guards, soldiers and mercenaries to gain experience in combat and working as a unit to protect the people he calls family.  With his training he has vowed to protect and see to it that young kids have a bright and happy future. Vuk wants to see kids  have a better childhood than he had going to great lengths seeing to it. Vuk travels the world helping who he can.
Physical Description: Vuk comes in at an immense 7ft 4in, weighing 457 pounds with a dark red hue coming off  his dark green scales and white underbelly. His bright red eyes that that seem to have a fire  burning in them have people avoiding eye contact. People take one look at Vuk and see a massive,  scary and intimidating fellow. Anytime he opens his mouth to talk or eat you can see a small white cloud of smoke leave his mouth. His temper sometimes gets the better of him as he is  impatient and makes snappy judgments. You will never see Vuk without a cigar, even well sleeping.

Name: Wanderer
Identity: Wandering Paladin who believes in Good
Known History: Not alot is known about Wanderer's history, all people know is that he was there on the Night of the Red sky, presumably helping escapee's, he's been wandering ever since and keeps a Paladin book as well as a note book to keep journal entries
Physical Description: a 6'4 strongly built 18 year old man with a combat tunic with plates on it, as well as a basic bronze sword with a beautiful runic shield

Name: Waylen Karson, AKA "Millenium"
Identity: Masked Hero with a Heart of Gold
Known History:
Growing up in North Rock, Waylen never knew his mother, who had died when he was very young. His father did his best to take care of him. Through school and his starting job at a tech startup, Waylen's father was always there for him. But it wouldn't last. One day, his father went missing, and he took it upon himself to investigate.

He never found his father. But in the process, he found out about everything his father had done for him and his mother. The medical bills, the unpaid loans. None of it was good. And all of it pointed to a part of society in Terra that sickened Waylen. The corps would never truly help. And when they don't, many go to the gangs. And all that does is drag people further down. So, once again, he took it upon himself to set things right. He took the prototype device the startup was working on, a device to produce a suit of tech armor with enhanced abilities. He quit, and took up his mantle of Millenium, protector of the people, a masked hero
Physical Description:
Dark skin, black hair, golden eyes, and angular features, Waylen's looks apparently take after his mother. Standing at 6'1", athletic, and about 55kg, he physically takes after his father. Clothes tend to fit him well, if a little loose, though they never hang off of his frame. He tends to wear casual clothes, but he has some fancier outfits if he needs them.

With his Driver activated, Millenium wears a suit of purple tech-armor over black and dark blue synth-fabric, and a helm with wolf-ish angles and fiery electronics. The Driver itself has three coin slots, arranged diagonally from his right side down to his left.

Name: Web
Known History: Though she was born in the Winter Court of Kor'Tarion's Fae Realm, and subsequently left before coming aboard the Worldhelm, Web has yet to speak openly about how this came about.
Physical Description:
A lithely built elf of average height, Web is often seen with a disinterest gaze on her face. Her violet eyes are often hidden under a snow white fringe, the rest of her long hair kept in a long single braid that reaches down to her waist. 

Most of the time she can be seen wearing dark clothes, favouring blacks and dark purples or blues. While she wears different styles, she generally favours looser clothing, and universally abhors sleeves.

Name: Wen Tian
Known History: There's not much to say about Wen Tian. He grew up poor on the fringes of Xiaohai, got lucky and learned from a master, and now he's on his way up in the world! Or, so he says at least...
Physical Description: Wen Tian is a young man of average stature, standing at around 5'9'', with medium-ish length blue hair and a slightly tanned skin.

Name: Whispers
Known History: As rumors around lastport say. 'Whispers ring out in times of uncertainty, like an old friend. Listen to the voices and it'll all come true.'
Physical Description: Varies per account, with a constant of eyes veiled in one way or another, flowy clothing and  a broken mirror held in hand.

Name: Wilhelm Bergmann
Known History:
A mining foreman who was born and raised in Constance, Wilhelm Bergmann has had a long career on the slopes of the Iron Mountains. His childhood was unremarkable, and he went to work in the mines as soon as he was of working age. 

A hard worker with a notable affinity for engineering, often repairing mining equipment out in the field, he even rescued a fellow miner from a natural gas explosion despite being burned himself.

Promoted to the role of foreman, the mine under Wilhelm's supervision was targeted by Merrani saboteurs seeking to disrupt Constance's resources. The mine's distance from the city led to longer response times from the KPLA, and a Merrani mech managed to enter the mines. To protect his workers, Wilhelm lured the mech into an isolated passage before causing a cave-in, sealing them both.

Unwilling to die, Wilhelm salvaged the mech and an industrial mining rig, crafting his own mech, the Killborer. Burrowing to the surface, Wilhelm vowed to enact vengeance on Merrane.
Physical Description:
An older man with a mean expression and a large mustache. His face and upper body are marred with burn scars. 

His attire is that of a common worker from Karlsgard and his equipment consists of a rugged revolver and an unusually intricate mining drill.

Name: Winter
Known History: A bandit from the High Pass in Aldistir, a part of the Wisp Winds, Winter has committed many crimes in the interest of survival. Her bandit clan are dangerous and unforgiving, taking lives quickly with no remorse. Winter, however, grew to hate this. Having her humanity showing through and finally committed to leaving late during the night at the height of winter, hoping for some method of reprieve or to prove she was more than her past. This has lead her to the Worldhelm, and she sees this as a chance to earn her attonement for the many crimes committed.
Physical Description: A 5'6" tall minotaur with fluffy legs and a cow's tail in a reddish brown matching her hair. Has large horns and a muscular build.

Name: Wyrt
Known History: The likeness of this man has perhaps been seen in drawings along wanted posters, labeled criminal as one who assaulted lizardmen of The Bluescale Empire. He's moved to avoid such attention, favoring to do tasks of varying difficulty, from fighting to kitten saving. The only payment Wyrt asks is a few questions.. and money, I mean you need that to get around.
Origin: The Blue Scale Empire, The Realm of Nezmira
Physical Description: Wyrt stands around 5 foot 8 inches, maybe 5 foot 6 and a half if you don't count the hat. Sized up at 186 pounds, the heavy clothes and wide brim hat obscure his features sans the eyes, which do carry a small light with them. His physical expressions are exaggerated to help make up the lace of facial tells.

Name: Xentrithia Mira Dregravor
Age:
physical age seems to be around 35
she forgot her actual birthday
Known History: Ex soldier that had been cut off from her expedition party having been forced to survive in the woods as a monster herself for an unsure amount of time. Others of her squad think she is KIA.
Physical Description: Definetly on the larger side with a size of 2 meters something, she is also on the heavier side not just because her height but the mutations her corruption she suffered which mainly also affected her height having tried to transform her into a large predator of the woods but having failed.

Name: Xing Wei
Identity: Hero Who Has Mastered His Rage
Known History: At a young age, Xing Wei and his family were shunned from their village because of his powerful connection to demonic qi, afraid he would one day develop into a corrupt cultivator. But that never happened. All it did was alienate them, and prevent anyone from helping when his parents were killed in their home by a vengeful tengu. That was the first bit of real demonic qi he cultivated, and it is when he swore vengeance against all yokai and the cultivators that allow them to exist. He began to scavenge battlefields to cultivate, careful to avoid falling prey to the ease of corrupt cultivation. Slowly, he builds his power to fight against the yokai and the corrupted cultivators, and to protect the lost and the weak. However, even after all this time, he is still haunted by the shame and powerlessness he felt that first night.
Origin: Yotsuya Village, Stained Forests, Teisei, Tian Yin
Physical Description: 5'10", powerful, and a little intimidating with his facial scars, and demon-aesthetic arms and armor, though some of his muscles are partially hidden beneath the yellows, greys, and browns of his second-hand robes. He has olive green eyes and long, dark hair he ties up, but a decent amount still falls in his eyes. Recent events have taught him mastery of the rage within him.

Name: Yarrow Cheung
Known History:
Over years and decades, Yarrow Cheung built up a reputation as a reliable officer, bodyguard, mercenary, and employee in 100G. She put her heart and soul into her work, patrolling the city and guarding the powerful, whatever the cost. She built up her fair share of collateral damage along the way. But for so long, she tried to justify the blood on her hands by telling herself it was all in the name of protecting the people and preserving order. And besides: it was either keep doing this or risk poverty and destitution once more. 
Then, in a confrontation, she was seriously injured. Near death and unable to do her job, she found herself having to ponder the consequences of everything she’s done over the years.
She wants to do better. She has to do better. There’s got to be more to her life than being a hired gun until the next shot doesn’t miss.
Physical Description: A muscular, lean woman with a bleached-blonde buzz cut, tan skin, and narrow, dark blue eyes. Standing at about 5'10, her most defining feature is a series of burn scars that occupy most of the upper right side of her body. She typically wears casual attire, with compartments, belts, and pockets attached for anything she needs to bring with her at a moment's notice. The two things she consistently wears are the jacket she's had since she was a teenager and a sword  on her waist, always readied for combat.

Name: Yin Yue
Known History:
Raised in the **Jade Bloom Pavilion** of **Xuanwu City**, Yin Yue grew up in a sanctuary of music and culture, guided by her renowned mother, **Yin Mei**, who taught her to cultivate through song rather than rigid forms. As a Bishi’e, she possessed an innate talent for harmonizing with the Dao, shaping the elements and fortifying herself through melody. 

Though sheltered within the Pavilion’s **Heavenly Blossom Theatre**, she could not ignore the corruption that tainted the city, where powerful sects practiced ruthless cultivation and mortals toiled in the blood mines. Yearning to restore harmony while forging her own legend, Yin Yue set out beyond her homeland, her voice not only a weapon but a promise. To bring balance back to a fractured world and leave behind a song that would be remembered for generations.
Origin: Xuanwu City, Wujing Guo, Tian Yin
Physical Description: A woman with sun-kissed skin, her gaze is captivating. Light green horns emerge gracefully from her forehead, while two larger horns curve just past her temples. Her dark teal hair cascades around her, complementing the flowing attire of a traveling performer. Yet, it’s her eyes that demand attention. Expressive, enchanting, and filled with the allure of someone who knows the world is her stage.

Name: Yorick Medraut
Known History: The Pale Maelstrom. A title known to those who frequent the human populated slums of Skuala, the largest coastal city in Nezmira, and the regions melting pot. A white haired man in colorful clothing who uses a children's toy made from the shells of Kiir to protect the people of the city. He's a bit of a vigilante, relishing in those both knowing his name, and singing his praise. He's well known for being a show off, and making a point to let his cutting words take the stage as much as his fighting ability.
Physical Description: Yorick is a 6'4'' well built man, who wears simple gear and baggy pants. He's about 200 pounds, and is rarely seen without his bandalore.

Name: Yorik Unfrid
Known History: A worshipper of Vanagandr alongside his sister, Astrid, Yorik started life as a hunter. Channelling his ferocity and hatred into his hunts to cleave beast and yokai in twain and claim his bounty in response. One day, he was challenged to kill a powerful Oni at the top of the twin peaks, a worshiper of Nimue named Yosuke. The two met and fought for days and nights until the mighty Yosuke fell under Yorik's blade. Yorik claimed his sword and his heart as treasure, but was overwhelmed with a vision. Nimue, having lost a good warrior, bestowed a vision onto Yorik. The vision was of death, destruction, despair... But also of hope, and a golden airship. It was up to Yorik to decide what he would do, but in his heart he had already made up his mind. He would atone, and bring peace to Aldistir. And once he was done, all the realms.
Physical Description: 6'5 wall of muscle with gorgeous long blonde hair. He often wears furs and leathers of slain beasts, the most striking being one of a large bear-like beast. His skin is littered with tattoos

Name: Yoyoy
Identity: A Broken Man Retracing his Steps
Known History:
Until recently, Yoyoy's story was an ordinary one. Raised under the tutelage of a reputable teacher, he spent decades training until he had disciples of his own. Taking up residence in the mountains south of the Tikba rainforest, Yoyoy spent several more decades cultivating while guiding any who sought his wisdom.

Yoyoy's path eventually took a sharp turn as his residence was set ablaze by a sect of Defilers who took advantage of the chaos to capture Yoyoy and his disciples. The intense flames and the panic that beset Yoyoy triggered Qi deviation, rendering him powerless to aid his disciples as they were taken into Land of the Defiled to be used as sacrifices.

As they were dragged through the desolate sands of the Land of the Defiled, Yoyoy's disciples sacrificed themselves to create a window of opportunity for their master to escape. He fled, walking through the lifeless desert for days until his body failed. He collapsed, stricken with hunger and shame as the Worldhelm claimed him.
Physical Description:
Standing at 5'6", Yoyoy's body is emaciated and his skin has an almost rotten pallor as his own poisonous Qi runs amok due to deviation. Less than a dozen hairs cling desperately to his scalp, and his facial features are sunken in. His eyes are clouded with a red haze that glows dimly.

His belongings are limited to a well-worn robe and a thick rope belt, as well as a wooden staff which doubles as a walking stick.

Name: Yui Kiddo
Known History:
Before she was even in middle school Yui was already in deep shit. Her deadbeat dad would sometimes send money home but she never saw him. She was instead raised by her mother who always had a tough time with the law. But that relationship ended when Yui's mom was framed for murder by a corrupt private security group in order to save a high ranking CEO. Being the daughter of a convicted felon doesn't really bring in a lot of social credit.

From there, Yui has only had one purpose in life, sticking it to the corporate overlords in any way that she could. At first it was self serving; anger and violence, lashing out at those in power. But eventually Yui started standing up for those victimized by the system. She became known as a tough private investigator who would help anyone down on their luck, be they man or monster; so much so that Saki started to become something of a heroic but flawed figure to marginalized groups.
Physical Description:
Yui has done everything she can to get away from being perceived as cute. Primarily this consists of body mods to make her teeth sharp with tusks that jut from the lower jaw, horns on her head, and red skin to make her look more a monster than a human. However she also carries herself with a tough no nonsense sort of attitude, standing at an impressive 6'1" and  giving off a cool defiance to anyone who deals with her. She keeps her hair chopped short and dyed in an androgynous way.  

Even through all the toughness she still likes to appear somewhat feminine, she prefers dresses, and can often be seen wearing feminine accessories. Though she draws attention away from them with tougher looking clothing like, belts, chains, and leather. Despite the façade, she can't always hide her gentler side, she sometimes lights up when she sees something she finds cute, though these moments are brief.

Name: Yukari (縁)
Known History:
Young, freedom-loving, and irreverent, Yukari was raised from a kit to protect her village's shrine from the Alds that roamed the forest. However, when she met one such raider-- a young lad named Jesper, wounded and lost-- she did not slay him on the spot. Instead, they would meet again and again over the next few moons, growing ever closer.

One day, she took him to the village in secret, to show him her favorite spot overlooking the shrine. The next, raiders were at their doorstep, Jesper among their number. There was pain in his expression. There was more of it in Yukari's heart.

The raiders were defeated, at great cost. Jesper fled. And Yukari, for her treason, was exiled, to wander the snowfields alone.

Two years later, believing in the Sunfire Citadel's promise of peace was a convenient lie to get a roof over her head. At least that's what she told herself. But when Ragnarok came, and she had the chance to flee... She didn't. And something in her heart changed that day.
Physical Description: Standing a humble foot from paw to shoulder, Yukari is a white-furred arctic fox with blue-gray accents in her coat, adorned with a blue and violet shawl and an assortment of paper charms. Her eyes are a piercing magenta, and she bears an ever-present smirk that gives the air of someone who knows something you don't.

Name: Yuki-Na
Known History:
Yuki-Na, like most yokai, grew up a follower of Kuzunoha; an impersonal bond to the "mother" of yokai at best. Blessed with deep ties to the land around her, she lived a peaceful (for Aldistir) life of relative seclusion within the Farwood.
Such peace was broken some 60-70 years ago, when the darkened sky alit with fire and acrid smoke. A band of Alds, intent to push back against the local yokai in the name of Vanagandr, invaded the forest. Cornered between flashing steel and walls of flame, Yuki-Na found herself suddenly among the Sea of Blizzards. It was Lorelei, not Kuzunoha, who came to her aid in time of need, the aesir revealing herself to Yuki-Na.
From that point, her allegiances changed, and a goal was obtained; she would be a guide through the blistering snow of that other world, to lead others who wish for no part in the endless feud between Kuzunoha and Vanagandr.
Physical Description:
Standing at 7’3” to the top of her head, and upwards of 9’ with her ‘horns’, Yuki-Na cuts an imposing figure. 
Somewhat fox-like in appearance, by day her soft white fur flows across her pelt like snowdrifts and down to a long but flat, fluffy tail, while at night, the fur shifts to an onyx black. 
From her head sprouts horn-like tree branches, their appearance shifting with her mood and goals: at times, the branches spring with eternally falling cherry blossoms, while at others, they alight with a ghostly blue fire.

Name: Yuna "Mongrel" Manami
Known History: "Mongrel" has a past covered in black ink. She is a temp worker for E.T.A, that is where most knowledge of her existence ends. She's miles deep in debt and clearly holds no loyalty to the company besides the leash they have her on.  If someone was truly curious they could perhaps dig up her familiarity to a rookie swordsman "Sparrow" who was wiped out with her team a long time ago. But, that is only the things E.T.A couldn't have completely eradicated from the database.
Physical Description: Yuna is a average 5'5 woman with white hair. Her piercing red eyes are analytical and fierce. Hiding most of her feelings behind a stoic visage. Though this is not to say she is afraid of voicing them to most people. Yuna regularly wears robes passed down from her family, she rarely speaks about the significance of them as she has yet to speak to them since her incident.

Name: Yunalesca
Known History: Little is known for now, Yuna is still new to the Worldhelm, she says she comes from a place called Paradise and yet she appeared suddenly before a group of adventures in the depths of hell...
Physical Description: Yuna is a young woman of average height with a lithe, athletic build, suggesting agility and quickness over brute strength. Her complexion is fair, with a healthy, slightly rosy undertone that complements her warm features. Her light auburn hair cascades just past her shoulders in soft waves, framing her face elegantly. Her large, almond-shaped eyes are a captivating shade of soft pink, exuding both warmth and a mischievous glint. She strikes a balance between grace and strength, making her presence both approachable and commanding, as if she’s equally at home in a noble gathering or the shadowy depths of hell itself.

Name: Yuri Sokolov
Known History: Merrani war hounds are given experimental tech at a young age and trained to kill people. Normally, they don't get to see who they kill up close. The magitech war machines and guns allow for that degree of dehumanization. Yuri Sokolov was one such soldier. However, during a sniper duel, he had the misfortune of meeting his target up close, and seeing that it was another boy like him broke Yuri's mind. After deserting the army, Yuri found himself wandering Lhodos, until a Realmstorm brought him to the Worldhelm.
Physical Description: Yuri Sokolov is tall, sports a lithe frame with short brown hair and brown eyes. He has a state of the art combat attire, and an experimental bow. His demeanor is distant, he clearly has trouble making friends.

Name: Yuruzu "The Cobalt Scar" Eiji
Known History: Yuzuru is one of 100gs newer temp workers, physically able and magically gifted in using that edge to aid him in battle. Despite his rough and ferocious appearance, many compliment his professionalism and respect for others. Not the most open about his past or life, many know he works as hard as he does for his immediate family. Ensuring jobs go well to help pay for his younger siblings schooling, along with paying off his parents debt and ensuring his father lives a well off life despite now being an Insolvent. Many speak of rumors surrounding "The Cobalt Scar", speaking that he's been augmented with illegal body mods. The only truth to these statements are his current canine form, along with both mental and emotional changes in his personality when under copious stress during missions. And finally, his abilities in fueling his martial prowess with magic & Esper abilities through his blade. The other rumor revolves around the man desiring to become a legendary temp, none know why.
Physical Description: A broad and heavy body individual, a physique showing some time both honing oneself along with his fair share of fights. Standing well over 6 foot, despite his wolf like appearance he looks put together and profesional. Dressed usually in a white overcoat that resembles a modernized Hakama. His weapon of choice an augmented blade with multiple hilts that resemble Tengu masks. His two most striking features are his sharp eye, the other covered with an eyepatch. The color of them ranging from a piercing turquoise to an even sharper red. The second are his wolf augments throughout his body.

Name: Zaid al Thuaban'n
Known History: A roamer of the sand dunes of Nezmira. Suspected ties to the revolutionaries in The Blue City.
Physical Description:
Zaid is a white-haired, dark-skinned human in his mid-twenties. Around 6ft tall and lean. He has long white hair and wears distinctly Nezmiran clothing, under which he hides the religious tattoos of his family; golden scales on his arm, and a golden winged serpent above his covered eye. 
He manifests aspects of the serpent Falak-khan through bodily transformation, symbols and prayers.

Name: Zamitra
Known History: use to work like a soldier to protect Skamos from external threats, but living as a human in Skamos is hard.  One day some travellers saw him and wanted him to put his swordsmanship to beater use and even teach out what he had learned to others. He follow the travellers through a storm and ended up in a place called Worldhelm
Physical Description: a very tall man 215cm/7,0 feet tall  and weighing 80 kg/ 176 pounds. He is clad in armor made from bugs material and  a sword taller than him. He has red eyes dark hair.

Name: Zecht
Known History:
A man born behind the walls of Bastion in Karlite lands. After years of hearing stories the reckless conquest of Marrane, he decided to join the military to keep his family and friends safe. After a deadly skirmish in one of the border villages, Zecht lost a leg and an eye but earned a magitech gunsword that belonged to the equivalent of a Captain in the Royal Merrani Army. He was promoted to the rank of Warden soon after and his prospects looked promising, though the struggle of both the collossi and the Merrane conquest still troubled him. However, with his prosthetics and new experience under his belt he set out to bring hope in these dark times.
It seems the Worldhelm thought the same when a Realmstorm appeared and whisked him atop the dimensional ship....
Physical Description: A man of a slightly muscular build with silver hair, standing at 6ft 2 inches. He wears vaguely eastern clothing while sporting a single prosthetic leg and an eye patch.

Name: Zexis
Known History: Zexis arrived on the Worldhelm due to very chaotic circumstances; according to him, shortly after his eyes opened, the world around him broke - shattered, like glass. He felt as though he was drifting in a void before the color returned and he was not where he was before. One could assume this was the result of a Realmstorm.
Physical Description: Taller than most Nezzim, Zexis stands at six feet and nine inches tall. With a bulk to match his broad shoulders, one could say Zexis might be a bodybuilder at first, suggesting he has a routine of rigorous exercise. His body is covered in pearlescent-white scales with horns to match. Dark markings frame his shimmering teal eyes, bringing to mind a likeness of eyeshadow.

Name: Zhao Tao
Known History: Grew up in Leytik training as an Empty Monk. After seeing and doing horrible things, turns a new leaf in his old age, using his shapeshifting capabilities to try and do some real good in the world before his past catches up to him.
Physical Description: Short and bald, covers most of his scarred body in martial arts garments.

Name: Zid Galloway
Known History:
Born Human in the Nezmira empire, Zid spent a long portion of his life working hard labour, and had sought any means possible to escape the drab life he lived and go anywhere he pleased, without threat of punishment or being torn apart by the Kirr. So, he spent his nights working on a new invention, a magical device he would keep secret before leaving the small village. He dubbed it, 'Argonaut,' or Argie. And set off.

With his Magicannon, he began roaming the sands to explore and seek out new and exciting places to explore. Often taking detours to hide from those who wished to brand him a mage under the Blue Dragon Decree or saving wandering caravans from Kiir attacks. All the while crafting all the magical tech he could think up.
Physical Description: 6'2, Scrawny, Dark skin and pink hair. His figure is very lanky and also pencil thin, his hands are calloused but his skin is near perfect with only a few blemishes here and there. He always wears a smile on his face

Name: Zmeika
Known History: Not a lot is publicly known about her currently other then she is kind of funny and like to eat anything she can get her hands on.
Physical Description: Zmeika is a short large dragon horned girl. She has a long thick draconic tail as well, both are tinged with blue magic affuence at the tip of her left horn and tail. She has winged draconic ears and long silvery grey hair with crimson red lizard-like eyes. As well as a collar of scales around her upper chest. Her lower legs are also changed in a draconic nature scaled and clawed instead of normal human feet.

Name: Zophiel
Known History:
Zophiel was raised in Dryholde by her father, an alchemist of some repute. Her mother wasn't in the picture, though from what father told her, she was a generous research patron. 

Her father was a soft-spoken, thoughtful man, but prone to being taken advantage of, which led the willful Zophiel to often argue on his behalf.

She continued as his assistant for her formative years, until the Night of the Red Sky, the worst day of her life. She remembers her father burning in alchemist's fire. His voice telling her to run. She remembers crawling from the overturned wagon, and... that's it.

When she arrived in Brightshield, she had a fiery hand on her shoulder and an uncertain look in her eyes. When the Crusaders began recruiting to fight the demons, she joined them.
Physical Description:
A crusader from Brightshield with stark white hair. She stands at just over 5'5, with a trained, military posture, though her smile cuts through the severity. 

On her right shoulder rests a hand formed of magical fire that does not burn. It shares the same material as her form-shifting weapon, the legacy of her father.

She has small scar under her bangs where she once once burned by demonfire, but the other wounds have since healed.

Name: Zora
Known History:
Zora was created as a weapon by the T&C company. She was tested on to find her limits until she eventually lashed out and escaped as a young teenager. Zora found herself on the streets for two years until she discovered the Vignettes and set ehr sights on proving herself. Zora built a name for herself under the alias "Lady Z" and moved to live alone in South Rock to spoil herself for the next few years..

That was until she found Vivian. She was a young orphan living on the streets like Zora was, and in seeing this child Zora took them in and spoiled them. For four years she lived with Vivian and the child taught her how to express herself, they even designed Zora's bike together!! Business boomed with Zora's positivity, and more business meant more money to spoil Vivian. Four years of bliss could only end in tragedy as T&C found Zora's apartment and killed Vivian. With her child dead Zora spent a year giving her money to any who opposed T&C..
Physical Description: Standing at 5'10, Zora is a tall female with pale skin. She has long purple hair that drapes to her knees to match her purple eyes (and blood if you ever see it). Zora's most defining trait is her blackened-clawed hand and leg that has a corruption seeping into her skin. It grows and shrinks the more she pushes herself but her forearm is always covered.

Name: Çuaromo Thiago Estevez Santonio
Known History:
Thiago was born to a family of Delver merchants, and grew up learning to barter for food and supplies, as well as appraising the worth of the treasures brought up by the other Delvers of their camp. It had always captivated him, the weight of ancient stones and steels, beyond even just their value in zenit.

At the age of nineteen, Thiago would venture on his first expedition underground, and there he would find his one eternal love - the Eld. The Eld, an ancient, enigmatic people, long dead, whose history and existence are only able to be pieced together by broken statues and an unspeakable script... Yes, he saw the ruins and knew exactly then that this was love.

He would delve for years, and find love with a woman of The Bazaar. For these years, he was happy - with a wife and child, a career as a professor of histories, and plenty of time to venture to the depths...

However, tragedy would strike, one expedition... Thiago would be the only survivor.
Other Names:
Çuaromo Thiago Estevez De La Santonio
Professor Santonio
Physical Description:
Çuaromo Thiago Estevez De La Santonio is an older man, standing at 6'4" with age apparent in the lines upon his face, as well as his scars.

He's rather... average, all things considered. Not overly broad or muscular, nor is he exceptionally thin. Though he wears plain clothes and a green cloak, the man does wear some golden adornments - treasures he's taken from the ruins he delves into.

Though, in moments of stress, when the depths call to him the loudest... there is another face of Thiago, rarely seen, and even rarer to be spoken of... The Coyote.

Name: ᵀʰᵉ Hegemon – Myeongjun Shin
Known History:
The boy formerly known as Myeongjun Shin grew up an isolated and quiet kid among Heartdom's mossy skyscrapers. He found comfort in scavenged electronics, but the specter of Vanagandr and the grand designs of Lilith always loomed over him. Unable to stomach the idea of staying idle, he enrolled in the academy, and threw himself into the House of Blades.

In becoming a Regal Vessel, the Hegemon has chosen to surrender himself to the convictions and judgements of both Sylvaine, his childhood friend, and Lilith herself. And now, he surrenders himself anew to the Worldhelm and Yubel. But it can't be that bad. They all probably know how to save the realms - or at minimum, they sure know a lot better than he does.
Physical Description: Myeongjun is a reedy, almost malnourished-looking boy, who has little presence despite standing at 6'2". In his weapon form, he appears as a light machine gun.

Name: 祟り蛙 (Tatarimokke)
Identity: The Anguished Tool Without a Wielder
Known History:
Tatarimokke was born in the small village of Ishiyama, raised to be a tool for his master: the Tokiyasu-Oni. He has since learned that his master's ends are cruel, and so he has fled. The Worldhelm saved him from the reprisal of his fellow masked warriors.

He is to strike down the foul and to defend the righteous. There is no nobler a duty for a blade such as him.
Physical Description:
Tatarimokke wears, at all times, a set of heavy robes and a mask meant to mimic an owl's face. These two things make it difficult to parse out all too much about his appearance, but a few things are still clear.

He stands just under six feet tall, though the boots he wears brings his height up an inch or so. His build seems an athletic one, enough to facilitate the physical feats Tatarimokke is capable of.

One other details of the owl-man are the two necklaces he wears. The first bears three small ofuda seals, while the second one holds five larger ones. They hold the symbols 恩 (meaning grace), 平和 (meaning peace), and 滅 (to destroy), which alternate in that order.
